# Gate 1

The heads—and these are the four camps of the **Divine Presence** <note>original: "Shekhinah," the indwelling feminine aspect of God</note> that are under the **Lord [Adonai]**—He is the end of all the actions of the "Unification of the Name" from above to below. This Name, called **Adonai**, is like a treasury and a hidden house for all kinds of **Divine abundance** <note>original: "Shefa," the spiritual energy that flows from the higher realms to the lower</note> and types of **emanation** <note>original: "Atzilut"</note> of all existences that are drawn forth from the **Blessed Lord [YHVH]** through all the "channels," until we find three Names aligned one against the other: <insert>A</insert> **Adonai** at the bottom; <insert>H</insert> **the Lord [YHVH]** in the middle; <insert>K</insert> **I Shall Be [Ehyeh]** at the top. From there, from **Ehyeh**, all types of emanation-abundance are emanated from the Source called the **Infinite [Ein Sof]** through the levels until they reach the **Blessed Lord [YHVH]**. From the Name **YHVH**, all the channels and extensions go to the Name **Adonai**. The Name **Adonai** is a treasury containing all the "royal protocols"; He is the **Great Sustainer** of all created beings, who feeds and provides for all through the power of **YHVH** within Him. By His word, they shall go out, and by His word, they shall come in—all those who come to cleave to the **Blessed Lord [YHVH]**. There is no way, side, or manner to cleave to the Name **YHVH** except through **Adonai**. Therefore, this Name is the storehouse of the **Unique Name** <insert>A</insert> and is the **Palace** <note>original: "Heikhal"</note> in which **YHVH** dwells. Thus, in the Torah, **YHVH** is always read with the pronunciation of **Adonai**, meaning: anyone who seeks **YHVH** will find Him within the Name **Adonai**. 

Because this is so, you must know that the **Blessed Lord [YHVH]** has **54 "squared" Names** <note>referring to permutations of the four-letter Name</note> which, when combined with **YHVH**, reach the sum of **216 letters** <note>represented by the Hebrew letters RI"V. This refers to the 72-syllable Name of God, derived from three verses in Exodus each containing 72 letters (72 x 3 = 216).</note>. These 54 Names are the secret of drawing power into all existing things in the world. He said that they stand below the side of the Palace of the Kingdom <term>Malkhut|The tenth Sefirah, representing the physical world and the Divine Presence on earth</term>; below they receive from it. During times when the Power of Judgment <term>Gevurah|The attribute of strength, restriction, and judgment</term> prevails in this world, this "Appointee" watches over it. According to the guidance received from above, that "Scribe" records for him. When the power of judgment strengthens below, she rules and plunders to the points of discovery, for this revelation is born until the lowest level and to every side. Heaven forbid—when things are repaired above, they are repaired below. Just as they are from Knowledge and Heart above, so are the forces of nature and the rod below, as it is said: *Woe to Assyria, the rod of My anger...* <note>Isaiah 10:5</note> until here are his words.

From now on, do not wonder at the great goodness and success of the wicked in this world, even if they perform general actions and use special properties in all their labors, their breads, and their waters. It is nothing, for their strength and dominion above are still extended by the awakening of the vessel they oppressed. Furthermore, they add more and more until their measure is full and the Lord looks down from above and sweeps it away. And we find in the scripture: *And we shall not cease to burn incense to the Queen of Heaven.* <note>Jeremiah 44:17</note> The word "Queen" <note>original: *Malkat*</note> is written missing a letter <note>In the Hebrew text, it is spelled without a 'vav', which the author interprets as a spiritual deficiency</note>, because they exchanged the "Carcass" <note>The impure forces</note> for the "Maidservant" and called her by the name "Matron" <note>The Divine Presence</note>. From ancient days they made for her "Cakes" (*Kavanim*) with water and flour, and they brought forth spiritual beings. This has not ceased; they still wail and nourish her with weeping and bitter mourning, surrounding the market of mourners and cutting themselves. For **Lilith** <note>The primary female demon in Jewish folklore</note> is of the night, and she walks in the darkness of the ear <unclear>ezan</unclear>, all of them beginning and living to strengthen the insolent and bitter waters that are upon her.

Indeed, the essence of their worship is like their service—their blessing shall yet dry up. In the first chapter of *Avodah Zarah* <note>A tractate of the Talmud concerning idolatry</note>, it says this: "gold-givers" <note>Refers to the golden calf or idolatrous wealth</note>. Adam was the first to experience this, before Eve was joined to him; he was with Lilith, for the "Husk" (*Kelippah*) precedes the "Fruit" in its action. For the nature of man below is to be awakened first toward evil before he awakens toward good, for *the inclination of man's heart is evil from his youth.* <note>Genesis 8:21</note> This is the meaning of "existence" (*Havayah*). This is the explanation of the Mishnah: "Before the Great King who is in the Treasury."

Regarding the secret of other matters—"fields" (*Sadeh*) and "demons" (*Shedim*) mentioned by Ecclesiastes—there was a benefit to this, for the "Maidservant" is a benefit for the markets, but not a true benefit. This language is hinted at four times in the Torah in the verse *You shall have no other gods* and against it *You shall not commit adultery.* Indeed, you will not find a "Circumcised Altar" <note>Meaning a holy sacrifice</note> mentioned in the Torah except that its cause is the "First Sin." *You shall not commit adultery* refers to the woman who plunders. Thus, the fruit of the divorce bill will grow the flowers of Israel in the desert, and He will remove the spirit of impurity from the earth. Further on in Gate 2, using a "Good Title," I have expanded on the matter of these plotting forces, and at the end of the book, I will reach the matters of the days that do not have names and their genealogies, as I have brought from the *Book of Wisdom* by Rabbi M. regarding the other "Wonders."

**A (א)**: They are found toward him in the likeness of rivers. The explanation is that she <note>Malkhut</note> is called "Sea" because she receives from all the Sefirot. Therefore, the waters of the sea are full because she also receives the "waters" that are in them. This is the secret of *All the rivers flow to the sea.* Solomon established his throne upon this, for whatever she receives, she influences the world, and he desired to receive even more flow.

**B (ב)**: *And regarding this he alluded: This sea is great and wide, where there are creeping things without number...* This is a hint that she receives all types of influence from the power above her and bestows it upon each one below according to their fitting strength—to this one much, and to that one little. This is the hint of *small creatures with great.*

**C (ג)**: *And within this sea are many ships, sailors, etc.* And how many types of waves and <unclear>sichi</unclear> that are not revealed within it, as I explained in the introduction. For everything that has a manifestation below has a root above. Just as there are ships below in the sea that carry merchandise from place to place, so there are many forces above...

And I say: *Cause Your face to shine upon Your desolate sanctuary, for the sake of the Lord [ADONAI]* <note>Daniel 9:17</note>—spelled Aleph-Dalet-Nun-Yod. For this attribute <term>Middah|A specific quality or emanation of God, in this case, the Sefirah of Malkhut</term> was what guarded Abraham and fought his wars in the secret of: *And he divided the night against them, he and his servants, and struck them* <note>Genesis 14:15</note>. Sometimes this attribute is called **Shekhinah** (Divine Presence), and she was dwelling with Israel constantly from the time the Tabernacle was made, as it says: *And they shall make for Me a sanctuary, and I will dwell [v’shakhanti] among them* <note>Exodus 25:8</note>. And you must know a great principle: Know that at the beginning of the creation of the world, the essence of the Shekhinah was primarily in the lower realms. For the arrangement of all created beings followed a ladder of levels: the upper realms corresponded to the upper, and the lower realms corresponded to the lower; therefore, the Shekhinah rested in the lower realms.

When the Shekhinah was below, heaven and earth were found to be united. This is the meaning of the phrase: *And the heavens and the earth were finished [vayakhulu], and all their host* <note>Genesis 2:1</note>—meaning they were integrated with one another and filled by one another. The conduits <term>Tzinorot|The spiritual pipes or channels that transmit divine energy from the higher Sefirot to the physical world</term> and the sources functioned in their perfection, flowing from above to below. Thus, the Blessed Name filled from top to bottom, supporting the verse: *The heaven is My throne, and the earth is My footstool* <note>Isaiah 66:1</note>. It was found that the Blessed Name dwelt in an equal balance between the upper and the lower realms.

Then Adam the First came and sinned, and the rows were corrupted, and the conduits were broken, and the <insert>pools</insert> <note>Hebrew: *breichot*, referring to the reservoirs of divine blessing</note> were cut off. However, the Shekhinah did not descend to the earth as a permanent dwelling, but only as a temporary dwelling, resting upon them. This is the secret of: *And God went up from upon Abraham* <note>Genesis 17:22</note>—meaning literally "from upon him." And regarding Jacob: *And God went up from upon him.* <note>Genesis 35:13</note> Concerning this, the Sages said: "The Patriarchs are themselves the Chariot" <term>Merkavah|A "Chariot" or vehicle that carries the Divine Presence into the world</term>. Thus, the Shekhinah in their days was hovering in the air and found no rest for the sole of her foot on the earth as she did at the start of creation.

Its ascent and its action upon created beings is a thing and its opposite. **A** Sometimes it acts for good, and sometimes for evil: to give life and to kill, to strike and to heal, to disinherit and to enrich, and other such opposites. **B** A hint to this matter is found in the verse: *See now that I, even I, am He, and there is no god with Me; I kill and I make alive; I wound and I heal* <note>Deuteronomy 32:39</note>. Regarding this, it is said: **C** *The stone the builders rejected has become the chief cornerstone* <note>Psalm 118:22</note>. For behold, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob took their portions above it in the higher Sefirot which are over it, until David came, took hold of it, and claimed it as his own attribute <note>David is traditionally associated with the Sefirah of Malkhut, which is the "throne" of the kingdom</note>. ## Gate 2

And they drew living waters from the House of Water-Drawing <note>original: "בית השואבה" — *Beit HaSho'evah*, a reference to the joyful water-libation ceremony held during the festival of Sukkot</note> and they caused the Shekhinah <term>Shekhinah|The indwelling Presence of God in the world, often described as the feminine aspect of the Divine</term> to return and dwell among those below in a tent, though not yet upon the ground as it was at the beginning of creation. The secret of this is found in the verse: *“And let them make Me a sanctuary, that I may dwell among them.”* (Exodus 25:8). Thus, the Shekhinah was like a guest moving from place to place. This is why it says *“dwell among them”* and not *“dwell below,”* signifying the likeness of a guest; meaning, in every place that Israel goes, I shall go with them and dwell among them, but not in a fixed location. This is the mystery behind the verse: *“And it came to pass, when the ark set forward...”* (Numbers 10:35).

Regarding this mystery, David was distressed and sought to establish a fixed place for the Shekhinah below. This is the secret of the verse: *“How he swore unto the Lord, and vowed unto the Mighty One of Jacob: ‘Surely I will not come into the tent of my house... until I find out a place for the Lord, a dwelling-place for the Mighty One of Jacob.’”* (Psalm 132:2-5). And it is written: *“For the Lord hath chosen Zion; He hath desired it for His habitation: ‘This is My resting-place for ever.’”* (Psalm 132:13-14). Because David sought to establish a place for the resting of the Shekhinah, saying, *“Arise, O Lord, unto Thy resting-place; Thou, and the ark of Thy strength,”* his thoughts were upright before the Shekhinah.

God sent word to him by the hand of Nathan the prophet: *“Go and tell My servant David: Thus saith the Lord: Shalt thou build Me a house for Me to dwell in? For I have not dwelt in a house since the day that I brought up the children of Israel out of Egypt, even to this day, but have walked in a tent and in a tabernacle. In all places wherein I have walked with all the children of Israel, spoke I a word with any of the tribes of Israel... saying: Why have ye not built Me a house of cedar?”* (2 Samuel 7:5-7). Elsewhere it is written: *“But thou shalt not build the house; but thy son that shall come forth out of thy loins, he shall build the house for My name.”* (1 Kings 8:19).

What did King David do? He prepared silver, gold, copper, iron, wood, onyx stones, stones for setting, antimony stones, stones of various colors, every precious stone, and marble stones in abundance. He arranged the entire order of the Sanctuary, all its houses, treasuries, upper rooms, inner chambers, the courts, the porch, the halls, and the rest of the entire form of the House, its courtyards and chambers. Everything he received through the Holy Spirit. He prepared the form of every single place and the weight of the silver, gold, and precious stones, and all other necessary items by weight, measure, and scale—all according to the orders of the structure and the needs of the Shekhinah. As it is written: *“Then David gave to Solomon his son the pattern of the porch [of the Temple], and of the houses thereof, and of the treasuries thereof, and of the upper rooms thereof, and of the inner chambers thereof, and of the house of the Atonement Cover; and the pattern of all that he had by the spirit, for the courts of the house of the Lord, and for all the chambers round about, for the treasuries of the house of God, and for the treasuries of the hallowed things; also for the courses of the priests and the Levites, and for all the work of the service of the house of the Lord... for the gold by weight... for all the vessels of every kind of service; for the silver vessels by weight... and the weight for the candlesticks of gold, and for the lamps thereof, of gold, by weight for every candlestick and for the lamps thereof; and for the candlesticks of silver, by weight, for every candlestick and for the lamps thereof...”* (1 Chronicles 28:11-15).

Through the service of
Kindness <term>Chesed|The divine attribute of Mercy or Loving-kindness</term> and Fear <term>Pachad|The divine attribute of Awe or Judgment, also known as Gevurah</term>, and the secret of silence with the Assembly. There are three worlds corresponding to it: the Upper World, which is the world of the Angels; the Middle World, which is the world of the Spheres <note>The celestial orbits of the planets and stars</note>; and the Lower World, which is the world of the Elements. <note>To understand this secret, see the following texts: *Maggid* page 12, *Nishmat Shabtai HaLevi*, *Pitchei Ya*, and *Shefa Tal* page 23 at the end of column 4 and page 24 at the end of column 3.</note> And when all things that the Shekhinah brought forth below are hidden, or when they are nullified, and when they all return—the waters, the Lebanon, and the entire inheritance—into a single unity. For all things emerged from the Supernal place through the process of emanation <note>original: "בהשתלשלות" — *Hishtalshelut*, the unfolding or "chaining" of divine light into physical existence</note>. They were clothed in the power of Kindness, and everything shall become Kindness according to the intention of the Creator. Through the merit of Kindness, the world is built, and "over all the glory shall be a canopy" (Isaiah 4:5). Then the upper siblings shall also be in unity, together they shall be complete in the building of the Eternal House. 

But when the "bolts" <note>The divine connections or flows</note> are interrupted or withdrawn—because when people turn their thoughts to arouse evil rather than good, according to the original intent of creation—then the flow of goodness is withdrawn and gathered back above. Then Might (*Gevurah*) flows upon the Queen <note>The Shekhinah</note> <note>The secret of this is explained in *Yesh Sachar* regarding the "casting of impurity" into her</note> with harsh judgment, and from it, the powers of the "Left Side" <note>The demonic or chaotic forces</note> are set in motion. If so, the House which is "far off" becomes separated due to this arousal, as explained above in the introduction to this book. It is not that the upper beings need the lower beings to receive their flow, but rather that they generate their flow when there is something below that corresponds to it. As will be explained soon, she brings forth her flow and is sweetened by it. But if there are no corresponding recipients below, the powers of judgment grow stronger and withhold the goodness meant for them, dividing the flow of Judgment to judge them along with the goodness called Kindness. Yet her flow is never completely severed; she is always "giving birth."

Because this attribute is the Court of Law for Israel and is the one that avenges their cause, it is called throughout the entire Torah **I** <note>original: "Ani" — the Hebrew word for "I"</note>. Many times it warns Israel not to sin, lest they be forced to stand in judgment before it, for it is impossible (a) not to complete the judgment. Regarding this, it is said in every place: *“And you shall fear your God; I am the Lord,”* <note>Leviticus 19:14</note> meaning: you must fear and dread my judgment, even though it is a judgment tempered with mercy.

Upon this foundation it is said: *“And if you walk contrary to me... I will also walk contrary to you... and I, even I, will chastise you seven times for your sins”* <note>Leviticus 26:23-24</note>. This attribute is called "The Well of Seven" <note>original: "Be'er Sheva"</note>, and within it are wells full of Fear, Might, and Judgment. These are the "Wells of Isaac," as it is written: *“And he went up from there to Be'er Sheva.”* <note>Genesis 26:23</note> It is Isaac <note>In Kabbalah, the Patriarch Isaac represents the attribute of *Gevurah* (Might/Judgment)</note> who draws the judgments into the name **My Lord** <term>Adonai|The Name of God associated with sovereignty and the physical world</term>, which flow through seven streams—some of them through judgment and some through mercy. This is the meaning of: *“**I**, even I, am He, and there is no god with me; I kill, and I make alive; I wound, and **I** heal”* <note>Deuteronomy 32:39</note>.

Because this attribute avenges the cause of Israel and fights their wars, it (b) performed the Plague of the Firstborn in Egypt and brought Israel out through the power of the Higher **Justice** <note>original: "Tzedek"</note> which is (c) called **Jubilee** <note>original: "Yovel" — usually associated with the 50th gate of Understanding and liberation</note>. When it performed the Plague of the Firstborn, no angel, prince, or any other being accompanied it. This is what is written: *“For I will pass through the land of Egypt this night, and will smite all the firstborn in the land of Egypt... I am the Lord.”* <note>Exodus 12:12</note>

Our Sages, of blessed memory, interpreted this: *“I will pass through the land of Egypt”*—I, and not an angel; *“and will smite all the firstborn”*—I, and not a seraph; *“and against all the gods of Egypt I will execute judgment”*—I, and not a messenger; *“I am the Lord”*—it is I, and no other. Therefore, it warns Israel, saying: Through this attribute I redeemed you, and through this attribute **I** (*Ani*) judge you. This is the meaning of the verse: *“**I** am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.”* <note>Numbers 15:41</note> And then it repeats at the end of the verse: *“**I** am the Lord your God.”* Do you not see that this verse begins and ends with **I** (*Ani*)? One (d) is for mercy, and one is for judgment.

Because this attribute rules over all created beings in the world and is the "Great Provider" whom all creatures need, it is called in the Torah by the term **Kingship** <term>Malkhut|The tenth and final Sefirah, representing God's manifest sovereignty in the world</term>. For all the affairs of the King (the Lord) and all His actions are performed through this attribute. This is the meaning of: *“For the kingdom is the Lord’s; and He is the governor among the nations.”* <note>Psalm 22:28</note> The concepts of "Kingship" and "Lordship" both indicate governance and authority. <meta>Continuity: This page continues the discussion of the Divine Presence acting as a judge. # Gate 1

...this [attribute], the Righteous Court of Law, dwells there always. He desires to grant them merit and cleanse them of the debt of all their transgressions and sins so that they may be righteous and prepared for the life of the World to Come. This is the meaning of the verse: *“And no inhabitant shall say, 'I am sick'; the people who dwell there are forgiven their iniquity.”* <note>Isaiah 33:24</note> Similarly, it is said: *“Only you have I known of all the families of the earth; therefore I will punish you for all your iniquities.”* <note>Amos 3:2; the idea is that God's closeness to Israel requires a more frequent, "cleansing" judgment.</note> Because this attribute called **Righteousness** <note>original: "Tzedek"</note> was always present in Jerusalem, enacting legal rulings, no person ever slept in Jerusalem with a sin still in their hand. This was because the debt of each day was collected on that very day, so that the debts of the people of Jerusalem would not accumulate and lead to destruction. This is what is written: *“Righteousness lodged in it.”* <note>Isaiah 1:21</note>

Because this attribute is the "gateway" to enter before the Blessed Name, and it is the one that distinguishes between the righteous and the wicked—denying the wicked permission to enter—David rejoiced when he was at peace with it. Through it, he would enter to behold the face of the Blessed Lord, as it is written: *“As for me, in **Righteousness** I shall behold Your face.”* <note>Psalm 17:15</note> Sometimes this attribute draws from the qualities of Lovingkindness and Mercy, becoming filled with compassion for Israel. In such cases, it performs judgment from the side of Grace and Mercy. That specific type of judgment is called **Justice** <term>Mishpat|In this context, judgment tempered with mercy, as opposed to strict law</term>, for it is blended with kindness and compassion. Therefore it is said, *“I was full of Justice; Righteousness lodged in it,”* <note>Isaiah 1:21</note> and it is written, *“Righteousness and Justice are the foundation of Your throne.”* <note>Psalm 89:15</note> Regarding this, [Jeremiah] said: *“O Lord, correct me, but with Justice; not in Your anger, lest You bring me to nothing.”* <note>Jeremiah 10:24</note>

This [tempered judgment] is unique to the Court of Law of the Land of Israel, as it is written: *“And He shall judge the world in Righteousness.”* <note>Psalm 9:9</note> The other nations, however, are judged in the Heavenly Court called **Equity** <note>original: "Mesharim"</note>, as it is written: *“He shall judge the peoples in Equity.”* <note>Psalm 98:9</note> This means that those courts that judge the nations of the world do not judge with kindness and mercy, but rather "measure for measure." There is no forgiveness of iniquity or transgression there; rather, it is "blood for blood" literally. 

But the attribute of **Righteousness** is unique to the Court of Israel, as it is said: *“Judges and officers you shall appoint for yourself in all your gates... and they shall judge the people with righteous judgment,”* <note>Deuteronomy 16:18</note> for it is written: *“Justice, Justice shall you pursue.”* <note>Deuteronomy 16:20</note> There is an "Upper Righteousness" <gloss>Binah</gloss> <note>The Sephirah of 'Understanding,' a higher source of divine energy</note> and a "Lower Righteousness" <gloss>Malchut</gloss> <note>The Sephirah of 'Sovereignty,' associated with the physical world and the Divine Presence</note> within the secret of **My Lord** <note>Adonai</note>, which is the foundation and support for it. This is why it says *“so that you may live”*—corresponding to Upper Righteousness—and *“and inherit the land”*—corresponding to Lower Righteousness. 

Because this attribute called **Righteousness** receives from the "Side of Above" and judges Israel, it is called **My Lord** <note>original: "Adonai"</note>. 
<margin>My Lord, peace be upon him</margin>
Moses, peace be upon him, requested this [attribute] specifically to be the Court for Israel, saying: *“If now I have found favor in Your sight, O My Lord, let My Lord, I pray, go among us; for it is a stiff-necked people; and pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for Your inheritance.”* <note>Exodus 34:9</note> However, the other nations are judged in the Heavenly Court and are punished by means of an angel or a prince <note>A guardian spiritual power</note>, and an angel or prince cannot forgive or change [a decree], as it is written: *“Behold, I send an angel before you... beware of him and obey his voice; provoke him not, for he will not pardon your transgressions.”* <note>Exodus 23:20-21</note> 

But regarding the attribute of **Righteousness**, which is **My Lord** and the Court of Israel, what is written? *“To My Lord our God belong mercy and forgiveness, for we have rebelled against Him.”* <note>Daniel 9:9</note> And it is written: *“O My Lord, hear; O My Lord, forgive; O My Lord, listen and act; do not delay.”* <note>Daniel 9:19</note> 

Explanation: Know that the negative commandments that a person might transgress—for which they are judged, punished, and avenged—number 365. This is equal to the number of days in the year in which a person can transgress. Thus, every single day, a person stands in judgment for their deeds. However, the attribute of **My Lord** is merciful, and through it we receive forgiveness for every iniquity and every sin. Therefore, you will find in the verse [Daniel 9:19] the name **My Lord** three times, and adjacent <insert>to it</insert> to them are the 365 [prohibitions] <note>A reference to the numerical or liturgical connection between the triple invocation of 'Adonai' and the yearly cycle of potential sin</note>. 

When this attribute wishes to decree judgment upon Israel, it becomes filled with kindness and mercy, and many times it transforms the Attribute of Judgment into the Attribute of Mercy. As it is written: *“How shall I give you up, Ephraim? How shall I surrender you, Israel? How shall I make you as Admah? How shall I set you as Zeboiim? My heart is turned within Me, My compassions are kindled together.”* <note>Hosea 11:8</note> Even when Israel did not want to return in repentance and it was impossible not to complete the judgment, this attribute would suffer [along with them]. But in any case, even though this Court called **Righteousness** judges Israel, it judges them like a father to a son, disciplining them with mercy. As it is written: *“For whom the Lord loves, He reproves...”* <note>Proverbs 3:12</note>

# Gate 1

...and the blessings and the fullness flow toward her upon all her hosts; then she is renewed and enriched. And regarding this <note>The Shekhinah, the feminine aspect of the Divine</note> it is said: *“Who satisfies your mouth with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle's.”* <note>Psalm 103:5</note> (D) This attribute called the **Eagle** <note>original: "Nesher"</note> has many "eagles" with many wings, and they are called the **Eagles of the Chariot**. <note>The "Chariot" (Merkavah) refers to the visionary structure of the Divine realm described by the prophet Ezekiel.</note> All of them protect Israel and spread their wings over Israel and save them from many troubles. This **Eagle**, along with all the other camps of dwellers called the **Eagles of the Chariot**, protected Israel in Egypt and brought them out from under their burdens. As the verse says: *“You have seen what I did to the Egyptians, and how I bore you on eagles' wings.”* <note>Exodus 19:4</note> The stature and fullness of all these camps called the **Eagles of the Chariot** depend on Israel’s ascent through the Torah and the commandments <note>Mitzvot</note>. Conversely, their descent and deficiency occur when Israel distances itself from the Torah and the commandments. Because this attribute must be linked with the higher qualities above it so that types of flow <note>original: "Shefa," divine sustenance</note> and blessing may come to it from them, God gave Israel the power to bind it to the higher qualities. This is the secret of what is called the **Phylactery of the Arm**. <note>original: "Tefillah shel Yad"; the leather box worn on the weaker arm during prayer.</note> (E) Regarding this it is said: *“And you shall bind them as a sign upon your hand, and they shall be as frontlets between your eyes.”* <note>Deuteronomy 6:8</note> One who recites the **Shema** <note>The central "Hear O Israel" prayer</note> in the morning without **Tefillin** <note>phylacteries</note> (B) is as if he bears false witness against himself, and his prayer has no path to enter. This is because "prayer is dependent upon prayer"—that is to say, the prayer of the mouth is dependent upon the **Phylactery of the Arm**. The Phylactery of the Arm opens the gates in the morning so that all the prayers of that day may enter before the Blessed Lord. Therefore, one requires Tefillin during the morning recitation of the Shema. The sages ordained that one should recite the Shema and afterwards pray the *Amidah* <note>The standing prayer</note>, because the **Phylactery of the Arm** used during the Shema opens the gates of prayer. Consequently, the Shema precedes the prayer. On Sabbaths and Festivals, one does not need Tefillin, for other great matters exist on those days and all the gates are open. To what can this be compared? To a time when the King is present; then there is no need for his signet ring. Therefore, Sabbaths and Festivals are exempt, for they themselves are a sign.

->**Sign E**<-

<gloss>The letter "Vav" of Isaac, which possesses the quality of gathering joy and is joined with her beloved... until here are his words.</gloss> To summarize: the Author intended by the "Eagles of the Chariot" to refer to the hand beneath these <note>the higher attributes</note>, as there are also other forces and angels with six wings. Regarding them, it is said in the scriptures that they "rest"—meaning with six wings and **Lovingkindness** <note>original: "Chesed"</note>, compassion, and mercy. They protect Israel with their wings and save them. Even the Community of Israel <note>the Shekhinah</note> says to the people of Israel: call this attribute "Mercy" for me, and the attribute of Mercy shall be mercy for Israel. <gloss>And a glass... and to testify further regarding prayer...</gloss> The question was already asked: Why were these attributes likened to birds and "unclean" animals <note>such as the eagle, which is not kosher</note>? The Kabbalistic sage **Rabbi Joseph Gikatilla** <note>A famous 13th-century Spanish Kabbalist</note> answered: since the attribute of **Lovingkindness** is mercy and preparation, a likeness was created among the living creatures below the Throne. Thus the **Eagle** was created. Through a metaphor, the Divine Presence <note>original: "Shekhinah"</note> is the "living one" within the secret of the "Return." <gloss>Return to my right hand because of the debt... therefore joy and blessing were placed in her, holy and pure, a soul divided in the Chariot...</gloss> The accusers shall be weakened and their strength diminished through the secret of: *“A lion has roared; who will not fear?”* <note>Amos 3:8</note> The light of the "thrice holy and pure" was crouching upon the Altar and consuming the sacrifices. Similarly, in the matter of the **Eagle**, the "Living Being" of the Community of Israel crouches over them. When the Righteous One spreads his hands to draw her to him, mercy is aroused for her. This attribute is truly for the one who merits it. In the printed version, it was "poor," but it is "the Eagle who merits." Therefore, the Community of Israel, in her descent, is clothed in a holy and pure garment in the likeness of an eagle, etc., for all the accusers will be weakened by it, and they flee from the fear of her existence. (A) And regarding this, it says: *“And you shall bind them as a sign upon your hand,”* etc. The meaning of "hand" <note>original: "Yad"</note> is "this" <note>Hebrew wordplay on "Koh"</note> or "Thy Hand, O Lord," for it is the "Great Hand." (B) This is like "bearing false witness against himself," for the recitation of the Shema is the **Secret of Unity** <note>Sod HaYichud</note> through the mouth and the intention of the heart, wherein one unites the Bride <note>the Shekhinah</note> with the Groom <note>the Holy One, Blessed be He</note> and all the "attendants," saying: "The Lord is our God, the Lord is One," as explained at the end of the book *The System* <note>Ma'arekhet HaElokut</note> and established in its place. There must be action along with intention, which is the placing of the Tefillin and binding them upon the arm, to bind the attribute and its preparations. If one does not do so, he bears false witness, for he says with his mouth what his actions do not demonstrate. For he says, "bind them as a sign upon your hand," referring to the foundation called a "sign" upon the "crown" <note>original: "Atarah"</note>, which is the "Weak Hand" <note>original: "Yad Kehah," a common Kabbalistic term for the left hand where Tefillin is placed, symbolizing the Shekhinah's receptive state</note>. It is named so because it receives from the "Hand" that fills her. Therefore, one must unify it and bind it with the other higher qualities so that it becomes "My right hand is kindness and mercy." If he does not do so, he speaks with his mouth but does not testify with his deeds—at the very least, he says something that he himself does not believe. Furthermore, his prayer will not find a path to enter. This is the secret of prayer—that the soul can also remember and be protected from above. Through the preceding action that opens the gate—as we explained regarding the verse *“O Lord, open my lips”* at the beginning of the Gate—his prayers are in the assembly and accepted with favor. Then the Phylactery of the Arm is not "weak," but rather pure and praiseworthy.

The abundance and power flow from there, from the names *Ehyeh* <note>original: א"היה, meaning "I Will Be"</note>, *YHVH* <note>The four-letter Name of God</note>, and *Yah*. The term "Kingship" <note>original: "Malchut"</note> refers to the way of governance through the power of Judgment that emerges through the power of the name *Adonai* <note>My Lord</note>. For within the letters "R-N-U" <note>Numerical value 256</note> which are (A) inside the "D-N" <note>Numerical value 54</note> names of *YHVH* within the name *Adonai*, it is said: "The Judge <note>original: "Dan," from the same root as DN</note> shall judge His people." <note>Genesis 49:16</note> And because this divine attribute takes vengeance for the covenant—and Saul did not complete the commandment—it rejected him and was given to David, and it is called the **Kingship of the House of David**. It always accompanied David, fighting his battles and defeating his enemies. Regarding this, he said: *“I pursued my enemies and overtook them; I did not turn back till they were consumed. I crushed them so they could not rise.”* <note>Psalm 18:38-39</note> (B) David’s primary connection was to this attribute, and from it, he inherited the kingdom. Through it, he would plead and prostrate himself, saying: *“To You, Lord [YHVH], I call; and to My Lord [Adonai] I make supplication.”* <note>Psalm 30:9</note> With it, he fought his enemies, saying: *“Bestir Yourself and awake for my justice, my God and My Lord [Adonai], for my cause. You have seen, O Lord [YHVH]; be not far, My Lord [Adonai], be not far from me.”* <note>Psalm 35:22-23</note> His longing was directed toward it when he said: *“My Lord [Adonai], all my desire is before You.”* <note>Psalm 38:10</note> And it is written: *“For You, O Lord [YHVH], do I wait; You will answer, My Lord [Adonai] my God.”* <note>Psalm 38:16</note> And: *“And now, what do I hope for? My Lord [Adonai], my hope is in You.”* <note>Psalm 39:8</note> In all his times of trouble, he would cling to this attribute, saying: *“In the day of my trouble, I sought My Lord [Adonai].”* <note>Psalm 77:3</note> And it is written: *“Behold me, My Lord [Adonai], for to You I call all the day.”* <note>Psalm 86:3</note> Because this attribute is in exile with Israel, we pray: “And the Kingship of the House of David Your Messiah, may You speedily return it to its place.” Sometimes this attribute is called:

### Eagle
The reason is that sometimes she is "rich," full of all goodness when Israel is righteous, drawing toward her from all the higher levels many kinds of flow, emanation, blessing, kindness, and mercy from all the Spheres <note>original: "Sefirot," the divine emanations</note> above her. But when Israel turns away from the paths of the Lord, then (C) this attribute becomes deficient, poor, and lowly. She is like a "fading leaf" and like "a garden that has no water." <note>Isaiah 1:30</note> Then it is as if her fruits have "fallen away" <note>original: *nanushar*, a wordplay on *Nesher* (Eagle)</note>. At such times, Israel is poor and lowly, plundered for reproach and derision. For when this attribute does not draw nourishment from above, she cannot provide nourishment to Israel. She is called **Eagle** <note>original: "Nesher"</note> from the expression for a tree that "sheds" <note>original: "mashir"</note> its fruit.

### And the Secret
of this I am setting before you. I have already informed you that the essence of the Divine Presence <note>original: "Shekhinah"</note> is on the earth, and your sign is: *“The earth is My footstool.”* <note>Isaiah 66:1</note> When the Divine Presence receives the flow of blessings from above, she is called a **Gathering of Water** <note>original: "Mikveh"</note>. When she does not receive blessings, she is called **Dry Land**. Your sign for this is: *“God called the dry land 'Earth,' and the gathering of waters He called 'Seas.'”* <note>Genesis 1:10</note> When this attribute is "dry" and deficient, then Israel is in hunger, thirst, nakedness, and lack of everything. They are "despoiled" from her, for Israel is like the leaves and she is like the body of the tree. This attribute is sometimes rich and sometimes deficient, sometimes full and sometimes empty. This is the secret of: *“Like an eagle that rouses its nest, hovering over its young...”* <note>Deuteronomy 32:11</note> When Israel returns in repentance, they renew her like an eagle as at the beginning, like the drawing of water through pipes, and they cause a flow to descend...

...spreading the Divine Names in great mercy. (A) There, within the 24 names of Being, everything is directed toward the Kingship to designate her through the explanation of the name *Adonai*. (B) David's connection was to this attribute because it is known that the children of Israel are naturally merciful; lest they be too merciful toward their enemies, David held fast to this attribute of Judgment to judge, enclose, and capture them, as is explained in the texts. (C) Regarding this attribute being "deficient, lowly, and poor" as mentioned (this is a great principle, see the book *Shefa Tal*): I have warned and testified to you in these places that you must not understand this as a deficiency in God Himself, God forbid! Rather, it must be interpreted that she is "poor and empty" only of that specific flow which she normally receives. But regarding her own essence, one cannot say she is "poor." This applies everywhere such language is used. Remember this, lest you err, for it is all according to the secret I revealed above regarding the "withdrawal of the Presence"—that the flow does not move according to the intended purpose of the creation’s repair. At the end of the system of explanations, I have chosen to explain all of this at length in a way that is closer to human understanding. (D) This attribute is called "Eagle" and has several aspects. I have come to write for Isaac Kohen, son of Jacob, of blessed memory, that within the Kingship are included three "eagles," which are the three pillars included within the four camps of the Divine Presence. These are: **Michael**, corresponding to the attribute of Kingship itself; the second is **Azriel**, corresponding to the "Great Crown" <note>original: "Atarah"</note> in the manner explained by the Master [Remaz]; and the third is **Nasriel**, so named because of the "drawing away" <note>original: "shiavat"</note> of Judgments and the returning of the children in repentance, so they conduct themselves in the "straight" way <note>original: "yashar," another wordplay on Nesher</note> toward their Father in Heaven. Through them, the scale of merit is tipped through repentance, or she shows mercy to her children, as in "an eagle rouses its nest over its young."

That is to say, they shall bless **Koh** <note>The Hebrew word *Koh* (כ"ה) means "Thus," but also has the numerical value of 25. It refers here to a specific divine attribute or "gate" through which blessing flows.</note>. This refers to the prayer of the hand <note>The *Tefillin* worn on the arm</note> which we mentioned. Regarding this, the Torah says: *“And they shall be for a sign upon your hand”* <note>Exodus 13:16. The author notes that the Hebrew word for "your hand" (yad'khah) is written with an extra letter 'H', allowing it to be read as "Yad Koh"—the hand of the attribute Koh.</note>, written with the letter *He*. And the reason we tie the prayer-tefillin of the hand on the left arm is because (B) from the Attribute of the Left—which is the Attribute of **Awe** <note>original: *Pachad*</note> and **Strength** <note>original: *Gevurah*</note>—power is drawn to the Attribute of *Koh*. 

Because the Attribute of *Koh* was what fought the battles of David, peace be upon him, he said: *“For by Koh, my Lord, I shall run through a troop.”* <note>A mystical reading of Psalm 18:30 (Hebrew verse 29). Normally read as "For by You," the author reads it as "By Koh."</note> He did not say "by You," but "by Koh," written fully. For it was with the power of this divine attribute that David struck and pursued all his enemies. This was also the power that fought the battles of Abraham, peace be upon him, against the kings, as we explained regarding the Attribute of **Justice** <note>original: *Tzedek*</note>.

This attribute is also what renews signs and wonders in the world; it performed the ten plagues in Egypt. I must enlighten your eyes regarding the reason for this. **Know** that it has already been said that the land of Egypt is second only to the Land of Israel. The "Prince" <note>Celestial patron/angelic representative</note> of Egypt is among the greatest of the national princes, to the extent that he took his portion in the firstborn of the zodiac signs: Aries <note>the Ram</note>. This sign rises in the month of Nissan, which is the "head of months," and it is like a firstborn to the twelve signs of the zodiac, as it says: *“This month shall be for you the head of months.”* <note>Exodus 12:2</note>

Because Pharaoh was deeply attached and clung to his own celestial Prince, and had no portion in the Name **YHVH** <note>The four-letter essential Name of God</note>, may He be blessed—since his Prince was his exclusive focus—the Blessed Name had to send Moses our Teacher, peace be upon him, to inform Pharaoh that there is a Master and Ruler in the world over all the princes and all the heavenly hosts, and He is **YHVH**, may He be blessed. Moses had to show that Israel is His portion and inheritance, and he warned Pharaoh to send them away because Israel is not a portion of any constellation or star, but rather the portion of **YHVH**, may He be blessed.

God told Moses that there is no way to enter into the knowledge of the Name **YHVH**, may He be blessed, unless one first opens the First Gate, which is *Koh*. From within it, the Name **YHVH** is revealed, for it is His Palace and His House. This is the meaning of: *“And God said to Moses: I Will Be What I Will Be [Ehyeh Asher Ehyeh]. And He said: Koh shall you say to the children of Israel: 'I Will Be' has sent me to you.”* <note>Exodus 3:14</note> 

He repeated this a second time and said: *“And God said further to Moses: Koh shall you say to the children of Israel: YHVH, the God of your fathers... This is My Name forever, and this is My memorial unto all generations.”* <note>Exodus 3:15</note> What is the meaning of "This is My Name" and "This is My memorial"? Even though there are several fundamental principles and secrets in this place, the first principle is this: "This is My Name **YHVH**"—and therefore the word "forever" <note>original: *le-olam*</note> is written defectively, missing a letter *Vav*. This implies: "You must **hide** <note>original: *le-alem*, which is spelled the same as *le-olam* without the *Vav*</note> the Name **YHVH** when reading it," for it is forbidden to pronounce it by its letters except in the Temple. As we say: "In the Temple, it is pronounced as it is written; in the provinces, it is pronounced by its substitute name." 

"And this is My memorial" refers to the name **Adonai** <note>My Lord</note>, which is the Palace of **YHVH**, and it is the substitute name used for its reading. That is to say: "Wherever you find the Name **YHVH** in the Torah, mention it by its substitute name **Adonai**." This is what our Sages of blessed memory said: *"I am not read as I am written; I am written as YHVH, but I am read as Adonai."* 

Behold, when the language of *Koh* was written here in two verses containing the Names **Ehyeh** and **YHVH**, it informed us that *Koh* is the gate for them to enter both. We have already informed you in our previous explanations that there are three Names: **Ehyeh** at the top <note>gloss: Keter Elyon - The Highest Crown</note>, **YHVH** in the middle <note>gloss: Tiferet - Beauty</note>, and **Adonai** at the bottom <note>gloss: Malchut - Kingship</note>. Therefore, the mention of the Name **YHVH** is called by the name **Adonai**, which is His Palace. This is why the word *Koh* is written in the two verses containing **Ehyeh** and **YHVH**.

When Moses went to Pharaoh on the mission of the Blessed Name, he began with the word *Koh*, because it is the gate to enter the knowledge of the Blessed Name **YHVH**. This is what is written: *“Afterward Moses and Aaron went and said to Pharaoh: Koh says YHVH, the God of the Hebrews: Let my people go...”* <note>Exodus 5:1</note> And Pharaoh replied: *“Who is YHVH that I should obey His voice? I do not know YHVH.”* Moses our Teacher said to him: "If you do not know the Name **YHVH**, know that the First Gate through which one enters to know Him is the attribute called **Koh**, through which heaven and earth were created, and which renews..."

# Gate 1

...to <unclear>be</unclear>, and there is no need [to explain] "and you shall bind them for a sign" <note>Deuteronomy 6:8, referring to the Tefillin</note>. (A) The term that serves as a sign for this divine attribute throughout the Torah, Prophets, and Writings is **Koh** <note>original: כ"ה. In Hebrew, this word means "Thus," but its letters—Kaf and He—carry the numerical value of 25, a significant number in this mystical system</note>. This attribute is the "opener" to all higher spiritual levels (B) and is the secret of the Holy Spirit <note>original: Ruach HaKodesh</note>. From this level, the prophets gaze into the world of prophecy, and they use it frequently. This is why the prophets often use the expression: **Thus says the Lord** <note>original: Koh amar YHVH</note>, which acts as a title for the Divine Presence <note>original: Shekhinah</note>. 

As we have informed you, our forefather Abraham was the first to begin bringing this attribute down to the lower world. He was the first to call upon God using the name *Adonai* <note>The name of God associated with Lordship and the physical world</note>, as it is said: *"My Lord [Adonai] God, what will You give me?"* <note>Genesis 15:2</note>. The Lord, blessed be He, <unclear>responded</unclear> that despite all the arrangements of the stars and the heavenly or earthly hosts, Abraham would have no offspring except through the power of the attribute called **Koh**. This attribute is the "Gate of Prayer," through which every petitioner finds their request granted, even to the point of changing the power of the constellations <note>original: Mazalot</note>. It is this attribute that transforms the Attribute of Justice into Mercy, bringing life instead of death, healing instead of illness, and children instead of barrenness—for everything depends upon it. 

It is the "Opening of the Eyes." Because everything depends on this attribute called *Koh*, the Lord said to Abraham: **"So [Koh] shall your offspring be"** <note>Genesis 15:5</note>. This means: through this attribute, you shall enter the Source of Sources and the Wellspring of all generations, up to the place called (C) (**K"A**) <note>original: כ"ע, likely an abbreviation for Keter Elyon, the "Supreme Crown," the highest of the ten Sefirot</note>, the "Constellation of all Constellations" from which living waters flow to all the stars. Through this, you shall have children; this is the "Constellation" <note>term: Mazal — while usually meaning "luck" or "zodiac sign," in Kabbalah it refers to the "dripping" (nozel) of divine influence from the highest levels</note> upon which even a Torah scroll in the Ark depends. It is not as the common thinkers believe, who speak only of the physical stars (D). 

What the Sages, of blessed memory, said in the chapter *"He who was overtaken by darkness"* <note>A chapter in the Talmud, Tractate Shabbat</note> contains many awesome and wondrous matters regarding this. Because our forefather Abraham inherited this attribute when God said, **"and you shall be a blessing,"** and finally, *"and the Lord blessed Abraham **in all** [Bakol],"* <note>Genesis 24:1</note> the Blessed Name saw fit to hand over the keys to open this blessing to the People of Israel. (E) He placed the supernal keys into the hands of the Priests <note>original: Kohanim</note> to draw down the blessing, flow, and emanation from all the higher levels and Sefirot to this specific blessing called **Koh**. 

Thus He commanded the Priestly Blessing: *"Speak to Aaron and his sons, saying: **Thus [Koh] shall you bless the children of Israel**"* <note>Numbers 6:23</note>. When this attribute is blessed and filled, then the flow and emanation come to Israel. Your sign for this is: *"And they shall put My name upon the children of Israel, and I will bless them."* Regarding the secret of the Priestly Blessing within the attribute of **Koh**, King David, peace be upon him, said: *"All Your works shall praise You, O Lord, and Your pious ones shall bless You"* <note>original: yevarekhukha. Psalm 145:10. The author notes that the word ends with the letters Kaf-He, spelling Koh</note> (F), written fully with the letter *He*.

->That is to say<-

To him, He shall open a gate for his prayer. Therefore, [the Sages] established the recitation of the Shema and the Prayer while wearing Tefillin. The author interprets "Koh" not as an adverb but as the specific divine attribute of Judgment</note>. *Koh says the Lord: By this you shall know that I am the Lord; behold, I will strike (Makeh) with the staff that is in my hand* <note>Exodus 7:17</note>. And the Name, may He be blessed, commanded to lash him in our court (B) for the number of 39 transgressions. For each one, [the penalty is] forty lashes, so that Israel should not come to the lashes of *Koh*. For that [divine punishment] is much stronger and more powerful than our lashes. 

And because *The ox knows its owner, and the donkey its master’s crib* (C), when He lashes the sinners, He lashes through the "ox" and the "donkey" <note>Isaiah 1:3. In Kabbalah, the ox and donkey represent specific spiritual forces or "husks" (Kelipot) that act as agents of punishment</note>. Therefore, it is fitting for the strap used for lashes to be composed of [the hide of] an ox and a donkey. 

And when this attribute draws from the attribute of **Strength** <term>Gevurah: the divine power of judgment and restraint</term> and **Fear** <term>Pachad: another name for Gevurah, emphasizing the dread of divine justice</term>, and is filled by them, then it destroys lands and sends plagues to all the inhabitants of the world. And you must draw down Mercy and Blessings to it, lest it destroy the world. And this is the secret of: *Koh (Thus) you shall bless the children of Israel* <note>Numbers 6:23</note>. It means if the sinner receives forty lashes (D) [in the earthly court], he will not come to the lashes of the attribute of *Koh*, which contains many additions beyond your lashes. *Lest he exceed in striking him with these*—meaning if he does not receive the forty lashes in this world, he will come to the lash that comes from the "Great *Koh*." And this is what our Sages of blessed memory said: "Do not read it as *makkah rabbah* (a great plague) but as *mi-Koh R-B-H* (from Koh, 207)." And your sign is that *R-B-H* is a hint to the 39 lashes in the Torah. (E) 

And the Sages also expounded: *Forty he may strike him, he shall not exceed* (F)—meaning forty minus one [39]. Everything depends on the scripture. # Gate 1

This knowledge and this attribute is the tree of the Lord <note>original: "YHVH"</note> called Knowledge <note>original: "Da'at"</note>, which is His palace and His house. But if, Heaven forbid, the channels coming through Justice are cut off, then she draws from the attribute of Hard Judgment <note>original: "Din ha-Kasheh"</note> (B), and from the "Left Side" <note>In Kabbalah, the 'Left Side' refers to the side of judgment and the potential for evil to manifest</note> there are things in which evil <note>original: "ra"</note> is renewed in the world. (G) As we will yet awaken your attention to this, with God's help.

The upper beings have no business with the lower ones, and the power of their speech was with them. Thus, he [Adam] diverted the pleasure from the upper beings and separated the "Covenant" from the "Uncovering" <note>original: "peri'ah," the second stage of circumcision</note> and made the Tree a "pool." Therefore, it struck him and he erred before it in judgment.

This is the secret behind the Sages' saying: "Adam the first man was a puller of his foreskin" <note>A metaphor for Adam trying to hide his circumcision/covenant and separate himself from God</note>. By separating, he revealed the removal of the good flow, and by joining the "Hard Power" <note>Gevurah</note> upon himself in the world, the "Foreskin" and the "Shell" <note>Klipot</note> came, as did the attachment to the "Crown" <note>original: "Atarah," the tip of the Yesod</note> which is the Kingdom <note>Malkhut</note>, so that the Divine Presence <note>Shekhinah</note> might dwell in them. This is the matter of the Shekhinah, the separation, and the flaw that the Kabbalists mention everywhere. Most who err here fall into the error we discussed regarding the descent of the numerical levels in her outpouring. They remove the good flow so that evil is awakened to agree with them. Adam's error is primary, and the flaw affects all aspects after him. Even though it is known that most matters follow their own benefit, and an act of merit can be extinguished, "there is no man who does good and does not sin," as explained in the *System of Flavors*.

(G) As we will yet awaken your attention to this, God willing: This refers to Gate 2 regarding the title of "Covenant," the "Guardian" there, for all the portions regarding forbidden sexual relations are dependent on this place. (D) <margin>Types of flow and emanation from the Tree of Life.</margin> Meaning from the prayer, which is the "Tree of Understanding" <note>original: "Binah"</note> called "Life," as will be explained in various places in Gate 5. (E) <margin>And this attribute is the reception of the Land of the Living.</margin> Meaning a "Land" and a "Receptacle" for the flow descending from the Upper Life. They said that the dead buried in the Land uniquely hers will rise first, because she rules over their life. Her specific length and the attribute of Kingdom <note>Malkhut</note> within them will be explained. The dead of Israel rise first, and afterward the dead of outside the Land, because the flow descends to her first, and afterward spreads from her to all lands, as it is said: *Who gives rain upon the face of the earth, and sends water upon the face of the fields* <note>Job 5:10</note>. This will be explained with study in Gate 5 under the title "The World to Come."

# Gate 1

The black [fire] of the script <note>A reference to the tradition that the Torah was written with "black fire on white fire"</note> and the Oral Torah <note>original: "Torah she-be-al peh"</note> both need one another; one cannot exist without the other. This is the meaning of the phrase "And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying" <note>original: "Vayedaber YHVH el Moshe lemor"</note>. "And he spoke" <note>original: "Vayedaber"</note> at the beginning of the verse is the secret of the Written Torah. "Saying" <note>original: "Lemor"</note> at the end of the verse is the secret of the Oral Torah. These two forms of expression—the language of "speaking" <note>term: "dibbur" — generally understood as a harsher or more direct form of speech</note> and the language of "saying" <note>term: "amirah" — understood as a softer, more internal form of speech</note>—contain the wisdom upon which the whole Torah is established.

Your sign for this is the verse: "Write for yourself these words, for according to these words I have made a covenant with you" <note>Exodus 34:27</note>. Your sign is "And you shall place them in the Ark," for the Written Torah is interpreted through the Oral Torah. This is because the entirety of the Written Torah is [contained within] the Oral Torah. 

Your sign for this is: "The Lord <note>original: "Adonai"</note> is the palace for the name YHVH." These two Torahs cling to one another like "two fawns that are twins of a gazelle" <note>Song of Songs 4:5</note>. # Gate 1

# Gate 1

Which were the letters Y-H-W <note>The first three letters of the Tetragrammaton, the চার-letter name of God</note> called by three names: **Shaddai, Elohim, Adonai**, and all is by the power of the name "Y-H-V-H" <note>The Tetragrammaton</note>, which carries everything and acts in everything. # Gate 1

The way to enter into the knowledge of the Name Y-H-V-H <note>original: "יהוה" – the four-letter essential Name of God, often unpronounced</note> is only through the Name Adonai <note>original: "אדני" – meaning "Lord," representing the manifest Presence or Kingship</note>. You should know that because this attribute receives the powers of the higher levels, ב it shifts into several "colors" <note>In Kabbalah, colors represent different divine energies: red for judgment, white for mercy, etc.</note>: to give life and to kill, to raise up and to cast down, to strike and to heal. Everything depends on the power drawn to it from the levels above it. According to the nature of what it receives, so it acts upon all created beings. And everything is done according to the straight law of true judgment; there is no injustice, no forgetfulness, and no favoritism there. ג And because this attribute is filled with abundance from those higher levels above it, it is sometimes called by the name of the specific level it attains <margin>and you shall see</margin> at that specific time. **For example:** You already know that the name associated with the attribute of Strength and Awe <note>term: Gevurah — the divine attribute of power, restraint, and judgment</note> is called *Elohim*, which is the Heavenly Court. ד By it, all creatures are judged to the right or to the left ה according to the "Middle Line" <note>The balancing path between Mercy and Judgment</note>, all in truth and uprightness. When the attribute of Strength decrees a judgment on those below to destroy, kill, or vanish, then the attribute of Adonai—which is the storehouse for all things descending from above—is filled with that same judgment decreed by *Elohim*. It then acts and completes the judgment that *Elohim* decreed upon the lower worlds. At that hour, it too is called *Elohim*, after the name of the attribute of Strength that decreed the judgment. In this way, the messenger is called by the name of the sender. Following this path, this attribute is sometimes called *Y-H-V-H*, sometimes *Adonai*, sometimes *Elohim*, and sometimes *Shaddai*. It all depends on the specific attribute that is influencing it with power or judgment, whether it be mercy or its opposite. When this attribute is filled from the source before it, it is called *Shaddai*, meaning that there is "enough" <note>original: "די" (Dai) – a play on the name Shaddai, implying self-sufficiency or "enoughness"</note>, perfection, and fullness. # Gate 1

All these aforementioned levels are drawn together in a single desire and a single will. Thus, the Name Adonai <note>original: "אדני" — the name of God associated with the physical world and the Presence/Shekhinah</note> is blessed by all of them. According to the abundance that fills the Name Adonai from the nine Sephirot <term>Sephirot: The ten creative powers or attributes through which the Infinite interacts with the universe</term> above it, so too will the entire world be blessed from the Name Adonai. At such times, all creatures of every kind are filled with every good and every bounty from the "Pool" <note>A metaphor for the Sephirah of Malchut (Kingship), which collects the "waters" of divine energy from above</note>. In the past, the pious ones would diminish the channels of Judgment and increase the channels of Kindness and Mercy. But sometimes, when human beings sin, they diminish the channels of Kindness and Mercy and increase the channels of Judgment. א And then several harsh matters are drawn toward the Name Adonai, may it be blessed, and the entire world is in pain and lack, suffering every kind of plague and illness. Sometimes all the higher channels are blocked, and from the external channels, evil forces—called "bad waters"—are drawn down; then every place is in distress. This results in the destruction of lands, the uprooting of kingdoms, and difficult, evil exiles. The end of the matter is this: Know that the Name called Adonai is named according to whatever is drawn into it, whether from within or without, whether for good or for evil, for life or for death, for plague or for pleasure. And this is the secret of the Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil. If the flow is from the side of Kindness, it is called "Good." If the flow is from the side of Judgment, there is a side that is still called "Good," even though it is from Judgment. This occurs if it comes from the Judgment of the inner camps; ב this is the secret of the verse: "And he was ruddy, with beautiful eyes and goodly to look upon" <note>1 Samuel 16:12, describing King David; "ruddy" symbolizes judgment/redness, but it is tempered and "good"</note>. But if it comes from the Judgment of the external forces, this is an "evil sickness," and this is the matter of "Evil." Understand this well: when the Name Adonai draws from the side of Kindness, it is called "Good." Even when it draws from the side of the inner Judgment, it is called "Good"—and this is the secret of the blessing "Blessed is the True Judge" <note>original: "ברוך דיין האמת" — the blessing recited upon hearing bad news or of a death</note>. This is why the sages established the blessing "He who is Good and does Good" <note>original: "הטוב והמטיב"</note> for particularly good news. But if the Judgment comes from the external forces that are outside the proper line, that is the matter of "Evil." When this attribute is clothed in a "spirit of grace and supplications" <note>Zechariah 12:10</note>, then the entire world is sustained with Kindness and Mercy. This is the secret of the verse: "To the Lord our God belong mercies and forgiveness" <note>Daniel 9:9</note>. Keep this great principle and understand from it that the Name, may it be blessed, is built according to the abundance drawn into the Name Adonai. May the Name in His mercy and kindness illuminate our eyes with the light of His perception.

# Gate 1

Regarding this attribute, we are not currently engaged in its explanation, and with the help of Heaven, we will yet awaken interest in them. Behold, I hand over to you a great principle: **Know** that this Name called *Adonai* <note>original: אדנ"י</note> is the Great Palace <term>Palace (Heikhal): In Kabbalah, a vessel or dwelling place that receives and contains the divine light from higher levels</term> to which all types of flow of Emanation <term>Emanation (Atzilut): The highest spiritual world, representing the direct radiation of divine light</term> come from the head of the Crown called *Eheyeh* <note>original: אהי"ה - "I Will Be," the name associated with the highest Sephirah, Keter</note> by way of Beauty called *YHWH* <note>original: יהו"ה - the Tetragrammaton, the central name of God associated with the Sephirah of Tiferet</note>. In it, all the rivers join, which are drawn from the level of the Crown; from the thirty-two paths of Wisdom; from the fifty gates of Understanding; from the seventy-two bridges coming from the waters of Great Kindness; from the forty-two types of flaming fire coming from Might; and from the seventy lights coming by way of the central line. All these levels, paths, gates, bridges, types of fire, and channels—all of them roll and come by way of Victory and Majesty and join together in the attribute of the Living God called Foundation. From there—meaning from the attribute of Foundation—they all enter the "Upper Pool" called *Adonai*. Do not say that all these aforementioned flows always come as one, for when the Name is in its fullness, it is called "YHWH is One."

---

<gloss>Since it is the Palace, all types of flow come to it. And when Justice is elevated, so to speak, this attribute acts as the receiver for the water channel, meaning the Foundation. When evil is distanced from it and all the "husks" <term>Husks (Kelipot): Spiritual shells or forces of impurity that conceal the divine light</term> are removed, it is complete in its fullness; there is no flaw in it and it lacks for nothing. For from the attribute that is the Foundation of all, it oversees everything, and all types of flow, grace, and blessing come to it from the "Womb of the Crown," as a reception of the "Cup of Will," containing all types of flow, sustenance, and paths of blessing and life. This is the secret of the "Locked Garden, my sister, my bride" <note>Song of Songs 4:12</note>, meaning that the forces of impurity shall not enter it. It shall be adorned with all types of jewelry coming to it from the flow... like a groom donning a priestly headdress and like a bride adorning herself with her jewels. Therefore, regarding David, it says of it: "You shall no longer be termed Forsaken, nor shall your land any longer be termed Desolate" <note>Isaiah 62:4</note>. Contemplate the secret of the two wings of "my sister, my bride" regarding Moses, and therefore "as a groom rejoices over a bride" <note>Isaiah 62:5</note>, the light shall be upon you to shine. But if, Heaven forbid, sins act like a cloud, it rolls away from its place and becomes a "wasteland." May the Name, for the sake of His mercies, save us from this. This hints that when the "husks" are foreign, the Bride is honored with additional beauty... and it is written: "Spread your wings over your handmaid, for you are a redeemer" <note>Ruth 3:9</note>. This is the secret of all the drawings-forth and types of flow that come to the Foundation of the world, called "All" (*Kol*). When it unites with Sovereignty, which is the secret of the Letter Vav, she is called the "Bride of YHWH"—may His Name be sanctified and His memory blessed forever. We are not currently explaining the other names of the Bride by which this attribute is called, but I will announce one name to you because it is used in all the books of the Kabbalists, and that is "Crown" (*Atarah*), for she is a crown and ornament to the world. The world is crowned and praised through her. The language of "crowning" refers to Jerusalem being like a fortress, and regarding her it is said, "with the crown with which his mother crowned him" <note>Song of Songs 3:11</note> and "you shall be a crown of glory in the hand of the Lord" <note>Isaiah 62:3</note>. א In it join all the rivers mentioned from the thirteen levels of the Crown. The explanation: these are the thirteen attributes of Higher Mercy that emerge from the thirteen permutations of the Name *Eheyeh*... and the thirty-two paths of Wisdom are the thirty-two letters and ten vowel points... with which the world was created through the power of the ten Sephirot... and the fifty gates of Understanding are the power of the inclusion of the seven Sephirot beneath it, each included within the others (7x7=49), and with her they are fifty... and the seventy-two bridges are seventy-two types of flow and powers spreading from the right side of the Crown, the numerical value of *Chesed* (Kindness). They called them "bridges" across the waters... and the forty-two types of flaming fire are types of the power of Judgment emerging from Might (*Gevurah*), and their secret is the Name of Forty-Two... and the seventy channels are seventy powers spreading and emerging from the combination of Kindness and Fear, which are thirty-five on this side and thirty-five on that side... until they enter one another's borders and become seventy. These are the "advocates of merit" for Israel, standing within against the seventy princes of the seventy nations who stand without... these are what are called in the *Sefer Ha-Bahir* <term>Sefer Ha-Bahir: "The Book of Brilliance," one of the earliest and most important foundational texts of Kabbalah</term> the "seventy heights" and "seventy houses"... and regarding them it is said that the Holy One, blessed be He, has seventy names, and corresponding to them seventy names for Metatron <term>Metatron: The highest archangel in Jewish mystical tradition, often described as the celestial scribe or the "Prince of the Presence"</term>... All of them are mixed in the "Aleph" of Understanding... for the multitude of names indicates the multitude of actions and powers emanating from Him, may He be blessed... and therefore this Name includes them all. ב And it is called YHWH as one...</gloss>

# Gate 2

To seek life and goodness, one should aim for the attribute of **El Chai** <note>original: "א"ל ח"י" - The Living God, a name associated with the Sephirah of Yesod (Foundation)</note>. When a person cleaves to the Name **Adonai** <note>The Lord, associated with the Sephirah of Malkhut (Kingdom)</note> in purity, then he is cleaving to **El Chai**. Regarding this, it is said: "And you who cleave to the Lord your God are all alive today" <note>Deuteronomy 4:4</note>. Sometimes this attribute is called **Elohim Chayim** <note>Living God</note>, as in the verse: "He is the living God and the eternal King" <note>Jeremiah 10:10</note>. <insert>a</insert> The secret is that **El Chai** pours life into the pool of **Adonai**, which is called **Elohim**. When He fills it with life, each of them is called **Elohim Chayim**, and then, by way of the channels, all living beings are filled with life. When Moses ascended on high, he drew the attribute of **El Chai** down to **Adonai** by saying: "And now, let the power of my Lord be great" <note>Numbers 14:17</note>. What is the "power of my Lord"? It is the secret of the life-force drawn to it from the **Living God** (El Chai). What is written afterward? "I have pardoned according to your word. But as I live..." <note>Numbers 14:20-21</note>. This is the secret that he drew life from the Living God into the attribute of "I" <note>original: "אני" (Ani) - a term often used to refer to the Sephirah of Malkhut</note>. Had he not done so, they all would have died instantly. Therefore, He waited for them in life until they produced fruit and the fruit of fruit, and only afterward did He exact punishment from them. One who contemplates this matter will understand the great power of drawing the attribute of **El Chai** into **Adonai**. As for the verse mentioning **Elohim Chayim**, the attribute of **Adonai** is also called **Elohim Chayim**. The reason is that it does not grant life except according to the Law <term>Law (Din): Divine Judgment or Justice</term>, and there is no favoritism there; therefore, it mentions **Elohim Chayim**, which is the attribute of Judgment combined with Life. Consequently, we mention these two attributes on Rosh Hashanah, which is the Day of Judgment—**Elohim Chayim** and **El Chai** and Shield—in the first blessing, as we say: "Remember us for life, O King who desires life... write us in the Book of Life for Your sake, O **Elohim Chayim**." **El Chai** and Shield—do you not see that these two attributes are included in this blessing? Now that we have made this principle known, know that the attribute of **El Chai** is sometimes called:

### El Shadai
<note>original: "אל שדי" - God Almighty</note>

The reason is that from it is drawn the strength, perfection, flow, and emanation into the Name called **Adonai**, until it says "Enough" <note>The Hebrew name "Shadai" is traditionally interpreted as "She-dai," meaning "He who [said] enough"</note>. Therefore, our Sages of blessed memory said in Tractate Hagigah: "Shadai—He who said to the world: 'Enough!'" Although the plain meaning is as they said there—that the world was expanding and moving until He said "Enough"—the inner principle is that through the attribute **El Shadai**, He provides food for every single creature and sends His blessings to **Adonai** until their "handmaidens" <note>referring to the lower spiritual forces or the recipients of the flow</note> cease from saying "Enough." When the attribute of **Adonai** is filled with the power of **El Shadai**, it is also called <insert>b</insert> by His name, **Shadai** and **El Shadai**, as I have already informed you. All the blessings and goodness poured into **Adonai** to fulfill the needs of every creature through **El Shadai** are found in the verse: "And may God Almighty (El Shadai) bless you and make you fruitful..." <note>Genesis 28:3</note>. This attribute is also the one that says "Enough" to any trouble so that it does not come upon a person; therefore, our father Jacob, peace be upon him, prayed using **El Shadai**. Sometimes this attribute is called:

# Source of Living Waters
<note>original: "מקור מים חיים" (Mikor Mayim Chayim)</note>

The reason is that these waters flow from the Upper Eden, from the source called **Ein Sof** <note>The Infinite; the highest, unknowable aspect of God</note> (this is the intention regarding the Crown <term>Crown (Keter): The highest of the ten Sefirot</term>), from which source life is drawn to every living thing. It is called the **Source of Living Waters** because there are other "bad waters" called "dead waters," which are the murky waters coming from the dregs of the "insolent waters" <note>referring to the forces of the "Other Side" or impurity</note>; these are foreign wells containing various types of bad water, from which come the bitter, curse-bearing waters. Therefore, the Blessed Lord needed to warn all Israel, saying: "For my people have committed two evils: they have forsaken Me, the **fountain of living waters**, to hew for themselves cisterns, broken cisterns, that can hold no water" <note>Jeremiah 2:13</note>. And it is written: "All who forsake You shall be ashamed... because they have forsaken the Lord, the **fountain of living waters**" <note>Jeremiah 17:13</note>. The reason it is called the **Source of Living Waters** is from several aspects: First, because this source emerges from the Upper Eden, and by it all living things live; when they drink from these waters, they shall not hunger or thirst, and they shall always be alive and endure forever. Second, just as a living being moves here and there and performs actions, so too these waters move and flow

It is also called "World" <note>Olam</note> because it conducts this world. <insert>a</insert> When **El Chai** pours life into the pool of **Adonai** called **Elohim**, it is because they received from the "Mah" <term>Mah: A Kabbalistic name for God associated with the value 45, often linked to the Sephirah of Tiferet</term> above; thus, the meaning of **Elohim Chayim** is the life of Elohim. <insert>b</insert> It is also called by His name **Shadai**, and his words were **El Shadai**, as I informed you at the end of the first gate.
