This Name acts as the conduit or "channel" that pours life-force from the higher realms into the lower world (Adonai/Malkhut).</meta>

# My soul thirsts for God, for the living God; when shall I come and appear before God? <note>Psalm 42:3</note>
## The second of the Holy Names

<margin>By way of the levels (meaning the Foundation <note>original: "יסוד" (Yesod) - the ninth Sephirah, representing the procreative and connecting force of the Divine</note>), it is called</margin>
**El Chai** <note>The Living God</note>. The reason it is called **El Chai** is that it is the conclusion of the nine levels known as the "nine mirrors" <note>original: "ט' אספקלריאות" (aspaklaria) - a term for the Sephirot as lenses or mirrors through which Divine light passes</note>. It draws the attribute of Mercy <note>Chesed</note> and the Vitality <note>original: "חח''י" (Chachay), a shorthand likely referring to the flow of life-force</note> from all the higher Divine emanations <note>Sephirot</note> toward the attribute of **Adonai** <note>The Lord / Kingdom</note>, as we have informed you. Because it draws from the attribute of Mercy, it is called **El** <note>a Name associated with kindness</note>, and because it draws from the Vitality, it is called **Chai** (Living). When Mercy and Life are joined together, it is called **El Chai**. As it draws this power into the attribute of **Adonai**, that attribute is also called the "Land of the Living" <note>original: "ארץ החיים" (Eretz HaChayim)</note>. 

This means it is the "land" where the supernal life-forces gather. By the power of this Name, the life of **Adonai** is rooted in all the various created beings in the world—such as the angels, all the heavenly hosts and their stars, and all the hosts of the earth and its offspring. This is the secret of the verse: "Let the earth bring forth a living soul according to its kind" <note>Genesis 1:24</note>. In the way of Supernal Wisdom, this verse includes the soul of every moving thing: every creature that creeps on the ground, every species of fish, bird, wild beast, and cattle, as well as the animal soul within man <gloss>a</gloss>, and included in this is the higher soul in man called the *Neshamah*. 

Therefore, our Sages interpreted this verse—<gloss>b</gloss> "Let the earth bring forth a living soul according to its kind"—as referring to the soul of the Messiah. How wondrous are their words and how mighty are their principles! From where do we learn to include in this verse the souls of all living beings, creeping things, fish, birds, beasts, human souls, and even the souls of angels, the heavenly host, the stars, and even the soul of the Messiah? You should know that all of this is included in this verse in a single word: **according to its kind** (*le-minah*). 

What does "according to its kind" mean? It means the soul of every single type of living being, each according to its species—if it is a higher being, then a higher soul; if an intermediate being, an intermediate soul; and if a lower being, a lower soul. Even the soul of the Messiah is included. All of this is contained in that word, "according to its kind." Let not the philosophers <note>The author is likely addressing medieval Aristotelian thinkers who argued that celestial beings like angels were pure intellects without "souls" in the biological sense</note> challenge me by saying that an angel has no soul. There is no creature in the world that does not have a "living soul" according to its kind. Everything is as it should be: the soul matches the "matter" of the creature—if the creature is supernal, the soul is supernal; if the creature is lowly, the soul is lowly. All souls, higher and lower, are drawn to them from the Name **Adonai**, which is called the "Land of the Living," by the power of **El Chai**. He is the one who pours the power of life into the Name **Adonai** from the Source of Life through the "Tree of Life." 

Because you will find that all living beings in the world receive life from **El Chai** through **Adonai**, we therefore ask on Rosh Hashanah <note>The Jewish New Year</note>: "Remember us for life" <note>original: "זכרנו לחיים"</note>. To whom are we directing this? To **El Chai**, our Shield. In this way, you may understand that one who wishes to attain eternal life should cleave to the word **El Chai** and draw the power of **El Chai** down to **Adonai** in his prayer. This was the longing and desire of King David, peace be upon him, when he said: "My soul thirsts for God, for the living God (*El Chai*)." 

When this attribute called **El Chai** is bound together with **Adonai**, then Israel achieves all their needs and requests. They will triumph over all their enemies, and no man shall stand against them. Joshua, peace be upon him, alluded to this when he said: "By this you shall know that a living God (*El Chai*) is among you, and that He will surely drive out from before you the Amorites, the Canaanites, etc." <note>Joshua 3:10</note>. Because we must bind the connection of the Sephirot and the levels to the attribute of **Adonai**, we say in the blessing following the "Verses of Praise" <gloss>c</gloss>: "Who chooses songs of praise, King, God, Life of the worlds." And anyone who wishes to seek...

# Gate 2, 201
## Page 25

The waters <note>referring to the divine flow often compared to water</note> **A** are three faithful witnesses to these matters. This attribute is called **Righteous** <note>original: "צדיק" (Zaddik)</note> throughout the entire Torah. Because it is called the Foundation <note>original: "יסוד" (Yesod)</note> and carries all things beneath it among all existing things, it is called the **Righteous One, the Foundation of the World**. The reason it is called "Righteous" is the secret of the abundance <note>original: "שפע" (Shefa) - the divine energy flowing from the higher realms</note> that it pours out, providing all goodness and blessing **B** and giving it to the attribute of **Adonai** <note>The Name associated with the Sephirah of Malkhut/Kingdom</note>. This is as the verse says: *The righteous one is gracious and gives.* <note>Psalm 37:21</note>

I must awaken your attention to a great and distinguished matter: **Know** that there are three names: Righteous (*Zaddik*), Justice (*Zedek*), and Charity/Righteousness (*Zedakah*). 
- The attribute of **El Chai** <note>The Living God</note> is called **Righteous** (*Zaddik*). **C**
- The attribute of **Adonai** is called **Justice** (*Zedek*). 
- When the **Righteous** (*Zaddik*) pours his blessing into **Justice** (*Zedek*), that abundance and emanation is called **Righteousness/Charity** (*Zedakah*). 

Thus, these three names are united as one: "Righteous" is to give; "Justice" is to receive; and "Righteousness/Charity" is the secret of the gift, the attachment, and the union. According to this secret, it is said: *The memory of the Righteous One is for a blessing.* <note>Proverbs 10:7</note> 

And now, I shall enlighten your path with a great principle: in the union <note>original: "זיוו"ג" (Zivug) - the mystical coupling of divine attributes</note>, the **Righteous** (*Zaddik*) pours his blessing and goodness upon **Justice** (*Zedek*), which is then called the "Land of the Living," and she provides goodness to all created beings. But if, Heaven forbid, the channels <note>original: "צנורות" (Tzinorot)</note> of this Righteous One are cut off and do not reach the attribute of **Justice**, **D** then she becomes filled from those pits called "Death." She then brings death and enacts all kinds of plagues and destruction in the world. (When Justice is united with Justice <note>referring to the lower aspect of judgment when severed from mercy</note>) (Explanation: This concerns the poor and the gracious, for the attribute of 'A' is a hidden matter). When he gives a gift from his blessings, or in that union called **Righteousness/Charity**, he brings to the attribute of **Justice** **E** life instead of death. This is the secret of the verse: *And Righteousness/Charity saves from death.* <note>Proverbs 10:2</note>

Come and see the great power of Charity (*Zedakah*): for when a person performs an act of charity, they draw the attribute of the **Righteous** (*Zaddik*) into the attribute of **Justice** (*Zedek*), bringing life to the world and saving it from death. And if it saves the world from death, how much more so does it save the person themselves? Do not say only from a strange <note>unnatural</note> death, but even from death itself. 

When the **Righteous** (*Zaddik*) is separated from **Justice** (*Zedek*) **F**, and the attribute of Justice remains empty (meaning, void of the abundance needed for the created world), then she rises to kill, destroy, uproot, and tear down, bringing many kinds of deaths upon the creatures. Some are natural deaths, some are deaths by plague, some are strange deaths, and various other kinds of death. 

Through this path, you should contemplate that whoever wishes to inherit the "Land of the Living" must cleave to the attribute of the **Righteous** (*Zaddik*). For anyone who cleaves to the attribute of Justice is called "Righteous" after His name and inherits the Land of the Living. Regarding this, it is said: *Your people shall all be righteous; they shall inherit the land forever.* <note>Isaiah 60:21</note> You already know what our Sages, of blessed memory, taught regarding this: "All Israel has a portion in the World to Come, as it is said: Your people shall all be righteous; they shall inherit the land forever." <note>Mishnah Sanhedrin 10:1</note>

Now we must awaken your attention to a great principle, which is a foundation and root for a person to know the severity of every transgression. Behold, we have informed you in this book that when the attribute of **Adonai** is filled from the Supernal Source called **El Chai** and **Righteous**, she is blessed and stands in her fullness, supplying the needs of all creatures. Thus, the entire world stands in its fullness, in joy, and in all...

# Gate 1

->Always watering the inheritance of fields, vineyards, and orchards, and providing for all human needs and activities as they move from place to place.<- The third point: he who seeks true life before the Lord <note>original: "י"י" - the Tetragrammaton</note>, these waters will make known his place. This occurs when a person walks along the bank of this river and does not depart from its edges; they will make known the place from which the river is drawn and lead him to the Source from which Life emerges.

**A** The sign for this is: *From Matanah to Nachaliel, and from Nachaliel to Bamot.* <note>Numbers 21:18-19. These place names are interpreted here as stages of divine emanation.</note> According to this path, a person must contemplate what the Blessed One said in the Torah: *See, I have set before you today life and good, and death and evil.* <note>Deuteronomy 30:15</note> For one who clings to the attribute of **El Chai** <term>The Living God; associated with the Sephirah of Yesod</term> will find life and good, but one who distances himself from the Living God will find the opposite: death and evil. For all systems are arranged one corresponding to the other. The sign for this is: *God has made even this corresponding to that.* <note>Ecclesiastes 7:14</note> This attribute is called **Foundation** <term>Yesod</term>; just as a house leans upon its foundations, so the attribute of **Adonai** <term>The Name associated with the Sephirah of Malkhut/Kingdom</term> leans upon the attribute of Foundation. **B** This is because the attribute of Adonai has no abundance or existence except through the attribute of Foundation, which is called the "Living God" <note>El Chai</note>. In the Talmud <note>Tractate Chagigah 12b</note> they said: "On what does the world stand? On a single pillar, and its name is Righteous <note>Zaddik</note>, as it is said: *The Righteous is the foundation of the world.*" <note>Proverbs 10:25</note> What we must awaken your attention to is that not all foundations are the same: there is a foundation that is above and its building is below; there is a foundation in the middle of its building; and there is a foundation that is below and its building is above.

**C** The sign for these are: the Upper World, the Middle World, and the Lower World. And a sign within a sign: Upper-Upper, Middle-Middle, Lower-Lower. The secret lies in the vowel points *Cholam*, *Shurek*, and *Chirik*. <note>The Cholam is a dot above a letter, Shurek is in the middle, and Chirik is below.</note> Our Sages of blessed memory have already hinted at this: "Come and see that the way of the Holy One is not like the way of flesh and blood. A human being is below and his burden is above him, but the Holy One is not so; He is above and His 'burden' is beneath Him," as it is said: *For the Lord is high and lifted up.* <note>Isaiah 57:15</note> Following this matter, you should contemplate that the attribute of **El Chai**, called Foundation, is above, and **Adonai**, called its "building," is below it. This is the wondrous secret of how Adonai yearns and longs to be elevated through the elevation of the Living God, **D** and desires to ascend to it always. Do not be surprised by this, for there is an example in this world: do you not see that the loadstone <note>original: "אבן השואב" - a magnet</note> draws things to it while it is above and what it carries is below it? So too the element of fire, the element of air, and the element of <meta>water</meta>

"Source" <note>Makor</note> in the Arabic language is *Suns* <note>possibly referring to a spring or fountain</note>. There is a foundation in the middle, like the celestial foundations and buildings, for the heavens are circular and every sphere has its foundation in its center. And there is a foundation below with its building above, such as our physical lower world. Through the sign of the vowel points, you will understand that the letters are like bodies and the vowels are like souls, giving them existence and the ability to move.

# Gate 2

To merit, and in this way you should contemplate what our Sages of blessed memory said: "Upon what does the world stand? Upon one pillar, which is the Tzaddik <note>The Righteous One; a title for the Sefirah of Yesod</note>, as it is said: *And the Righteous is the foundation of the world* (Proverbs 10:25)." And know that this attribute is called "Good" throughout the entire Torah, and as a sign, they said: *Tell the Righteous **for it is good*** (Isaiah 3:10). And now we must awaken you to this matter: know that all the emanations descending from above, from all the upper <term>Sefirot</term> <note>The ten creative powers or attributes of God in Kabbalah</note>, all operate in the way of goodness and perfection. Even if Judgment (*Din*) descends to the world through the attribute of Fear <margin>א</margin> and Might (*Gevurah*), if the matter comes by way of the Righteous One (*Tzaddik*), it all comes in the way of absolute goodness. No "evil" acts upon anything in the world except for the benefit of the one who was damaged, because the matter came to them through the Tzaddik, and everything is for the best. This is the secret of what our Sages of blessed memory said: "No evil thing descends from heaven." If so, what is the meaning of the verse: *For evil came down from the Lord* (Micah 1:12)? <margin>ב</margin> Know that outside the partitions <note>Original Hebrew: *Mechitzot*; refers to the boundaries of the divine realm</note> (meaning in the "External Forces" <note>Original Hebrew: *Aniyei*, likely a corruption or specific term for the 'others'</note> and called *Galgati* and *Zorin* <note>Technical names for external spiritual forces</note>) of the Sefirot, there are "Plagues" called "Evil," and they are <margin>ג</margin> outside the Sefirot, surrounding them. Sometimes they attach themselves to the attribute of *Adonai* <note>The Name of God associated with the tenth Sefirah, Malchut</note> and descend to the world, and this is <margin>ד</margin> the secret of "For [evil] came down *from* the Lord" and not "from *He*" <note>A subtle linguistic distinction in Hebrew implies the evil comes from a source associated with God's name but not directly from His essence</note>. Along these lines, it is said of the Works of Creation: *And God saw that it was good* (Genesis 1:4), and at the end it is said: *And behold, it was very good* (Genesis 1:31). Our Sages said in *Genesis Rabbah*: "'Behold it was good'—this is the Good Inclination; 'Very [good]'—this is Death." For even Death, when it comes through the attribute of the Tzaddik, is called life and good. This is the secret of why the Righteous are called "living" even in their death. Concerning this, it is said: *And the Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil* (Genesis 2:9). When the attribute of *Adonai*, which is called the Tree of Knowledge, draws from the attribute of "Good" <note>Yesod</note>, all its actions are called "Good," and all life and all death that come to the world are entirely good. In this way, Nahum of Gamzu used to say regarding every plague and every illness that came upon him: "This too is for the good." And Rabbi Akiva, peace be upon him, used to say always: "Everything the Heaven does, it does for the good," as in that story in Tractate Berakhot in the chapter titled *Ha-Roeh* (The One Who Sees). But if, Heaven forbid, the channels of the Tzaddik are cut off from flowing to the attribute of Justice <note>Tzedek, another name for Malchut</note> which is called the Tree of Knowledge, then <margin>ה</margin> the attribute of Justice draws upon itself from the many

<margin>א</margin> "Absolute goodness": This means it is called "Good" because it bestows upon the <term>Malchut</term> <note>The final Sefirah, representing the physical world</note> that which it draws from the Upper Good, such as the fragments of Beauty (*Tiferet*). Thus, everything will be for the good of the world, for even if sickness or misfortune occurs, it is for the good, as will be explained shortly—that it is intended to awaken people to return in repentance. 

<margin>ב</margin> Know that outside the partition of the Sefirot are the forces of "Plagues" called "Evil." These are the messengers of Judgment and the forces of impurity mentioned in Chapter 30, which attach themselves to the attribute of *Adonai* to receive its power and might, as explained nearby. Thus, the good abundance that normally descends is turned into "evil" for the recipients, so they may be punished by it. This is based on its power as "evil," as I wrote above in the introduction to the book.

<margin>ג</margin> "Outside the Sefirot, surrounding them": This does not mean literally that they surround all of them, but rather they surround the <term>Yesod</term> <note>Foundation</note> and the <term>Atarah</term> <note>Crown/Crest of Malchut</note>. They are truly at a distance, like husks (*Klippot*) around a tree. They are not attached like skin, but rather like the appearance of a cloud or mist around it, creating a barrier for sinners. These forces are far from the purity of the Circumcision <note>Likely referring to the spiritual state of Yesod</note>. These external forces are three, and the most external and highest of them are included in the mystery of the "Great Sea." As taught in Chapter 30, they are the source of all judgments and the external forces of impurity. These surround the world from above. This is the secret of the "Hand" reaching until the joint of the fingers. This was also taught regarding the reception of divine abundance: sometimes these forces attach themselves to these Sefirot in a way that causes the channels to become "crooked" or "leaking," turning toward judgment. Nevertheless, everything ultimately goes through the Great Sea, and from there that abundance descends to them. It is as if they "ascend" above, but they are never truly joined or attached there, Heaven forbid. For from the upper eight Sefirot they never receive abundance, because the abundance there always descends with the intent of perfecting creation. However, among the sages of the Kabbalah, some say that they do not even receive from *Malchut* itself, but only from the Palaces (*Heikhalot*) of the world of Action, which correspond to *Malchut*. These are the "foreign" palaces that receive from the attributes of Kindness (*Chesed*) and Fear (*Pachad*). These palaces are external but strong enough to receive the influence of Kindness and Fear from *Malchut*. Thus, they all receive from Kindness and Fear themselves, but the influence never ascends higher, Heaven forbid—especially these forces, for they are entirely impure. They are called "Outside the Camp." Even from these holy Palaces they are distant, for what does the impure have to do with the pure? Our intention here is to bring the matter closer to human understanding, and Blessed is He who knows and bears witness. The matter of the Palaces is explained in the commentary of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai and in the "Explanation of the System" in the Gate of Malchut.

<margin>ד</margin> This is the secret of "For evil came down from the Lord," for the attribute that attaches itself to the Name of the Lord increases within it.

Know that the attribute of **El Chai**, which is called "Tzaddik" <note>The Righteous One</note>, stands to look, to see, and to gaze upon the children of men. When the "Righteous One" sees that people are engaging in the Torah and the commandments, and that they desire to purify themselves and conduct themselves in purity and cleanliness, then the attribute of the **Tzaddik** spreads out, expands, and is filled with every kind of abundance and emanation from above to pour out onto the attribute of **Adonai**. This is done to give a good reward to those who uphold the Torah and the commandments and purify themselves. Thus, the whole world finds itself blessed through those righteous people, and even the attribute of **Adonai** is blessed through them. # Gate 2

It is said: *The Lord will bless His people with peace* (Psalm 29:11). Our Sages, of blessed memory, said: "You have no vessel that holds blessing other than peace." Know that since Peace is the conclusion of the nine upper luminaries <note>original: "aspaklario't"; referring to the nine Sefirot above the final one, Malkhut</note>, and it is that which pours blessing into the Name **Adonai** <note>The Name associated with the Sefirah of Malkhut, the gateway to the physical world</note>, it was therefore established at the end of the Priestly Blessing and at the end of the final blessing of the *Amidah* prayer. The reason is that by its word they shall go out, and by its word they shall come in—all those who seek to cleave to the Supernal Light, which is called "the life of the World to Come."

I must awaken you to the inner secret: Know that our Sages said that when Moses ascended to the heights, the Holy One, blessed be He, said to him: "Moses, is there no 'Peace' in your city?" <insert>2</insert> He replied: "Is there any servant who gives a greeting of 'Peace' to his Master?" <insert>3</insert> God said to him: "You should have assisted Me." At that moment, Moses our Teacher, peace be upon him, opened his mouth and said: *And now, I pray, let the power of my Lord [Adonai] be great* (Numbers 14:17). What is written immediately after? *I have pardoned according to your word* (Numbers 14:20), and *As I live*—as if to say: "You have given Me life with your words." The secret here is that the attribute called **Shalom** <note>Peace</note> pours life into the attribute of **Adonai** when they are joined as one. So great is the power of Peace that even the celestial beings require it, as it is written: *He makes peace in His high places* (Job 25:2). When a person takes hold of the Torah and the commandments, it is as if—so to speak—he brings peace to the Heavenly Host <note>original: "pamalia shel ma'ala"</note>. The secret of this is: *Or let him take hold of My strength, that he may make peace with Me; and he shall make peace with Me* (Isaiah 27:5).

Know that this attribute is also called **Zichron** <note>Remembrance or Memory</note>. In this place, all the inhabitants of the world are remembered for all their deeds, for better or for worse. According to the "Remembrance" that comes from this place, so is the judgment decreed upon all who enter the world. For this reason, the day of Rosh Hashanah is called a "Day of Remembrance" <note>Yom HaZikaron</note>. The secret of Rosh Hashanah is the secret of **Adonai**; the "Day of Remembrance" is the secret of **El Chai** <note>The Living God; a title for the Sefirah of Yesod</note>. Because we stand in judgment on Rosh Hashanah and all our deeds come for accounting and remembrance before **Adonai**, this is the secret of why we say: "Remember us for life, O King who desires life... write us in the Book of Life... for the sake of the Living God [El Chai] and our Shield."

This attribute remembers all forgotten things; therefore, on Rosh Hashanah, we conclude the blessing with "Who remembers the Covenant" <note>Zokher HaBerit</note>. Because this is the secret of Remembrance and the secret of the Covenant, we seal the blessing with these two matters: "Who remembers the Covenant." Because David, peace be upon him, desired to connect and cleave to this attribute, he would say: *A Psalm of David, to bring to remembrance* (Psalm 38:1). This is also the secret of the "reminder-portion" <note>azkarata</note> of the meal offering, and the secret of the "meal offering of remembrance, bringing iniquity to mind" (Numbers 5:15). The sin of the suspected adulteress <note>sotah</note> is dependent on this place for punishment, for it is a "meal offering of jealousy." In this place resides "jealousy," as hinted by the phrase *the jealousy of the Lord of Hosts* (Isaiah 9:6). Furthermore, "deposits" <note>pikdonot</note> are like "remembrances" <note>zichronot</note>, except that "deposits" are through **Adonai** while "remembrances" are through **El Chai**. Since these two attributes—**El Chai** and **Adonai**—are perfected when joined together, the Holy One, blessed be He, gave the Sabbath day to Israel to correspond to these two attributes.

---

In Gate 2, he explains the "vessel": "When a person takes hold of the Torah and the commandments, etc." This is what the Holy One said to Moses: "Is there no peace in your city?" meaning, is the attribute of Peace not attached to your "City"? This "City" is the Kingdom <note>Malkhut</note>, of which Moses was a servant to God; she was his "Master," as is known to the Kabbalists. Therefore, Moses replied: "Is there any servant who gives peace to his Master?" meaning, does any person have the power to benefit or harm Him? For it is the celestial beings who should assist to cause the flow and maintain them in peace. But the Holy One said to him: "Even so, you should have helped Me," meaning, you are the emissaries who awaken the "Mayim Nukvin" <note>term: "feminine waters"; the spiritual longing or initiative from below that triggers a divine response from above</note>. It is written in the hand of man to help and assist in the Name, and to perform an action below so that an awakening occurs above, as I have mentioned many times.

<insert>4</insert> Immediately, Moses opened and said: *And now, I pray, let the power [koach] of the Lord [YHVH] be great.* The meaning is: let the abundance coming from the "Tiferet" <note>the Sefirah of Beauty/Balance</note> to the "Power" <note>koach</note>, which is the numerical value of 28, increase. This refers to the Kingdom <note>Malkhut</note> called **Adonai** in the accounts of Peace. This is the secret of *As I live...* (Numbers 14:21). The secret of Rosh Hashanah is the secret of **Adonai**, which is the first [Sefirah from the bottom], and it contains the [other] Sefirot; it is the first Sefirah from the bottom up. This is the secret of *and it was written for a remembrance.* For all remembrances come to merit the lower world. When the world is worthy to be remembered for good, it is called "Remembrance" <note>azkaratah</note>, for then it is remembered above as a "remembrance for a pleasant aroma." But the opposite is true of the offering of the suspected adulteress; therefore, no frankincense or oil is placed upon it <note>as these represent light and wisdom</note>, for there is no drawing down of good abundance. As it is written regarding the *Sotah*: *it is a meal offering of remembrance, bringing iniquity to mind.* If the sacrifice is for mercy, it would be pleasant; therefore, he calls it a "meal offering of remembrance" as God said "and I will remember." But if not, it is for judgment, and that is a "meal offering of jealousy." In this place is the "Jealousy"—meaning the eye that separates the "Aluf" <note>The Chief/God</note> and the connection. This causes the Remembrance to be withdrawn. Therefore, in this place, "Jealousy" is revealed in cases of sexual immorality. What it says and explains as "Jealousies" (plural) is like "herbs" <note>lan'anah</note> and "wormwood," for the punishments for sexual immorality are dependent on them, as explained earlier in this Gate. # Gate 2

<gloss>1</gloss> The "External Forces" <note>original: "Chitzonim"; these are the spiritual forces of imbalance or "husks" that exist outside the divine light</note> are called a "sickly evil." They are the source of various types of destroyers and calamities sent to the inhabitants of the world according to the requirements of strict judgment. When these forces are active, every plague and every wound is renewed in the world; this is the mystery of the **Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil**. These forces stand opposite one another <note>meaning the forces of Good and Evil are balanced in the world to allow for free will</note>. However, you must contemplate the matter of Moses our Teacher, peace be upon him, of whom it was said: *And she saw him, that he was good* (Exodus 2:2). This means he was attached to this specific attribute of "Good." Therefore, when he was born, the entire house was filled with light. You should also contemplate the blessing of "The Good and He who does Good" <note>original: "Ha-Tov Ve-ha-Metiv"; the fourth blessing of the Grace after Meals</note>, which was established by the Sages at Yavne regarding the fallen soldiers of Betar <note>Referencing the Bar Kokhba revolt; the Sages thanked God that the bodies did not decompose and were eventually allowed to be buried</note>. "The Good" refers to the fact that they did not decompose, and "He who does Good" refers to the fact that they were eventually given a proper burial. Know and believe that the attribute of the **Righteous One** <note>original: "Tzaddik"; often identified with the Sefirah of Yesod</note> stands ready to fulfill the will of anyone who asks and to show mercy when a person intends to mend and improve their ways. Concerning this, it is said: *The Lord is good to all, and His mercies are over all His works* (Psalm 145:9). This is the "Guide" for sinners toward repentance. Regarding this, it is said: *Good and upright is the Lord; therefore He guides sinners in the way* (Psalm 25:8). The explanation is this: He brings suffering, plagues, and illnesses upon people entirely for their own benefit, so that they will return in repentance. Thus, all those sufferings and plagues are found to be a "complete good," for they are the cause for a person to repent and merit the Supernal Good and the life of the **World to Come**. This is the meaning of the verse: *Good and upright is the Lord; therefore He guides sinners in the way.* Understand that the Name **Adonai** <note>representing the Presence of God in the physical world</note> is sometimes called *Ehyeh* <note>I Shall Be</note> when it prepares to create. <insert>Every provision for the created world was looked upon and prepared through the attribute of Good.</insert> He was the Creator of all that is created and the Former of all forms, as it says regarding the work of Creation: *And God saw that it was good* (Genesis 1). This means He looked upon them through the attribute of "Good" and prepared them, and then created the world. This is the fundamental truth. If not for the attribute of Good, the Name *Adonai* (which is called "God" in the account of Creation) would not be able to complete the provision and needs of all creatures. Because all the works of Creation were sealed with this attribute called "Good," it says: *And God saw everything that He had made, and behold, it was very good* (Genesis 1:31).

<gloss>2</gloss> Sometimes this attribute is called **Good Intellect** <note>original: "Sechel Tov"</note>, because through this attribute, a person enters into the **Shining Mirror** <note>original: "Aspaklaria Ha-Me'irah"; a higher level of prophetic or spiritual perception</note>. Through the attribute of the "Living God" <note>original: "El Chai"</note>, a person gains the insight to enter, to know, to contemplate, and to become wise in the truth of the Lord. This attribute of "Good Intellect" stands by a person when they fulfill the Torah and the commandments. This is the secret of the verse: *The beginning of wisdom is the fear of the Lord; a good intellect have all those who do them* (Psalm 111:10). The great secret is: *One who acts wisely concerning a matter shall find good* (Proverbs 16:20). Because King David, peace be upon him, was attached to this attribute, he would say: *A Maskil [Psalm of Insight] of David*. Every use of the term *Maskil* <note>Insight/Understanding</note> in this context is dependent on this attribute. <gloss>3</gloss> One who knows the secret of "Grace" <note>original: "Chen"</note> will know that *A good intellect grants grace* (Proverbs 13:15). Know that there is a difference between "one who has insight" (*Maskil*) and "one who understands" (*Meven*). The secret of the "Understander" is that they draw from the source of Understanding (*Binah*). <gloss>4</gloss> The "One with Insight" (*Maskil*) is one who draws from the "Good Dwelling" <note>original: "Mashkena Ha-Tov"</note> from beginning to end. Behold, this attribute is called throughout the entire Torah **Peace** (*Shalom*). We have already informed you of the reason: when Israel is righteous and good, the Name *Adonai* is in its fullness and perfection, with every kind of flow and blessing. But if, Heaven forbid, Israel leaves the will of the Name (blessed be He), then the attribute of Mercy, called **YHVH**, departs from the Temple of *Adonai*, and she is left empty and low. When a Righteous One awakens in the world to return in repentance or to mend what was damaged, then this attribute called **Peace** acts as a "Good Advocate" <note>original: "Melitz Tov"</note> between *YHVH* and *Adonai*. He is the one who establishes peace between them and brings them close to dwell together without separation or "cutting" <note>original: "Kitzutz"; a term for creating a rift in the divine unity</note> in the world. At that moment, *YHVH* is found to be One. Believe that it is impossible for blessing to come to the world except through this attribute called Peace, and regarding this, it is said—

---

1. **The External Forces:** This means that the power of the "Small What" <note>original: "Mah Ha-Ketannah"</note> that flows and is born upon it was prepared for the middle sides and recognizes its power to act according to their judgment—to kill, to wound, and to destroy—and there she receives from them...
2. **Sometimes this attribute is called Good Intellect:** Because through this attribute, one enters to look upon the "Accompanying Vision."
3. **Explanation of Grace:** The Grace of the Prayer is also called "Good." The "Good" enters to remind and to provide for the "One who acts wisely concerning a matter shall find good."
4. **One who knows the secret of Grace, etc.:** This is dependent on the Kingdom (*Malkhut*), which is simply called "Grace." The Prayer is called "Great Grace" in the name of the hidden treasures of the Presence (*Shekhinah*). For this reason, the Kabbalists are called "Masters of Grace" (*Ba'alei Chen*). The Foundation (*Yesod*) takes the Grace from the Prayer and gives it to the Kingdom.
6. **Insight (Maskil) from the drawing of Good from beginning to end:** The explanation is that "Understanding" (*Meven*) is the secret of the Prayer starting from the attribute of Understanding (*Binah*), while "Insight" (*Sechel*) is the end of thought...
7. **Then she is left as an empty memory:** For the matter of emptiness is here...

# Gate 8

<meta>modern pencil '28' in upper left margin</meta>

This is **My God** <note>original: "Elohai"</note>. “The house of my prayer” is the secret of **The Lord** <note>original: "Adonai"</note>. The tongue literally mentions Him regarding the two attributes of “Remember” and “Keep” <note>Referencing the two versions of the Fourth Commandment: "Remember the Sabbath" in Exodus and "Keep the Sabbath" in Deuteronomy</note>. If, God forbid, one profanes the Sabbath, it is as if he denies the primary principle, because the Sabbath is the core of the **Tree** <note>The Tree of Life/Sefirot</note> from bottom to top. Therefore, this attribute is called **Foundation of the World** <note>original: "Yesod Olam"</note> because it carries upon itself the powers of **The Lord** <note>Adonai</note>. It is the core of cores and the core of the knowledge of the Name (may He be blessed) for the Gate closest to all created beings. This is the secret of the core of the lower letter **Vav** <note>The letter ו in the Divine Name, which Kabbalists associate with the vertical channel of Yesod</note> <margin>A</margin> in the image of a foundation from bottom to top. Because the Sabbath is the secret of drawing power from the higher **Sefirot** <note>Divine emanations</note> into the name **The Lord** <note>Adonai</note>, it is the secret of the unification of all the Sefirot; for the **Living God** <note>original: "El Chai," an appellation for Yesod</note> rests within the name **The Lord** <note>Adonai</note> in the secret of *And He rested on the seventh day* and the secret of *And God finished on the seventh day*. Our Sages (of blessed memory) said: “The Holy One, Blessed be He, said to Moses: ‘I have a good gift in My treasury, and **Sabbath** is its name, and I wish to give it to Israel; go and inform them.’” Do you not see that the Sabbath sits within His treasury? And you already know that His treasury is **The Lord** <note>Adonai/Malchut</note>. Therefore, anyone who observes the Sabbath according to its laws brings these two Names <note>Yesod and Malchut</note> close together and unites them one with the other. When these two Names are brought close, all the Sefirot are found to be united. This is the secret of **Rest** <note>original: "Menucha"</note>, which is the "Rest" (*Noach*) and "Grace" (*Chen*) of **The Lord** <note>Adonai</note> <margin>B</margin>, as it is said: *The spirit of Elijah rested upon Elisha*. And it says: *And He rested on the seventh day*. Therefore, <margin>C</margin> it is said: "Remember" and "Keep." For this reason, <margin>D</margin> because the soul, through the **Living God** <note>El Chai</note>, flies from the name **The Lord** <note>Adonai</note>, it was necessary to say that an **Additional Soul** <note>original: "Nefesh Yeterah"</note> is added to a person on the Sabbath and is taken from him at the conclusion of the Sabbath, in the secret of: *On the seventh day He ceased from work and was refreshed* <note>original: "Vayinaphash," which shares a root with "Nefesh" (soul)</note>. <margin>E</margin> Whoever has eyes will see the matter explicitly. Thus, the Sabbath binds the final Sefirah, which is **The Lord** <note>Adonai/Malchut</note>, with all the higher Sefirot. Therefore, the Sabbath is called the “Seventh Day,” as it is the seventh Sefirah from **Understanding** <note>original: "Binah"</note> downward. It turns out that **Understanding** <note>Binah</note> binds the two Sefirot above it <note>Keter and Chokhmah</note> with the six Sefirot below it <note>Chesed through Yesod</note>, and it is also the seventh from bottom to top. Thus you find it said that the **Living God** <note>El Chai/Yesod</note> is the secret of the seventh in this world, and **Understanding** <note>Binah</note> is the secret of the seventh in the World to Come. In **Understanding** <note>Binah</note> <margin>F</margin>, all redemptions and all types of freedom are bound. I must awaken you to a great principle: Know that when the attribute of the **Living God** <note>El Chai</note> is united with the attribute of **The Lord** <note>Adonai</note>, then the attribute of **The Lord** sits upon the Throne of Kingship and rules over all created beings. But when the **Living God** is separated and departs from it, then the attribute of **The Lord**, which is called the **Shekhinah** <note>Divine Presence</note>, goes into exile and is enslaved <margin>G</margin> under other governments and foreign powers. This is the secret of: *A handmaid that is heir to her mistress* (Proverbs 30:23). Therefore, they said one must “link Redemption to Prayer,” <note>A requirement in the morning service to transition immediately from the blessing of "Redeemer of Israel" to the "Amidah" prayer</note> for the secret of Redemption is the **Living God** <note>El Chai</note> and the secret of Prayer is **The Lord** <note>Adonai</note>. When both are linked to one another, then everything is in a state of unity, perfection, and blessing. <margin>H</margin> And the secret of *The Lord supports all who fall* and it says:

->Fallen<-

---

(A) In the image of a foundation from bottom to top: Meaning, regarding the generative forces above, for the order is reversed; they take hold first. It is like a foundation from bottom to top. But regarding the thing that receives from it—which is the foundation and its existence—it can be called “below,” and from it, “above,” as will be explained regarding the Foundation (*Yesod*). (B) That is to say, "The spirit of Elijah rested upon Elisha"—explained as being from the power of a spiritual speaker. (C) Therefore, it mentions "Remember" and "Keep"—explained as "Remember" being the power of the Luminary, which is the Assembly of Israel. (D) And because the soul flies by way of the **Living God** <note>El Chai</note>: Explained as flying from its storehouse, which is **Understanding** <note>Binah</note>. That is to say, it is "breathed in," then enters through the **Living God** and comes to the world through the **Divine Presence** <note>Shekhinah</note>. (E) "Whoever has eyes will see the matter explicitly": For his intention is not that there are literally two souls, only that then, at the arrival of the Sabbath, one cleaves to and is elevated by that attribute which is called Sabbath and is called "Soul," because of its "flying" from there and being added to by the flow from it. This is why it "refreshes the wise man," and at the conclusion of the Sabbath, it is taken back from him—meaning, like a thing that is hidden, he examines himself, and from the attachment to the Sabbath, he recovers this flow. (F) "And in Understanding (*Binah*) all redemptions and types of freedom are bound": Because it is the Jubilee <note>original: "Yovel," the 50th year of liberty</note>, and the end of all things is to return there; and they all cease their rule, and redemption shall be given to all, and its existence will be further explained, with God's help, in Gate 8. (G) "And is enslaved under other governments": She must lower her face to the depths (and this is the secret of the Exile of the **Shekhinah**). According to their intention in prayer, she desires and longs for the union of the Source <note>original: "Mazzal"</note> and its precision, according to the intention of the Priests' prayer, and not through the movements of Strict Judgment, as we have explained many times. (H) "The Lord supports all who fall": Explained as the **Righteous One** and **Righteousness** <note>original: "Tzaddik" (Yesod) and "Tzedek" (Malchut)</note>. (I) "And to rise": As it is explained, "She shall not rise again" <note>Amos 5:2</note>—explained as our Rabbis of blessed memory taught.

# Gate 1

These [matters], <gloss>1</gloss> “Remember” <note>original: "Zachor"</note> pertains to the day, corresponding to the **Living God** <note>original: "El Chai," the attribute of Yesod</note>, and “Keep” <note>original: "Shamor"</note> pertains to the night, corresponding to **The Lord** <note>original: "Adonai," the attribute of Malchut/Sovereignty</note>. Therefore, it is said in the Ten Commandments: “Remember” and “Keep” <note>Referencing the two versions of the Sabbath commandment in Exodus 20 and Deuteronomy 5</note>. Know and believe as a true tradition <term>Kabbalah</term> that the source of all blessings that come to the attribute of **The Lord** <note>Adonai</note> to bless Israel <gloss>2</gloss> is this place called “Remembrance” <gloss>3</gloss>. And the secret is: *In every place where I cause my name to be mentioned, I will come to you and bless you* <gloss>3</gloss>, and it is written: *The memory of the righteous is a blessing.* <gloss>4</gloss> And the hidden secret is: *The Lord has remembered us; He will bless.*

And corresponding to this attribute, the Blessed Lord gave to Israel the **Secret of the Sabbath**. I must inform you how this is so. Know that the three upper Sefirot—which are **Crown** <note>Keter</note>, **Wisdom** <note>Chochmah</note>, and **Understanding** <note>Binah</note>—are unified above. When the Sefirot are bound one to another, Understanding <note>Binah</note> unites with the six Sefirot beneath it, down to this Sefirah called **Living** <note>Chai/Yesod</note>, which is called **Sabbath**.

Upon this principle was the creation of the world in six days <gloss>5</gloss> and on the seventh day He rested <note>original: "Shabat"</note>. Behold, the Sabbath corresponds to the Sefirah of **Foundation** <note>Yesod</note>, which is the Sefirah of the **Living God** <note>El Chai</note>. Therefore, the Sabbath day is called the "Source of Blessings and Holiness," as it is said: *And God blessed the seventh day and sanctified it, for on it He rested.* Thus, the Sabbath day is the source of all blessings and the drawing down of holiness to the lower realms.

Know that the person who keeps the Sabbath according to the law becomes like a **Throne for the Chariot** <note>Merkavah</note> for the Blessed Name. Therefore, the Sabbath is called "Rest" <note>original: "Menuchah"</note>. It is written: *This is my resting place forever and ever.* It is as if the Blessed Lord rests upon human beings and dwells upon them like a king upon his throne. The sign is *And He rested on the seventh day*—He Himself rested. It follows that anyone who keeps the Sabbath according to the law is as if he fulfills the entire Torah. The Prophet said: *Happy is the man who does this, and the son of man who holds it fast; who keeps the Sabbath from profaning it, and keeps his hand from doing any evil.*

Know and believe (and so it is written in many places) that one who has marital relations from Sabbath eve to Sabbath eve <note>Friday night to Friday night</note> merits righteous children, for the Sabbath is the attribute of the **Righteous One** <note>Tzadik, another name for Yesod</note> worthy of the life of the World to Come, for Sabbath is the secret of the **Living God** <note>El Chai</note>. Of him it is said: *Who gives his fruit in its season.* Therefore the Prophet said: *Thus says the Lord to the eunuchs who keep My Sabbaths, and choose what I desire, and hold fast to My covenant.* Could it be that the eunuchs are the most praised in Israel, and only eunuchs keep the Sabbath? Rather, the explanation of the verse is this: those righteous ones who, during the six days of the week, do not have marital relations but are like eunuchs, and on Sabbath nights they have their relations <gloss>7</gloss>. For the language of “keeping” <note>original: "Yishmoru"</note> is the language of the woman <note>referring to the female aspect of the Divine, Malchut</note>, as it is said: *Of all that I have said to the woman, she shall keep.* <gloss>8</gloss> And the sign is: “Remember” for the day and “Keep” for the night. And when they do so, what is written? *And I will bring them to my ->holy mountain and make them joyful in my house of prayer. My holy mountain<-*

---

The Blessed Lord gave the Sabbath day to Israel corresponding to these two attributes <note>Remember/Day/Yesod and Keep/Night/Malchut</note>. The meaning is so that they may inherit both, and the Sabbath day corresponds to:
(1) **Remember** <note>Zachor</note>, which is the attribute of the Day, and the Night from it corresponds to **Keep** <note>Shamor</note>, which is the attribute of Night—like a Sefirah in the Gate of the 50 Gates of the Temple. The language of the scripture is "Remember" for the Male and "Keep" for the Bride <note>the Shekhinah/Malchut</note>, and it is Day, and "Keep" is for the Night.
(2) And the secret is: *In every place where I cause my name to be mentioned...* This explains **Sovereignty** <note>Malchut</note>, which is the name, and the Male is the [letter] **Vav**, like the Sefirah in the Gate of the 50 Gates of the Ascent built here.
(3) And it is written: *The righteous is for a blessing.* You already know that this is through the flow of blessing included there, bringing its destruction <note>unclear: perhaps referring to breaking the husks of evil</note>.
(4) Regarding what was said, "the hidden secret is *The Lord has remembered us; He will bless*," the explanation is known: when saying *The Lord has remembered us* <note>original: "Zacharenu," which can also be read as "Our males"</note>, it means the males among us He will bless. It implies that the Lord, who is our Male [aspect], will bless us. This follows what is said in the **Book of the Brightness** <term>Sefer HaBahir</term>: "Remember" and "Keep" are for the Bride. You know who our Male is—"Remembrances" <note>Zichronot</note> is a doubling of the tongue—and who the Female is: she is the Queen <note>Malchut</note> in whom are the deposits and the Torah. As it is said: *Of all that I have said to the woman, she shall keep*, and for her light she shall also keep for the completed request. The Male was the King, the Lord of Hosts of prayers and the **Foundation** <note>Yesod</note> (in the secret that "all that happened to Jacob happened to Joseph") <note>A Midrashic link between the patriarch Jacob and his son Joseph, who represents Yesod</note> because their matters are one and their essence is equal in every place. And He proved it with mercy, as it says: *Remember Your mercies... therefore My heart yearns for him, I will surely have compassion on him, says the Lord.*
(5) *And on the seventh day He rested.* Because the Foundation <note>Yesod</note>, which is the seventh, rested [Sabbath] by coming into Sovereignty <note>Malchut</note> in one union and attachment. One "Sabbath" for the Foundation and one for its Night.
(6) And of him it is said: *Who gives his fruit in its season.* The explanation of "His Season" <note>original: "Be'ito"</note> is when the "Season/Time" <note>Et</note> connects with the [letter] **He** <note>the final letter of the Divine Name, representing Malchut</note>. Foundation is the end of the [divine] equalizing, and the word "Season" has already been explained as a nickname for the Righteous One <note>Tzadik/Yesod</note>.
(7) For the language of "Keep" is the language of the woman. The explanation of the verse is like *And his father kept the matter*, meaning the eunuchs [abstain] from one Sabbath eve to the next.
(8) The language itself proves these two attributes: "Remember" and "Keep." The terms "My Holy Mountain" and "My House of Prayer" literally point to these attributes, for Prayer is in Sovereignty <note>Malchut</note>.

# Gate 2
**G**
<meta>pencil mark: 89; catchword: [will return]</meta>

**The Lord** <note>original: "Adonai," the Sefirah of Malchut (Sovereignty)</note> acts to bring about redemption as an emissary of the **Lord** [YHVH] <note>The Tetragrammaton, the highest four-letter name of God</note>, saving the righteous and redeeming them from every mishap, illness, and all types of destruction and calamity. In that moment, this attribute is called **The Redeeming Angel**. Because the attribute of **Adonai**, which is called the **Divine Presence** <term>Shekhinah: The aspect of God that dwells within the world</term>, accompanied Jacob on his mission for the Lord—as it is said: *If God will be with me and guard me on this path... then the Lord shall be my God* <note>Genesis 28:20-21</note>—this attribute accompanied Jacob to redeem him from all forms of destruction. Thus, Jacob said: *The Angel who redeems me from all evil* <note>Genesis 48:16</note>. The reason he called this attribute an "angel" is because it only acts in redemption as an emissary of the Lord [YHVH]; for the attribute itself requires redemption, as the Sages of blessed memory said: <gloss>A</gloss> "When they were exiled to Egypt, the Shekhinah was with them." Therefore, when **Adonai** acts in redemption, it is as an emissary of the Lord [YHVH], and is thus called **The Redeeming Angel**, meaning it is called by the name of the One who sent it.

The explanation of this second principle <gloss>B</gloss>: Know that the attribute of the **Jubilee** <term>Yovel: The 50th year in the biblical cycle, here representing the higher Sefirah of Binah (Understanding)</term> above is the "Seventh," and it is the highest realm and the secret of complete redemption and freedom. From the Jubilee, which is the secret of complete redemption, the **Living God** <note>original: "El Chai," the Sefirah of Yesod (Foundation)</note> receives the flow of redemption and brings it to the world. Just as it receives the power of life from the Jubilee, it is therefore called the **Living God**.

Thirdly <gloss>C</gloss>: Know that through the power of the Sefirot of the Jubilee which are drawn into the **Living God**, Israel was redeemed and departed from Egypt, as it is said: *The children of Israel went up armed [chamushim] from the land of Egypt* <note>Exodus 13:18</note>. Do not read it as *chamushim* ["armed"], but rather as *chamishim* ["fifty"]. Likewise, it says: *The fiftieth year shall be a Jubilee for you* <note>Leviticus 25:11</note>. And it is written: *He shall have the right of redemption... and in the Jubilee he shall go out* <note>Leviticus 25:24-28</note>. And it is written: *In all the land of your possession, you shall grant redemption for the land.*

Fourthly <gloss>D</gloss>: The great general rule is that which is written: *In this year of Jubilee, each of you shall return to his ancestral possession* <note>Leviticus 25:13</note>. Know that from the Jubilee, the **Living God**—the Redeemer—draws forth [sustenance] and redeems the righteous at the time that He supports **Adonai**. Thus, the Jubilee is the "Upper Seventh," and the Sabbath—which is the secret of the **Living God**—is the "Lower Seventh." We count seven weeks of years for the Jubilee, and for the Sabbath we count six days, and on the seventh day is the Sabbath. Now, if you should say that the Jubilee is the beginning of the eighth, as it is called "the fiftieth year," know that with God’s help, we will hint at great principles regarding this matter <gloss>E</gloss> when we reach the explanation of the Name **Y-H-Y-H Y-H** <note>A specific permutation of the Divine Name</note>, which is the secret of the Jubilee and the secret of **Understanding** <note>Binah</note>; *there I will give my loves to you* <note>Song of Songs 7:13</note>.

Now know and believe that the Sabbath is the "eye" of all goodness and the source of all emanation for the Name **Adonai** and for Israel who cling to this attribute. From the Sabbath, a person enters into the life of the **World to Come**, which is the secret of the Jubilee, as we have informed you. The World to Come is called the **Great Sabbath**, which is the Upper Seventh, while the **Living God** is the secret of the Sabbath that is the Lower Seventh. From the World to Come, the Sabbath draws all emanation, great goodness, life, and redemption.

If this is so, open your eyes and see how you must keep the Sabbath if you desire to merit life and redemption and to enter the life of the World to Come. Behold, our Sabbath is like a **gatehouse** <note>original: "Beit Sha'ar"</note> used to enter the **great halls** <note>original: "Traklin"</note> of the life of the World to Come, which is called the Great Sabbath. Prepare yourself in the vestibule so that you may enter the hall. When you understand this, then *you shall call the Sabbath a delight* <note>Isaiah 58:13</note>—this refers to our Sabbath; *and the holy of the Lord honorable*—this refers to the Upper Sabbath which is called the Jubilee. Therefore, the Sages of blessed memory interpreted: *and the holy of the Lord honorable*—this refers to the **Day of Atonement** <note>Yom Kippur</note>. Know and believe that all Atonements emerge from the Jubilee, and from there forgiveness is drawn down to the name **Adonai**. Then it is said: *To the Lord our God belong mercy and forgiveness* <note>Daniel 9:9</note>, and it says: *O Lord [Adonai] hear, O Lord [Adonai] forgive, O Lord [Adonai] listen* <note>Daniel 9:19</note>. With God’s help, in its proper place, we will explain to you the reason why the attribute of Jubilee is called both the "Seventh" and the "Eighth." You will find it said that anyone who keeps the Sabbath according to its laws becomes unified with the Lower Seventh, which is called...

<margin>**B**</margin> Know that the attribute of Jubilee is **Understanding** [Binah], which receives from the **Supreme Crown** [Keter] in its place in Gate 3.
<margin>**C**</margin> Know that by the power of the Sefirot of the Jubilee which are drawn into the **Living God**, Israel was redeemed: This is explained at greater length below in Gate 8. The "fifty" corresponds to the fifty gates of Understanding and the days of the world, which are fifty thousand years, when everything shall return to its foundation and its ancient state, as will be said momentarily.

<header>### Gate 2</header>

"She has fallen and will not rise again" <note>Amos 5:2</note>. Therefore, Israel must focus every day with great intention on **joining redemption to prayer**, so that these two Names may be coupled and unified. When a person reaches the blessing of "True and Firm" <note>the *Emet Veyatziv* prayer recited after the Shema</note> at the words "Redeemer of Israel," they must intend in their heart to understand the secret of this redemption—what it is and how one joins it to prayer when starting "My Lord, open my lips" <note>the opening verse of the *Amidah* prayer</note>. This is the great principle.

As for that Sage who was praised because he "once joined redemption to prayer," do not imagine that on other days he would interrupt or speak between redemption and prayer—God forbid! That would be a transgression, heaven forfend, for the Lord our God and for His holy, pious servants to do such a thing. Rather, the **secret of joining redemption to prayer** is that he would intend, during the blessing of "True and Firm," to draw down all the "channels" <term>tsinorot: the conduits through which Divine energy flows</term> and to unify all the *Sefirot* <term>Sefirot: the ten creative powers or attributes of God</term> until the flow of all these channels reached the conclusion of the blessing, "Who redeemed Israel."

When he began the words "My Lord, open my lips," the power of **El Chai** <note>The "Living God," representing the Sefirah of Yesod (Foundation)</note> rested upon the attribute of **Adonai** <note>The "Lord," representing the Sefirah of Malchut (Sovereignty)</note>, and the Sefirot were unified by this Sage. This is a great matter that requires proper thought: to draw down all the channels and arrange all the Sefirot until they all reach the attribute of **El Chai** and pour themselves into the attribute of **Adonai**. Because such a great task is beyond the strength of an ordinary person to intend and perform every day, it was necessary to mention that he "once" joined redemption to prayer in this way. This "joining" was achieved through speech and action, for he knew how to focus on the Divine powers and draw the abundance through the channels until they all reached **El Chai**, and from there, they emptied into the Name **Adonai**.

This is the secret of "joining redemption to prayer." The sign for this is: *They are joined forever and ever, fashioned in truth and uprightness* <note>Psalm 111:8</note>. Since the secret of redemption and prayer is the secret of **El Chai** and **Adonai**, and it is also the secret of "Remember" and "Keep" <note>the two versions of the Sabbath commandment</note>, our Sages of blessed memory said: "If Israel were to keep even one Sabbath according to its law, they would be redeemed immediately." This is a clear reason why all Israel would join "Remember" to "Keep," for this is the secret of joining redemption to prayer.

If you should ask: "Why was Israel not redeemed on that day when that Sage joined redemption to prayer?" Know that one individual can only perform this joining according to the measure of one person. But if all Israel were to join them according to the measure of total perfection and the fullness required to connect and unify redemption with prayer, then they would all be redeemed.

The secret of joining redemption to prayer through the secret of **El Chai** and **Adonai** is the secret of: *Who redeems your life from the pit, who crowns you with kindness and mercy, who satisfies your prime with goodness, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s* <note>Psalm 103:4-5</note>.

Now that we have alerted you to this great principle, know that when the Lord, may He be blessed, wished to redeem Israel from Egypt, He joined the attribute of **El Chai** (called "Redemption") to the attribute of **Adonai** (called "Prayer"). The secret of this is: *The children of Israel groaned because of the labor, and they cried out, and their plea rose up to God because of the labor* <note>Exodus 2:23</note>. It is also written: *And God saw the children of Israel, and God knew* <note>Exodus 2:25</note>.

<margin>C</margin> And the great secret is: *I have also heard the moaning of the children of Israel, whom the Egyptians keep in bondage, and I have remembered My covenant* <note>Exodus 6:5</note>. After you know this, know that sometimes [the Divine] is called by the language of "Redeemer." The reason is that when **El Chai** connects with **Adonai**—which is the secret of Redemption and Prayer—**Adonai** becomes filled with the abundance of Redemption, and the attribute of **Adonai** [continues]...

...[She] will not rise again through the hands of man, as happened with the First Temple and the Second Temple. But the Holy One, blessed be He, in His own glory, will establish her in the future to come, as it is written: *On that day I will raise up the fallen Tabernacle of David* <note>Amos 9:11</note>. Then that "falling" shall be established for all generations, for the work of His hands shall never be destroyed. This is what is written: *The Lord builds Jerusalem; He gathers the outcasts of Israel* <note>Psalm 147:2</note>. Regarding the First and Second Temples, it was said: *Unless the Lord builds the house, its builders labor in vain* <note>Psalm 127:1</note>. But He, may He be blessed, will Himself support the "fallen one" forever and build her house.

**A** Our Sages of blessed memory said: "If Israel kept the Sabbath according to its law, the Holy One would hasten to break our exile." Some say they must keep two Sabbaths. It may be said that everything leads to one place and one matter according to our intention. The mention of "two Sabbaths" hints at the two attributes, **Remember** and **Keep**, which were spoken in a single utterance; they are gathered together as "one Sabbath," as I explained above.

**B** *And He saw the children of Israel, and God knew*: The word "knowledge" implies connection, as in *And Adam knew his wife* <note>Genesis 4:1</note>.

**C** The Great Secret: *I have also heard... and I have remembered My covenant*. This means that joining redemption to prayer acts as a foundation to bring [the people] out. Because "I have heard their cry" in My Great Name, so did the **Ramban** <note>Rabbi Moshe ben Nachman, a 13th-century scholar</note> of blessed memory explain. The "ascent" is gathered in the [future] House just as it was in the first days.

<meta>This page continues the exploration of Gate 2, specifically detailing the mystical significance of the Covenant (Circumcision) and its relationship to the Divine Names and Sefirot. 206 Gate 2

The term "covenant" is used because both of them **א** <note>This refers to the "Covenant of the Tongue" and the "Covenant of the Member" (circumcision).</note> represent a single secret: the Covenant of the Tongue and the Covenant of the Member <term>ma'or: literally "source of light," a euphemism for the male organ</term>. This is the secret of the "covenant of circumcision" (*milah*) and the "uncovering" (*pri'ah*). 

Regarding this, our Sages of blessed memory said: "One who circumcises but does not perform *pri'ah* <term>pri'ah: the act of pulling back the membrane during circumcision</term>, it is as if he did not circumcise at all." This means that the *pri'ah* is the secret of the Name **Adonai** <note>The Name associated with the Sefirah of Malchut (Sovereignty)</note>. When one does not perform the *pri'ah* through the letter *He* <note>The final letter of the Tetragrammaton, often associated with Malchut</note>, he lacks the first *Sefirah* through which one enters the Palace of **YHVH** <note>The Tetragrammaton, the four-letter Name of God</note>, may He be blessed. For one enters from **Adonai** into **El Chai** <note>The "Living God," associated with the Sefirah of Yesod (Foundation)</note>, and from **Chai** unto **YHVH**, may He be blessed. Since he did not perform the *pri'ah*, he cannot even enter the level of **El Chai**, for he lacks the *pri'ah* which is the Name **Adonai**.

Now that we have informed you of this, know that the LORD, may He be blessed, desired to make our father Abraham (peace be upon him) complete in all the *Sefirot* <term>Sefirot: the ten divine emanations or attributes</term>. He said to him: "Walk before Me and be perfect" <note>Genesis 17:1</note>. In order for you to be grasped within My "Chariot" <term>Merkavah: the Divine Assembly or structure of the spiritual realms</term>, I am placing a mark in your flesh, and it is called a "covenant of flesh," as it says: "And I will set My covenant between Me and you" <note>Genesis 17:2</note>. It is also written: "And My covenant shall be in your flesh **ג** for an everlasting covenant" <note>Genesis 17:13</note>. "My covenant shall be in your flesh" refers to the covenant of the flesh [circumcision], while "for an everlasting covenant" refers to the **Covenant of the Tongue**. 

The Covenant of the Tongue is the secret of the Torah, which is drawn forth from **Binah** <note>Understanding, the third Sefirah</note> through the secret of the counting of fifty days <note>The period between Passover and Shavuot</note>, corresponding to the fifty years of the Jubilee. If Israel had not accepted the covenant of the flesh, they would never have merited to receive the Torah, which is the Covenant of the Tongue.

This is what is stated in the *Sefer Yetzirah* <note>The Book of Formation, an ancient foundational text of Jewish mysticism</note>: "When our father Abraham came, he looked and investigated, understood, engraved, and hewed... the Master of the World was revealed to him and called him His beloved, and made a covenant with him between the ten fingers of his hands—this is the Covenant of the Tongue—and between the ten toes of his feet—this is the Covenant of Circumcision."

If you should ask: "Was not the attribute of *pri'ah* given to Abraham?" the answer is that this specific quality was already his, for it is the attribute of **Adonai**, and he was the first to call God by this Name. 

Thus we find that there are three types of covenant: 
1. The **Covenant of the Tongue**, which is the covenant of the mouth, the covenant of the Torah, the "everlasting covenant," and the covenant of **Binah**.
2. The **Covenant of Circumcision** (*milah*), which is the "covenant of flesh," the "covenant of the Rainbow," and the "covenant of the Sabbath." 
3. Between these two covenants is held the **Covenant of Adonai**, which is the covenant of the Oral Torah and the covenant of *pri'ah*. 

Because of this, it is said: "According to these words I have made a covenant with you" <note>Exodus 34:27</note>; this refers to the covenant of the Written Torah and its return to the Oral Torah. 

These three covenants are: 
- The first covenant: **Binah / YHVH**.
- The final covenant: **Malchut / Adonai**.
- The middle covenant: **Sabbath / El Chai**. 

Thus, the covenant of the Sabbath binds **Adonai** and **YHVH**. Were it not for the covenant of circumcision, which is the covenant of the Sabbath, we would not have merited the Written Torah or the Oral Torah, for the secret is **YHVH-Adonai**. 

Know that the Name **El Chai**, which is called "Covenant," is the "Gatehouse" to enter the attribute of **Tiferet** <note>Beauty/Harmony, the central Sefirah</note>, which is the secret of the Written Torah emanating from **Binah** in the secret of the fifty [gates], as we explained. If a person does not enter through this gate, which is the Covenant, how can he reach the Torah which is further within and above? Because the covenant of circumcision is the secret of **El Chai** and the secret of the Sabbath, the Sages fixed the blessing for circumcision: "...the Living God <note>El Chai</note> is our portion, our Rock; He commanded to save the beloved of our foundation <note>the circumcised organ</note> from destruction, for the sake of His covenant which He set in our flesh. Blessed are You... who makes the covenant." 

Do you not see that the Name **El Chai** is fixed in the blessing of circumcision? Regarding this, it is said: "And you who cling to the LORD your God are all alive (*chayim*) today" <note>Deuteronomy 4:4</note>. **ד** Know that the covenant of circumcision is the secret of the Sabbath: *Milah* and *Pri'ah* correspond to the secret of "Remember" (*Zakhor*) and "Keep" (*Shamor*) the Sabbath day. "Remember" for the day and "Keep" for the night, corresponding to **El Chai** and **Adonai**. 

Since the covenant of circumcision includes the covenant of these two *Sefirot*, the scripture says: "If not for My covenant by day and night, I would not have set the statutes of heaven and earth" <note>Jeremiah 33:25</note>. The secret of "statutes" (*chukkot*) refers to **El Chai** and **Adonai**, through the secret of the masculine "Statute" (*Chok*) **ה** and the feminine "Statute" (*Chukkah*).

Which is called **Shabbat**, and from there one merits the "Upper Seventh" which is called the **World to Come**. And if, Heaven forbid, a person profanes the Sabbath, he is far removed from life, for "those who profane it shall surely be put to death" <note>Exodus 31:14</note>, as the gate is closed before him, preventing him from entering the life of the World to Come. Therefore, our Sages of blessed memory said regarding the matter of <gloss>A</gloss> the Sabbath: although the Sabbath itself is revealed, the giving of its reward is not revealed. This is because the reward of the World to Come is hidden, and its goodness is such that "no eye has seen it, O God, beside You, who acts for those who wait for Him" <note>Isaiah 64:3</note>. And it is written: "How great is Your goodness, which You have hidden for those who fear You, which You have performed for those who take refuge in You" <note>Psalm 31:20</note>. According to this principle, you should know that even though the Sabbath is revealed to us, the giving of its reward is not revealed; rather, it is sealed and closed. Not even one of the prophets prophesied concerning what it is, because it is the Great Good and the "Hidden Light" from the six days of Creation, which no creature can look upon except for the Lord, may He be blessed.

You must be diligent in fulfilling the **Three Meals** on the Sabbath, for they are the secret of the "bond of unity" and the secret of the bond of the "Great Sabbath" <note>The "Great Sabbath" often refers to the Sefirah of Binah (Understanding), the source of cosmic rest.</note> within the Sabbath day that we observe. When a person fulfills the three meals on the Sabbath, it is as if he unifies the Lord, may He be blessed, <gloss>B</gloss> in the secret of "The LORD is one and His Name is one" <note>Zechariah 14:9</note>—that is to say, through the **Three** (Upper Sefirot) and the **Seven** (Lower Sefirot). Then he is worthy to be saved from three tribulations. These three meals correspond as follows:
*   The first corresponds to **Adonai** <note>The Name associated with the Sefirah of Malchut (Sovereignty), the "bottom" of the divine structure.</note>, which becomes unified on the Sabbath day; this is the secret of the unification of the **Seven**. 
*   The second corresponds to **YHVH** <note>The Tetragrammaton, representing the central Sefirah of Tiferet (Beauty).</note>.
*   The third corresponds to **Binah** <note>The Sefirah of "Understanding," the divine mother.</note>, which is bound in the secret of **Ehyeh** <note>The Name "I Am," associated with the highest reaches of the divine.</note>; this is the secret of the unification of the **Three**.

The secret of the Sabbath being called "Delight" (*Oneg*) is the secret of the **River** (*Nahar*) flowing out of **Eden** to water the **Garden** (*Gan*). For this is the secret of the true and perfect unity in the secret of <gloss>C</gloss> **Eden, River, Garden** <note>In Hebrew, the first letters of these words—Ayin (Eden), Nun (Nahar), Gimmel (Gan)—spell "Oneg" (Delight).</note>. Anyone who fulfills the three meals on the Sabbath is as if he unifies the ten **Sefirot** in a perfect unity through the secret of the Names **Adonai, YHVH, Ehyeh**, and they are all unified through **El Chai** <note>The "Living God," associated with the Sefirah of Yesod (Foundation), which acts as the "connector" in the divine body.</note> above and below. Above, it is bound to **Binah**, which is the secret of the bond of **Ehyeh**, for Binah is bound to Ehyeh in the secret of the Three Sefirot. Below, it is bound to **Adonai**, which is the secret of the bond of the seven lower Sefirot. Thus, the Sabbath binds all the Sefirot above and below; therefore, the Sabbath is "Remember" (*Zakhor*) and "Keep" (*Shamor*) <note>The two versions of the Sabbath commandment in the Decalogue, representing the male and female aspects of divinity.</note>.

Now, know and contemplate how you shall keep the Sabbath and how you shall conduct yourself in the matter of guarding it—regarding work, speech, rest, delight, and honor. Happy are you when you guard the Sabbath, for you shall be called a "guest" to the ten Sefirot. Sometimes the attribute of **El Chai** is called in the Torah <gloss>D</gloss> **Covenant** (*Brit*). Know and understand that every instance of the word "Covenant" in the Torah is divided into three types of matters in its meaning, yet all is one in connection. Those three types are divided among these three Names: **Adonai, El Chai, Binah**. <gloss>F</gloss> The Covenant of **Binah** is the "Covenant of the Mouth," the "Covenant of the Tongue," and the "Covenant of the Lips," as it is said: "According to (*Al Pi*) these words I have made a covenant with you" <note>Exodus 34:27. "Al Pi" literally means "by the mouth of."</note>. And the Lord, may He be blessed, gave us the **Covenant of Circumcision** (*Brit Milah*) to merit us to **El Chai**. The Covenant of **Adonai** corresponds to the "Covenant of the Torah," which is bound between the Covenant of **El Chai** and the Covenant of **Adonai**.
