<meta>This page continues the discussion of the divine attributes and the pathways of prayer. While the previous page focused on the connection between "Justice" and "The Righteous One," this page transitions into the celestial halls (Heikhalot) and the specific mechanisms by which human prayer—especially the prayer of the broken-hearted and the community—reaches the Divine.</meta>

# Gate 2

...before the gates of repentance. And in this celestial hall, which is called the attribute of the **Living God** <note>original: *El Chai* (אל ח"י), a name often associated with the Sefirah of Yesod, the foundation of life</note>, there is one place containing gates called the **Gates of Tears**. The Blessed Holy One Himself opens these gates three times every day. These gates are prepared for the "masters of repentance" <note>original: *Ba'alei Teshuvah*, those who return to God</note> when they turn back and feel regret for their evil deeds. When such a penitent person prays and weeps, shedding tears during their prayer, their prayer and weeping enter before Him through these Gates of Tears. This is what our Sages, of blessed memory, meant when they said: "Even though the gates of prayer may be locked, the gates of tears are never locked," <note>Talmud, Berakhot 32b</note> as it is said: "Put my tears into Your bottle; are they not in Your book?" <note>Psalm 56:8</note> The hint for this is found in the prayer of King Hezekiah, of whom it is said: "And Hezekiah wept bitterly." Whereupon the Blessed Holy One said: "I have heard your prayer, I have seen your tears." <note>Isaiah 38:5</note> And although there is a difference in the matter of tears between the time when the Holy Temple stood and the time of its destruction, nevertheless, the Gates of Tears are always open. The prophet has already said: "Return to Me with all your heart, with fasting, with weeping, and with mourning." <note>Joel 2:12</note> Therefore, when a person desires their prayer to be accepted, they should focus their intent and shed a tear, and their prayer will not return empty-handed.

We find a similar case regarding Hannah: "And she was in bitterness of soul, and prayed to the Lord, and wept sore." <note>1 Samuel 1:10</note> You should know that this righteous woman knew all the gates of the <term>Halls<gloss>Heikhalot; celestial palaces or levels of reality through which prayer ascends</gloss></term>, and all her actions were done with specific mystical intention <note>original: *Kavanah*</note> to enter the "Chambers of the Chariot" <note>original: *Hadrei Merkavah*, referring to the highest mysteries of the Divine Throne</note>. What is written immediately after? "And she vowed a vow and said, 'O **Lord of Hosts** <note>original: *YHVH Tzevaot*</note>, if You will indeed look on the affliction of Your maidservant and remember me, and not forget Your maidservant...'" Through her vow, she reached up to the level of <term>Understanding<gloss>Binah; the third Sefirah, often called the "Divine Mother" from whom souls emanate</gloss></term>, which draws the "sons" <note>the lower Sefirot</note> from the **Crown** <note>original: *Keter*, the highest Sefirah</note>. She entered and established herself at the level of the "Lord of Hosts," the place where all created beings are born. 

In this Hall, there is a specific place where the prayers of those individuals enter who offered their prayers before the communal prayer. All those who rise early in that Hall—when the community finishes their prayers—a specific appointed official enters that place and takes all those prayers that preceded the community and raises them up together with the communal prayer before the Blessed Holy One. All these matters we have discussed refer to the prayers of individuals. However, regarding the prayer of a community, no appointed official or gatekeeper has the power to delay it. Rather, when the community prays, their prayer enters and is accepted in every instance. This is the secret of the verse: "He will turn to the prayer of the destitute, and not despise their prayer." <note>Psalm 102:17</note> It does not say "his" prayer <note>singular</note>, but "their" prayer <note>plural</note>. The explanation of the verse is: "He will turn to the prayer of the destitute"—meaning when an individual prays, his prayer is scrutinized to see if it is worthy of acceptance, and many "adversaries" <note>original: *me'ar'erim*, spiritual prosecutors</note> challenge it. But when the community prays, "He does not despise their prayer," even if their prayer is not entirely worthy, it is accepted from above. This is what our Sages, of blessed memory, meant: "From where do we know that the Holy One, blessed be He, does not loathe the prayer of the many? As it is said: 'Behold, God is mighty and does not despise [the many]'" <note>Job 36:5; Talmud, Berakhot 8a</note>. Our Sages also said: "A person should always join himself with the community," and "When is there a 'Time of Favor'? At the time when the community prays." And the verse says: "For what great nation is there that has God so near to them, as the Lord our God is in all things that we call upon Him for?" <note>Deuteronomy 4:7</note>

Now, know and contemplate that these two Halls—one called <term>ADONAI<gloss>The name associated with the Sefirah of Kingdom/Malkhut</gloss></term> and the second called <term>EHYEH<gloss>The name "I Will Be," associated with the Sefirah of Binah/Understanding</gloss></term>—are the ones through which all the prayers of Israel ascend and bond. The secret of communal prayer is the secret of *ADONAI*, which is the secret of the "Assembly of Israel" <note>original: *Knesset Yisrael*</note>, and therefore it is never rejected. All these things we have said regarding individual and communal prayer apply when Israel is upon their own land, and especially in Jerusalem, and even more so in the Holy Temple. But when Israel is outside the Land <note>original: *Chutz la'Aretz*</note>, many adversaries and many accusers stand against the communal prayers, and how much more so against individual prayers. For when Israel is outside the Land, they are under the authority of the "Princes of the Nations," and there is no path for their prayers to ascend, as the Gates of Heaven are found only in the Land of Israel. And so it says regarding Jacob: "How awesome is this place! This is none other than the house of God, and this is the gate of heaven." <note>Genesis 28:17</note> Thus, outside the Land, everything is closed off toward heaven. <margin>Hezekiah</margin> And there are times when those Princes of the Nations do not assist Israel at all, as it says: "And there is none that holds with me in these things, but Michael your prince." <note>Daniel 10:21</note> And even more so, for **Samael**, the prince of Edom, stands and constantly accuses Israel, challenging them in order to destroy their merits. And all the accusers against Israel in the lands of the nations all stand...

## Gate 2

...according to your faith. He <note>King David</note> would designate his entire generation based on this, saying: **"Guard my soul, for I am pious"** <note>original: *chasid*, referring to the attribute of *Chesed* or Kindness; Psalm 86:2</note>. Because the continuity of generations among the descendants of man flows from this attribute of David, the Scripture says: **"I said, the world shall be built on kindness"** <note>Psalm 89:3</note>. However, because sometimes this attribute—called the "Kindness of David"—is withdrawn and gathered into the heights of the upper worlds, as it is said: **"the righteous is taken away from the evil to come,"** <note>Isaiah 57:1</note> the Scripture therefore says: **"Help, Lord, for the godly man [the pious] ceases; for the faithful fail from among the children of men"** <note>Psalm 12:1</note>—this refers to the secret of the "faithful mercies of David." One who knows the secret of the "mercies of David" knows the secret of **"Give thanks (a) unto the Lord, for He is good; for His mercy endures forever"** <note>Psalm 118:1</note>—referring to the first and the middle. He will then understand many deep matters hinted at in the Torah.

Now that we have awakened you to these great principles, we must inform you that the attribute called <gloss>God of Life</gloss> <note>original: *El Chai* (אל ח"י), associated with the Sefirah of Yesod</note> is like a refinery and a test for receiving prayers from the hand of **ADONAI** <note>original: אדנ"י, a Name of God associated with the Sefirah of Malchut (Kingship/The Shekhinah). The text glosses this as the "Community of Israel" or the "Entrance World"</note>. For further study, see the *Zohar* (Portion of Pekudei), the *Pardes* (Gate of the Palaces), and *Pitchi Yah*. 

In this celestial palace, many guards and many legions stand to test and refine every prayer that enters the Palace of **ADONAI**. In this palace, they examine the prayers, the outcries, and the supplications. When an individual prays, their prayer enters through the Palace of **ADONAI** and is scrutinized in this place. If it is worthy to enter through the attribute of the "God of Life," then the guardians of the gates receive that prayer and bring it in until it reaches the presence of the **Blessed Lord** <note>original: *YHVH*</note>. 

But if, Heaven forbid, the prayer a person offers is not fit, that prayer is called from above an "invalid prayer." All the words of that prayer are called "disqualified." An announcement (b) declares: "That prayer shall not enter before the **Blessed Lord**." A voice proclaims: **"I am the Lord, that is My name; and My glory I will not give to another, nor My praise to (b) idols"** <note>original: *pesilim* (פסילים). The author makes a pun here: *pesilim* means "idols," but it shares a root with *pasul*, meaning "disqualified" or "invalid." Isaiah 42:8</note>. Immediately, they cast out that prayer with a rebuke and push it outside; it does not enter, and the gates are locked in its face. This is what is meant by: **"He will turn to the prayer of the destitute [the lonely one]"** <note>original: *ar'ar* (ערער), which can also mean "one whose prayer is contested" or "appealed"; Psalm 102:17</note>. For in this place, they turn and examine every prayer that an individual offers, and they "contest" <note>original: *me'ar'erim*</note> it.

Now, if you should say: "It seems then that most individual prayers are ruined and lost, for not one in a thousand can focus his individual prayer with the necessary intention (*kavanah*) to be worthy of acceptance!" Know that this is not so. Rather, for all those "invalid" prayers (called *pesilim*), when they are pushed outside and do not enter, the **Blessed Lord** has provided a place for them to enter (c). For the **Blessed Name** created a firmament and appointed officers and guards over it. All those rejected, invalid prayers are brought into that firmament and remain there. 

If that individual who offered the invalid prayers later stands up and offers a single prayer with great intention (*kavanah*), and this prayer is fit and perfect, then that "kosher" prayer ascends. It enters that outer palace where the previously offered invalid prayers are held. It retrieves all those invalid prayers, and they all ascend together with the fit prayer. They enter as a single unit before the **Blessed God**. Thus, it turns out that not a single word of all the prayers an individual offers will fall away [be lost]. 

But if the person does not return in repentance and does not pray with proper intention, all those invalid prayers are eventually cast out of the "camp" to an impure place, because the person's path follows after impurity. Then, the gates are locked before him...

**In your faith:** As it is said: "The breads are more desirable than the attribute of David." For kindness and the "noise of the table" are discussed here. This is the "Book of the Generations of Adam," as will be explained in Gate 3.

(a) **Give thanks to the Lord for He is good:** "Give thanks to the Lord" hints at the Upper Kindness which is above the Name [YHVH], and "For He is good" hints at the lower. "For His mercy endures forever" refers to the lower kindness, which is the "Mercy of the World." All are forms of Kindness. Now learn the sign: Head, End, and Middle.

(b) **And My praise to idols:** For when they merit the power to use "Splendor" (*Hod*) as the Sefirah of Kingship (*Malchut*) during prayer, it is possible to enter the "day of ascents," which is the Sefirah of Understanding (*Binah*), called "Praise" (*Tehillah*), as will be seen in Gate 8. For "Praise" is included in the "Days," and not for the "disqualified/idols."

(c) **The Blessed One created one firmament:** The nature of this firmament is explained further on. The prayer would descend between the "scattered ones" and the "overturned ones." Strengthen the "Root Prayer" so it may guard the "Crown" (*Keter*) for its Maker. Regarding this, it is said: "He turned to the prayer of the destitute," etc. For he took the "Table of the Sages" which was in the firmament, appearing in the name of Tradition (*Kabbalah*) and Repentance (*Teshuvah*) with intention.

# Gate 2

At the beginning of the prayer, we say: **"O Lord, open my lips"** <note>Psalm 51:17; original Hebrew: *Adonai Sefatai Tiftach*</note>, which is the gate through which one enters. And at the end of the prayer, we say: **"May the words of my mouth be acceptable"** <note>Psalm 19:15; original Hebrew: *Yihyu l'ratzon imrei fi*</note>, because "Acceptance" <note>original: *Ratzon*</note> is the secret of the levels [of divinity] as they ascend from below to above. This is the secret of the letter *Yud* <note>The first letter of the Four-Letter Name of God, Y-H-V-H</note> of the Unique Name, which is called "Acceptance" <gloss>Ratzon</gloss>. From this Acceptance, which is the *Yud*, it ascends through the "tip of the upper *Yud*" and attaches to the **Supreme Crown** <note>The highest Sefirah, *Keter*</note>, which is called the **Infinite** <note>original: *Ein Sof*</note>.

Thus you have learned that prayer revolves around the Great Name. At the start of the prayer, we say: **"O Lord [Adonai], open my lips,"** which is the secret of the final letter *He* (ה) of the Name; she is situated below all the <term>Sefirot</term> <note>The ten divine emanations</note> of the Name. But at the end of the prayer, we say: **"May the words of my mouth be acceptable [for Ratzon],"** which is the secret of the letter *Yud* (י) of the Name, which is the peak of all levels from below to above. Thus, the Name is sealed within the prayer at both the beginning and the end. This is the Name *Yah* (י"ה), which is half of the Name of the Blessed Lord, and half of it is considered as the whole.

Because prayers ascend all the way to the **Crown** <gloss>Keter</gloss>, the sages established the "Crown" prayer in the <term>Musaf</term> <note>The "Additional" service recited on Sabbaths and Festivals</note> service: **"A Crown they shall give to You, O Lord our God."** This means that all the prayers of the Morning Service <note>original: *Yotzer*, the Creator service</note> that Israel prayed ascend to the Crown. This is why we say "A Crown they shall give to You" specifically in the *Musaf* prayer and not in the Morning prayer; for during the Morning prayer, the prayers have not yet reached the Crown. But by the *Musaf* prayer, they have already arrived there, because the Morning prayers are complete and have ascended to the **Crown**.

If so, from these principles we have awakened in you, you should realize that when a person focuses their intention during prayer, they are unifying God through that very prayer. They begin with the final letter *He* of the Name until they have unified all the Sefirot and reached the letter *Yud*, which is the first letter of the Name, until the prayer is found clinging to the **Supreme Crown**.

Therefore, you must understand that prayer is called "Service" <gloss>Avodah</gloss>, just as we have said. This is the secret of what the Sages said: "What is the service of the heart? It is prayer." Following this path, consider that prayers stand in the place of **Sacrifices** <gloss>Korbanot</gloss>. You already know that the secret of the sacrifices is the secret of "drawing the Sefirot near" <note>A wordplay on *Korban* (sacrifice) and *Kiruv* (drawing near)</note>, the ordering of the levels, and the repair of the [divine] channels. Therefore, they are called *Korban* from the language of "drawing near" <gloss>kiruv</gloss>. Thus, prayer stands in the place of sacrifices, except that sacrifices draw the levels near through physical action, while prayers do so through speech and mystical intent <gloss>sod</gloss>. This is the meaning of the verse: **"So we will render for bullocks the offering of our lips"** <note>Hosea 14:3</note>. This is what the Sages of blessed memory meant when they said: "Prayers were established corresponding to the daily and additional sacrifices."

Now that we have awakened you to these principles regarding the Name called **Living God** <note>original: *El Chai* (אל ח"י), the name associated with the Sefirah of *Yesod* (Foundation)</note>, we must now enter into the explanation of His other Names, blessed be He, according to the order of the levels. May the Name guide us in the way of truth, Amen and Amen, Selah.

->**These are the names that correspond to "Living God" in order:**<-

**Living God** • God of Living Water • God Almighty <note>original: *El Shaddai*</note> • Source of Living Waters • **Foundation** <gloss>Yesod</gloss> • **Righteous One** <gloss>Tzadik</gloss> • Good • All-Good Intelligence • **Peace** <gloss>Shalom</gloss> • Remembrance • Remember the Sabbath • Holy Mountain • Redemption • Lower Seventh • The Lower Extremity • **Sabbath** • **Covenant** <gloss>Berit</gloss> • Sign • Oath • The Good Mountain • Statute • Mount Zion • Every Mighty One • **Israel** • Lord • Faithful Mercies of David • Life of the Worlds • Lower Intercessor • Mighty One of Jacob • Lower Kindness.

**"O Lord God of hosts, hear my prayer; give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah."** <note>Psalm 84:9</note> **"Even the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may have her young—a place near your altar, Lord of hosts, my King and my God."** <note>Psalm 84:3</note>

<header>Gate 2</header>

Between the earth and the heavens, there is something like a wall or a partition that separates Israel from their Father in heaven. These are <margin>Lamentations 3</margin> what are called "The Intervening Cloud," and regarding this, it is said: **"You have covered Yourself with a cloud, so that no prayer can pass through"** <note>Lamentations 3:44; original Hebrew: *Sakkotah ba-anan lach me-avor tefillah*</note>. Likewise, it says in the visions of Ezekiel in the exile: **"And I looked, and behold, a stormy wind came out of the north, a great cloud, and a fire flaring up... and in its midst, like the color of <term>Chashmal</term>"** <note>Ezekiel 1:4. *Chashmal* is a mysterious celestial glow, often interpreted by the Sages as "speaking silence" or a type of angelic energy</note>. One who understands this verse will understand how many partitions hinder us in exile. 

Even within the Land of Israel, it is written: **"But your iniquities have separated between you and your God"** <note>Isaiah 59:2</note>. If this is true in the Land, how much more so outside the Land. If so, what becomes of the prayers of Israel said outside the Land? Know that prayers offered outside the Land have no way to ascend before the Blessed Lord except when the people of Israel direct them from outside the Land toward Jerusalem. When they reach Jerusalem, they depart from there and ascend on high. This is what Daniel said when he prayed in the exile: **"And his windows being open in his upper chamber toward Jerusalem, three times a day he kneeled upon his knees, and prayed, and gave thanks before his God"** <note>Daniel 6:11</note>. 

King Solomon spoke of this explicitly when the Holy Temple was built, as he prayed for Israel and said: **"If they sin against You—for there is no man who does not sin—and You be angry with them, and deliver them to the enemy, so that they carry them away captives unto the land of the enemy, far off or near; and if they shall bethink themselves in the land where they were carried captive, and repent, and make supplication unto You... and pray unto You toward their land, which You gave unto their fathers, the city which You have chosen, and the house which I have built for Your name; then hear You their prayer and their supplication in heaven, Your dwelling place, and maintain their cause..."** <note>1 Kings 8:46-49</note>. 

Now, know and see how King Solomon (peace be upon him) revealed that the prayer of one outside the Land does not ascend on high from the place where they pray until it first goes to the Land of Israel, and from there to Jerusalem, and from there to the Holy Temple—only then does it ascend on high. Therefore, all of Israel who are in exile are situated around Jerusalem at the four corners of the earth, and Jerusalem stands in the center. Consequently, all those in exile to the East should pray toward the West, facing Jerusalem. Likewise, those in the North should turn their faces to the South. Thus, all Israel praying in the land of their exile are sending their prayers to Jerusalem and to the Holy Temple, and from there the prayers ascend before the Blessed Lord.

Now we must inform you of the difference between a prayer from outside the Land and a prayer from within the Land of Israel. Know that a prayer from the Land of Israel is like someone who needs to speak with the King and whose house is close to the King’s palace; there is no adversary, no evil occurrence, and no destroyer on the path. But a prayer from outside the Land is like someone who needs to speak with the King but whose house is very far from the King, and on the road there are many <term>listim</term> <note>original: *listim*; from the Greek *leistes*, meaning bandits or highwaymen</note>, many evil occurrences, and many wild beasts. 

See now how careful a person must be to escape the damage of the road! After such vigilance and protection, one must intend that their prayer be worthy of being accepted, as we have said. In this way, know that there are many hindrances and accusers against the prayers of Israel as they travel toward Jerusalem, caused by the impure forces of the nations of the world. Therefore, you must consider how much we are obligated to purify ourselves and focus our intention <gloss>kavanah</gloss> in our prayers when we pray outside the Land, so that we may be worthy of being accepted before the Blessed Lord.

After we have awakened you to these subtle principles, which are like hints, we must inform you that the secret of **El Chai** <note>The Living God; a Name associated with the Sefirah of Yesod, the "Foundation" which channels divine energy</note> is the secret of the place where prayers and requests are examined. When the prayer is proper and attaches to **El Chai**, then the Name called **Adonai** <note>Lord; the Name associated with the Sefirah of Malchut, the "Kingdom" and the gateway of prayer</note>—which is the secret of Prayer itself—draws near to **El Chai**. Then all the <term>Sefirot</term> <note>the ten divine emanations</note> are unified through the prayer. When the prayer attaches to **El Chai**, it enters all the inner chambers until it ascends to the level of **Binah** <note>Understanding; the divine "Mother" from which the lower Sefirot emanate</note>. And from **Binah**, it attaches to **Chokmah** <note>Wisdom</note>, which is called **Ratzon** <note>Will or Acceptance</note>. This is why we say—

<header>Gate 3 & 4</header>

...and **"good to look upon."** <note>1 Samuel 16:12</note> Thus, we find David was a composite of **Judgment** and **Mercy**. You will find this written concerning David: **"And David executed judgment and righteousness for all his people."** <note>2 Samuel 8:15</note> **"Judgment"** comes from the side of Strict Justice, for he was **"ruddy"** <note>Hebrew: *admoni*, implying a red complexion associated with blood and war</note>. **"Righteousness"** comes from the side of Loving-kindness and Mercy, as he was **"of beautiful eyes and good to look upon."** Therefore, when David "clothed" himself in the attribute of "ruddy," he fought the wars of the Lord against the enemies of the Lord and did not return his sword empty. But when he "clothed" himself as "beautiful of eyes," he provided for Israel and performed many acts of kindness with a **"generous eye."** <note>Literally "a good eye" (Ayin Tovah)</note> As it says: **"He who has a generous eye will be blessed, for he gives of his bread to the poor."** <note>Proverbs 22:9</note> And when he "clothed" himself as "good to look upon," he would descend into the depths of the Torah; he would see and contemplate the hidden secrets and long to taste their flavors. He would say, **"The law of Your mouth is better to me than thousands of gold and silver pieces,"** <note>Psalm 119:72</note> and he would yearn and desire, saying: **"Open my eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of Your law."** <note>Psalm 119:18</note> He sustained the Torah through the attribute of "good to look upon," and through this quality, he would descend into the secrets of the Torah. Therefore, these three attributes were joined in the attribute of the **"Living God"** <term>El Chai: a Name associated with the Sefirah of Yesod, the foundation</term>, which are Kindness, Judgment, and Mercy. David took hold of all three and he, too, became the **fourth leg** of the Throne that carries the [other] three. For this reason, the Torah said: **"Three pilgrimage festivals you shall celebrate for Me in the year,"** <note>Exodus 23:14</note> corresponding to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. And the fourth leg is the festival of **Atzeret** <note>Shemini Atzeret, the "Eighth Day of Assembly"</note>, as it says: **"On the eighth day there shall be an assembly for you."** <note>Numbers 29:35</note> Our Sages of blessed memory said at the end of Tractate Sotah that the Eighth Day of Assembly is a festival unto itself regarding the sequence of the Temple service, and they said it is a distinct pilgrimage festival. But one might ask: there are only three pilgrimage festivals! How can the Eighth Day be a festival unto itself, making four? Rather, it is truly a festival unto itself <margin>Gate 4</margin> corresponding to the **Shield of David** <note>Magen David</note>. This is the secret of the "fourth leg" of the Chariot-Throne. The entire secret is that the Torah said "Three pilgrimage festivals you shall celebrate for Me in the year" and mentioned it three times. And when Judah was born—who is the secret of the Shield of David and the secret of the fourth leg and the fourth son—what did Leah say? **"This time I will praise the Lord; therefore she called his name Judah, and she stopped giving birth."** <note>Genesis 29:35</note> "This time" certainly refers to the secret of the fourth "time" or fourth leg. "I will praise" <note>Hebrew: *Odeh*</note> refers to David, the prince of God in thanksgivings and praises. "And she stopped giving birth" refers to the 72 names <note>numerical value of *Ayin-Bet*</note>; it is the standing point of the **Sefirot** <term>Divine emanations</term>, and from here onward is the realm of "separation." When **"Remember"** <note>Zakhor/Male</note> and **"Observe"** <note>Shamor/Female</note> are joined, the Kingdom of the House of David belongs to David, and **"a river went out of Eden to water the garden, and from there it was parted"** <note>Genesis 2:10</note> (meaning: from there onward is the aspect of the world of separation; see further ahead).

Know that these two attributes called **"YHVH Elohim of Hosts"** <note>YHVH Elohim Tzeva'ot</note> are the source from which all the "hosts" of the world—upper and lower—are drawn according to their kinds. From them, all the wars of the world are drawn. In this place lies the secret of **Jealousy**, as it is written: **"The jealousy of the Lord of Hosts shall perform this,"** <note>Isaiah 9:6</note> and it says: **"And the Lord will be jealous for His land."** <note>Joel 2:18</note> From this place, the prophets draw their sustenance in their visions, as it says: **"Thus says the Lord of Hosts."** Know that the level of Moses our Teacher (may he rest in peace) was above all other prophets. Moses our Teacher did not use the phrase "Lord of Hosts," because his level was cleaved directly to **YHVH** <note>The Tetragrammaton, the highest Name</note> and he did not need to look through the "Mirrors of the Hosts." Therefore it is said that Moses looked through a **luminous mirror** <note>Hebrew: *Aspaklaria Metzuchtzachat*</note>, as it is written: **"With him I speak mouth to mouth, manifestly and not in riddles; and he beholds the likeness of the Lord."** <note>Numbers 12:8</note> But the other prophets looked through a **non-luminous mirror**, as it is written: **"And by the hand of the prophets I have used parables."** <note>Hosea 12:11</note> And He said: **"If there be a prophet among you, I the Lord will make Myself known to him in a vision, and will speak to him in a dream."** <note>Numbers 12:6</note> The matter of "making Myself known in a vision" is the secret of the "Mirrors of the Hosts." Therefore, the visions of the prophets are through the Name "Lord of Hosts," and they constantly mention "Lord of Hosts," for that is the place from which they draw, the secret of the **Mirrors of the Hosts** who **"assembled at the door of the Tent of Meeting."** <note>Exodus 38:8</note> Thus you have learned that there are three levels: **Torah, Prophets, and Writings.**

# Two Holy Names

Which are the third and fourth in the order of the levels, and they are called: **God of Hosts** <note>original: *Elohim Tzva’ot*</note> and **Lord of Hosts** <note>original: *YHVH Tzva’ot*</note>. Sometimes they are included as one, as it says: **"Lord God of Hosts, hear my prayer."** <note>Psalm 84:9</note> At other times, each is mentioned on its own, as it says: **"God of Hosts, restore us; let Your face shine, that we may be saved,"** <note>Psalm 80:8</note> and as it says: **"The Lord of Hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress. Selah."** <note>Psalm 46:8</note> 

We found it necessary to bring these two Names together in one gate, even though the other Names were each given their own specific gate. This is because these two Names require one another for their explanation. When one is not explained, the other also remains in need of clarification; thus, we must explain them as one, for they are united with each other. These two Names, called **God of Hosts** and **Lord of Hosts**, are both designated to pour out—by way of the "conduits" <note>the spiritual channels of divine energy</note>—all the flow of the higher **Sefirot** <term>Sefirot: The ten creative powers or attributes through which the Infinite interacts with the universe</term> and bring them into the attribute of **The Living God** <note>original: *El Chai*, usually associated with the Sefirah of Yesod (Foundation)</note>. Both operate according to "Straight Judgment" <note>equitable law</note> among all the hosts of the world. One operates from the side of **Loving-kindness** <note>Chesed</note> and the second operates from the side of **Judgment** <note>Din</note>. Both draw Judgment, Kindness, and Mercy into the attribute of **The Living God**. 

We must inform you that the attribute of **The Lord of Hosts** is what draws down the Supernal Kindness and the "Kindness of Abraham"—which is eternal kindness—into the attribute of **The Living God**. The attribute of **God of Hosts** draws down the power of **Might** <note>Gevurah</note>, Judgment, Dread, and Punishment into the attribute of **The Living God**. Therefore, the attribute of **The Living God** includes everything and is called **"All"** <note>Hebrew: *Kol*</note>, because everything is within it. All the **Sefirot** pour Kindness, Judgment, and Mercy into it through the names **Lord God of Hosts**. 

This is the secret of the verse: **"I am the Lord, Maker of all"** <note>Isaiah 44:24</note>, for everything emerged from the attribute called **"All"** <note>*Kol*</note>, as it says: **"And God saw all that He had made, and behold, it was very good."** <note>Genesis 1:31</note> It also says: **"Therefore all Your precepts concerning all things I consider right."** <note>Psalm 119:128</note> And it says: **"And the Lord blessed Abraham in all things"** <note>Genesis 24:1</note>. 

We have already informed you that the attribute of **The Living God** is called **"All"** because everything is within it. When it pours the flow of emanation into the attribute of **Adonai** <note>The Name associated with Malkhut/Kingship, the final Sefirah</note>, the attribute of **Adonai** is also called by the term **"All,"** for it is comprised of the "All," for the reason that **"My Name is within him."** <note>Exodus 23:21</note> When the attribute of **Adonai** is comprised of the **"All,"** it then also pours its blessings into all created beings according to their kinds. Therefore, the totality of all created beings is also called by the name **"All,"** after the attribute of **Adonai** which sustains every single creature according to its kind. 

Now, you must keep this principle in mind: whenever you find the term **"All"** <note>*Kol*</note>, it indicates one of three things. Sometimes the term **"All"** indicates the attribute of **The Living God** <note>Yesod</note>. Sometimes it indicates the attribute of **Adonai** <note>Malkhut</note>. And sometimes it indicates all created beings together. The reason is as we have just informed you: from the power of the **"All"** comes the **"everything."** 

If so, contemplate what was said of Abraham: **"And the Lord blessed Abraham in all"** <note>Genesis 24:1</note>; and of Isaac: **"And I ate of all"** <note>Genesis 27:33</note>; and of Jacob: **"Because I have all."** <note>Genesis 33:11</note> For all three were blessed by the attribute that is comprised of the "All." You find, then, that all blessings and good things come to the attribute of **The Living God** through **Lord God of Hosts**. Therefore, **The Living God** is included in all things: Kindness, Judgment, and Mercy from the "Three Legs" <note>The Patriarchs/three primary Sefirot</note>. 

Since King David (peace be upon him) "clothed" himself in the attribute of **The Living God**, and he is (b) the secret of the **Fourth Leg** of the Legs of the Chariot <note>The Divine Chariot is supported by four pillars; David completes the triad of the Patriarchs</note>, he was comprised of Kindness, Judgment, and Mercy from the three legs. Concerning him it was said: **"And he was ruddy, with beautiful eyes and good to look upon."** 

**"Ruddy"** <note>original: *Admoni*</note> is the secret of the drawing down of Judgment, called "Red Fire." **"With beautiful eyes"**—this is the secret of the Kindness of Abraham, which is the secret of the "Eye of Kindness," for he was the "eye of the world." **"And good to look upon"** refers to the **Beauty of Jacob** <note>Tiferet</note>, upon whom "Goodness" depends. 

And if you should say: "Behold, it is written of Esau: **'And the first came out ruddy'**?" <note>Genesis 25:25</note> In the "ruddiness" of Esau there is no mixture of goodness or beauty, but he was entirely ruddy like a hairy mantle. But regarding David it is written: **"ruddy with beautiful eyes."** 

You find, then, that the wicked Esau inherited destruction and the shedding of blood. But David (peace be upon him) inherited the attribute of **Kingship** <note>Malkhut</note> in its proper arrangement: to perform kindness, mercy, justice, and righteousness, and to execute judgment—even to kill according to the absolute law. For of Esau it is said: **"And the first came out ruddy, all over like a hairy mantle,"** but of David it is said: **"And he was ruddy, with beautiful eyes and good..."**

### The Chariots of Egypt and the Celestial War

Samael <note>The celestial accuser or prince of the kingdom of Edom/Rome, here acting as the spiritual power behind Egypt</note> was augmented by six hundred "chosen chariots" <note>Exodus 14:7</note> in addition to the standard chariots of Egypt. If you do not interpret it this way, why does the verse state: **"And he took six hundred chosen chariots"** and then afterward **"and all the chariots of Egypt"**? Were the chosen ones not also Egyptian chariots? Rather, the six hundred chosen chariots were distinct from the earthly Egyptian chariots. Therefore, it was necessary to specify "and all the chariots of Egypt" as well. 

The battle was fought in the higher realms, and it was necessary for the **Lord** <note>original: *Adonai*</note> to don three types of garments: 
1. The **Royal Garment**, which is the attribute of **Beauty** <term>Beauty: *Tiferet*, the central Sefirah that balances Mercy and Justice</term>, the "Pride of Jacob." 
2. The **Garment of Loving-kindness** <note>original: *Chesed*</note> from the side of Abraham, to save Israel. 
3. The **Garment of War** from the side of Isaac, representing **Might** <term>Might: *Gevurah*, the Sefirah of judgment, discipline, and power</term>, to wage war against the celestial camp of Egypt. 

When the Divine clothed itself in these three garments, it was through the mystery of the three verses: **"And [the angel of God] moved,"** **"And [it] came [between the camps],"** and **"And [Moses] stretched out [his hand]"** <note>Exodus 14:19-21; in Hebrew, *Vayisa, Vayavo, Vayeit*. These three verses each contain 72 letters and together form the 72-fold Name of God</note>. These are the secret of the three garments we mentioned. Through them, the war was waged against the "Egypt of above" and they were defeated. 

This is the secret behind the verse: **"And He removed the wheels of their chariots, so that they drove them heavily,"** <note>Exodus 14:25</note> and why Egypt said: **"Let us flee from the face of Israel, for the Lord fights for them against the Egyptians."** This is what the Torah means by: **"The Lord will fight for you, and you shall remain silent."** <note>Exodus 14:14</note> It also says: **"And Israel saw the great hand which the Lord laid upon the Egyptians."** <note>Exodus 14:31</note> 

Though the text mentions "The Lord" <note>original: *YHVH*</note> in the context of the war with Egypt and does not explicitly mention "Lord" <note>original: *Adonai*</note> in that specific section, we have already informed you that <gloss>all the Names are included within the Name *YHVH*</gloss>. Each individual Name has its known function. When it says **"The Lord fought for them,"** it is known that this refers to the mystery of the "Final Heh" <note>The last letter of the four-letter Name Y-H-V-H</note> of the Name *YHVH*, which is the attribute that fights the wars of the Lord and is called *Adonai*. This Master of Wars defeats them, for *Adonai* acts through the power of **"The Lord God of Hosts."** He was "clothed" in them through the power of the three "chariots" known through the mystery of **"And [the angel] moved," "And [it] came,"** and **"And [Moses] stretched out."**

Following this path, understand that the Name called **God of Hosts** <note>original: *Elohim Tzva’ot*</note> is the one that provides power to the Name **Lord** <note>original: *Adonai*</note> to fight the wars of the Lord. The secret is found in: **"God of Hosts, return now; look down from heaven and see, and be mindful of this vine."** <note>Psalm 80:15</note> **"Return now"** is like the verse: **"Return, O Lord, to the ten thousands [of Israel]."** <note>Numbers 10:36</note> It means to return and provide power to the Name *Adonai*, which is called **"this vine."** 

And through whom do you "be mindful" of this vine? Through the one who is the "Appointed One," who is the **Living God** <note>original: *El Chai*, referring to the Sefirah of Yesod</note>. According to this path, we say: **"God, restore us; let Your face shine, that we may be saved."** <note>Psalm 80:8</note> This attribute is called <insert>Splendor</insert> <note>original: *Hod*</note> in this verse, as it is said: **"Yours, O Lord, is the greatness, the might, the beauty, the victory, and the splendor."** <note>1 Chronicles 29:11</note> 

The secret of why it is called **Splendor** <note>original: *Hod*</note> is because it "clothes" itself in the attribute of **Might** <note>original: *Gevurah*</note> and power to humble the enemies, to win wars, and to save those who love the Lord. This is the mystery of the verse: **"And my splendor was turned in me into corruption, and I retained no strength."** <note>Daniel 10:8</note> Because this is the place of victory in war and the performance of miracles and wonders, it is at this place that "Thanksgivings" <note>original: *Hoda’ot*, a wordplay on *Hod*</note> are recited. All the types of thanksgivings that David (peace be upon him) said in the Book of Psalms are associated with these two adjacent attributes <note>Victory (Netzach) and Splendor (Hod)</note>. 

Thanksgivings for miracles and wonders are established in this place, following the mystery of: **"Let them give thanks to the Lord for His goodness, and for His wonderful works to the children of men."** <note>Psalm 107:8</note> This also follows the secret of the "Four Who Must Give Thanks": a sick person who has healed, a prisoner who has been released from the dungeon, those who cross the seas, and those who travel through deserts. <gloss>In this place, He bestows good upon the undeserving</gloss>, for in these two attributes, there are places where angels are appointed to tear up a person's death sentence or other punishments. This is the secret of what the Sages (of blessed memory) said: **"They tear up a person's decree of seventy years,"** for there are seventy ministers who stand in the House...

# Gate 2
<meta>catchword: unified</meta>

The Torah, the Prophets, and the Writings correspond to the Source, the Stream, and the Pool. Moses, our teacher—may he rest in peace—clung to the **Source** <term>Source: *Maqor*, representing the highest, purest level of revelation</term>, which is the secret of pure waters that have no trace of murkiness; therefore, his prophecy was crystal clear. The Prophets clung to the banks of the **Stream** <term>Stream: *Nachal*, a flow that moves further from the source</term>; therefore, their prophecy was mixed with imagery and imagination, just as a stream is mixed with types of sediment. And the rest of the **Writings** <note>The *Ketuvim*, the third section of the Hebrew Bible</note> cling to the **Pool** <term>Pool: *Breikha*, a collection of water that is stationary</term>, for they are gathered waters and are not as crystal clear. Now that we have informed you of these principles in a general way regarding these two names, we must begin the explanation of each one of them individually, with the help of the Higher One, writing in this order; may He guide us in the path of truth and prophecy.

## An Explanation of the Splendor of the Name Called "God of Hosts"
<note>original: *Elohim Tzevaot*</note>

This is the secret of the attribute that draws all types of Judgment <term>Judgment: *Din*, the restrictive power of God</term> and Might <term>Might: *Gevurah*</term> from the side of the Left. It draws from **Understanding** <note>original: *Binah*</note> and from **Fear** <note>original: *Pachad*, a name for the Sefirah of Gevurah associated with the patriarch Isaac</note>, and it fights the "Wars of the Lord of Hosts" both above and below. This is what is written: **"On that day the Lord will punish the host of heaven in heaven and the kings of the earth on the earth"** <note>Isaiah 24:21</note>. 

I must inform you of the essence of this matter. I have already told you that the name called **Lord** <note>original: *Adonai*</note> is the ruler over all the multitudes above and below. He is the Great Provider <gloss>meaning: over the Assembly of Israel, the root of the world that includes and distributes</gloss> among created beings. In His hand are all the treasuries of the kingdom, the warriors, and all the weapons of war: chariots of fire and horses of fire, sparks, swords, bows, arrows, catapult stones, and all other instruments of battle. Sixty mighty ones surround this name, all of them "gripping the sword, expert in war, each with his sword upon his thigh because of fear" <note>Song of Songs 3:7-8</note>. They all receive power and might from the side of **Fear** <note>Pachad/Gevurah</note>. The secret of **"each with his sword upon his thigh because of fear"** <note>original: *mipachad*, meaning both "out of terror" and "from the Sefirah of Pachad"</note> refers to this.

We have already informed you that the name called **Lord** <note>Adonai</note> is the attribute of **Kingdom** <term>Kingdom: *Malkhut*, the final Sefirah that manifests divine will in the physical world</term>. He rules over all created beings; He gives life and brings death, makes poor and makes rich, brings low and lifts up, wounds and heals. All these things that the name **Lord** performs through the prophets are according to the flow that comes to Him from the higher levels <note>Literally "the levels above the head"</note>, whether for good or for evil, for life or for death, for peace or for war, for plenty or for famine. 

Now we must inform you that when the name **Lord** wears the garments of war and is armed to fight in heaven and on earth, He clothes Himself in the weapons of the warriors of **Fear** <note>Pachad</note>. He also clothes Himself in weapons from the side of **"God of Hosts"** <note>Elohim Tzevaot</note>, who draws from the attribute of the **"Living God"** <note>El Chai</note>, the attribute of the **"Ruddy One"** <term>Ruddy One: *Admoni*, a reference to Esau/Edom but here used to describe the red-hued attribute of strict Justice</term>. If you search, you will find that in the name **Ruddy** <note>Admoni</note>, the name **Lord** <note>Adonai</note> is hinted at; this means that from there, might and war are drawn to the name **Lord**. 

The secret of this is: why is it written **"God of Hosts"** and **"Will You not go out with our hosts?"** <note>Psalm 60:12/44:10</note> Contemplate this verse and you will find "God of Hosts" in the context of war. The explanation of the verse is this: "Why, O God, have You abandoned us?"—which is the secret of the attribute of Kingdom and War—"Why have You abandoned us and why do You not wear the garments of vengeance and war from the attributes of **God of Hosts**, which are *our* hosts?" For they belong to us and we belong to them, and no other nation has a portion in the foundation of **God of Hosts** except for Israel. As it says: **"For the Lord your God is a jealous God in your midst"** <note>Deuteronomy 6:15</note>—"in your midst" and not in another nation. And it says: **"The zeal of the Lord of Hosts will perform this"** <note>Isaiah 9:6</note>. Therefore it said: **"and do not go out with our hosts"**—meaning, with those two names called **"The Lord God of Hosts,"** which are our hosts.

The matter of wars works in this way: know that when the Blessed Name wishes to uproot a nation or humble it, He does not humble or uproot that nation until He first humbles its celestial Prince. For our Sages of blessed memory said: "No nation falls unless its Prince falls first," as it is said: **"On that day the Lord will punish the host of heaven in heaven"** and only then **"and the kings of the earth on the earth."** 

Know and believe that when Pharaoh pursued Israel at the Sea, and it was said of him: **"And he took six hundred chosen chariots and all the chariots of Egypt"** <note>Exodus 14:7</note>, the war was happening both above and below. The battle was fierce in the heavens. The secret lies in the phrasing **"he took six hundred chosen chariots"** and afterward **"and all the chariots of Egypt,"** for the Prince of Egypt had joined with Samael...

# Gate 54

The two pillars <note>Referring to Yakhin and Boaz, the two bronze pillars at the entrance of Solomon’s Temple</note> represent the secret of the **two tablets** which connect the **Written Torah** (contained in the two tablets) to the **Oral Torah** (which consists of the **Six Orders** <term>Six Orders: *Shisha Sidrei Mishnah*, the foundational text of Jewish law</term>). The mnemonic for this is: "His legs are like pillars of marble" <note>Song of Songs 5:15</note>; these are the "six" <note>The Hebrew word for marble, *shesh*, also means six</note> that support the Six Orders of the Mishnah. Thus, you see that the two tablets and the Six Orders of the Mishnah emerge as one, and both are bound to each other. Anyone who busies themselves with the Written Torah and the Oral Torah essentially connects the "Tent" <note>The Tabernacle</note> to be one, and unifies the Blessed Name (A). This is the secret of **Yakhin and Boaz** <note>original: *Yakhin ve-Boaz*</note>. Know that the attribute called **Boaz** receives strength <note>original: *oz*</note> from **Might** <term>Might: *Gevurah*, the Sefirah of judgment and restraint</term> and power from **Understanding** <term>Understanding: *Binah*, the mother Sefirah from which the lower attributes emerge</term>; it is what gives "strength and power to the people." From this place, all types of force, emanation, and might are drawn from the side of **Judgment** and **Fear**. Through this power, the attribute called **ADONAI** <note>The name of God associated with the Sefirah of *Malchut* (Kingdom)</note> sits in the **Splendor of the Kingdom**. ### Skies
<note>original: *Shachaqim*, the third of the seven heavens in Jewish cosmology</note>

These are the two chambers that prepare food for the righteous (B). They are called "Skies," as our Sages of blessed memory said: "The *Shachaqim* are where they grind manna for the righteous." You should know clearly that through the secret of the Skies, the **manna** and the **dew** are drawn down. The sign for this is: "And when the dew fell upon the camp in the night, the manna fell upon it." (C) You already know that the "Dew of Hermon" descends upon the mountains of Zion. For whom does it grind? For the "Righteous Ones," which are **The Righteous One** (*Tzaddiq*) and **Justice** (*Tzedeq*) <note>Kabbalistic terms for the Sefirot of *Yesod* (Foundation) and *Malchut* (Kingdom)</note>. Generally, *Tzaddiq* and *Tzedeq* receive power, sustenance, and life for all the righteous ones

(D) As it is said: "Who rides the heavens for your help, and in His excellency on the Skies." Then, what is their reward? (A) The secret of **Yakhin and Boaz** is that they represent the language of "Preparation" <note>original: *Hakhanah*, related to Yakhin</note> and the "Establishment" of a thing in its proper form and "Strength" <note>original: *Ozo*, related to Boaz</note>. It also hints at the **Written Torah**, which is the preparation for the **Oral Torah**. One receives "Strength" based on the verse "And He shall give strength to His king." (B) They are called **Skies** (*Shachaqim*) because they prepare and "grind" <note>The Hebrew root *Sh-Ch-Q* means both sky/cloud and to grind/wear down</note> sustenance and life for the righteous. See above regarding the secret of the "Righteous Ones"—the Sefirot of **Foundation** (*Yesod*) and **Kingdom** (*Malchut*), called *Tzaddiq* and *Tzedeq*, who channel the higher attributes. Through them, they prepare food for all, especially for the righteous who perfect their deeds. (C) You already know that the "Dew of Hermon" refers to the flow from the **Crown** (*Keter*); it is called "Dew of Hermon" because it is "totally for Israel" <note>A wordplay on *Chermon* and *Charam*, or 'devoted'</note> and descends upon the mountains of Zion, as I wrote in Gate 20. There the manna also descends, as I will write at the end of Gate 5 and in Gate 30. (D) "Rides the heavens for your help" means: while Israel is below, He "rides the heavens" above according to their spiritual awakening and purification, as I have written several times. "Heavens" refers to **Kindness** (*Chesed*) and **Fear** (*Pachad/Gevurah*), as I wrote nearby.

# Gate 54

(ה) In the Higher Court <note>The celestial tribunal where divine decrees are finalized</note> and afterward a deciding factor, and that verdict which they sign there still has a remedy in this place <note>Meaning that through the attributes of Netzach and Hod, a decree might still be mitigated or healed</note>. 
Therefore, four must give thanks <note>Referring to the four categories of people required to recite a blessing of thanksgiving (*Birkat HaGomel*): those who crossed the sea, traveled the desert, recovered from illness, or were released from prison</note> for this is the place of thanksgivings, and from here is the secret of **acts of loving-kindness** <note>original: *gemilut hasadim*</note>.
And therefore we say: "He who bestows good things upon the guilty." The secret of bowing and the **Modim** <note>The "Thanksgiving" prayer in the Amidah</note> prayer is fixed at these places.
(ג) And the sign for this is: "For to You every knee shall bow" <note>Isaiah 45:23</note>. The secret of the "Modim of the Rabbis" <note>A specific communal response during the Modim prayer</note> in this place is fixed in the Name **YHVH Elohim Tzevaot** <note>The divine name associated with the Sefirot of Netzach and Hod</note>. They are the secret of the attribute of "Disciples of the Wise who increase peace in the world" <note>A famous Talmudic teaching from Berakhot 64a</note> and its secret to those who "know grace" (נ) they are the ones who increase peace.
And so it says: "For the seed of peace, the vine shall give its fruit, and the earth shall give its increase, and the heavens shall give their dew" <note>Zechariah 8:12</note>.
And you already know that "the dew of Hermon descends upon the mountains of Zion" <note>Psalm 133:3</note>, which are **Netzach** and **Hod**. And because they are the place of thanksgivings, which is the secret of "For to You every knee shall bow," our Sages of blessed memory said: "One must bow during the *Modim* prayer." And every blessing that comes to the world comes through these. 
Therefore, one who does not bow during *Modim*, his spine becomes a serpent after seventy years. The secret of the **seventy years** refers to the seventy princes <note>The guardian angels of the seventy nations</note> who stand in the circular row. And the Serpent stands outside as an ambusher against **Netzach** and **Hod**. 
Anyone who is not careful with the Disciples of the Wise—or with Netzach and Hod—is worthy of being bitten by the serpent. This is what they meant by: "Anyone who transgresses the words of the Sages is liable for death" and is worthy of being bitten by the serpent. 
Therefore, know that when the Name called **ADONAI** clothes itself in the garment of **Hod**, it is victorious in all the wars of Israel, takes vengeance for us from our oppressors, and pays recompense to all the enemies of our soul. Therefore, we must give thanks to the One who wore the garment of **Hod** and won the war; the secret is: "You are clothed in glory and majesty" <note>Psalm 104:1</note>.
And this is the "God of Thanksgivings, Master of Wonders." Therefore, contemplate every place where you find the language of "thanksgiving" (*hoda'ah*), for it corresponds to this place.
And know that corresponding to this attribute, Solomon made in the Holy Temple (כ) the second pillar and called its name **Boaz**, for there were two pillars, **Yakhin** and **Boaz**. 
The secret is: "His legs are pillars of marble, set upon bases of fine gold" <note>Song of Songs 5:15</note>. These "legs" are **Netzach** and **Hod**, the secret name of **YHVH Elohim Tzevaot**, and they are the pillars of the Sefirot. 
Corresponding to them, Solomon made the two pillars, Yakhin and Boaz. And as for what it says, "pillars of marble" <note>The Hebrew word for marble, *shesh*, also means "six"</note>, you already know that the Middle Line is the secret of **Tiferet** (Beauty), which is the secret of the letter **Vav** <note>The numerical value of the letter Vav is six</note> of the Unique Name. 
These two pillars are at the bottom of the *Vav* of the Name, for the letter *Vav* is the secret of "six" and sustains six names: **Greatness, Might, Beauty, Victory, Splendor, and Foundation** <term>Greatness... Foundation: *Chesed, Gevurah, Tiferet, Netzach, Hod, Yesod*</term>. 
Therefore it said: "His legs"—which are Netzach and Hod—are "pillars of six" <note>original: *amudei shesh*</note>, meaning they are the pillars of the *Vav*. And upon whom do they stand? Upon **Foundation** (*Yesod*), and Foundation sits upon the Throne called **ADONAI**. Thus the secret is explicitly explained. 
"Set" (*meyussadim*) is a hint to **Yesod** (Foundation). "Upon bases of fine gold" (*adnei paz*) refers to the Name **ADONAI**.
It turns out that the seven lower Sefirot are tied together in this verse: "His legs are pillars of six"—here are five Sefirot: Greatness, Might, Beauty, Victory, and Splendor. "Set" refers to the sixth Sefirah, which is Foundation. "Upon bases of fine gold"—this is the seventh attribute to them, which is **ADONAI**.
And now that we have awakened you to this great secret, know that from this place—which is Greatness, Might, Beauty, Victory, Splendor, and Foundation, which is the secret of "His legs are pillars of six"—from here were created the two **Seraphim** <note>A high rank of angels</note> called "the possessors of six wings."
They are called Seraphim because they burn (*sorefim*) all those who do not care for the honor of their Creator when they gaze upon the Work of the Chariot <term>Work of the Chariot: *Ma'aseh Merkavah*, the highest level of Jewish mysticism</term> and engage in the secret of the **Hashmal** <term>Hashmal: A divine "electrum" or amber-like brilliance mentioned in Ezekiel 1:4</term>. 
They are the ones who burn all those who make use of the names of the **Crown** (*Keter*). These are the sources and springs from which the **Six Orders of the Mishnah** are drawn, until they reach the attribute of **ADONAI**, which is called the **Oral Torah**. And because these...

<meta>This page continues the discussion of the divine structure, moving from the role of the Sefirot in prayer to their role as the source of prophecy. It establishes a hierarchy between the prophecy of Moses and that of all other prophets based on which Sefirot they "draw" from.</meta>

# Gate 3 [Part] 4 [Page] 39

This place refers to and is the secret of "the zeal <note>original: *kin’ah*, also translated as jealousy or passion</note> of the Lord of Hosts shall perform this" <note>Isaiah 9:6</note>; therefore it is said, "envy <note>*kin’ah*</note> is the rottenness of the bones" <note>Proverbs 14:30</note>. And because zeal is dependent upon this place, it is said regarding the meal offering of a woman suspected of adultery: "it is a meal offering of jealousy <note>*kin’ot*</note>, a meal offering of memorial, bringing iniquity to remembrance" <note>Numbers 5:15</note>. And those who know the secret of **Zeal** <note>original: *Kin’ah*</note> and the secret of **Remembrance** <note>original: *Zikaron*</note> know (a) that Zeal and Remembrance are joined forever and ever. 

Know that these two names, which are **Netzach** <term>Victory/Endurance</term> and **Hod** <term>Splendor/Majesty</term>, are the source of the prophets' nourishment; it is from this place that the prophets draw all types of prophecy, each according to his strength and according to his level of attainment—except for Moses our Teacher, peace be upon him. He ascended to receive the Torah from above this place, for his prophecy was through a direct vision and not through riddles <note>A reference to Numbers 12:8</note>. 

Therefore, you will find the prophets referring in their prophecy to "Thus says the Lord of Hosts" <note>original: *Koh amar YHVH Tzevaot*</note>, but in the prophecy of Moses our Teacher, peace be upon him, he does not mention "the Lord of Hosts" <note>*YHVH Tzevaot*</note> because his prophecy ascended higher than this place. You will find that the [other] prophets refer in their prophecy to the four lower **Sefirot** <term>Divine emanations or attributes</term>, which are **Adonai**, **El Chai**, **YHVH Tzevaot**, and **Elohim Tzevaot**. All of these are included in the secret of "Thus <note>original: *Koh*</note> says the Lord of Hosts." 

What you must know and believe is that the prophecy of all the prophets—whether the prophecy of Moses our Teacher, peace be upon him, or the prophecies of all the others—all their prophecy came from the Name **YHVH**, may He be blessed. You should not say that the prophecy of Moses was from YHVH but the prophecy of all other prophets was through an angel. Do not believe this! 

If so, what is the difference between the prophecy of Moses and the prophecy of all other prophets? Know that the prophecy of Moses was unified with **Tiferet** <term>Beauty/Harmony</term>, which is a **clear mirror** <note>original: *aspaklaria me’irah*</note>, and from there he attached himself to the higher Sefirot. But all the other prophets did not unify with Tiferet (which is the secret of the Name **YHVH**) except through the mediation of the lower Sefirot: the Names **Adonai**, **El Chai**, and **YHVH Elohim Tzevaot**. These prophets did not achieve attachment to YHVH except through the medium of **Malchut** <term>Kingdom</term>, **Yesod** <term>Foundation</term>, **Netzach**, and **Hod**. 

This is the secret of "Thus says the Lord of Hosts." Whenever you find the prophets speaking with YHVH through a medium, the "vision" we mentioned is only through the gathering of the lower Sefirot. You already know that the final Sefirah, called **Adonai**, is called the **mirror that is not clear** <note>original: *aspaklaria she-eina me’irah*, a dull or opaque lens</note>, and through it the prophets saw by means of imagery, as it is said: "and by the hand of the prophets I used parables" <note>Hosea 12:11</note>. This is the secret of their constant saying, "Thus says the Lord of Hosts." 

The secret is what is said regarding "the mirrors of the serving women <note>original: *tzov'ot*</note> who assembled <note>*tzav'u*</note> at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting" <note>Exodus 38:8</note>. The Tent of Meeting is the secret of **Adonai**. Moses our Teacher entered the Tent of Meeting and spoke with YHVH, which is the "clear mirror," face to face. But the other prophets speak with YHVH through **Adonai**, which is the "mirror that is not clear." 

This is the secret of: "And I appeared to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob as **El Shaddai**, but by My name **YHVH** I was not known to them" <note>Exodus 6:3</note>. That is to say: I was not revealed to them through the Name YHVH such that they would see Me through a "clear mirror," but rather through **El Shaddai**. You already know that **Shaddai** is the secret of **Adonai**, as we informed you at the end of the first Gate. Thus you have learned that the prophecy of all prophets was through attachment to and the speech of YHVH, may He be blessed. There is no prophecy through an angel; rather, all prophets are through YHVH. The difference between the prophecy of Moses and other prophets is that Moses' prophecy was through YHVH without the mediation of the four lower Sefirot, while all other prophets were through the mediation of the four lower Sefirot. 

Now, if you should say: "Behold, we find many prophecies through an angel!"—as it is written regarding Abraham, "And the angel of the Lord called to him from heaven," and in the prophecies of Zechariah, "And the angel who spoke with me answered..." implying that this prophecy was through an angel—do not be dismayed in your spirit by these places and their like, for you will yet hear the words of the Living God concerning them. And in many other places regarding the other prophets: do not wonder in your mind when prophecy does not come in the Name of YHVH, may He be blessed. In *Leviticus Rabbah* they said: "'And He called to Moses'—not like Abraham, of whom it is written: 'And the angel of the Lord called to Abraham a second time from heaven.'"

Between them, for the secret of the three names **El, Elohim, and YHVH** <note>God, the Judge, and the Eternal</note> is called the Name of "He who sits in the heavens" <note>Psalm 2:4</note>. It says, "Who rides upon the heavens to your help" <note>Deuteronomy 33:26</note> and "The heavens are the Lord's heavens" <note>Psalm 115:16</note>. Concerning this, it is said: "Then hear Thou in heaven Thy dwelling place" <note>1 Kings 8:39</note>. Similarly, it says, "And Jacob was a simple man, dwelling in tents" <note>Genesis 25:27</note>. (א) And it says, "Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters" <note>Genesis 1:6</note>. Through this path, you shall contemplate every place where you find the word **Heavens** <note>original: *Shamayim*</note>, for it is the secret of the two names representing **Gedulah** <term>Greatness/Loving-kindness</term> and **Gevurah** <term>Strength/Judgment</term>, which are *El* and *Elohim*. Both of these together are called "Heavens." The name **YHVH** stands in the middle of them both, acting as the "firmament in the midst of the waters." In every place where you find the word **Skies** <note>original: *Shechakim*</note>, it is the secret of the two names **Netzach** <term>Victory/Endurance</term> and **Hod** <term>Splendor/Majesty</term>, which are "The Lord God of Hosts." **El Chai** <term>The Living God</term> stands in the middle of them both; He is the "third verse" that decides between them. From the Heavens, the divine flow <note>original: *shefa*</note> descends to the Skies. From the Skies, it flows to *El Chai*, and from *El Chai* to *Adonai* <note>the Sefirah of Malchut/Kingdom</note>. The secret of all this is: "Drop down, ye heavens, from above, and let the skies pour down righteousness" <note>Isaiah 45:8</note>. Similarly, it says: "And He commanded the skies from above, and opened the doors of heaven" <note>Psalm 78:23</note>. The explanation of the verse is as follows: "He commanded the skies" from the place that is above them, which is the "Heavens," as it is said, "and opened the doors of heaven." Know that these two names, which are the Lord God of Hosts—**Netzach** and **Hod**—are called the **Essence of the Heavens** <note>original: *Etzem ha-Shamayim*</note>. Regarding them, it is said: "And as it were the essence of the heavens for purity" <note>Exodus 24:10</note>, because their "essence" <note>original: *atzmum*, also meaning their power or bone-structure</note> comes from the place called Heaven. This is a known secret—blessed are those who know this grace—for they are literally the essence of the heavens. From them, all types of "bones" <note>original: *atzamot*</note> receive their strength. Even "the essence of this very day" <note>a phrase often used in the Torah to denote a significant date</note> receives its power from them. The secret is: "All my bones shall say: Lord, who is like unto Thee?" <note>Psalm 35:10</note>. This is the place from which the power of life comes to the dead of Israel through *El Chai*. Similarly, it says, "And He shall make thy bones strong" <note>original: *yachalitz*, meaning to strengthen or arm; Isaiah 58:11</note>, meaning He shall nourish them, from the language of "we will pass over armed" <note>Numbers 32:32</note>, and "every one armed for war" <note>Numbers 31:5</note>, and "twelve thousand armed for war" <note>Numbers 31:5</note>. From the place of the "Lord of Hosts," they are the "armed of the host," and "He shall make thy bones strong." (ב) Know that there is one bone in the human spine called the **Luz** <term>an indestructible, nut-shaped bone</term>. This is the very essence of a person, his root and foundation. From it, the primary developments of a human—the heart, the brain, and the liver—originate, as well as the place of the seed. This bone is formed from the finest and choicest part of the drop of seed, and it is the primary support for all of a person’s bones. When a person dies and his limbs fall apart and his bones rot, that specific bone is not destroyed and does not dissolve. If one were to put it in fire, it would not burn. In a mill, it would not be ground. By a hammer, it would not be shattered. It is the bone that exists forever and ever. It is the one that receives the power of freshness and delights after the death of the righteous, as it is said, "And He shall make thy bones strong." It is also the one that receives punishments for the wicked, as it is said: "and their iniquities shall be upon their bones" <note>Ezekiel 32:27</note>. This bone's root and essence are from the "Essence of the Heavens," and from there it receives the power of permanence and the standing of the entire human body. Know that the secret of bowing in prayer is found in the secret of the bones. Therefore, the Sages found it necessary to hint that one must bow during the *Modim* <note>the "Thanksgiving" prayer</note> until all the vertebrae in the spine are loosened. You already know that *Modim* corresponds to **Netzach** and **Hod**. And because "Zeal" <note>original: *kin’ah*</note> comes from the Essence of the Heavens, every place where the language of zeal is mentioned in the Torah, such as, "For the Lord your God in your midst is a zealous God" <note>Deuteronomy 6:15</note> <margin>in the place</margin>

(א) And the matter of "Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters": the explanation of the firmament <gloss>in the place</gloss> is that it is always in the middle of the waters. In the language of the secret, there are "Upper Waters" and "Lower Waters." The first [letter] *Heh* is above and the second *Heh* is below, representing **Chokhmah** <term>Wisdom</term> and **Binah** <term>Understanding</term>. The firmament is between them, following the secret of the Name [YHVH]: the letter *Yod* belongs to its tongue and the [final] *Heh* for healing, with the *Vav* in the middle. Regarding what I mentioned about the *Yod* being below, this was the *Yod* of the scribe; this is the secret of the **Kingdom** <note>Malchut</note> which was called the "Soul" of that medicine. This is the "small *Yod*" of the **Foundation** <note>Yesod</note> which includes the upper parts in Gate 3, Part 4, nicknamed the "Little Luz." All of this is from the place called Heaven, which consists of the "Foundation" and "Awe" <note>original: *Pachad*, another name for Gevurah</note>, which are Water and the Sea. They are the gathering of the Heavens from there, for they are the ones who perform all the actions of the Heavens. (ב) Know that there is a bone in the human spine called the **Luz**. Concerning it, it is said that it is the aforementioned secret for healing. You already know that when a person is sick, as mentioned above, and to merit this, it was hinted at in the paths of his creation—this Luz bone is the medicine for his restoration and his ascent during his resurrection. Its mouth is the essence. In any case, the vertebrae of the spine number eighteen, corresponding to the "Living" <note>Hebrew: *Chai*, which equals 18</note> prayers, awakening the "Foundation" of above. The vertebrae of the bones [and] the word *Luz* plus the word *Full* <note>original: *malei*</note> become the letters of the Name. According to the secret of memory, the Luz is the essence of the life of the [sick] person... he will stand because from within it he shall be sanctified to the height of the [sick] person to stand for the Resurrection of the Dead. This is "my place from the dust"—this bone that grew from all the vertebrae that were with it in the general "Foundation," just as our folly is tossed about in the nickname of the **Shekhinah** <term>Divine Presence</term>. For every action and blessing in the world comes through it... this bone is to shine upon him for resurrection, as explained in the collection on the Torah portion *Terumah* <gloss>explanation</gloss>.
