This is a hint that "**He is YHVH to his God**" <note>original: "הוא יי' לאלהיו"</note>—that YHVH is the source of Kindness. They have a single intent. For in our origin and in our hidden source, the division of Judgment and Mercy is as it appears to the Kabbalists mentioned regarding the secret of the hidden realms. In the *Zohar*, regarding the "**Ancient of Ancients**" <term>Aramaic: *Atika de-Atikin*; the most primordial, hidden level of the Divine</term>, before everything, All was One. All was Straight, not opened, not closed, and not turbulent. There were no "days" to distinguish one thing from another. Everything was originally one, only later becoming differentiated for the "Small Face" <term>Aramaic: *Zeir Anpin*; the emotive attributes of God that interact with our world</term>. From there, we find our Law and Justice, which are balanced one with the other. The intent is for everything to be integrated so that the holy portion may be received.

And it is written: "**He is YHVH to his God**" <note>Psalm 100:3</note>. This is as if to say: "For all His ways are justice." Justice is the "way" that is revealed and visible below to the eye of all, and not just above. When it says "For all His ways are justice," it means it is a path revealed to the eye of every observer. It does not say it is "hidden," as in the verse: "The path that no bird of prey knows" <note>Job 28:7</note>. The explanation of the verse is thus: He revealed the secret of "**but**" <note>Ach</note>—for "but" is the quality of Grace when combined with the freedom of Understanding. And the judgment passes because the Attribute of Judgment enters beneath the Attribute of Kindness, as will be explained later in the explanation of "Between Me and the children of Israel."

(6) As we have said, and as our Sages of blessed memory explained: "He began to build His world with the **Attribute of Judgment** <term>Hebrew: *Middat HaDin*</term>, as it is said: 'In the beginning Elohim created' <note>Genesis 1:1; the name 'Elohim' denotes Judgment</note>. He saw that it could not endure, so He stood and partnered the **Attribute of Mercy** <term>Hebrew: *Middat HaRachamim*</term> with it, as it is said: 'On the day that YHVH Elohim made earth and heaven'" <note>Genesis 2:4; the addition of 'YHVH' signifies the introduction of Mercy</note>. This matter is true, established, and correct. But come and see great and wondrous matters here regarding the Powers: "Lift up your eyes on high and see: **Who** <note>Hebrew: *Mi*</note> created **these** <note>Hebrew: *Eleh*</note>?" <note>Isaiah 40:26</note>. Certainly, the thing called *Mi* ("Who") created *Eleh* ("these"), which is (ב) the secret of the "One Day," the secret of **Binah** <term>The Sefirah of 'Understanding,' the divine womb or source</term>. This extends until the Sabbath day—the six days in which the heavens, the earth, and all other creatures were made. As we have said, the word *Mi* <note>Who</note> is above (ג) and the word *Yam* <note>Sea</note> is below. The phrase "Who [*Mi*] created her" is the beginning of the "clotting" or "enclavement" of the Name **Elohim** within the secret of the Name called **YHVH ADNY** <note>The Tetragrammaton YHVH combined with Adonai</note>. For it is written with the letters of **YHVH** but read with the vowel points of **Elohim**, according to the secret of **YHVH** and its years. (ד) This is the secret of *Mi* <note>Who</note> and the secret of "all the rivers go to the **Sea** [*Yam*]" <note>Ecclesiastes 1:7</note>. From this attribute called *Mi*—which is the secret of Elohim being clothed in the Name YHVH—the attribute of **Gevurah** <term>Might/Severity</term> (ה) inherited Judgment and Fear. The attribute of Gevurah is literally called **Elohim**. Through these two attributes, the attribute called **ADNY** <note>Adonai, associated with the Sefirah of Malchut/Sovereignty</note> inherited the Name Elohim and wore its garments. Then the world was created through the secret of **YHVH ADNY**.

If you understand this principle, you will find the Name **YHVH Elohim** both within the secret of YHVH: YHVH in the shape of its letters, and YHVH in the shape of its vowel points <note>referring to the practice of vocalizing the Tetragrammaton with the vowels of Elohim</note>. Thus, this Name testifies to the secret of **YHVH Elohim**, a "Full Name." And the secret is: "YHVH is the Elohim" in truth—YHVH in the form of the letters is the Elohim in the form of the vowels. And because it says in the verse "YHVH is the Elohim" twice, it corresponds to **Upper Justice** <note>original: *Tzedek Elyon*; associated with Binah</note> (ו) and **Lower Justice** <note>original: *Tzedek Tachton*; associated with Malchut</note>. The secret is: "Know this day and take it to your heart that YHVH is the Elohim in heaven above and on the earth below; there is no other" <note>Deuteronomy 4:39</note>. "In heaven above" refers to Upper Justice; "on the earth below" refers to Lower Justice. If so, everything is hinted at in the secret of **YHVH ADNY**. You have thus learned that the attribute of **ADNY** was present in the creation of the world when the attribute of *Mi*—which is the secret of Binah and the secret of YHVH in writing and in vowels—created the world.

Behold, the attribute of Upper Justice called Binah, the attribute of Gevurah, and the rest of the **Sefirot** <term>Divine emanations/attributes</term> poured their power into the Name **ADNY** and were clothed in the Name **Elohim**, and He created the world. This is what is written: "In the beginning Elohim created." Because the Name Elohim is sometimes (ז) "missing" and sometimes "full," it was necessary to mention it during the creation of the world while the world was not yet in its fullness and the form of its creatures was not yet finished. But when the creation of the world was completed, the Name **YHVH Elohim** was mentioned. **Elohim** was used as long as the forms were not finished; **YHVH** was added at the completion of all forms. For the Name called Elohim is not full and complete except through the Name YHVH. The secret is: "Or who makes him **mute** [*Ilem*]? Is it not I, **YHVH**?" <note>Exodus 4:11</note>. This is the secret of Elohim: when two letters of the Name YHVH, which are **YH** <note>the first two letters of the Tetragrammaton</note>, are missing from the Name Elohim, what remains is ***Ilem*** <note>meaning 'mute' or 'silent'</note>—according to the secret of Elohim being *Ilem-YH*. Therefore, the world was created with the Name Elohim, but when all things and all creatures were perfected and the world was in its fullness, it was necessary to mention **YHVH Elohim**. This is what the Sages of blessed memory meant when they said: "He mentioned a full Name over a full world." Therefore, when the work of creation was finished, He began to mention YHVH Elohim over the fullness of the world. Know and believe that the secret of (ח) the **entire Unity** <term>Hebrew: *Sod HaYichud*; the realization of God's absolute oneness</term> is the secret of YHVH Elohim, and the sign is: "Hear O Israel, YHVH our Elohim, YHVH is One." Therefore, you must understand in every place you find "YHVH Elohim" in the Torah that it is a Full Name, as are all the things found in that section.

(א) As we said at the end of Gate 1. (ב) **The secret of One Day:** The explanation is when one merits the three upper [Sefirot] as one, as explained above in Gate 2. (ג) **The word *Yam* [Sea] below:** For it receives from Binah and is engraved in it like the likeness of a seal, where the writing is entirely reversed upon the impression, as explained in the previous gate. (ד) **And both are the secret of *Mi*:** The explanation is that Malchut and Binah are both the secret of *Mi* [Who] and the secret of *Yam* [Sea], as explained. (ה) **From it, the attribute of Gevurah inherited:** As explained further on here in Gate 9. (ו) **And Lower Justice:** Meaning Malchut and Binah, hinting at the connection of Upper and Lower, like the matter of *Mi* above and *Yam* below. As it said, "makes him mute [*Ilem*], is it not I [YHVH]"—behold, there is a connection here of Upper and Lower. And so from this perspective, in the connection of the letter *Lamed* of the Name. (ז) **Sometimes it is missing:** Meaning the Name of God called by the name of the Sefirah of the End [*Sof*], and sometimes missing from the Upper Shekhinah... (ח) **For the secret of the entire Unity is the secret of YHVH:** Which means that it includes all the Names above and below, Binah and Malchut, and the final *He*, and so it is.

While the previous page touched upon the Name of Hosts and the balance of Judgment and Mercy in the context of Gate 5, this section returns to the foundational relationship between the Name YHVH and the Name Elohim, specifically focusing on the process of Creation and the interplay between the Sefirot of Binah (Understanding) and Malchut (Sovereignty).</meta>

# Gate 2

(א) As we have said, and as our Sages of blessed memory <note>original: "חז"ל" (Chazal); the ancient Rabbinic authorities</note> have stated, the Holy One began to build His world with the **Attribute of Judgment** <term>Hebrew: *Middat HaDin*; the divine quality of law and strictness</term>, as it is said: "In the beginning, God [Elohim] created" <note>Genesis 1:1; the name Elohim denotes Judgment</note>. However, He saw that the world could not endure, so He stood and partnered the **Attribute of Mercy** <term>Hebrew: *Middat HaRachamim*; the divine quality of compassion</term> with it, as it is said: "On the day the Lord [YHVH] God [Elohim] made earth and heaven" <note>Genesis 2:4; here the name YHVH, denoting Mercy, is added</note>. 

This matter is true, established, and correct. But come and see great and wondrous matters: the Scripture says, "Lift up your eyes on high and see: **Who** created **these**?" <note>Isaiah 40:26</note>. This is an awesome matter called "**Who** [*Mi*] created **these** [*Eleh*]," which is (ב) the secret of the "One Day," the secret of **Understanding** <term>Hebrew: *Binah*; the third divine emanation, often called the "Divine Mother"</term>. Its time extends until the Sabbath day—the six days in which the heavens, the earth, and all other creatures were made. And as we have said, the word **Who** <note>original: "מי" (Mi)</note> is above, (ג) and the word **Sea** <note>original: "ים" (Yam); note that Mi and Yam use the same letters in different orders or contexts</note> is below. 

The phrase "**Who** [*Mi*] created **these** [*Eleh*]" <note>The Hebrew letters for "Who" (M-Y) and "These" (A-L-H) can be rearranged to spell "Elohim" (A-L-H-Y-M)</note> is the beginning of the "clothing" of the Name **God** [Elohim] within the secret of the Name called **Lord** [YHVH Adonai]. For it is written with the letters of the Name **YHVH**, but it is read with the vowel points of the Name **Elohim** (ד). These two are the secret of the "Foundational Waters" <note>original: "מי יסודים"; a play on *Mi* (Who) meaning water</note>, and "all the rivers flow into the sea." 

From this attribute called **Who** [*Mi*], which is the secret of the Name Elohim clothing itself in the Name YHVH, the **Attribute of Might** (ה) <term>Hebrew: *Gevurah*; the attribute of power and restraint</term> inherits Judgment and Dread. This Attribute of Might is literally called **Elohim**. Through these two attributes, the attribute called **Lord** [Adonai] <note>associated with the Sefirah of Malchut, the lowest sphere</term> inherits the Name **Elohim** and puts on its garments. Then the world was created through the secret of **YHVH Adonai**. 

If you understand this root, you will find the Name **Lord God** [YHVH Elohim] where both are in the secret of **YHVH**—in the form of its letters it is YHVH, and in the form of its vowel points it is Elohim. Thus, this Name testifies to the secret of "the Lord is God" [YHVH Hu HaElohim], a full Name. The secret is that YHVH is truly the God: YHVH in the shape of the letters, and Elohim in the shape of the vowel points. 

And because it says in the verse "The Lord is God" [YHVH Hu HaElohim] twice, it corresponds to **Upper Justice** (ו) and **Lower Justice**. This is the secret of: "Know therefore this day, and consider it in your heart, that the Lord is God in heaven above and upon the earth beneath; there is none else" <note>Deuteronomy 4:39</note>. "In heaven above" refers to Upper Justice; "And upon the earth beneath" refers to Lower Justice. 

If so, everything is hinted at in the secret of **YHVH Adonai**. You have learned that the attribute of **Adonai** was involved in the creation of the world when it desired the "Who" [*Mi*], which is the secret of **Understanding** [*Binah*]—the secret of YHVH in writing and Elohim in vowel points—and thus the world was created. 

Behold, the attribute of Upper Justice (called *Binah*) and the attribute of Might (*Gevurah*) and the rest of the Sefirot poured their strength into the Name **Adonai**. It was then clothed in the Name **Elohim** and created the world. This is the meaning of "In the beginning, God [Elohim] created." Because the Name Elohim is sometimes (ז) "diminished" and sometimes "full," it was necessary to mention it during the creation of the world while the world was not yet in its fullness and the form of its creation was not yet finished. But when the creation of the world was finished, the Name **YHVH Elohim** is mentioned. **Elohim** is used while the forms were not finished; **YHVH** is used at the completion of all forms. 

For the Name called **Elohim** is not full and complete except through the Name **YHVH**. The secret is: "Or who makes him mute [ilem]... is it not I, the Lord [YHVH]?" <note>Exodus 4:11</note>. This is the secret of the Name **Elohim**: when the two letters of the Name YHVH (which are Y-H) are missing from the Name **Elohim** [A-L-H-Y-M], what remains is **Mute** [A-L-M] <note>The Hebrew word for "mute" (Ilem) uses the same letters as the remaining part of Elohim when the letters of God's name (Yah) are removed</note>. Therefore, the world was created with the Name **Elohim**, but when all things and all creatures were perfected and the world was in its fullness, it was necessary to mention **YHVH Elohim**. This is what the Sages of blessed memory meant when they said: "He mentioned a full Name over a full world." Therefore, when the work of creation was finished, the Torah began to mention **YHVH Elohim** regarding the fullness of the world. 

Know and believe that the secret (ח) of the entire **Unity** <term>Hebrew: *Yichud*; the declaration of God's oneness</term> is the secret of **YHVH Elohim**, and the sign of this is: "Hear O Israel, the Lord [YHVH] is our God [Elohinu], the Lord [YHVH] is One." Therefore, you must understand every place where you find **YHVH Elohim** in the Torah, for it is a full Name, and all things found in that...

...and heavens in purity and the earth in joyful light. For **El** <note>original: *El* (אל)</note> is the secret of the supernal **Grace** <term>Hebrew: *Chesed*; divine benevolence or lovingkindness</term>, and from it, Grace is poured forth upon **Abraham**. The secret is what is said regarding Abraham: "And he called there upon the name of **YHVH, El of the World**" <note>Genesis 21:33</note>, for then he acquired for his portion the **Attribute of Grace** and held fast to it. Therefore, we say in the blessing of the "Shield of Abraham" <note>The first blessing of the *Amidah*, the central silent prayer</note>: "**God Most High** [**El Elyon**] who bestows good favors." It also says: "Blessed be Abram to **El Elyon**" <note>Genesis 14:19</note>. 

When the name **YHVH** <note>The four-letter Name of God, often associated with Mercy</note> unites with **El** and says "**El YHVH**," the name YHVH is found to be blended with Grace and Mercy, and there is no Judgment <term>Hebrew: *Din*; strict justice or severity</term> there at all. Even though YHVH is a name of Mercy, and even though it contains a small amount of Judgment, nevertheless, it is entirely included within Mercy. 

When the name **YHVH** unites with **Elohim**, as in the phrase "**YHVH Elohim**," the name YHVH is found sitting in judgment, judging His creatures with both the attributes of Mercy and Judgment, in the secret of "**YHVH Elohim**," each person according to what is fitting. But when Grace and Mercy combine in the secret of **El YHVH**, then all the **Sefirot** <term>The ten divine emanations or "vessels" of God's light</term> are in joy and perfection, and they all receive Grace and Mercy from above. This is the meaning of: "**El YHVH**, and He gave us light" <note>Psalm 118:27</note>. 

You will find in the **Thirteen Attributes of Mercy** <note>The qualities of divine compassion revealed to Moses after the Golden Calf</note> that these two names alone are mentioned: "**YHVH, YHVH, El** Merciful and Gracious" <note>Exodus 34:6</note>. Because these two names encompass Grace and Mercy, they are mentioned in these Thirteen Attributes. Contemplate this deeply. Our Sages of blessed memory have already said: "A covenant is made regarding the Thirteen Attributes of Mercy that they do not return empty-handed" <note>Talmud, Rosh Hashanah 17b; meaning these prayers are always effective</note>. Therefore, understand that **El YHVH** includes Grace and Mercy.

Furthermore, observe that the name **El** corresponds to **Abraham**, who is the secret of the attribute of **Grace** [*Chesed*]. The name **YHVH** corresponds to **Jacob**, who is the secret of **Mercy** <term>Hebrew: *Rachamim*; the balance between Grace and Judgment</term>. Consequently, the name that corresponds to **Isaac**—which is **Elohim**, signifying **Dread** <term>Hebrew: *Pachad*; the fearful aspect of strict judgment</term>—is not present when the Torah mentions **El YHVH**. Therefore, pay attention whenever you find these two names, **El YHVH**, in the Torah, for they are the secret of Grace and Mercy.

Sometimes you will find in the Torah the name **YHVH** joining with both **El** and **Elohim** in the secret of **El Elohim YHVH**, as written in the Psalm of Asaph: "The Mighty One, God, the Lord [**El Elohim YHVH**], has spoken and called the earth from the rising of the sun to its setting" <note>Psalm 50:1</note>. And as it is written concerning the children of **Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh**: "**El Elohim YHVH**, He knows" <note>Joshua 22:22</note>. 

Know that when these three names connect, a **Court of Three** <note>A *Beit Din*; a legal panel representing a complete judicial process</note> sits upon the throne, judging the world as is fitting—whether for good or for punishment, for life or for death. For **El** is the secret of Grace for those who deserve it. **Elohim** is the secret of reward and punishment for those who deserve it. **YHVH** is the secret of True Judgment for those who deserve it. Thus, these three names encompass all Law, Mercy, and Judgment. 

The great proof of this is when the children of Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh made the altar on the other side of the Jordan, and all Israel wanted to go up against them in war. Before they fought, their brothers sent **Phinehas** and **Eleazar** <note>Phinehas was the son of Eleazar the priest</note>, the leaders of Israel, to speak with them regarding the altar they built. They replied with this matter, saying: "**El Elohim YHVH, El Elohim YHVH**, He knows, and may Israel know: if it was in rebellion or in trespass against the Lord—do not save us this day!—to build an altar for ourselves to turn away from YHVH." 

Know that the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh needed to mention these three names together—**El Elohim YHVH**—for a necessary reason. They mentioned the name **El**, which is the name of Grace; they mentioned the name **Elohim**, which is the name of Judgment and punishment; and they mentioned the name **YHVH**, who is the True Judge, deciding between El and Elohim. 

They effectively said: "We made this altar for the name of **YHVH** as a memorial only, and not for burnt offerings or sacrifices. May the Blessed Name pour His blessings, goodness, and grace upon us through the attribute of **El**, who is the witness who knows our intention regarding this altar. But if we made this altar out of wickedness, to rebel and trespass against the Lord and His dwelling place, and for this altar to serve us for burnt offerings or sacrifices, then **Elohim**—who is the Witness, the Judge, and the Prosecutor—will collect from us and punish us for this great transgression. And the name **YHVH**, which is the **Middle Line** <term>The central pillar of the Sefirotic tree that balances right (mercy) and left (judgment)</term> that decides, He shall decide the judgment according to the intention with which we made this altar—whether for a good reward or for punishment." Therefore they had to mention these three names: **El Elohim YHVH**, which are the secret of **Greatness** <term>Gedulah; another name for Grace</term>, **Power** <term>Gevurah; Judgment</term>, and **Beauty** <term>Tiferet; the balancing Mercy</term>. And so...

(6) **Victory** <term>Hebrew: *Netzach*; the seventh emanation, representing endurance</term> is associated with **God** <term>Hebrew: *Elohim*; the name associated with Judgment</term> within the attribute of **Majesty** <term>Hebrew: *Hod*; the eighth emanation</term>. The letters and the vowel points also depend upon this Name. All of creation and all speech stands through Him, may He be blessed forever and for all eternity. 

Do not let it enter your mind that these things we have told you now regarding this principle are merely matters to be accepted and believed without reason. Rather, these things are a **Tradition** <term>Hebrew: *Kabbalah*</term>, a transmission, and a knowledge that we possess. We have the ability to provide a reason and proof for each of them from our perfect Torah, like a demonstration visible to the eye. <meta>This page continues the discussion of the Divine Names from Gate 5, specifically exploring how the combinations of the names El, Elohim, and the Tetragrammaton (YHVH) manifest as garments of Mercy or Judgment during the creation and governance of the world. It bridges the previous discussion of the name "Hosts" (Tzevaot) with the cosmic administration of justice.</meta>

-># Gate 5<-

In the creation of the world, Asaph mentioned in the Psalm: "The Mighty God, God, the Lord, has spoken and summoned the earth" <note>Psalm 50:1; original Hebrew: *El Elohim YHVH diber va-yikra aretz*</note>. This is because the Blessed Lord <term>Hebrew: *YHVH*; the four-letter name representing the attribute of Compassion</term> clothes Himself during the creation of the world in three types of garments: the garment of **Great Mercy** <term>Hebrew: *Rachamim*</term>, (1) the garment of **Absolute Judgment** <term>Hebrew: *Din*</term>, and the **Middle garment** which balances Mercy and Judgment. All of this follows the secret of the creation of all beings; for some were created through Mercy, some through Absolute Judgment, and some through a mixture of Judgment and Mercy. According to the Wisdom, Grace, Mercy, and Judgment present at the moment of creation, so too is the path of God’s leadership over the world's creatures. Sometimes He conducts them with Absolute Mercy, sometimes with Absolute Judgment, and sometimes with a blend of both.

Contemplate the secret of the **Three Books** that are opened on **the New Year** <term>Hebrew: *Rosh Hashanah*</term>: the books of the righteous, the wicked, and the intermediates. These correspond to the names **Mighty God** <note>*El*</note>, **God** <note>*Elohim*</note>, and **the Lord** <note>*YHVH*</note>. Therefore, observe every place in the Torah where you find the Blessed **Unique Name** <term>The Tetragrammaton (YHVH)</term> joined with *El* or *Elohim*, or all three together. Observe the order of these words according to the path of uprightness and truth.

Sometimes you will find the name **Lord** joined with the name **Hosts** <term>Hebrew: *Tzevaot*</term>, saying **Lord of Hosts** <note>*YHVH Tzevaot*</note>. You will not find this combination in the Five Books of Moses <note>The Torah</note>, but only in the books of the Prophets and the Writings. As it says in the Prophets: "Thus says the Lord of Hosts," and in the Writings: "The Lord of Hosts is with us, the God of Jacob is our fortress, Selah" <note>Psalm 46:8</note>. Know that when the Name clothes itself in the name called **Hosts**, it is finalizing the sentence of the **Heavenly Court** <term>Hebrew: *Beit Din shel Ma'alah*</term> for both the good and the harm of all creatures. Just as the judgment emerges through the three names—*El*, *Elohim*, and *YHVH*—so the sentence is finalized when He clothes Himself in the **Lord of Hosts**. The secret of this is: "And the Lord of Hosts is exalted in judgment" <note>Isaiah 5:16</note>. I shall hint to you a great secret regarding this verse: Know that when 
<margin>God (Elohim)</margin> the Heavenly Court decrees a judgment upon the creatures, then the **Lord of Hosts** finalizes that judgment through the name **Lord** <term>Hebrew: *Adonai*; associated with the final emanation, Kingdom, and the execution of justice</term>. The secret of this is: "Judges and officers you shall appoint for yourselves in all your gates" (2), "and they shall judge the people with **righteous judgment**" <note>Deuteronomy 16:18; the word for "Righteousness" (*Tzedek*) is a title for the name *Adonai*</note>. And then (3) "whenever the living creatures moved, 
<margin>the Wheel (Ofan)</margin> the wheels moved beside them" <note>Ezekiel 1:19</note>. The secret of the "Living Creatures" <note>Chayyot</note> is the secret of the **Judges**, and the secret of the "Wheels" <note>Ofanim</note> is the secret of the **Officers**. The judgment is finalized by **Righteousness** <term>Hebrew: *Tzedek*</term>, which is the name *Adonai*.

When the Blessed Name decrees judgment upon Israel, and the Name called **Lord of Hosts** sees that Israel cannot endure that punishment, the name **Lord of Hosts** ascends to draw out Favor and Mercy from above to ease the troubles of Israel. He leaves the judgment to the attribute of **El**, which is the attribute of **Grace** <term>Hebrew: *Chesed*</term>, and performs **Charity** <term>Hebrew: *Tzedakah*</term> for Israel, diminishing the trouble and the punishment. Even if Israel is not worthy, He does this from the side of Charity. This is what is written: "The Lord of Hosts is exalted in judgment, and the **Holy God** <note>*Ha-El Ha-Kadosh*</note> is sanctified through **righteousness** <note>Isaiah 5:16; "Righteousness" here means charity or grace</note>." 

Therefore, the Prophets would mention Israel with the name **Lord of Hosts** in matters of testimony and warning, for both good and ill. When the judgment was finalized against Israel, had the **Lord of Hosts** not "exalted" that decree and handed it over to **El**—the attribute of Supernal Grace—no remnant or survivor would have remained of the "enemies of Israel" <note>A common euphemism in Jewish texts used to avoid speaking of the destruction of Israel itself</note>. This is why it is said, "To You, O Lord, belongs righteousness, but to us, shame of face" <note>Daniel 9:7</note>.

If so, contemplate the Torah in every place you find "Lord of Hosts" written. Sometimes you will find these three names explicitly in a verse, such as: "Lord God of Hosts, restore us; show the light of Your face, that we may be saved" <note>Psalm 80:20</note>. And it says: "Lord God of Hosts, hear my prayer; listen, O God of Jacob, Selah" <note>Psalm 84:9</note>. The intention here is that the attributes of Grace, Mercy, Judgment, and Awe each clothe themselves in their proper place. The Lord <note>YHVH</note> in the attribute of **Victory** <term>Netzach</term>...

And as the conclusion of Gate 8, which contains all the **Emanations** <term>Sefirot</term> in great perfection, as explained later at the end of the explanation of the titles of the Lord. The garment of **Judgment** is the secret of **Kingdom** <term>Malchut</term>, managed at times by the movements of the Glory of the titles in this gate. When they are clothed in **Absolute Mercy**, they are the world of the **Noble Intellects**. Those clothed in Mercy and Judgment are the **World of the Spheres**, which contain both harmful forces and nourishing forces—sometimes acting through Mercy and sometimes through Judgment, according to the merits of people. So too in the **Lower World**, which centers on Man, who corresponds to *El*, *Elohim*, and *YHVH*. Because of these three divisions, there was thought given to them, and therefore the righteous are written in the **Book of Life**, the wicked in the secret of "What" <note>Hebrew: *Mah*; likely a reference to a specific kabbalistic numerical value or state of being</note>, and the intermediates in the **Book of Mercy and Judgment**, which is **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term>. # Gate 5

The Great [Powers] <note>Refers to the emanations of divine kindness</note> that subdue all those of harsh judgment are called **El** <note>original: א"ל (*El*)</note>. Concerning this, it is said: "To whom then will you liken God?" <note>Isaiah 40:18; original Hebrew: *ve-el mi tedamyun El*</note>. This means that even in the form of the letters that indicate the Essence of Being <term>the Tetragrammaton, YHVH</term>, He has no known likeness or letter to represent Him, except from the aspect of the letter of **Understanding** <term>Hebrew: *Binah*</term>, which points to and testifies of Him. This is the meaning of "To **whom** [*Mi*] will you liken God?" Through the power of *Binah*, which is called **Who** <note>The Hebrew word for "Who" is *Mi* (מ"י). In Kabbalah, *Mi* is a name for *Binah*, representing the highest point where questioning can begin</note>, we can imagine His existence, but nothing else. 

Know that this is the secret of the **tip of the letter Yod** <note>original: *kotzo shel yod*</note> of the Unique Name, which hints at the Supernal Existence that is without limit or measure <term>Keter, the "Crown" or first Sefirah</term>. From the secret of the tip of the *Yod* emerges the letter *Yod* itself, which is called **Wisdom** <term>Hebrew: *Chokhmah*</term>, an infinite Will. This is the secret of the verse: "But Wisdom—where [from *Ayin*] shall it be found?" <note>Job 28:12; original: *v'hachokhmah me-ayin timatze*</note>. The secret of Wisdom is the second *Sefirah*, while **Nothingness** <note>Hebrew: *Ayin*</note> is the secret of the first *Sefirah*. These two *Sefirot* are included in the secret of the letter *Yod*—both in its tip and its shape. You thus find that the letter *Yod* of the Unique Name includes two of the holy Names, which are the two highest *Sefirot* called **I Shall Be** <term>Hebrew: *Ehyeh*</term>. *Ehyeh* is the secret of the tip of the *Yod*, while the *Yod* itself is the shape of the letter.

**The secret of the second letter** of the Name, which is **He** <note>ה</note>, is a hint to **Understanding** <term>Hebrew: *Binah*</term>. She is the secret of the "knot" of the nine *Sefirot* and the "knot" of the ten *Sefirot*. <note>Refers to *Binah* acting as a bridge</note> She links the three Supernal *Sefirot*—which are **Crown, Wisdom, and Understanding** <term>Keter, Chokhmah, Binah</term>—with **Greatness, Strength, Beauty, Victory, Splendor, and Foundation** <term>Chesed, Gevurah, Tiferet, Netzach, Hod, Yesod</term>. She also links the tenth, which is **Kingdom** <term>Malchut</term>, when it is connected with the **Foundation** <term>Yesod</term>. Thus, you find that *Binah* connects all ten *Sefirot*: the seven [lower] *Sefirot* and *Malchut* with the three Supernal *Sefirot*. 

This is the letter **He**, the second letter of the Name **YHVH** <note>The Tetragrammaton</note>, may He be blessed. This letter is the secret of *Binah*. Her specific name in the Torah is **YHVH**, but while the shape of the letters is *YHVH*, the vocalization <note>vowel points</note> of the letter *Yod* is the vocalization of **Elohim** <note>A name associated with Judgment</note>. This is because the attribute of **Strength** <term>Hebrew: *Gevurah*</term>, which is called *Elohim*, is drawn from *Binah*. Therefore, wherever you find in the Torah the combination "the Lord GOD" <note>original: *YHVH Adonai*</note> such as "The Lord GOD is my strength" <note>Habakkuk 3:19</note>, or "GOD the Lord" <note>original: *Adonai YHVH*</note> such as when Abraham said, "GOD the Lord, what will You give me?" <note>Genesis 15:2</note>—the Name appearing in these verses and those like them is the secret of *Binah*, which contains both **Mercy and Judgment**. From her, the powers of Judgment are drawn; therefore, her name is written as *YHVH* (because the shape of these letters represents Mercy) but her vocalization is that of Judgment. Therefore, know that <note>ג</note> the beginning of Judgment in the *Sefirot* is the secret of *Binah*, arising from the thought of *Chokhmah* (Wisdom), and from *Binah* the power of Judgment and Strength is drawn. You thus learn that the secret of the second letter...

From these hidden depths, the world was created. # **The Secret of the Second Letter of the Name**
This is the secret of the letter **He** [ה], which is the secret of **Understanding** <term>Hebrew: *Binah*</term> (b) <margin>(b) Included in the tongue and the mouth: For she is like the "ice" <note>Refers to a crystalline purity</note> of the tongue and mouth. # **The Secret of the Third Letter of the Name**
This is the secret of the letter **Vav** [ו], and it includes six *Sefirot* according to the numerical value of the *Vav* <note>In Hebrew numerology, Vav equals 6</note>. Three *Sefirot* are from the upper half of the *Vav* and above, and three are from the lower half and below. The three *Sefirot* from the upper half of the *Vav* are **Greatness** <term>Chesed/Kindness</term>, **Power** <term>Gevurah/Judgment</term>, and **Beauty** <term>Tiferet</term>. The three *Sefirot* from the lower half of the *Vav* are **Victory** <term>Netzach</term>, **Splendor** <term>Hod</term>, and **Foundation** <term>Yesod</term>. All these six *Sefirot* are included in the letter *Vav*. Behold, the letter *Vav* of the Name crowns (e) <margin>(e) Behold, it stands in place of the entire Name, as explained later in the clarification of the "Middle Line," which is the "constellation" of *Yesod*. There, everything is included and tied together.</margin> the place of the entire Name. You will see further depths and wonders in these letters of the Name, with God's help; your eyes shall see and your heart shall rejoice.

# **The Secret of the Fourth Letter of the Name**
This is the secret of the letter **He** [ה], which is the secret of the final *Sefirah* called **Kingdom** <term>Hebrew: *Malkhut*</term>. This is the secret of the Unity of the Blessed Lord. In her, faith in the Unity of the Creator is built and established. From the secret of this *He* and below is the realm of "Separation." This is the secret of: "A river went out of Eden to water the garden, and from there it was parted and became four heads" <note>Genesis 2:10</note>. These are the secret of the four camps of the **Divine Presence** <term>Hebrew: *Shekhinah*</term>. Thus, the Name YHVH, may He be blessed, includes the ten *Sefirot* in their proper order.

# **The Secret of the Name YHVH, Blessed be He, Regarding the General Rule of Holy Names: Know**

For all His names, may He be blessed, are all carried by and included within the Unique Name, which is the Name YHVH, blessed be He. Some are like roots, some are like branches, and some are at the very top of the foliage of the Tree. The Unique Name, blessed be He, stands in the center and is called the **Middle Line**. The rest of the names are included in it from this side and that side, like the top of a tree, its roots, and its branches. How so? The first letter of the Name YHVH hints at two names: the tip of the *Yod* that points upward hints at the Great Primordial Light, the depth of the Primordial Being in His essential truth. This is called **"I Shall Be"** <note>original: אהי"ה (*Ehyeh*)</note>, which is what is called **Infinite** <term>original: *Ein Gevul*</term>. It is also called **"Nothing"** <term>original: *Ayin*</term> due to the abundance of its hiddenness from all existing things, upper and lower. There is no one who can understand anything of it. If a questioner asks: "What is it?", the answer is "Nothing"—meaning, there is no one who can understand anything of it. Regarding this, it is said: "From one end of the heavens to the other" <note>Deuteronomy 4:32</note> you may inquire, but you may not inquire what is above or what is below. This is the secret of the tip of the *Yod*—the uppermost point—which is a hint to the Supernal Crown <term>Keter</term> called *Ayin* (Nothingness), which is excluded from all comprehension. No one can know anything of it except for the faith in its existence. Its existence is not grasped by any other. Therefore, it is called *Ehyeh* ("I Shall Be") in the language of "existence," and that existence (f) <margin>(f) He alone knows it.</margin> He alone knows. Therefore, it uses the term *Ehyeh* beginning with the letter *Aleph*—like the words "I will gather," "I will see," "I will do," "I will come"—indicating a thing that stands in its own essential truth. Thus He says "I Shall Be" <note>*Ehyeh*</note>, as if to say: "I alone am the one who knows My own existence." This is the tip of the *Yod* of the Name. The reason it is hinted at only by the tip of the *Yod* and does not have a distinct letter of its own is because no one can measure it, liken it, or form it even in the shape of a known letter. Therefore, it is called *Ehyeh* in the depth of the beginning of the great ones...

<meta>This page continues the discussion of the letters of the Divine Name, specifically focusing on the two occurrences of the letter **He** [ה]. # **Gate 5**

<meta>pencil note: 53</meta>

...and greatness, and salvation, and redemption. She <note>The Divine Presence or Shekhinah</note> dwells with Israel always, even in their exile, as it is said: "And let them make Me a sanctuary, that I may dwell among them" <note>Exodus 25:8; original: *v'asu li mikdash v'shakhanti betokham*</note>. And above her, at the end of the eight <term>Sefirot: divine emanations or channels of God's light</term>, there is another stone "more precious than pearls" <note>Proverbs 3:15</note>. This is the one that encompasses the seven *Sefirot* below it. Therefore, it is called **Socheret** <note>A precious stone mentioned in Esther 1:6</note>, from the language of "encompassing" or "going around," for the Aramaic translation of "around" is *sachur ve-sachur*. Since this stone is the eighth *Sefirah* called **Understanding** <term>Hebrew: *Binah*</term>, sitting high above and surrounding and encompassing everything, it is called **Socheret** <note>The "Circulator"</note>.

The second, lower stone, which is the secret of the **Divine Presence** <term>Hebrew: *Shekhinah*</term>—the one that dwells with Israel always—is called **Dar** <note>Also from Esther 1:6</note>. This is a "beautiful dwelling" <note>A play on the word *dar* meaning to dwell</note>. Therefore, these two stones—the upper and the lower—are called **Dar** and **Socheret**. The upper is *Socheret* because it encompasses the seven *Sefirot*, and the lower is *Dar* because it dwells <note>*darah*</note> with Israel always. 

Upon this concept, the stones of the **Ephod** <term>the High Priest's ceremonial vest</term> were established as "stones of remembrance for the children of Israel" <note>Exodus 28:12</note>. This is the meaning of: "And you shall take the two stones... and engrave on them the names of the children of Israel: six of their names on the one stone, and the names of the remaining six on the second stone, according to their birth" <note>Exodus 28:9-10</note>. The "six of their names" refer to those who merit the glory of the *Shekhinah* in this world, which is the secret of *Dar*. Those who merit the glory of the *Shekhinah* in the secret of *Dar* will then merit the second, complete stone called *Socheret*, which is the secret of the **World to Come**. 

"According to their birth" <note>Hebrew: *k'toldotam*</note> refers to the "products" of their lives: whether they are good deeds or bad deeds, whether many or few—for these "products" are the actions of man. And because these two attributes are called "two stones" in equal measure, they also stem from the secret of the two letters **He** [ה] in the Unique Name <term>the Tetragrammaton, YHVH</term>, may He be blessed. The stone called *Socheret* is the secret of the **first He** of the Name, and the stone called *Dar* is the secret of the **final He** of the Name. 

Because of this, these two attributes are often called by the same name. The first *He* of the Name, the secret of the stone called *Socheret*, is called **Upper Justice** <note>Hebrew: *Tzedek Elyon*</note>. The final *He* of the Name, the secret of the stone called *Dar*, is called **Lower Justice** <note>Hebrew: *Tzedek Tachton*</note>. Concerning them, the Torah says: "Justice, justice shall you pursue" <note>Deuteronomy 16:20; original: *Tzedek tzedek tirdof*</note>. This means: be a pursuer of [lower] justice, which is the secret of the *Shekhinah*, so that you may merit [upper] justice, which is the secret of the life of the World to Come. (e) And the secret is: "He who pursues justice and loving-kindness finds life, justice, and honor" <note>Proverbs 21:21</note>. 

These two attributes are also both called **God** <term>Hebrew: *Elohim*</term>. The first *He* of the Name, which is the upper one, is written as **YHVH** but read as *Elohim* in the secret of the Name. The final *He* of the Name is written as **Elohim** and read as *Elohim*. Regarding both of them, the Torah says: "The Lord He is God; the Lord He is God" <note>1 Kings 18:39; original: *Adonai hu ha-Elohim*</note>—twice. The first corresponds to the first *He*, and the second corresponds to the final *He*. A sign for these two <margin>Regarding the *He*</margin> letters is the phrase "Lord God [is] my strength" <note>Habakkuk 3:19; original: *Adonai Elohim kheli*</note>. Or "Lord God," as in the verse: "Lord God, how shall I know that I will inherit it?" <note>Genesis 15:8</note>. Thus we find the lesson that the secret of the fourth letter of the Name, which is the letter *He*, is that which includes all the *Sefirot* above it. This letter *He*, the last in the Name, is called by the name **Lord** <term>Hebrew: *Adonai*</term> because He is the "Lord of all the earth" <note>Joshua 3:11</note>. 

Now that these great principles have been shown to you, contemplate and know that the Great, Honored, and Awesome Name, which is **YHVH**, may He be blessed, is the Name that includes all other names among all the holy names mentioned in the Torah. There is no name among the holy names that is not included in the Name YHVH. Now that you know this great thing, you must understand how much you need to reflect and be careful when you mention them—to know that when you mention them, you carry upon your mouth all His holy names, as if you were bearing...

***

(b) You will also see in the musical flourish that there are ten praises corresponding to the five "doubles." The "Praise God" <note>Halleluyah</note> begins its flourish from the "Holy Crown" [*Keter*] and ends with the movement... and the "shout of a King is in him" for the victors... and it was at the end of the building. And the songs began with the flourishes, all taken in the name **YaH** [יה], which includes the whole Name as will be explained at the beginning of the gate. It is also the name of Upper Mercy and Wisdom, where the end is found in the beginning and the beginning in the end. 

(c) Sometimes you will find for the letter **Waw** [ו], etc., that they intended to write the word in a specific tongue... as explained in the *Kehal*... and therefore it does not enter there.

<meta>This page continues the exposition of the letters of the Four-Letter Name of God (the Tetragrammaton). It moves from the high mystical realm of "Understanding" (Binah) associated with the first letter He [ה], through the "Middle Line" associated with the letter Waw [ו], and concludes with the final He [ה] which represents the Divine Presence (Shekhinah) among humanity.</meta>

# **Gate 5**

Of the Name that is the secret of the letter **He** [ה]: this is the secret of **Understanding** <term>Hebrew: *Binah*; the divine quality of analysis and structure</term>. This is the secret of the Name written as **Y-H-W-H** but pronounced as **Elohim** <note>original: *Adonai* usually replaces the Name, but in certain mystical contexts, it is vocalized with the vowels of *Elohim*</note> through its pointing, in the secret of "Y-H-W-H Elohim." Sometimes *Binah* is called by the name **Yah** [יה], because the two letters *Y-H* are the secret of the three upper <term>Sefirot: divine emanations</term>. The tip of the *Yod* [י] is the secret of *Ehyeh* <note>original: "I Will Be"; the name associated with the highest crown, Keter</note>. The *Yod* itself is **Wisdom** <term>Hebrew: *Chokhmah*</term>, which is called *Yah* based on the secret of the first letter of the Name. The *He* [ה] of the name *Yah* is the secret of *Binah*, which is called *Yah* based on the secret of "He is One." Thus it is explicit to you that the first two letters of the Name, the secret of *Yah*, include three of the holy Names: *Ehyeh*, *Yah*, and *Y-H-W-H*.

Now, contemplate the matter and understand each and every letter of the letters of the Name, so that you may know how to direct your intention through all His names, may He be blessed, in the secret of the honored and awesome Name, Y-H-W-H, may He be blessed. **The secret of the third letter** of the letters of the Name is a hint to the six *Sefirot* below the conduct of the upper *Sefirot*, and it is the letter **Waw** [ו]. It is the secret of the bond of all the *Sefirot*, both upper and lower. It ascends to the **Crown** <term>Hebrew: *Keter*</term> and descends to the **Kingdom** <term>Hebrew: *Malkhut*</term>; it sustains all the *Sefirot*, and they are all united within it—those above it, those below it, those to the right, and those to the left. It is called the **Middle Line** <term>Hebrew: *Kav Ha-Emtza'i*; the path of balance</term>.

The secret of this letter, which is the third letter of the Name called *Waw*, includes six Names corresponding to the six *Sefirot*:
*   **El** [אל] corresponding to **Greatness** <term>Hebrew: *Gedulah* or *Chesed*; Kindness</term>
*   **Elohim** [אלהים] corresponding to **Strength** <term>Hebrew: *Gevurah*; Judgment</term>
*   **Y-H-W-H** [יהוה] corresponding to **Beauty** <term>Hebrew: *Tiferet*; the central balance</term>
*   **Y-H-W-H of Hosts** [יהוה צבאות] corresponding to **Victory** <term>Hebrew: *Netzach*</term>
*   **Elohim of Hosts** [אלהים צבאות] corresponding to **Splendor** <term>Hebrew: *Hod*</term>
*   **Living God** [אל חי] corresponding to **Foundation** <term>Hebrew: *Yesod*</term>

Thus you have learned that the secret of the *Waw* of the Name is the collective of six Names from the Names of the Name, may He be blessed. And because you will find the Name *El* which is also the Name of the *Keter* (Crown) and the Name of *Gedulah* (Greatness), you will find one Name for the attribute of Greatness called *El*. This is the secret of Greatness called "Who" <note>original: *Mi*; a mystical interrogation of the source of being</note>. And so it says: "God is Y-H-W-H and He gave us light" <note>Psalm 118:27; original: *El Y-H-W-H va-ya'er lanu*</note> and "The Holy One comes from Mount Paran, Selah" <note>Habakkuk 3:3</note>. 

With God's help, through the word **El**, we shall explain the secret of **Eloah** <note>God</note> and the secret of **Elohim**, and you will find the wonders of the "One perfect in knowledge" <note>Job 37:16</note> in the secret of the three Names in the language of Divinity: *El*, *Elohim*, and *Eloah*. You will find that *El* is the secret of the Name of **Loving-kindness** <term>Hebrew: *Chesed*</term>. *Elohim* is the Attribute of Justice combined with the first half of the Name Y-H-W-H, which is the name **Yah** [יה]. *Eloah* is the second half of the Name Y-H-W-H, which is **W-H** [וה]. 

You will see great and wondrous things in the Psalm: "Praise God! Praise God in His sanctuary; praise Him in the firmament of His power" <note>Psalm 150:1; original: *Halleluyah Hallelu El be-kodsho...*</note>. You will find at the beginning of the Psalm that it includes the secret of *Elohim* and *Eloah*. *Halleluyah* [הללויה] is "Praise" [*Hallelu*] plus the first half of the unique Name [*Yah*]. *Hallelu El be-kodsho* [הללו אל בקדשו]—the secret of *El* ascends here and there as you will now see. *Halleluhu bi-reki’a uzo* [הללוהו ברקיע עוזו]—"Praise Him" [*Halleluhu*] contains the final half of the Name, *W-H* [וה], may He be blessed. Thus, *El* is found in the middle: *Y-H* [יה] on this side, and *W-H* [וה] on that side. Sometimes *El* joins with *Y-H* and that is the secret of *Elohim*; sometimes *El* joins with *W-H* and that is the secret of *Eloah*; and sometimes *El* stands by itself. All three are included at the beginning of this Psalm: *Halleluyah Hallelu El be-kodsho Halleluhu bi-reki’a uzo*. And the secret of this Psalm is that from here on it says "Praise Him" [*Halleluhu*]. You will see further wonders in this. Thus you have learned that *El*, *Elohim*, and *Eloah* are all clothed within the Unique Name [Y-H-W-H].

Sometimes you will find "Eloah" [אלה] written without the letter *Waw*, as it says: "They sacrificed to demons, no-god" <note>Deuteronomy 32:17; original: *lo Eloah*</note>. You will see further wonders in this, with God's help. Thus we have learned that in the secret of the *Waw*, which is the third letter of the Name, these names are included: *El*, *Eloah*, *Elohim*, *Y-H-W-H*, *Y-H-W-H of Hosts*, *Elohim of Hosts*, and *Living God*. Now, contemplate the greatness of the Holy Name which is the foundation and root of all Names—how much more so <note>original abbreviation: *k"sh*</note> regarding all other languages and titles, and titles of titles, and all the families of the earth that are carried upon the languages.

# **The Secret of the Fourth Letter**
# **of the Blessed Name**

This is the secret of the final letter **He** [ה], which is the secret of **Kingship** <term>Hebrew: *Malkhut*</term>. It is the secret of Dominion; it is the secret of the **Divine Presence** <term>Hebrew: *Shekhinah*</term>; it is the secret of the **Lower Wisdom** <term>Hebrew: *Chokhmah Achronah*</term>. It is the secret of the Name called **Adonai** <note>Lord</note>. For this Name, as we have informed you, is the secret of the perfection of Unity. She is the **Stone of Israel** <note>Genesis 49:24</note> that draws to them all kinds of delicacies, goodness, and greatness.

For the letter *He* [ה] begins the lineage of Judgment from "behind" Wisdom, as will be explained later, as it were, as a title of the established Name. Therefore, the essence of our standing is in the [letter] *He* as will be explained at the beginning of Gate 8. (1) "It ascends to the Crown" means the upper tip of the *Waw*, or when it is drawn out [vocalized] as it were to the Middle Line, and it has the power of the *Yod*, and thus it is established above and below, and from it comes Judgment; understand this well.

<meta>This page continues the exploration of the Divine Names within Gate 5. Having previously discussed the letters of the Tetragrammaton and their association with the upper Sefirot (Divine Emanations) like Understanding (Binah), the text now shifts to explain how the Name Y-H-W-H acts as a root that "clothes" itself in different functional names—such as El or Elohim—depending on whether God is acting with Mercy or Judgment.</meta>

# **Gate 5, Chapter 20**
->N 2<-

<margin>
Refer to page 50 for what is written here.
</margin>

I shall now explain this introduction. Know that the Name Y-H-W-H <note>The Tetragrammaton, the four-letter name of God</note>, may He be blessed, clothes Himself and glories in the holy names. All the holy names are attached to the truth of this Name, may He be blessed, and each one of them indicates a specific, individual matter. How so? When the Name, may He be blessed, desires to have mercy on His world and to pity them, He then clothes Himself in the garment of **Kindness** <term>Hebrew: *Hesed*; the attribute of unconditional benevolence</term> and compassion. Then the Great Name, which is Y-H-W-H, brings forth the banner of Kindness and Mercy, and engraved upon that banner is the name **El** <note>original: *A"L*; a name of God associated with the Sefirah of Kindness</note>. The scriptural sign for this is: "Every man by his own banner, with the ensigns" <note>Numbers 2:2</note>.

And when the Lord, may He be blessed, brings forth this banner, He then does good, shows mercy, and is gracious to His creatures, and He rejoices with them. This is the secret of: "May the glory of the Lord endure forever; let the Lord rejoice in His works" <note>Psalm 104:31</note>. And the secret of: "And he called there on the name of the Lord, the Everlasting God (*El*)" <note>Genesis 21:33</note>. Then He wears and glories in the garments engraved with the attribute of *El*. This is the secret of "The King sitting upon the Throne of Mercy," and the secret of "The Lord, the Lord, God (*El*), merciful and gracious" <note>Exodus 34:6</note>. And the secret of "For the Lord your God is a merciful God (*El*)" <note>Deuteronomy 4:31</note>. The sign for this is: "For the Lord is a great God (*El*), and a great King over all gods (*elohim*)" <note>Psalm 95:3</note>.

**Elohim** is the attribute of **Judgment** <term>Hebrew: *Din*; the attribute of justice and restriction</term>; that is to say, the attribute of Kindness is greater than the attribute of Judgment. From here you may understand the secret of "And God (*Elohim*) tested Abraham" <note>Genesis 22:1</note>, for *Elohim*, which is the attribute of Judgment, gave the test <note>original: *Nes*; also means "banner" or "standard"</note> and the banner into the hand of Abraham, who is the secret of the attribute of *El*, which is the secret of the attribute of Kindness. This is the meaning of the phrasing "tested (*nissah*) Abraham," from the language of "lift up a banner (*nes*) for the peoples" <note>Isaiah 62:10</note>. And this is the secret of "The God of Abraham, the God of Isaac," where it does not say "*and* the God of Isaac," because the attribute of Judgment is subjugated (†) beneath the attribute of Kindness; for the banner of Isaac, which is the attribute of *Elohim*, is handed over to Abraham, who is the secret of the attribute of *El*.

And when the Name, may He be blessed, is angry with the people of the world because of their evil deeds, He then brings forth His weapons of indignation. Engraved upon the banner of the weapons of indignation is the form of the name *Elohim*. Then He executes judgment, takes vengeance upon the people of the world, and punishes them for the evil of their deeds, as the form of the name *Elohim* is engraved upon the banner of Y-H-W-H. The secret of this is: "Let God (*Elohim*) arise, let His enemies be scattered" <note>Psalm 68:1</note>. This is also the secret of what was said: "Rise up, O Lord (Y-H-W-H), and let Your enemies be scattered, and let those who hate You flee before You" <note>Numbers 10:35</note>.

If you should find it difficult and ask: "How can it say Y-H-W-H in this verse and *Elohim* in that verse?" Do you not know that all names are dependent upon the name Y-H-W-H, and He clothes Himself in them? When it says "Rise up, Y-H-W-H, and let Your enemies be scattered," it is as if it said: "Rise up, Y-H-W-H, and bring forth the weapons of war and the banner in which the name *Elohim* is engraved." This is the secret of "Let God (*Elohim*) arise, let His enemies be scattered, and let those who hate You flee before Him." For Moses our teacher, peace be upon him, spoke his words in a concealed manner, and David came and explained them, saying: "Let God (*Elohim*) arise." When the Name, may He be blessed, brings forth the banner upon which *Elohim* is engraved, He then clothes Himself in garments of vengeance. The secret is: "Who is this that comes from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah?" <note>Isaiah 63:1</note>. And it says: "He put on garments of vengeance for clothing, and was clad with zeal as a cloak" <note>Isaiah 59:17</note>.

And when the Name, may He be blessed, brings the people of the world into judgment, He clothes Himself in "middle garments" between Judgment and Mercy, and brings forth the banner upon which everything depends, and upon which the name Y-H-W-H, may He be blessed, is engraved. He wears neither garments of pure mercy nor garments of pure judgment, for He does not judge His creatures by the attribute of absolute Judgment, nor by the attribute of absolute Mercy. Rather, He judges with the attribute of Judgment mixed with the attribute of Mercy. Nevertheless, the attribute of Mercy is more abundant than the attribute of Judgment. The secret is: "Slow to anger and abundant in kindness." Our Sages of blessed memory said: "'Abundant in kindness' means He tilts the scales toward kindness" <note>Talmud, Rosh Hashanah 17a</note>. Since it says "abundant in kindness," it implies that there is a small amount of judgment within it; for if it were entirely kindness, why would it need to say *abundant* kindness? What difference would "much" or "little" make to us? Rather, the explanation of the verse is this: when a person sins, God does not punish him immediately, but is "slow to anger" and waits, perhaps he will return in repentance. If he does not return in repentance, they judge him according to his deeds. And even though they judge him, they judge him with "abundant kindness" and tilt toward kindness if even a small merit is found for him. But if no merit is found for him, they finalize his sentence for his sin. This is the secret of "abundant in kindness and truth"—meaning, "slow to anger" at the beginning; "abundant in kindness" at the time a person is judged; and "truth" when his sentence is finalized, even for punishment. That is to say—

Tests, etc. ... and so it is fitting to explain ... † beneath the attribute of Kindness, and the meaning of "The God of Abraham" is that He is also "The God of Isaac."

<meta>This page continues the discussion on the sanctity of the Tetragrammaton (Y-H-W-H). # **Gate 5**

[upon] your mouth and upon your tongue is the Name, may He be blessed, and all His holy names, and the world and its fullness. When you know this, you will understand the secret of **"You shall not take the name of the Lord (Y-H-W-H) your God in vain"** <note>Exodus 20:7; the Third Commandment</note>. For how can a lowly and humble creature carry upon its tongue the Name of the Great Lord, may He be blessed, in whom all the hosts of above and below are carried? And even more so, how could one use it as an **ax** <term>Hebrew: *garzon*; an analogy for using the Divine Name as a tool for personal or magical gain</term> to cut with? 

But when you mention the Lord, may He be blessed, it is proper to praise and exalt Him, as it is said: "When I proclaim the name of the Lord (Y-H-W-H), ascribe greatness to our God" <note>Deuteronomy 32:3</note>. You should know that at the moment a person mentions the Name Y-H-W-H, may He be blessed, and moves its letters with the motion of the tongue, he causes a vibration in the world on high. All the hosts of the heavenly angels are stirred, asking one another: "Why is the world vibrating?" and they say: "Because that certain wicked person is mentioning the **Explicit Name** <term>Hebrew: *Shem HaMeforash*; the unique, essential name of God</term> and it has reached his lips." According to the motion with which he moved it, so move all the names and attributes <term>Hebrew: *kinnuyim*; descriptive names of God like 'Merciful'</term> that are suspended from it. Therefore, heaven and earth tremble. 

Then they say: "Who is this wicked person who has shaken the world by mentioning the Great Name for naught? Is it not that wicked person who committed such-and-such a transgression on such-and-such a day, and sinned in this-and-that way on a certain day?" Thus, mentioning the Name becomes the cause for all his iniquities to be remembered. You should understand it this way: just as when you move the central trunk of a tree, all the branches and all the leaves on the tree shake. So too, when a person mentions the Name Y-H-W-H, may He be blessed, all the hosts of above and below shake, because they are all suspended from Him. 

All of this applies when it is not in the Temple. But when the **High Priest** <term>Hebrew: *Kohen Gadol*</term> would mention it in the Temple, then all the hosts of the world were joyful and received an abundance of divine flow <term>Hebrew: *shefa*; the spiritual energy that sustains existence</term>, because he was arranging the "pipes" <note>The spiritual conduits through which divine energy flows</note> and pouring out blessing to all the inhabitants of the world. 

Now that we have informed you of all these principles, we must return and inform you how the Great and Holy Name Y-H-W-H, may He be blessed, guides the entire world with His great power. We will explain how all the holy names are attached to Him, and how the other attributes found in the Torah—such as **Merciful** (*Rachum*) and **Gracious** (*Chanun*) and their like—are like **garments** <term>Hebrew: *malbushim*</term> that the King wears. These garments are not actually part of the King’s essence. Rather, they are like tools and vestments that the King wears and arms himself with. 

Sometimes He wears garments of glory and royalty, when the King is at ease, in quiet and in security, and all the lands of His kingdom are at peace, with no adversary or evil occurrence. Then the King rejoices with His servants, wears beautiful clothes, arms Himself with various ornaments, and puts on festive attire. 

Sometimes the King suffers the distress of wars from several sides, with oppressors and marauders entering His land to destroy His kingdom. Then the King wears different garments: armor, helmets, shields, swords, and bows; and all His servants are in haste until the wrath passes, or until the King takes vengeance on His adversaries and enemies and fulfills His desire upon them. 

And sometimes the King sits in his house, and none of his army or cavalry are with him, but only the members of his household: his brothers, his children, and his wife who are close to him. Then the King removes some of the garments he was wearing while his ministers and servants were with him. The King remains with his household, and they all see him and his form more revealed than it was with the many garments. He performs many matters with them and does not hide from them as he was covered by his garments before the masses. This is because his household members are as precious to him as a limb of his own body, and he is not concerned about removing some of his garments and tools in their presence. 

And sometimes the King is alone, apart from all the members of the household. No one from his household remains with him except the Queen alone. And the King is not ashamed to remove his clothes before the Queen as he would do before the other members of his household.

# **Gate 5**

[in] which attribute He stands or in which garment He is clothed. And when He is called by the name **El** <note>The Hebrew name *El* often signifies God's power or His attribute of Loving-kindness in Kabbalistic thought.</note>, you must know who His camps and His hosts are. Then your eyes will see and your heart will rejoice. After you have known this, you will need to know how the descriptive titles are tied to the Name **Y-H-W-H**, may He be blessed, and at which point of the Name that title is tied.

the attribute called **Fire**, and who are the descriptive titles drawn from the attribute called **Water**, and so for each and every attribute. When you understand this, understand the action of each and every attribute. Likewise, you must know and contemplate how these attributes mix with one another. When you understand this, you will understand that the entire Torah is like a commentary on the Name **Y-H-W-H**, may He be blessed, and you will understand the secret of "The Torah of the Lord (Y-H-W-H)" <note>Psalm 19:8</note> in truth—the Torah of the Lord, certainly. Therefore, you will find that the Name **Y-H-W-H** is sometimes called by this title and sometimes by that title, and everything is according to the attribute with which He guides His world, just as you find written: "Gracious and Merciful is the Lord (Y-H-W-H)" <note>Psalm 145:8</note>. When you understand this, you will understand how the world and all its creations are all suspended from the Name **Y-H-W-H**, may He be blessed. Nothing in the world can exist except through His Great Name, may He be blessed. You will understand that you are a lowly, light, and despised creature compared to the greatness of the Perfect in Knowledge, may He be blessed, and may His name and memory be blessed.

**Know** that the connection of all the Chariots <term>Hebrew: *Merkavot*; the divine structures or 'vehicles' through which God's presence is revealed</term> and all the systems and all the hosts of the world are suspended from three names. Two of these three names are suspended from the Name **Y-H-W-H**, may He be blessed. The two that are suspended from the Name **Y-H-W-H** are called **El** and **Elohim**. **El** is on the right. **Y-H-W-H Elohim** <note>Meaning Y-H-W-H acting through the name Elohim</note> is on His left. Thus, the entire world and its creatures are suspended from these three names: **El, Elohim, Y-H-W-H**. 

**El** on the right. **Elohim** on the left. **Y-H-W-H** in the center. This is the secret of the verse: **"I saw the Lord (Y-H-W-H) sitting on His throne, and all the host of heaven standing by Him on His right and on His left"** <note>1 Kings 22:19</note>. The secret of "the heavens" in this verse refers to the two names **El** and **Elohim**, which are called "Heavens." This is the secret of the verse: **"Until you know that the Heavens rule"** <note>Daniel 4:23; original Aramaic: *ad di tinda di shallitin shamaya*. The author interprets "Heavens" as a reference to these Divine Names.</note> over all the earth. And this is the secret of **"O You who dwell in the heavens"** <note>Psalm 123:1</note>. Those on the right are the hosts of the Name called **El**. Those on the left are the hosts of the Name called **Elohim**. And upon whom are they all carried? Upon the Name **Y-H-W-H**, may He be blessed. This is why it says: "And all the host of heaven standing by Him on His right and on His left." On their right for merit, through the secret of the Name **El**; and on His left for liability, through the secret of the Name **Elohim**. For the attribute of **El** is for mercy and merit, and the attribute of **Elohim** is for judgment and liability.

# Gate 5

That is to say, in truth, punishment comes upon a person from the side of righteous judgment. This is why it is said, "Blessed is the True Judge" <note>Hebrew: *Baruch dayan ha-emet*; a blessing recited upon hearing bad news or a death, acknowledging God's justice.</note>, and the verse says, "A God of faithfulness and without iniquity" <note>Deuteronomy 32:4.</note>. Behold, we have informed you through all of this that when God, may He be blessed, judges His creatures, He judges them with the **Attribute of Mercy** <term>Hebrew: *Middat HaRachamim*; the divine quality of compassion</term> tempered with the **Attribute of Judgment** <term>Hebrew: *Middat HaDin*; the divine quality of strict justice</term>. The majority of the judgment is kindness, while only a small part is strict justice; this is the secret of the phrase "Abundant in Kindness" <note>Exodus 34:6.</note>.

And when He, may He be blessed, judges the world, it is sometimes called the "Judgment of Y-H-W-H," and sometimes called the "Judgment of Elohim" <note>Elohim is the Name associated with strict justice, while Y-H-W-H is associated with mercy.</note>, all according to the nature of the verdict that emerges. How so? The scripture says, "For Y-H-W-H is our Judge" and "O Y-H-W-H, correct me, but with justice" and "Y-H-W-H will enter into judgment"—behold, here "Judgment" is adjacent to the Name Y-H-W-H, may He be blessed. Yet at other times, "Judgment" is called by the name Elohim, as it says, "When Elohim arose to judgment," and "For Elohim is the Judge; He puts down one and lifts up another," and "For Elohim shall bring every work into judgment." 

The secret behind this is that the Name is called at the conclusion of the trial according to the verdict: if the judgment results in mercy, it is called **Y-H-W-H**, and if the judgment results in strict justice, it is called **Elohim**. 

Following this path, contemplate every place in the Torah where you find the Great Name—which is Y-H-W-H, may He be blessed—called by one of the other Names or by one of the <term>descriptive titles</term> <gloss>Hebrew: *kinnuyim*; epithets like "The Merciful" or "The Great"</gloss>. Observe toward which side that Name or title leans: whether toward kindness, mercy, judgment, or punishment, and with which attribute He is approaching His creatures. When He is called by one of the Names or titles, you should understand that the Name **Y-H-W-H** is "clothed" in specific garments suited for that particular hour. Maintain this principle always throughout the entire Torah, and through it, you will understand many things that are currently hidden and sealed.

Now that you know this, understand what our Sages of blessed memory have already said: it is forbidden to erase the Holy Names, but other descriptive titles may be erased—such as "Merciful," "Gracious," "Forgiver," and the like. I shall now enlighten your eyes, with God's help. **Know** that the Holy Names which may not be erased—such as **Ehyeh** <note>"I Shall Be," revealed at the burning bush.</note>, **Elohim**, **El**, **Eloah**, **Shaddai**, and their equivalents—are "attached" to God, may He be blessed, and are close to Him. These Names serve as signs for the three Supernal Roots attached to them. 

The other descriptive titles which *may* be erased—such as "Merciful," "Gracious," "Pious," "Forgiver," and their like—are like "vessels" for the Holy Names. These titles are the support for the **Seventy Nations** who are under the rule of the Seventy Ministers <note>In Jewish tradition, the world is divided into seventy nations, each overseen by a heavenly prince or ministering angel.</note>. Now that you know this, know that the other erasable titles, like "Merciful" and "Gracious," are like vessels for His Holy Name (which may not be erased), and through them the Holy Names perform their actions. 

How so? For example: **The Name** appointed over the Banner of Loving-kindness <note>Hebrew: *Chesed*.</note> is **El**. **The Name** that carries the weapons of war, and which has "Judgment" engraved upon its banner, is **Elohim**. The titles that are its servants, soldiers, and hosts are: "Ehyeh" <note>Meaning "I Shall Be."</note>, "Judge," "Arbiter," "Strong," "Powerful," "Man of War," "Warrior," "Visitor of Iniquity," and "Requiter of Reward." 

**The Name** appointed over the Judgment that is inclusive of both Mercy and Justice, and which has **Y-H-W-H** (may He be blessed) engraved upon its banner, is comprised of both. The titles that form its soldiers and hosts are: "Inscrutable," "Bearing Iniquity," "Passing over Transgression," "Truth," "Exalted," "High," "Keeper of Mercy," "Dweller of Eternity," and "Holy." 

**After** we have informed you of this, we must inform you of the reason why these specific titles are designated for the Name *El*, why these are for the Name *Elohim*, and why these are for the Name *Y-H-W-H*, may He be blessed. For the attribute of **El** is for mercy and merit, and the attribute of **Elohim** is for judgment and liability.

*A Psalm of Asaph: The Mighty One, God, Y-H-W-H <note>original: "El Elohim Y-H-W-H"</note> has spoken, and called the earth from the rising of the sun unto its setting.* And regarding the matter of the children of Reuben
<margin>Joshua 22</margin>
and the children of Gad, when they built the altar, it is written: *The Mighty One, God, Y-H-W-H, He knows, and Israel, he shall know; if it be in rebellion, or if in transgression... save us not this day.* The secret of why they needed to mention these three Names is that they were saying: "Behold, we accept upon ourselves the decree of the Heavenly Court <term>Hebrew: *Beit Din shel Ma'alah*; the celestial tribunal</term>, which is 'The Mighty One, God, Y-H-W-H,' in which all the attributes of the Name are included—for kindness and for judgment, for good and for evil." If my intention was for good, let Y-H-W-H judge us with the attribute of "The Mighty One" <note>original: "El," usually associated with Mercy/Kindness</note>; and if for evil, let the Lord judge us with the attribute of "God" <note>original: "Elohim," usually associated with Strict Justice</note>. *The Mighty One, God, Y-H-W-H, He knows.* Observe this great principle. **And after** we have informed you of this, we must enter into an explanation of the secret of the thirty titles <term>Hebrew: *Kinnuyim*; descriptive names or epithets used to refer to God</term> hinted at the beginning of Ezekiel’s Chariot <note>The *Merkavah*, the divine throne-chariot envisioned by the prophet Ezekiel</note>: *And it came to pass in the thirtieth year* <note>Ezekiel 1:1</note>. These are the secret of the thirty titles which are the supports of the Chariot. Through them, May He be Blessed, He judges all His creatures for good or its opposite—for a good reward or for punishment, for life or for death—and everything is according to what the world deserves. Even though His judgments, May He be Blessed, all lean toward mercy, nevertheless, at the finalization of the verdict, He does not overlook or waive anything. And though He is slow to anger and waits, in the end, He completes the judgment. This is what our Sages of blessed memory meant when they said: "Whoever says the Merciful One is indulgent, his life shall be relinquished <note>original: *vatran... yitvatrun ma'ohi*; a Talmudic warning that God is patient but ultimately just, not "lax"</note>; rather, He is long-suffering but collects His due."

Therefore, you must know that each one of these three Names—which are *El, Elohim, Y-H-W-H*—performs an action unique to it. Each of them carries nine titles, and with each [Name] itself, they are completed to ten; thus, the total is found to be thirty. All of them are dependent on the Name Y-H-W-H, and He is included within them. All these titles are called "wings," and when the Name, May He be Blessed, judges all the creatures of the world according to the appropriate law, He judges them through these thirty titles. These are called "variations" <note>Hebrew: *Shinuyim*; a wordplay on *Shanim* (years) from the verse in Ezekiel</note> because the creatures are changed <note>or "varied"</note> by them for good or for evil, and you find the creatures are judged by them. How so? This righteous person is different <note>or "varied"</note> from the wicked person, and just as this one is different from that one, so too their judgments are different from one another. According to the variations among human beings, so are the variations in the judgments appropriate for them. For instance, the title "Merciful" <term>Hebrew: *Rachum*</term> finalizes the verdict for good; the title called "Man of War" <term>Hebrew: *Ish Milchama*</term> finalizes the verdict for punishment. Every person, according to the attribute found within them, so He finalizes the judgment upon them. 

And since these three Names—*El, Elohim, Y-H-W-H*—each include ten, totaling thirty through which the judgments vary among the creatures, it is therefore written: *And it came to pass in the thirtieth year.* Through thirty variations, Ezekiel the Prophet (peace be upon him) came to inform us that Israel had completed their sins until there remained no place of merit for Israel in the Heavenly Court among all thirty variations to protect Jerusalem from being destroyed. Rather, from the side of absolute Judgment, and with the agreement of *El, Elohim, Y-H-W-H*, and with all their thirty titles, they all agreed in a true judgment that Jerusalem should be destroyed. This is the secret—(and see the book *Avodat HaKodesh* <note>A classic 16th-century Kabbalistic work by Meir ibn Gabbai</note>)—of *And it came to pass in the thirtieth year.* After these thirty titles reached an agreement, then Jerusalem was destroyed. This is the fourth attribute, which is the letter *Dalet* <note>the fourth letter of the Hebrew alphabet</note>, the fourth [letter] of the Name [Y-H-W-H] which is the letter *He*. This is why it says: *in the fourth [month], on the fifth day of the month.* Then the Divine Presence <term>Hebrew: *Shekhinah*</term>, which is the letter *He* of the Name, called "I" <note>Hebrew: *Ani*</note>, went into exile. This is the secret of: *And I [Ani] was in the midst of the exile.* Literally "I"—the fourth attribute, the fourth letter of the Name called *Ani*—went into exile. This is what our Sages of blessed memory said: "Beloved are Israel, for in every place they were exiled, the Divine Presence was with them." If so, behold, we have informed you of the secret of *And it came to pass in the thirtieth...*

None of them have any power or light of their own, but only from the Name, Y-H-W-H, who is the Source and the Wellspring from which they all draw and are sustained. He gives a portion to each and every one of the Supernal Princes, and from that portion which He gives to each, every Prince sustains his own nation and pours goodness into that portion which he has in the land and the nation that fell to his lot.
