### Gate 5

<margin>I Will Be - 1</margin>
Israel shall never face total destruction. This is the secret of the verse: *For I the Lord do not change; therefore you, O children of Jacob, are not consumed* <note>Malachi 3:6</note>. Now that you know this, I will inform you of the explanation of the parable I mentioned above. Know that when the Blessed Name appears before the nations, He is like a King standing before his ministers and all his servants, standing clothed in royal garments or battle armor, as we informed you above; He is not seen by them except through His garments and his military protocols. Therefore, the Name is not seen at all by the nations of the world, because the majority of the Titles <term>Hebrew: *Kinnuyim*; descriptive names of God like "Great" or "Mighty"</term> and the "garments" cover Him (A) and hide Him from them.

But when the Blessed Name stands with the congregation of Israel, He stands with them like a King with the members of his own household. He removes some of the clothing, just as it is the way of a King to remove some of his garments when he is with his family. This is the secret of the verse: *Three times a year all your males shall appear before the face of the Lord your God* <note>Exodus 23:17</note>. Our Sages of blessed memory said: "Just as one comes to see, so he comes to be seen" <note>A classic Rabbinic play on the Hebrew vowels of the word "appear" (*yera'eh*) and "see" (*yireh*), suggesting a mutual revelation between God and the pilgrim</note>. A great secret is hinted at here, and this is the secret of why everyone is obligated to "appear." 

Even though the Blessed Name, when unifying with Israel in the Temple, removes some of the Titles which are His garments—as they said regarding the Explicit Name <term>The Tetragrammaton, the four-letter name of God</term>: "In the Temple it is pronounced as it is written, but in the provinces it is pronounced by its Title"—Israel thus sees the truth of the Name YHWH (may He be blessed) more than the other nations. Nevertheless,
<margin>YHWH 310</margin>
He is still clothed in some garments and Titles. The reason is that the common multitude is not yet worthy to reach the true essence of the Name YHWH, nor are they able to perceive the ultimate depth of His Being. 

But when the Blessed Name unifies with the righteous, the pious, the patriarchs of the world, and the "Mighty Ones" <note>The *Eitanim*, a traditional term for the founding fathers of Israel</note>, then He removes all the Titles from Himself, and *the Lord alone shall be exalted* <note>Isaiah 2:11</note>. It is found that the Essence of the Blessed YHWH stands with Israel like a king who has stripped off all his garments to be alone with his wife. This is the secret of the verse: *Return, backsliding children, says the Lord; for I am married to you* <note>Jeremiah 3:14</note>. And it says: *And I will betroth you to Me forever* <note>Hosea 2:21</note>. *And I will betroth you*—just as a king strips off his clothes to be one with his wife, so the Name YHWH strips off all His Titles and garments and unifies with Israel, with their pious ones, the ascetic and the pure. 

This is the secret of: *I have put off my tunic; how shall I put it on?* <note>Song of Solomon 5:3</note>. The explanation of this verse is that the Holy One, blessed be He, was complaining about Israel, saying: "Behold, I have stripped off my tunic—meaning all those Titles called 'my tunic'—so that the Princes of the nations of the world <note>The celestial patrons or guardian angels of the 70 nations</note> would not be able to take hold of My Name, and I remained with Israel alone. Why then do you sin and want Me to return to wearing those Titles? For then the Princes of the nations will take hold of them and lead you into exile." Therefore He said: *I have put off my tunic.* He then said: *I have washed my feet; how shall I defile them?* This means: "I have washed the Divine Presence <term>Hebrew: *Shekhinah*</term>, which is called 'the footstool of My feet,' from the filth of the land of the nations when I brought her out of the exile where I had wandered with Israel. How can you cause Me to lead her back into exile with you in the lands of the nations, where they will defile her
<margin>A D H Y</margin> <note>The letters of the names Adonai and YHWH intermingled</note>
with their impurity?" This is the secret of *I have washed my feet; how shall I defile them?* 

And if so, consider this: when Israel went into exile, YHWH donned the thirty Titles, which are the "Tunic," and then the nations took hold of them. This is the secret of: *O God, the nations have come into Your inheritance* <note>Psalm 79:1</note>. Then they were exiled to Babylon, and this is the meaning of: *And it came to pass in the thirtieth year...* <note>Ezekiel 1:1. The author links the "30th year" to the 30 Titles/Garments</note>. When the Name was clothed in all the Titles and garments, the Divine Presence descended to Babylon, as it says: *And I [ANI] was among the captives by the river Chebar.* The "River Chebar" (G) was so called because it was "already" (*ke-bar*) from those trees of Eden—all this occurred in exile. But in the time to come, when the Divine Presence returns to her place, the Name will strip off all those garments, Titles, and wings, and then Israel will see the Name eye to eye. This is the secret of: *And your Teacher shall no longer be hidden [winged], but your eyes shall see your Teacher* <note>Isaiah 30:20</note>. This means He will no longer be "winged"—He will no longer be clothed in those Titles called "wings."

For in everything that was spread out and revealed, it will descend by necessity to merit all of Existence, and His meaning shall not change at all. For just as things that are spread out lose their original linguistic meaning and change into another language, so too the Unique Name <term>The Tetragrammaton</term> was unique to Israel and from Israel, and distinguished from the other Names which belong to higher merits. For there is nothing in the other names of God like what is in this Name, as has been explained many times. He carries them and all their functions, and it is the core of His existence. Since they are He, may He be blessed, as mentioned regarding the "Assembly," and He is the primary intent. Likewise, all the letters are explained as generalities and combinations in His letters, as I wrote at the beginning of this Gate. And they did not err... and hide Him from them, and therefore they [the nations] have no power, nor does the Divine Presence dwell among the nations of the world.

# Gate 5

Every Rosh Hashanah in the world, the Blessed One <note>Original: *it-barach*</note> gives a portion to every Minister <term>Hebrew: *Sar*; an angelic prince or patron deity tasked with governing a specific nation</term> among all the Ministers of the nations, providing the means by which he will sustain his land and his nation. From this comes the secret of the liturgy: "And regarding the countries, on this day it is said: which is for the sword and which is for plenty; and the creatures are remembered on it, to be recorded for life or for death," etc. No nation in the world has the power to add to the portion given to its Minister on Rosh Hashanah. Even if that nation prays during the year for an increase in goodness or food beyond what was decreed on Rosh Hashanah without their prayers, it is in vain. 

But Israel is not so, for they are the portion of the Lord <note>Original: *YHVH*</note>, may He be blessed. Even though they stood for judgment on Rosh Hashanah, on any day they desire, they can tear up that judgment and renew a good decree for themselves. This is what is meant in the Torah: *For what great nation is there that has God so near to it, as the Lord our God is in all our calling upon Him?* <note>Deuteronomy 4:7</note>. Contemplate deeply the greatness of this verse. It is also written: *to maintain the cause of His servant and the cause of His people Israel, as every day shall require* <note>1 Kings 8:59</note>. This means that every single day, Israel can tear up the judgment decreed upon them on Rosh Hashanah and renew it for the better. No other nation in the world can do this, for not one of all the seventy Ministers can add to his nation more than that reward and portion given to him on Rosh Hashanah. 

Therefore, the sages established the prayer "It is our duty to praise" <note>Hebrew: *Aleinu Le-shabbe'ach*</note> in the Rosh Hashanah service. If you understand well, you will find that in this prayer they mentioned the secret of the seventy nations, which are the seventy families of the children of Noah; thus it mentions "the nations of the lands" and "the families of the earth." As for the statement that "they pray to a god who cannot save" <note>Isaiah 45:20</note>—is he truly a god? Rather, he is a Minister. Every such Minister is called "god" <note>Hebrew: *El*</note> due to his greatness and high rank. However, he cannot add [to the decree]. Not one of all the supernal Ministers can add or subtract from the portion given to him on Rosh Hashanah. For even the Minister of every single nation looks toward the portion given to him from the house of the Great King, the Lord, may He be blessed. Like one of the needy of the world, he too receives a portion, and therefore "cannot save." He certainly cannot save, for there is no salvation without Him, in the Name of the Lord, may He be blessed; and this is "Israel is saved by the Lord with an everlasting salvation." 

From this, you should contemplate how all the supernal Ministers are themselves lacking, to the point that the Blessed Name must give them food and sustenance. Know that from the first letter of the Name of the Lord <note>The letter *Yod* (י)</note>, all the Ministers and all the nations receive their sustenance. (100) This is the secret of the verse: *You open Your hand and satisfy the desire of every living thing* <note>Psalm 145:16</note>. "You open Your *Yod-ka*" <note>A wordplay on *Yadecha* (Your hand) and *Yod-ka* (Your letter Yod)</note> indeed. Therefore, you find the scripture says: *It is better to take refuge in the Lord than to trust in man* <note>Psalm 118:8</note>. For one must not trust in the salvation of any of the Ministers who are included in the Name "Man" <term>Hebrew: *Adam*; in Kabbalistic thought, the structure of the lower spiritual powers is sometimes modeled after the human form</term>. For all things found in the world, both upper and lower, have no flow of abundance from themselves, except from the Great King, who is the Lord, may He be blessed. 

Therefore it says, *It is better to take refuge in the Lord than to trust in man*—referring to the well-known "man" on Rosh Hashanah who includes the entire Chariot <term>The *Merkavah*; the collective structure of the divine throne and its surrounding angelic forces</term>. It then repeats: *It is better to take refuge in the Lord than to trust in princes* <note>Psalm 118:9</note>. What is meant by "princes"? You must know that seventy Ministers stand in a row around the Chariot—some to the right and some to the left. Those Ministers standing on the right side are all "generous" <note>Hebrew: *Nedivim*, related to the word for "princes" in the verse</note> and more giving. But those standing on the left side are all harsh and do not give even to their own nation except through judgment and difficulty. Therefore, the verse repeats, *than to trust in princes*—lest you think a person should trust in these generous Ministers standing on the right side. Even these are nothing to trust in, for they have no salvation except what the Name, who is the Lord, gives to them. Therefore it says, *It is better to take refuge in the Lord than to trust in princes.*

After all this, he explains further and says that just as all those supernal Ministers encompass the Name of the Lord round about, so too their families below encompass Israel, who are the portion of the Lord. Therefore he said: *All nations compassed me about; in the name of the Lord I will cut them off* <note>Psalm 118:10</note>. See how much the reason for the verse is explained here! He said above that the Lord <note>YHVH</note> is in the middle and the Ministers are around Him; and below, Israel is in the middle and all the nations are around them. Why is Israel in the middle? Because they are the portion of the Lord.

But when Israel sinned, the "channels" <term>Hebrew: *Tzinorot*; the spiritual conduits of divine abundance</term> were broken, and the nations of the world inherited the blessing that was intended for Israel. That same flow that was drawn from those channels followed the principle of: *For a servant when he reigns* <note>Proverbs 30:22</note>, because those harsh shells entered between the Name and Israel. 

But when the Lord returns the captivity of Zion and the Name and Israel are united, and all intermediaries are removed from between them, then not one of all the Ministers of the nations will receive any flow, blessing, or goodness except through the Assembly of Israel, which prevails over them all and rules over them all, and she is the one who gives them sustenance. And all the Ministers and nations—their sustenance will be from that which remains at the end of all the final levels of the <unclear>emanations</unclear>.

# Gate 5

...is the second shell. "And flashing fire" <note>Ezekiel 1:4</note> is the third shell. "And a brightness was around it" is the fourth shell, the delicate one we mentioned. Afterward, the text begins to speak of the "Secret of the Lord," saying "from the midst of it like the color of the Hashmal" <term>Hebrew: *Hashmal*; a mysterious celestial substance or "electrum" seen in Ezekiel's vision</term>. At the end of the portion, it says "it was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the Lord." Thus you see these four shells; they separate Israel from the Lord. These are what are called the "Uncircumcision" <note>Hebrew: *Arlah*; usually referring to the foreskin, but used here metaphorically for spiritual blockage</note>. Therefore, the scripture says, "For all the nations are uncircumcised" <note>Jeremiah 9:25</note>.

What did the Holy One, blessed be He, do? He said to Abraham: "Abraham, my son, walk before Me and be whole" <note>Genesis 17:1</note>. Abraham said before Him: "Master of the Worlds, how shall I stand before You whole?" He replied: "At the time when you cut away the uncircumcision <note>the foreskin</note> from your body, which is the portion of the nations called 'uncircumcised'." Therefore, it says: "Any uncircumcised male who is not circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin, that soul shall be cut off." Why is he cut off? Because of the Covenant of Circumcision <term>Hebrew: *Brit Milah*</term> that he did not cut. This is the meaning of "He shall surely be circumcised, he who is born in your house" <note>Genesis 17:13</note>.

Because all the nations are called "uncircumcised," the scripture says: "All nations surrounded me; in the name of the Lord, I will cut them off" <note>Psalm 118:10</note>. This means that just as in the covenant of circumcision a person cuts the foreskin, so too with the Name of the Lord <note>Original: *YHVH*</note> I will cut the "uncircumcision" of the four barriers standing between him and the Lord. This is the secret of "In the name of the Lord, I will cut them off."

You will find in this passage that the expression "surrounded me" is mentioned four times, while the expression "I will cut them off" is mentioned three times. As it says: "All nations **surrounded me**; in the name of the Lord, **I will cut them off**. They **surrounded me** like bees; they were extinguished like a fire of thorns; in the name of the Lord, **I will cut them off**. They **surrounded me**, yes, they **surrounded me**; in the name of the Lord, **I will cut them off**." <note>Psalm 118:10-12</note>

Why does it use the language of "surrounded me" four times? Because there are four shells from the nations that separate Israel from the Lord, as I informed you:
1. The "stormy wind" mentioned by Ezekiel.
2. The "great cloud."
3. The "flashing fire."
4. The "brightness around it."

Since these are the four shells of the nations, he says "surrounded me" four times. And why did he say "I will cut them off" three times? Because the cutting of the circumcision—when a man cuts the foreskin, which is the secret of these four shells—is performed through three steps:
1. The cutting of the foreskin <term>Hebrew: *Milah*</term>.
2. The uncovering of the membrane <term>Hebrew: *Periah*</term>.
3. The suctioning of the wound <term>Hebrew: *Metzitzah*</term>.

Therefore, he said "three" <note>referring to the three times "I will cut them off" is mentioned</note>. You will yet hear more of this, with God's help—the words of the Living God regarding the secret of *Milah*, *Periah*, and *Metzitzah*. When Abraham received the covenant of circumcision, he was separated entirely from the nations called "uncircumcised." Afterward, Isaac was born.

Now that I have informed you of this great principle, I will inform you of the reason the scripture says regarding the planting of trees: "When you plant any tree for food, you shall regard its fruit as uncircumcised. Three years it shall be uncircumcised to you" <note>Leviticus 19:23</note>. The word "uncircumcised" <note>Original: *Orlah*</note> is used three times corresponding to the three harsh shells of uncircumcision. But in the fourth year, a "redemption" <note>Hebrew: *hillul*; a play on words between 'praises' and 'de-secrating/breaking'</note> is required through the heights, and this is "Holy for Praises" <term>Hebrew: *Kodesh Hillulim*</term>, meaning a "breaking through" <note>Original: *Hillul*</note> the heights against the fourth, delicate shell called "Brightness around it" <note>Original: *Nogah*</note>. Then, "in the fifth year you may eat its fruit," for behold, we have moved inward from the four shells to cleave to the Name of the Lord, in the secret of the final *He* <note>The last letter of the four-letter Name of God, Y-H-V-H</note> of the Name, which stands at the Gate. Therefore, it says: "This is the gate of the Lord." And this is the hint in the "fifth" year—"in the fifth year you may eat its fruit"—with the "fifth" <note>emphasizing the letter *He*, which has the numerical value of five</note>, for they have already exited the "uncircumcision" and cleaved to the Name of the Lord, may He be blessed.

# Gate 5

...is one. Thus, you find yourself learning that the Holy Names—such as *El*, *Elohim* <note>original: "א"ל אלהים"</note>, and their like—are the secret of the banners <term>Hebrew: *Degalim*; here referring to the spiritual divisions or standards of the heavenly host</term> through which the Name Y-H-V-H <note>The four-letter essential name of God, often referred to as the Tetragrammaton</note> clothes Himself, shines through them, and is glorified. Therefore, these Holy Names may not be erased. Just as the Holy Names are not erased, so too the Ministers <term>Hebrew: *Sarim*; angelic princes who represent the seventy nations in the celestial realm</term> who depend upon them in the light of the Supernal Chariot <term>Hebrew: *Merkabah*; the divine throne-chariot seen in Ezekiel's vision</term> are never lost.

However, the other descriptive epithets <term>Hebrew: *Kinnuyim*</term> that *may* be erased—such as "Merciful," "Gracious," "Long-suffering," and their like—are all like the armies of those Ministers and deputies. They do not possess the same level of sanctity as the Holy Names (a), and therefore they can be erased, for they are merely the "garments of the garments."

Now, you might ask: since the Holy Names are also like garments, and when the Name clothes Himself in them He becomes hidden and concealed from Israel—why then are they not erased? For surely it would be for the good of Israel and the greatness of the Name to be revealed, as it is said, "I have put off my coat; how shall I put it on?" <note>Song of Songs 5:3</note>. 

Know that even though we say the Holy Names are garments in which the Name clothes and covers Himself, there are two sides to this matter: 
1. If the Name Y-H-V-H clothes Himself in them alone while distancing Himself from the Assembly of Israel <term>Hebrew: *Knesset Yisrael*; the collective spiritual soul of the Jewish people</term>—this is the "evil," the "Exile," and the "great distress." This is the cause of the "Shells" <term>Hebrew: *Klipot*; forces of impurity or concealment</term> creating a barrier between Israel and their Father in Heaven.
2. But if the Name Y-H-V-H chooses Israel and Jerusalem and unites with the Assembly of Israel, and "no stranger is with them in the house," then all those Holy Names and descriptive epithets hover around them. The Ministers remain on the outside, while the Name Y-H-V-H and the Assembly of Israel remain within. This is the great spiritual height and the Glory <term>Hebrew: *Tiferet*</term>.

In every context, understand that the Lord strips off those garments in order to unite with the Assembly of Israel, but He does not destroy those garments from the world (b). There is a great need for those garments to be used, as it says, "Spread your wings over your handmaid, for you are a redeemer" <note>Ruth 3:9</note>. Therefore, they are not erased. The secret of this is: "And Aaron shall come into the Tent of Meeting (c) and shall put off the linen garments which he put on when he went into the holy place, and shall leave them there" <note>Leviticus 16:23</note>.

When the Blessed Name strips off those garments, He leaves them in their place because the Ministers of the nations take hold of them. These Ministers of the nations are a great necessity for the functioning of the Chariot. For this reason, the Holy Names are not erased. 

But the descriptive epithets that *are* erased—such as "Merciful," "Gracious," and the like—are like the seventy nations that are destined to be erased from the faith they currently hold; they will all eventually unite in the faith of Israel, as has been explained. This does not refer to other rebellious or heretical nations, as it is said, "For then I will turn to the peoples a clear language, that they may all call upon the name of the Lord, to serve Him with one accord" <note>Zephaniah 3:9</note>. 

Through this path, you will find that the Holy Names, which the seventy Ministers take hold of, are not erased. But the other epithets, which the seventy nations take hold of, are erased, because the current faith of the seventy nations is destined to be erased <note>meaning their pagan or non-monotheistic beliefs will be replaced by a pure recognition of God</note>. Through this approach, contemplate deep secrets and hidden matters regarding the Holy Names and the epithets, and then you will see the words of the Living God clearly. And now that we have informed you...

<note>Commentary at the bottom of the page</note>

Initially, the Divine Presence was forced to turn her face toward the external forces for the sake of her children; this was considered a blemish or deficiency for her, as she should have been turned toward the heavens. 
(a) **They are destined to have their thoughts erased:** as mentioned later. Heaven forbid that the Names themselves be erased for this reason, or that their sanctity be diminished. One might answer that the primary "epithets" refer to the names of actions and powers in the "Separate World" <note>The lower realms of existence</note>, such as "Merciful" and "Gracious." When the action ceases, the epithet also passes. All Names that are *not* erased indicate the Divine Essence itself and His holy Sefirot <term>the ten divine emanations</term>. Or, it could be said that this shows the great distinction between His banners/armies and His Essence; it is a great honor, for "in the multitude of people is the king's glory." 
(b) **There is a great need to use them:** because the world follows its natural order of upper, lower, and middle realms. "There is no difference between this world and the days of the Messiah except for the subjugation to foreign kingdoms" <note>A classic Talmudic principle from Berakhot 34b</note>. Thus, they are a necessity for the Chariot so the upper world remains in its standing and existence. If the garments were totally destroyed, the world would cease to exist. This will not happen even in the time of the Messiah; we find no scriptural language indicating the world's destruction, only the cessation of certain temporary things. The world will not be annulled until the seventh millennium, which is the "Great Sabbath." 
(c) **And shall put off the linen garments:** these are like the weekday garments or the Middle Line.

This is also the secret of: "Come, let us go up to the mountain of Y-H-V-H, to the house of the God of Jacob... for out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of Y-H-V-H from Jerusalem" <note>Isaiah 2:3</note>. Understand the secret of these two things mentioned at the end of the verse: "For out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of Y-H-V-H from Jerusalem." One who understands this will understand all that we have said. He will know that no blessing or goodness will be drawn from any side of the world to any of the Ministers or the nations except through Zion and Jerusalem. Because blessing and abundance come to them all through Zion and Jerusalem, all the Ministers and all the nations will long to serve them, for from them comes their sustenance. This is the meaning of "For out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of Y-H-V-H from Jerusalem."

This is also the secret of: "Behold, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their masters, as the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes look to Y-H-V-H our God, until He has mercy on us" <note>Psalm 123:2</note>. When you understand this, you will understand what the prophets said: "And Y-H-V-H shall be King over all the earth." When? "In that day shall Y-H-V-H be one, and His name one" <note>Zechariah 14:9</note>—at the time when the Name unites with the Assembly of Israel. Then the faith of all nations will be upon the Name Y-H-V-H (blessed be He), and out of their great desire to cling to the Name Y-H-V-H, they will serve Israel.

This is what was established in the prayers of <unclear>Rosh Hashanah</unclear>: "And so, the righteous shall see and be glad, and the upright shall exult," etc. Observe how they mentioned Zion and Jerusalem. Furthermore, they said earlier: "And so, instill Thy awe, O Y-H-V-H our God, upon all Thy works... and let all creatures prostrate themselves before Thee; and let them all form a single band to do Thy will with a perfect heart." Do you not see how they hinted here at the secret of all that I have explained?

Therefore, know and understand that the Name (blessed be He) is destined to remove all the epithets <term>Hebrew: *Kinnuyim*; titles for God that can be erased</term> when He comes to receive the Assembly of Israel. When He is united with her, then all the epithets will serve the Name, and the nations will remain on the outside, while the Name Y-H-V-H and the Assembly of Israel stand within, happy and tranquil. Then the seven channels from the seven Sefirot <term>the ten divine emanations or attributes in Kabbalah</term> will flow into the Assembly of Israel.

This is the secret of: "Moreover the light of the moon shall be as the light of the sun, and the light of the sun shall be sevenfold, as the light of the seven days, in the day that Y-H-V-H binds up the breach of His people, and heals the stroke of their wound" <note>Isaiah 30:26</note>.

<margin>The secret of the wellspring of redemption and freedom</margin>

(3) When you understand the secret of the "sevenfold" mentioned in this verse, you will understand the secret of the Fifty Gates of Understanding <term>Hebrew: *Binah*</term> that will be opened; the Jubilee <term>Hebrew: *Yovel*; the 50th year of liberation</term> will then be in effect, and redemption and freedom will be present for Israel. Then all the channels will pour blessing upon the Assembly of Israel, and all those evil and impure "shells" <term>Hebrew: *Kelipot*; spiritual forces of evil or concealment</term> will be distanced from the Assembly of Israel. 

This is the secret of "in the day that Y-H-V-H binds up the breach of His people, and heals the stroke of their wound"—He heals the "stroke" of the wicked Samael <term>The primary archangel of accusation and the personification of evil</term> who cast impurity into the Sanctuary. (3) This refers to the defect of the moon <note>The moon often symbolizes the Shekhinah or the Assembly of Israel; its "defect" represents the state of exile and spiritual diminishment</note>. Therefore, the healing of the wound is mentioned at the end of the verse containing the secret of the moon.

You thus find yourself learning from all these principles that the Great Name, the Name Y-H-V-H (blessed be He), is alone the essence and the root. All other Names and epithets take hold of Him from this side and that. And even though the Name *Ehyeh* <note>original: אה"יה; "I Will Be"</note> is the source for the Name Y-H-V-H, nevertheless, everything is one thing.

### Contemplate
And you shall find the secret of these three Names: each of them carries nine epithets. The name **El** carries nine, and with it, the name **Y-H-V-H** <note>the Tetragrammaton, the four-letter essential Name of God</note> is mentioned, and likewise for **Elohim**. Here you will find the secret of the "thirty years" that we mentioned above, which are alluded to in the secret of Ezekiel’s Chariot, as it says: "And it came to pass in the thirtieth year" <note>Ezekiel 1:1</note>. With these, all judgment is finalized in the Great Court <term>Hebrew: Beit Din HaGadol</term> of seventy-one members above. Similarly, in the other courts below, they judge with these thirty matters.

What you need to know is that according to the secret of this order, it is written: "I saw Y-H-V-H sitting on His throne, and all the host of heaven standing by Him" <note>1 Kings 22:19</note>. These "hosts of heaven" are the secret of the two Names called "Heaven," namely the secret of **El** and **Elohim**. From them, Y-H-V-H is called "The Heavens" and "The Rider of the Heavens" <note>Psalm 68:34</note>, and it says "O You who dwell in the heavens" <note>Psalm 123:1</note>. Regarding this, it is said: "Then hear You *the* heavens, Your dwelling place" <note>1 Kings 8:30</note>. It does not say "hear *from* the heavens," but rather "hear *the* heavens"—referring to the actual "Heavens" which are the Names **El** and **Elohim**.

The hosts of **El** and of **Elohim** stand over Him, to His right and to His left, as we have written in this preceding table. These epithets of **El** argue for and seek to turn the case toward merit <note>acquittal</note>; this is the secret of "from His right hand went a fiery law for them" <note>Deuteronomy 33:2</note>. Those epithets of **Elohim** argue for liability <note>conviction</note>; this is the secret of His left hand. This is what the Sages, of blessed memory, meant by: "all the host of heaven standing by Him on His right hand and on His left"—those on the right argue for merit and those on the left for liability.

After these two groups of the right and left argue their claims, they judge the defendant in the Court of Seventy-One, in the place positioned between the Great Name **Y-H-V-H** and the Name called **Elohim**. Between these two Names, the Chamber of Hewn Stone <term>Hebrew: Lishkat HaGazit; the hall in the Jerusalem Temple where the Sanhedrin sat</term> is established on high, in the place where the entire world is judged. After the arguments of the right and left, the Great Name standing in the middle—which is the Name **Y-H-V-H**, blessed be He—concurs to finalize the judgment, whether for life or death, for good or for evil. Then the decree is issued and the judgment is decided.

At that point, the side called **Elohim** completes that legal sentence. There stand the witnesses, the judges, and the officers. When they wish to carry out the decree, they send the document via the angels called "officers" to the lower court called **ADNY** <term>Adonai; the Name associated with the physical manifestation of Divine sovereignty</term>. Then the judgment is finalized in the lower world. What you need to know is that the place where they judge is between **Y-H-V-H** and **Elohim**, and the majority of that place is within the portion of **Elohim** and outward.

Three corresponding to them in the Small Sanhedrin <term>a court of 23 judges</term> who sat before the Great Sanhedrin... three... 23... and so it is before the <unclear>Divine Presence</unclear> on the Throne of Judgment on high and still...

# Gate 5

Now that we have informed you of these great principles regarding the secret of the Name **Y-H-V-H** (may He be blessed), concerning the secret of the Sacred Names that may not be erased and the secret of the Epithets that may be erased <note>In Jewish law, the seven primary Names of God are considered so holy they cannot be erased once written; other descriptive titles (epithets) do not carry the same restriction</note>, we must return to inform you of the secret of these thirty variations through which **Y-H-V-H** (may He be blessed) leads His creatures according to the proper law. We shall explain to you which direction each of these thirty variations leans toward: what is the specific attribute of each name or epithet, how the Names are attached to the Name **Y-H-V-H** (may He be blessed), and how the erasable epithets are bound to the Sacred Names that are not erased.

The sign for this is "The standard of the camp of Judah" <note>Numbers 2:3</note>, of which it is written, "and his host, and those who were numbered of them." You will find a **Standard** <margin>(א) You will find a "Camp," meaning the Name returns to rest upon its standard. It leaves its "place" as the first, as explained within, and returns to the Unique Name upon which everything depends. He is the one who holds everything together, similar to the point in the center of a circle from which all lines extending to the surrounding circumference are drawn and spread out.</margin>, you will find a **Camp**, and you will find **Their Hosts**. In this same way, the Name **Y-H-V-H** (may He be blessed) is the Essence <term>Hebrew: *Ikkar*; the root or core</term>, while the other Sacred Names are the form of the **Standards**, and the remaining Epithets are the secret of **Their Hosts**.

If this is so, open your eyes and see what we have previously informed you in this Gate regarding the matter of His Great Name and the matter of the other Sacred Names and Epithets. After we have informed you of this, we must enter into the explanation of the secret of these three Names, which are **El, Elohim, Y-H-V-H**: how the Epithets take hold of them, how the Name **Y-H-V-H** (may He be blessed) clothes itself in all or some of them, and what action is performed by each "garment" and the "One who wears it."

Once you know this, you will understand that the Name **Y-H-V-H** (may He be blessed) is the "Mound" toward which everyone gazes <note>A reference to the Temple Mount or a central point of orientation</note>; all individual details depend on His collective whole, and all Names and Epithets depend on the Name **Y-H-V-H**. 

What you need to know is that there are three Names arranged from top to bottom: **Ehyeh** <note>Meaning "I Will Be"</note> is at the top, **Adonai** <note>Meaning "My Lord"</note> is at the bottom, and **Y-H-V-H** is in the middle. Likewise, there are three names from the sides: **El** is on the right, **Elohim** is on the left, and **Y-H-V-H** is in the middle. Do you not see that the Name **Y-H-V-H** (may He be blessed) is in the middle, directed toward all sides? Therefore, you must contemplate that everything depends on Him, and He is the one who bears everything—may He be blessed and exalted forever and ever.

We must also awaken you to a great principle regarding a single verse: "For behold, **Y-H-V-H** comes out of His place" <note>Isaiah 26:21</note>. Our Sages of blessed memory said: "He leaves the Attribute of Mercy and comes to the Attribute of Judgment." But what "place" does He have? For it is written: "Who has measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, and meted out heaven with the span, and comprehended the dust of the earth in a measure, and weighed the mountains in scales?" <note>Isaiah 40:12</note>. Our Sages have already said: "He is the place of the world, but His world is not His place" <note>A classic Midrashic teaching that God encompasses the universe, but the universe does not encompass Him</note>. It is also written: "Behold, the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain Thee" <note>1 Kings 8:27</note>. So what is "His place"? And how can it say that "**Y-H-V-H** comes out of His place"?

Rather, the explanation of the verse is this: "Behold, **Y-H-V-H** comes out of His place"—which is **Ehyeh**, the attribute of Absolute Mercy—and comes to the Attribute of Judgment, which is **Adonai**. When you understand this, you will understand the secret of the arrangements of the Name from top to bottom. You will know that the "place" of **Y-H-V-H** (may He be blessed) is **Ehyeh**. Then the verse and what the Sages interpreted will make sense to you: "He leaves His place"—He leaves the Attribute of Mercy and comes to the Attribute of Judgment.

In this same way, you can understand this verse from the side: "He leaves His place"—He leaves the attribute whose standard is inscribed with **El**, which is the sign of Mercy, and comes to the attribute whose standard is inscribed with **Elohim**, which is the sign of Judgment, as it is written: "Every man by his own standard, with the banners" <note>Numbers 2:2</note>. 

**And after** you understand how the Name **Y-H-V-H** (may He be blessed) is the central height—for all His Names and Epithets take hold of Him from all around and are all bound to Him—you should contemplate that all the Names and Epithets, except for **Ehyeh** and **Y-H-V-H**, do not rise "from His shoulder and upwards" <margin>(ב) "From his shoulder and upwards"—meaning from the "Arms of the World" and higher, which are called His Name in the secret of the form of the merits of the [letter] He.</margin>. Even if the Left <note>The side of Judgment</note> is associated with Mercy through the Name **Ehyeh**, it is <margin>(ג) "Like the form of the standard"—meaning that which is engraved on his standard as a sign of Mercy, which you will yet see with God's help; this is what will be clarified as we proceed below.</margin> like the form of a banner. 

But you need to know that all the Epithets have their root in the "garment" of the Attributes, which we will yet explain with God’s help. I am now arranging for you the entire order of the Epithets that depend on the order of these three Names—**El, Elohim, Y-H-V-H**—in this order:

# Gate 5

<page-num>21</page-num>
<meta>catchword: For</meta>

Beyond the court of seventy-one (a), there are three other courts of twenty-three in the places where the people of the world are judged. But there is a difference between one court and another, for in specific places they judge life and death, and in specific places they judge wealth and poverty. With God's help, you will yet hear all these matters in their proper order—that in the Heavenly Court, not all judgments are conducted in one place; rather, there are specific places above where specific types of judgments are issued. 

And with God's help, we will also inform you of the secret of the places where the twenty-four <note>Likely referring to the twenty-four elders or judges in the heavenly assembly</note> judge, and from their partition, the messengers and the judicial rulings emerge in their hands, reaching the hosts of the lower heavens—where the sun, moon, and stars reside along with the host of the constellations—and how these and those carry out the judgment upon the creatures according to what was decreed in the Court on High. And among them all, there is no one who can change a single thing from all that the Great Name Y-H-V-H (blessed be He) has decreed (b). This is the secret of: "Indeed, in the path of Your judgments, O Y-H-V-H, we have hoped for You" <note>Isaiah 26:8</note>. 

After we have informed you of this, we must return and inform you of the secret of these epithets of "El" standing on the right—from what thing they are drawn—and similarly the secret of the epithets of "Elohim" standing on the left—from what side they are drawn. As well as the epithets standing in the middle, adjacent to the Name Y-H-V-H (blessed be He), and they will guide us in the way of truth.

**Epithets** of *El* <note>original: "God" as a name of Kindness</note> standing on the right side, which turn toward the merit of the creatures; these are called the "Epithets of Kindness." This is the attribute that our father Abraham (peace be upon him) inherited on high, for this is the attribute of Kindness <term>Chesed: the divine attribute of boundless love and giving</term> and the merit of the creatures. The secret is hinted at in the verse: "And Abraham drew near and said: 'Will You indeed sweep away the righteous with the wicked? ... perhaps there are fifty righteous...'" <note>Genesis 18:23-24</note>. For all the epithets that are the attribute of Abraham turn toward merit because of Abraham, just as Abraham our father did when he said, "Perhaps there shall lack five of the fifty righteous." 

And He said, "I will not destroy." They return through the beauty of Kindness and speak of merit: "Perhaps forty shall be found there." They continue to add to the defense of merit until they reach the end of the entire attribute of Kindness, which consists of ten epithets: "Perhaps ten shall be found there." And if, Heaven forbid, there is not even the minimum argument—which is one argument for each of the ten epithets of Kindness—then the matter is punished and the judgment is finalized, just as they finalized the judgment in Sodom and Gomorrah. 

Thus are all judgments of their kind finalized. Then all the epithets that plead for merit return to their place, and the Name [Y-H-V-H] withdraws from the judgments, and the epithets called *Elohim* <note>The Name associated with strict Judgment</note> finalize the verdict. This is the secret of: "And Y-H-V-H went His way as soon as He had finished speaking with Abraham, and Abraham returned to his place" <note>Genesis 18:33</note>. Then the third Name, which is *Elohim*, finalizes the judgment, and this is: "And it came to pass, when Elohim destroyed the cities of the plain" <note>Genesis 19:29</note>. In the destruction by *Elohim*, it is *Elohim* who finalizes the judgment, for the attribute of *El*—which belongs to Abraham—had already finished, Y-H-V-H had returned them to their place, and *Elohim* remained to finalize the judgment.

If you should ask: "Behold, it is written: 'And Y-H-V-H <note>original: *V’Y-H-V-H* (the 'and' is significant in Kabbalah)</note> rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah sulfur and fire.' Behold, the Name Y-H-V-H is written in this place, yet He is finalizing the judgment?" Know that in every place in the Torah where you find it written "And Y-H-V-H," it refers to Him and His Court. He issues the verdict, and His Court—which is *Elohim*—finalizes the judgment. This is why it says at the end: "And it came to pass, when Elohim destroyed the cities of the plain." 

Now that we have informed you of this, contemplate that this portion was not written in the Torah for nothing; it came to teach and make known the judgment of Sodom and Gomorrah, and it came to hint at all the judgments decreed in the world in the Court on High. For Abraham and his epithets—which are the Name *El* with its epithets—stand there perpetually, pleading for the merit of the inhabitants of the world. After they finish pleading for merit, they return to their place. Guard this principle always for every place in the Torah. This is what is meant by: "You will give truth to Jacob, and kindness to Abraham" <note>Micah 7:20</note>. The attribute of Kindness is handed over to Abraham to plead for the merit of all creatures. We have already informed you that the form of the Standard of the attribute of Kindness is called *El*. You should know that Abraham inherited the attribute of *El*, as it says: "And he planted a tamarisk tree in Beer-sheba, and called there on the name of Y-H-V-H, the Everlasting God <note>original: *El Olam*</note>" <note>Genesis 21:33</note>. And it is written: "Blessed be Abram of God Most High <note>original: *El Elyon*</note>." And you already know

# Gate 5: Page 59

<page-num>59</page-num>

...“And Isaac loved Esau because there was a hunt in his mouth.” <note>Genesis 25:28</note> And what is the meaning of “a hunt in his mouth”? It means he saw the children of Israel—represented by Jacob—being hunted by the judgments of Gehenna <term>Gehenna: the place of spiritual purification or punishment after death</term>, and he was pained. But when he saw the exile of Edom <note>Edom is traditionally associated with Esau and later historical empires like Rome</note> and saw that the "hunt" of Gehenna was instead placed in the mouth of Esau, he rejoiced and said: **Exile atones for sin.**

This is the meaning of: "Israel is holy to the Lord, the first of His harvest; all who eat of it shall be held guilty." <note>Jeremiah 2:3</note> Behold, I have informed you that even though the attribute of Isaac is **Fear**, its intention is to bring merit to Israel. This is the secret of the prayer: “Remember for the sake of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel Your servants,” for the Blessed Name <note>original: "HaShem Yitbarak"</note> grants merit to Israel through the exile of Esau.

And I shall explain further: “And Isaac loved Esau because there was a hunt in his mouth.” This means that since Isaac represents the **Attribute of Judgment** and **Fear**, he loves all the agents of judgment who know how to "hunt" the wicked into Gehenna. If not for the attribute of Fear regarding the judgments of Gehenna, how many righteous people might have stumbled into sin? Thus, the attribute of the **Fear of Isaac** <term>Pachad Yitzchak: a name for God emphasizing the quality of awe and judgment</term> is of great benefit, for it causes a person to fear the judgment of Gehenna and they become careful not to commit a transgression. This is the secret of the Fear of Isaac.

Regarding this, it is said: "Happy is the man who fears always." <note>Proverbs 28:14</note> If so, open your eyes and see how beneficial fear is, for it prevents a person from sinning. This is the secret of "Happy is the man who fears always"—it means happy is the person who sees how great the punishments of the laws of Gehenna are, which are themselves called "Fear."

As our Sages of blessed memory <note>original: "AZAL"</note> said: “Each man with his sword upon his thigh, because of fear in the nights” <note>Song of Songs 3:8</note>—this refers to the fear of Gehenna, which is compared to the night. When a person fears the judgments of Gehenna, he restrains himself from many transgressions. This is the secret of "Happy is the man who fears always," and the secret of "Fear," and the secret of "Fear" which prunes away sins.

Therefore, understand that Fear is a great necessity for Israel to escape the judgments of Gehenna. If Israel is not careful and does not fear before the Lord, it is better for them to fall into the exile of Esau than to fall into Gehenna, for **exile atones for sin.** Thus, Isaac—who is the Attribute of Fear—rejoiced that Israel would fall into the exile of Esau and have their sins atoned for, rather than falling into Gehenna, which is a very harsh judgment. For this reason, it says: “And Isaac loved Esau because there was a hunt in his mouth.”

Now that I have informed you of this, we must inform you of the secret of those savory dishes <term>mat’amim: delicacies or tasty foods</term> that Isaac requested from Esau, and how Jacob came and completed the dishes for Isaac his father and inherited Esau’s blessing. I have already informed you that our father Isaac (peace be upon him) is the **"Perfect Burnt Offering"** <note>A reference to the Binding of Isaac, where he was considered a sanctified sacrifice</note> and the Divine Presence <term>Shekhinah: the indwelling presence of God</term> never departed from him even for a single moment. How then could a stumbling block come by his hand? Or how could he love Esau? Or how could he wish to bless the wicked and leave the righteous? Or how could a blessing be sustained through eating and drinking? Indeed, prayer should come before eating! And the Torah says: “Do not drink wine or strong drink, you or your sons with you” <note>Leviticus 10:9</note>—so how could Isaac eat and drink and then bless the wicked?

My son, do not be seduced by your own thoughts, and do not accept or believe that a completely righteous man like our father Isaac (peace be upon him) would fail in a small matter. Rather, all his deeds were balanced on the scales of justice for the sake of the Blessed God. Know that when our father Isaac saw that there are two worlds—this world and the World to Come—and he saw Israel pushed aside and suffering in this world, and he saw his own attribute (the Attribute of Judgment) stretched out against Israel, he was pained. He said: “What will my children do in the hands of the nations, among the seventy nations, and how will they conduct themselves among them in their exile?”

He said: “It is better that I give Esau, my son, the blessing of **this world**, which comes through eating and drinking, so that he may rule over Israel once they have sinned and gone into exile. It is better that they fall into the exile of Esau, their brother, than fall into the exile of other foreigners who are the seventy nations.” Isaac said: “Since it is impossible for the Attribute of Judgment not to collect its debt from Israel, it is better that it collects the debt through their brother than through a stranger.” This is the secret of: “Do not abhor an Edomite, for he is your brother.” <note>Deuteronomy 23:8</note>

Therefore, Isaac loved Esau because he was the "repair" <term>tikkun: a spiritual rectification or fixing</term> for Jacob, preventing his children from falling into Gehenna. When he saw that Jacob’s children would be saved from Gehenna even while being "hunted" in the exile of Esau, he rejoiced. This is the secret of “a hunt in his mouth.” Because the matter was so, Isaac said: “Esau is not worthy to inherit the upper, intellectual blessing, but he shall inherit the lower, physical blessing. It is fitting to bless him for a physical matter, which is something the body enjoys.” This is the meaning of eating and drinking. Therefore, Isaac said to Esau: “Make for me savory dishes...”

# Gate 5

To walk in the day by the authority of the **Attribute of Abraham**, according to his commandment and his agreement. This is the secret of the phrase: "The God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob" <note>Exodus 3:6</note>. Note that the text does not say "*and* the God of Isaac" in the same way it says "*and* the God of Jacob" <note>In the Hebrew phrasing of the Patriarchs, the conjunctive "and" is often omitted before Isaac to show his attribute is subordinate to Abraham's</note>. This is so that the Attribute of Isaac does not take precedence over **Greatness** <term>Greatness: "Gedulah," another name for the attribute of Kindness or Chesed</term>, and so that the attribute of the **Fear of Isaac** remains under the **Kindness of Abraham**. 

This is the secret behind the verse: "And the two of them walked together" <note>Genesis 22:6, regarding the binding of Isaac</note>. It means that Isaac has no permission to proceed until the Attribute of Abraham teaches merit on his behalf; for if it were not so, the Attribute of Isaac would destroy the world. This is also the secret of: "And it came to pass that God tested Abraham." Know this: Abraham "bound" Isaac <note>The Akedah or "Binding of Isaac"</note> so that the Attribute of Isaac would be (see folio 36b) bound hand and foot, suppressed beneath the Attribute of Abraham.

Now I shall inform you how the **Kindness of Abraham** teaches merit. He is "Great" and to him belongs "Abounding Kindness" <note>original: "Rav Chesed"</note>. When a person stands for judgment and his sins are weighed, the Kindness of Abraham brings forth his banner, upon which is engraved the name **El** <term>El: A Divine name specifically associated with the attribute of Kindness</term>. This name removes the first of the sins that arose in the scale, according to the secret of "God [El], Merciful and Gracious." It does not begin counting sins until the third one, as it is said: "Behold, all these things God works, twice, even three times, with a man" <note>Job 33:29</note>. 

Even as the sins are weighed, the Attribute of **Long-suffering** <note>original: "Erech Apayim"</note> waits for him. At the conclusion of the verdict, if his sins and merits are found to be equal, the Kindness of Abraham tips the scale toward merit. This is the secret of "Abounding Kindness"—if Abraham is able to save him. But if not, then **Jacob** "contends with the mountain" <note>A legal metaphor for a difficult case</note>. Then the Attribute of Jacob, which serves as the **Court of Law** <term>Beit Din</term> between Abraham and Isaac, issues the final ruling and declares: "Guilty." 

When the Attribute of Jacob—which is the secret of the name **Y-H-V-H**—says "Guilty," it is written at the end of the verse: **"and Truth"** <note>Referring to the Thirteen Attributes of Mercy in Exodus 34:6</note>. "Truth" is the secret of the final verdict of the third attribute, which is the secret of the name **Y-H-V-H**, the secret of Jacob, and the secret of **Truth** <note>original: "Emet"</note>. As it says: "You give Truth to Jacob" <note>Micah 7:20</note>, which is the secret of "The judgments of the Lord [Y-H-V-H] are Truth" <note>Psalm 19:10</note>. When Truth comes to issue a ruling and finds no merit at all in the case, then the two attributes—Abraham and Jacob, which are **El** and **Y-H-V-H**—depart. 

Judgment is then left to be finalized by the hand of **Elohim** <term>Elohim: The Divine name associated with strict Justice and Judgment</term>. As it says: "And the Lord [Y-H-V-H] went His way as soon as He had left off speaking with Abraham, and Abraham returned to his place" <note>Genesis 18:33</note>, and afterward it is written: "And it came to pass, when **Elohim** destroyed the cities of the plain" <note>Genesis 19:29</note>. This is the secret of: "For judgment belongs to God [Elohim]" <note>Deuteronomy 1:17</note>, meaning the final verdict is handed to the name Elohim to be completed. 

This is the secret of the **Fear of Isaac**; the righteous are terrified of this attribute, as it says: "My flesh trembles for fear of You, and I am afraid of Your judgments" <note>Psalm 119:120</note>. Thus you have learned the conclusion of the verse: "God [El], Merciful and Gracious, Long-suffering, and Abounding in Kindness and Truth." All the titles from "El, Merciful..." onwards are titles of the attribute **El** (Kindness), except for the final word **"Truth,"** which is the title of **Y-H-V-H**, the attribute of Jacob. It is called Truth because it issues the final legal ruling. This is the secret of "You give Truth to Jacob," "The judgments of the Lord are Truth," and "Blessed is the True Judge" <note>The blessing said upon hearing bad news or a death</note>.

Now that we have informed you of these great principles regarding the attribute of **El** and some of its titles, we must return to inform you of the secret of the name **Elohim**. This is the attribute of **Fear and Judgment**, which is the attribute of Isaac. Although we have already explained much about the Attribute of Fear within the context of Abraham, we must still explain the attribute of **Elohim** as it stands on its own. May God, in His great mercy and kindness, guide us in the way of truth.

**Titles** of Elohim: These stand on the **Left Side** <term>The Left Side: In Kabbalah, the "Left" represents Gevurah (Strength/Judgment), while the "Right" represents Chesed (Kindness)</term>. They are the ones who teach and remind of the "debts" (sins) of created beings. These are called the **Titles of Judgment**, and this is the root of Isaac, peace be upon him, for this is the attribute that completes the judgment upon His creatures.

We must inform you of this great principle: We have already told you that the attribute of Abraham teaches merit for creatures, while the attribute of Isaac teaches liability <note>original: "chovah" or guilt</note>. Thus we find written of Isaac: "And Isaac loved Esau because there was a hunt in his mouth" <note>Genesis 25:28</note>. How is it possible that a great righteous man like our father Isaac—from whom the Divine Presence <term>Shekhinah</term> never departed for even a moment—would love a completely wicked man like Esau? 

Rather, this is one of the great secrets of the Torah. Know that our father Isaac, peace be upon him, could gaze into the far future. He foresaw that the children of Jacob would sin and provoke the Blessed One, thereby deserving the judgment of Gehenna. When Isaac saw Israel suffering in the **Exile of Esau**, he rejoiced. He said: "**Exile atones for sin.**" Therefore, he said: "I love all the troubles brought by Esau very much, for they teach the liability of Israel, so that their judgment may be completed through exile in this world [rather than in the next]." This is why "Isaac loved..."

# Gate 5 <note>The Hebrew header "שער ה ס" likely indicates Gate 5, Section 60</note>

He acts to remove Judgment from there and elevates it to the **Attribute of Mercy**, which is called the **Elder** <note>original: "Zaken"</note>. (1) And when the Attribute of Judgment ascends to that place, it has no power either to speak or to see. This is the secret of the verse: *“But the Lord of Hosts is exalted in judgment, and the holy God is sanctified in righteousness”* <note>Isaiah 5:16</note>. Regarding this it is said: *“And it came to pass, when Isaac was old, and his eyes were dim”* <note>Genesis 27:1</note>; that is to say, this verse speaks both about him [the person] and about his attribute [Judgment]. <margin>number 178</margin> Therefore, the Blessed Lord, in times of harsh Judgment, has mercy on His world and says: *“For My own sake, for My own sake, will I do it; for how should My name be profaned?”* <note>Isaiah 48:11</note>. This is what our Sages, of blessed memory, meant when they said: "The Son of David [the Messiah] will not come except in a generation that is entirely guilty" (2). This is the secret of the law: *“It is all turned white; he is clean”* <note>Leviticus 13:13, referring to the paradoxical law where a leper is declared pure if the white infection covers their entire body</note>.

In this same way, contemplate that the **Fear of Isaac** <term>Fear of Isaac: A title for the attribute of Gevurah or "Strict Judgment"</term> has no power or dominion at the moment when the **Supreme Crown** <term>Crown: "Keter," the highest and most merciful of the Divine emanations</term> shines its face downward. This is because the Crown's great light is stronger than the sight of the eyes of the **Fear of Isaac**. This is the secret of: *“The Lord make His face shine upon you and be gracious to you”* <note>Numbers 6:25</note>. What is the meaning of *“and be gracious to you”* <note>original: "v’yichuneka"</note>? It means that even if you are not worthy of mercy, at the time when He shines His Supernal Face, He will give you a "free gift" <note>A play on the Hebrew root "C-N-N" which relates to both grace and unearned gifts</note>. This is the secret of: *“The Lord make His face shine upon you and be gracious to you.”*

**And behold,** I shall further enlighten your eyes with the help of Heaven. Know that wherever you find the "shining of His face" from above, it is a great secret (3). There are three hundred and ten <note>original: "Shin-Yod," the numerical value of "Yesh" (substance/existence)</note> faces of wrath, and all of them are attached to the **Fear of Isaac**. But when the Attribute of the Crown shines its face and brings forth the banner of Mercy, the **Attribute of God** <note>original: "El," the name associated with Kindness/Chesed</note> laughs <note>The Hebrew "Shachak" (laughter) is phonetically and mystically linked to "Yitzchak" (Isaac)</note> within it. This is the secret of the watches of the "faces of wrath." At that moment, all the faces of wrath return to a state of shining and are entirely transformed into Mercy. This is the secret of: *“God is the Lord, and He has given us light”* <note>Psalm 118:27</note>. And this is: *“Happy is the people that know the joyful shout [Teruah]; they walk, O Lord, in the light of Your countenance”* <note>Psalm 89:16</note>.

If so, contemplate the secret of: *“And it came to pass, when Isaac was old, and his eyes were dim from seeing.”* Then you will grasp the secret of: (5) *“Blow the Shofar at the new moon, at the hidden time for our feast day”* <note>Psalm 81:4</note>, and the secret of: *“Happy is the people that know the joyful sound; they walk, O Lord, in the light of Your countenance.”* (6) And it shows what the **Shofar of the Ram of Isaac** is. When you contemplate these matters, you will then enter the secret of what we say in liturgy: **“Former of the Luminaries”** <note>original: "Yotzer HaMeorot," the blessing for daylight</note> and **“Creator of the Fire-lights”** <note>original: "Borei Meorei Ha-Esh," the blessing over a candle at the end of the Sabbath</note>. You will then understand the difference between the two: for the "Forming of the Luminaries" is drawn from the Great Mercies from above in the secret of *“God is the Lord, and He has given us light.”* However, the "Fire-lights" are drawn from the **Attribute of Elohim** <term>Elohim: The Divine Name associated with Judgment and Law</term>, from the attribute of Darkness, as it is said: *“And darkness was upon the face of the deep”* and *“Who forms light and creates darkness.”* Therefore, the **Attribute of God** <note>El/Kindness</note> shines into the darkness included within the **Attribute of Elohim** (7), which is the secret of fire. This is the secret of: *“The Lord make His face shine upon you and be gracious to you.”*

Now that we have informed you of this regarding these two attributes [Kindness and Judgment], we must inform you of the purpose of the **Name YHWH**, may He be blessed, which tips the balance in the middle, and how He leads His world. 

->**Appellations**<- of the Blessed YHWH standing in the middle of the line:
To their right is **Kindness** <note>Chesed</note> and to their left is **Judgment** <note>Din</note>, and they are included in the middle from both Kindness and Judgment. These Appellations in the middle are called the **Appellations of Mercy**, and regarding them it is said: *“To the Lord our God belong mercies and forgivenesses”* <note>Daniel 9:9</note>. 

I shall now explain, with the help of Heaven. Know that regarding all the Holy Names, Appellations, and Attributes—whether they are called "Kindness," "Mercy," or "Judgment"—there is not one among them that is "pure kindness," "pure judgment," or "pure mercy" without some mixture. All of this applies from the Name **Ehyeh** <note>“I Will Be,” associated with Keter</note> and downwards (8). But from Him and upwards, all is absolute Mercy and absolute Kindness.

(1) **And is called "Elder"** <note>Zaken</note>: This is explained because it is entirely the attribute of Mercy, as it is said: *“And the Ancient of Days sat”* <note>Daniel 7:9</note>. (2) **And this is the secret of "it is all turned white; he is clean"**: This means that when the affliction is over his entire flesh, and from his head to his feet there is no sound spot, then according to the secret, it is called "turned over to the whiteness of mercy," and he is clean. (3) **And this is because there are 300**: This corresponds to the "310 Worlds" <note>original: "Yesh Olamot"</note> which belong to the attribute of *Yesh* [Being/Substance], of which it is said: *“That I may cause those that love Me to inherit substance [Yesh]”* <note>Proverbs 8:21</note>. "El" [God] is the number that explains them. This is also found in Gate 7, Gate 10, Gate 9, and Appellation 10. (4) **The people that know the joyful shout [Teruah]**: Our Sages said: those who know how to blast the shofar with power. Others explain it from the language of "knowing" and "binding," meaning they know how to appease "What" <note>original: "Mah," a mystical name for a specific level of Divine reality</note> and to bind themselves to Mercy. (5) **Blow the Shofar at the new moon... at the hidden time [Keseh]**: Meaning, blast with Mercy during the "new moon of the shofar," which is included in Judgment and Mercy, in order to **cover** <note>A wordplay on "Keseh" (hidden/throne) and "Kisuy" (covering)</note> the eyes of Judgment on our feast day. (6) **And see what the Shofar of the Ram of Isaac is**: For it was uprooted from "Mah," a weak [feminine] principle, and mixed with Mercy to become a Shofar, which is entirely Judgment and Mercy, as mentioned at the beginning of the Gate. (7) **Which is the secret of "No" [Lo]**: For the foundation of "No" is not in its place above; it is sweet without bitterness. For if it had bitterness, it would not illuminate all the light beneath the firmament of the sphere at night. # Gate 5

"...and eat, so that my soul may bless you" <note>Genesis 27:4</note>. It specifically says "my soul" <note>original: *nafshi*</note>, because it is the vital soul that receives physical nourishment, not the higher spirit <note>original: *neshamah*</note>. Following this path, our father Isaac (may peace be upon him) intended to lighten the punishment of Israel during their exile so they would not inherit the judgments of Gehenna <note>the place of spiritual purification or "hell"</note>. Even though the Divine Presence <term>Shekhinah: The feminine, indwelling presence of God on earth</term> says that even in exile, Israel needs to lighten the heavy yoke of Esau from upon them. This is the secret of the verse: *“And Rebekah loved Jacob”* <note>Genesis 25:28</note>. For the Divine Presence in the time of our father Abraham was called **Sarah**. (2) In the time of Isaac, she was called **Rebekah**. In the time of Jacob, she was called **Rachel**.

As for **Leah**, she represents the secret of the **Jubilee** <term>Jubilee: "Yovel," the 50th year of release, symbolizing the high Sephirah of Binah (Understanding) from which souls originate</term>. The two handmaidens <note>Bilhah and Zilpah</note> are the secret of the two "maidservants" of the Divine Presence (3), and from there, everything was set in order. Therefore: *“And Rebekah heard when Isaac spoke to Esau his son”* <note>Genesis 27:5</note>. Rebekah then commanded Jacob to prepare the savory meats so he could receive the blessing intended for Esau. If not for this, not a single person in Israel would have escaped the sword of the exile of Edom <note>Edom is the traditional Rabbinic term for the Roman Empire and, later, Christendom, identified with Esau</note>. Contemplate this deeply.

**Behold**, I have informed you of the secret of Isaac's blessing and his love for Esau. Now that you know this, I must inform you that if Isaac had not been bound upon the altar <note>The *Akedah* or Binding of Isaac</note>, and if Abraham had not taken the fire and the knife in his hand, not one of Israel could have endured before the Judgment of Isaac. It was not because Isaac hated his son Israel—heaven forbid!—but rather because of his extreme piety. His "Fear" and his "Judgment" were so tautly stretched to make them fear and tremble before the Blessed Lord so they would not sin. But he saw that they were destined to sin. He saw that Israel could only be saved either by the punishment of Gehenna or the punishment of exile; therefore, he intended to complete the judgment of Israel through exile.

However, when the **Attribute of Loving-kindness** <note>original: *Chesed*</note>—which is the Attribute of God (*El*) and the Attribute of Abraham—saw that if Israel’s judgment were fully completed in exile, they would all be destroyed and perish, leaving no survivor, the Attribute of Loving-kindness took the fire and the knife into its own hands. This was to ensure that Israel would not be consumed or lost in exile. This is the secret of the verse: *“And yet for all that, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject them, nor will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly”* <note>Leviticus 26:44</note>.

After knowing this, I must inform you of the reason why Isaac’s eyes were too dim to see. Know that the Blessed Lord diminished the **Attribute of Judgment** so that it would not be overly precise in scrutinizing every single sin. This is the secret of the words: *“And his eyes were dim from seeing.”* Why does it first say "Isaac was old" and then "his eyes were dim"? **I shall now enlighten your eyes**, with God's help. Know that there is a level above called the **Perfect Attribute of Mercy**, which is named **Ehyeh** <note>the Divine Name meaning "I Will Be"</note>. This level is called the "Elder" <note>original: *Zaken*</note>, for it has mercy without any mixture of Judgment. When human beings sin, the Attribute of Judgment is stretched out against them. But when they stand for judgment, the Blessed Lord—who is the Four-Letter Name <note>YHVH</note>—sees that if the judgment is carried out to its end, there will be destruction in all the worlds...

(Relates to page 63) His intention was to act according to the strength of his judgment. (1) "Bound hands and feet"—explaining the difficulty of the binding. "So that my soul may bless you"—he sought to provide a meal and drink to awaken the internal power from which the blessing is earned. Leah was the secret of the Jubilee, the source of Understanding... the two handmaidens are the secret of the maidens who serve the Divine Presence... Rebekah loved Jacob because she yearned for her husband always, even in times of anger, to guide her children with mercy... she acted with wisdom so that Esau would not have the full physical blessing, for if Israel had no physical blessing, they could not survive in this world.

# Gate 5, 61

The Attribute of Judgment associated with Isaac mingles with it, for there is no attribute of mercy that does not contain some judgment, and no attribute of judgment that does not contain some mercy. (See *Tikkunei Zohar* and *Pardes Rimonim* <note>Reference to classic Kabbalistic works: *Pardes Rimonim* was authored by Moshe Cordovero</note>). If you should ask: "If so, why do you call it the 'Attribute of Judgment' if it contains mercy, and why do you call it the 'Attribute of Mercy' if it contains judgment?" Know that the attribute whose essence is mercy and which mostly manifests in mercy—even if it contains a bit of judgment—we call the Attribute of Mercy. And any attribute whose essence is judgment and mostly manifests in judgment—even if it contains a bit of mercy—we call the Attribute of Judgment <note>original: *m"h*, abbreviation for *midat hadin*</note>.

However, there is no name or title from the name *E-H-Y-E-H* <note>original: "I Will Be," the name associated with the highest Sephirah, Keter</note> and below that is entirely absolute judgment or entirely absolute mercy. For if you judge it so, you will be found "cutting the shoots" <term>Cutting the shoots: A Talmudic idiom for heresy, specifically the act of separating Divine attributes from their unified source</term> and separating the Unity. For if you say the Attribute of Mercy is absolute mercy, it would never connect with the absolute Attribute of Judgment. They would be found (a) like two opposites that never approach one another. If they do not connect, the Unity is separated into disjointed parts: the Attribute of Mercy on its own and the Attribute of Judgment on its own. Concerning this it is said: *“A whisperer separates the Master”* <note>Proverbs 16:28; here interpreted as one who causes division within the Divine hierarchy</note>.

**But the secret** of the connection between the *Sephirot* <term>Sephirot: The ten creative emanations through which God interacts with the universe</term>, the Names, the Titles, and the Attributes into one another is as I will tell you. Know that the attribute of the Supreme Crown <term>Keter: The "Crown," the highest and most hidden Sephirah</term>, which is entirely mercy, first unites with the side of Wisdom <term>Chokhmah: The first flash of Divine intellect</term> that faces upward, which is also mercy. From the other side of Wisdom that faces downward—called the "Back"—the Attribute of Judgment is born. <margin>And from the upper side</margin> of the judgment of Wisdom that faces downward, take Understanding <term>Binah: The Sephirah that expands and processes the flash of Wisdom</term>; that side called "Judgment" returned to be called "Mercy" relative to the system of Understanding, because the further things distance themselves from the Crown, the more judgment is born within them.

Therefore, the "Back" of Wisdom is called "Judgment" relative to the Crown, but called "Mercy" relative to Understanding. From these two *Sephirot* called Wisdom and Understanding, all other Names and Titles are emanated. Thus you have learned that every "Right" side comes from the side of Wisdom (b) and every "Left" side comes from the side of Understanding. Even though the Right is from Wisdom, Wisdom is not absolute mercy, as we said: even the "Back" of Wisdom is called "Judgment" relative to the Crown; how much more so the Right that extends from Wisdom, which contains both judgment and mercy.

But this is the rule: all the *Sephirot* emanated from the side of Wisdom are all called the Attribute of Mercy, because the *Sephirot* emanated from Understanding are all judgment. Relative to their arrangement with one another, these are called mercy and those are called judgment. It is not because those of the Right are absolute mercy, but because their majority and essence is mercy, though they contain a bit of judgment. Nor is it because those of the Left are absolute judgment, but because their majority and essence is judgment, though they contain a bit of mercy. And this is the secret of the connection of the *Sephirot* and the Chariot <term>Chariot: *Merkavah*, the structure of the Divine realm</term>: for without the intermingling within the attributes, they would never approach or be bound to one another.

**Thus** you have learned that the attribute of *El* <note>original: *A"L*</note>, which is the attribute of Abraham, even though it is called Kindness <term>Chesed: The fourth Sephirah, associated with unconditional love</term> and contains much mercy, a bit of judgment is mixed into it. And the attribute of *Elohim*, which is the attribute of the "Fear of Isaac," even though it is called Judgment and contains many types of punishment, a bit of mercy is mixed into it. But the attribute of the name *Y-H-V-H*, which is the Middle Line and stands in the center of all the Names as we have informed you—with Kindness on its right and Judgment on its left—without doubt this Name is included in judgment and mercy from both sides. Therefore, it decides whether for life or for death, for pleasure or for plague. Therefore, you find the name *Y-H-V-H*, which is the secret of the Middle Line, standing in the center (c). This is the attribute of our father Jacob (may peace be upon him), and therefore it is said of him: *“Jacob was a wholesome man, dwelling in tents”* <note>Genesis 25:27</note>, meaning Jacob is the

The Attribute of Judgment <note>original: *Midat Ha-Din*, the divine power of limitation and justice</note> associated with Isaac is intermingled with it; for there is no attribute of mercy that does not contain a bit of judgment, and there is no attribute of judgment that does not contain a bit of mercy (see Chapter 9 and in the *Pardes* <note>Referring to *Pardes Rimmonim* by Moshe Cordovero, a central Kabbalistic text</note>). But the essence of the matter is that in the combination [of the Sefirot], it is said of them: "right and left, front and back." One is to the right, one to the left, one behind, and one facing forward or upward. This is its beginning and its end, as will be explained. 

And even though all of these are spiritual, having no physical body or place, all of this is said regarding their influence and action upon one another as "influencer" and "receiver." Regarding this, it was said that there is no name or attribute from the Name E-H-Y-E-H and below that is "simple" without the Chariot. For in its "face" turned upward to the influencer, it is Mercy; but in its "face" turned downward to the one receiving from it, it is Judgment. For the one who influences is always the giver of mercy, while the receiver is lacking from him, and therefore [the receiver] is not as full of mercy as the giver, and is considered "Judgment" relative to him. 

Consider this: the lower it is, the more it tends toward Judgment. To understand the arrangement of the powers and their combination with one another, I have placed before you a diagram of their standing and appearance. You will see that **Dread** <note>original: *Pachad*; another name for the Sephirah of Judgment/Gevurah</note> is the furthest from the Crown, and therefore it is absolute judgment and strength. Yet, even it was mixed with Kindness to influence **Beauty** <note>original: *Tiferet*; the central Sephirah</note> and to stand in the middle and decide between them. This matter continues to cascade down until the end, which is like a judgment so harsh that no creature could endure it. Therefore, His wisdom was great enough to cascade matters in this way, to turn back and sweeten the judgment even in **Foundation** <note>original: *Yesod*</note>, so that the judgment here would be tempered, as the matter is explained at length in the book *The System* <note>original: *Sefer Ha-Ma'arekhet*, likely referring to *Ma'arekhet Ha-Elohut*</note> in the chapter on "The Arrangement of the Planets." These are ancient and deep matters, and we have spoken here according to the tradition and the bond of those who explain, so that the words of the author may be clarified as he proceeds with this matter. The depths of these words are for those who know the hidden grace from the tradition regarding **(c) the Attribute of Judgment** associated with Isaac. This refers to the causes of judgment within it, as will be clarified in the discussion of the Name of *MaH* <note>A specific numerical expansion of the four-letter Name of God</note> and the Name of Isaac...
