# Gate 5

The secret of the **Middle Measure** <note>The "Middle Measure" refers to the Sefirah of *Tiferet* (Beauty/Harmony), which balances the extremes of the divine attributes.</note> is like the twin-leaves of the palm branch (*Lulav*) which sustains two sides in the center. In this way, **Jacob** sustains the two "tents," which are the Tent of Abraham—representing **Lovingkindness** (*Chesed*)—and the Tent of Isaac—representing **Judgment** (*Din*). This is the secret of the verse: *And Jacob was a simple man, dwelling in tents* <note>Genesis 25:27</note>. For why was it necessary for the verse to say "dwelling in tents" [in the plural]? It should have said "dwelling in a tent." Rather, it teaches that the attribute of Jacob stands between two tents, sustaining and grasping both the Right and the Left through the Middle Measure. Thus, we find Abraham and Isaac both grasped by Jacob: Abraham on Jacob's right, and Isaac on Jacob's left. This is the secret of the "Third Script" that decides between them—between the attribute of *El* <note>A name of God associated with mercy and expansive love.</note>, which is Lovingkindness, and the attribute of *Elohim*, which is Judgment.

You therefore learn that the Great Name **Y-H-W-H** <note>The Tetragrammaton, the four-letter Name of God, representing the attribute of Mercy/Tiferet.</note>, may He be blessed, who stands in the center, includes both Lovingkindness and Judgment. This is what they meant in the *Chapters of the Palaces* <note>original: *Pirkei Heikhalot*; a seminal work of early Jewish mysticism describing the ascent to the divine realm.</note>: "On His right is life, and on His left is death." Once you know this, we must inform you that from here you will understand how all the Names, all the epithets, and all the attributes are attached to the Name Y-H-W-H, may He be blessed. This is what was said in the *Book of Creation* <note>original: *Sefer Yetzirah*; an ancient foundational text of Kabbalah.</note>: "The Holy Palace is aligned in the center." This is the secret of the Name Y-H-W-H, which is in the center of all Names—whether from above, from below, or from the side. This is the secret of the verse: *I saw the Lord sitting on His throne* <note>Isaiah 6:1</note>, amidst all the Names and epithets, performing His actions.

According to the action that needs to be performed, He "clothes" Himself in the Name or epithet appropriate for that action. Keep this principle always in your heart: for behold, you find Y-H-W-H sometimes called "Merciful" and sometimes called "Jealous and Vengeful," "Master of Wrath," and "Man of War," as it says: *A jealous and vengeful God is Y-H-W-H, and a master of wrath* <note>Nahum 1:2</note>, and it says *Y-H-W-H is a man of war* <note>Exodus 15:3</note>. Now, if He is entirely Mercy, how is it possible to say of Him these difficult epithets of Judgment? Rather, it is through that "side of Judgment" which we said is mixed with the attribute of Mercy. These epithets of Judgment attach to it, and according to the appropriate measure, the epithets attach to Him and He clothes Himself in them. Thus, the Name Y-H-W-H is found to be inclusive and perfected in all of them by clothing Himself in the garment appropriate for each matter. Keep this principle, and through it you will see that the Blessed Name does not change—as it says: *I, the Lord, have not changed* <note>Malachi 3:6</note>. Instead, the change is according to the necessary Judgment; He clothes Himself in the epithets appropriate to complete the Judgment, whether for good or for ill. Keep this very, very great principle, and you will see the greatness of His blessedness and the power of His Kingdom.

Now that we have informed you of these great rules, we must return to explain what we began to clarify in this gate. We have already explained that from the **Crown** (*Keter*) and downward, there is no "Simple Attribute" that is not mixed with its companion. This is because the **Emanation** (*Atzilut*) of **Wisdom** (*Chokhmah*), which was drawn out from the Crown, necessitated all opposites and all mixtures, and the entire path of Emanation and the connection of the **Chariots** (*Merkavot*). For Wisdom is adjacent to the Crown and to **Understanding** (*Binah*). Since it sits between two Sefirot, it has a "Front" and a "Back." The Front faces the Crown, and the Back faces Understanding. Since it possesses a Front and a Back, it is the cause of all opposites, changes, and all the mixtures in the world. From here were born every "Front" and "Back," every "White" and "Black," "Right" and "Left," and "Above" and "Below." This is one of the deep secrets regarding the connections of the Chariot and the Emanation of Existences.

# Gate 5

Even a **completely righteous man** <note>original: *tzaddik gamur*</note> was liable to that punishment. This is the secret of the verse: *The sons of God came to present themselves before Y-H-W-H, and the Accuser also came among them* <note>Job 1:6. The "Accuser" refers to Satan, acting here as a celestial prosecutor.</note>. There is no permission to reveal more than this at this time. 

Now, the "young lions" <note>original: *kefirim*; here representing destructive spiritual forces or prosecutors</note> act as accusers below against man; they ascend above and say, "So-and-so has committed this transgression; hand him over to us, for he belongs to us." Thus, the **Attribute of Elohim** <note>The divine name associated with strict justice and the "Left" side of the divine emanations.</note> on the left does not hinder them, for it indeed teaches their liability. Who, then, hinders them? The **Attribute of El** <note>The divine name associated with expansive mercy and the "Right" side.</note>, which teaches merit, as we stated above. Therefore, the "young lions" hasten their claims and roar for prey, *seeking their food from El* <note>Psalm 104:21. The text interprets this literally: they "seek" their permission to consume/punish from the attribute that holds them back.</note>, because He is the one who restrains them.

Now that we have informed you of these great principles, it is proper for us to explain the meaning of the **connotations** <note>original: *kinnuyim*; epithets or descriptive titles of God (e.g., "Gracious," "Mighty")</note> that are attached to the three Names mentioned above. This is to show you how the connotations of the Attribute of **El** involve the Attribute of **Judgment** mixed with their **Lovingkindness**, and how the connotations of **Elohim** involve the Attribute of **Mercy** mixed with their **Judgment**. Likewise, it is proper to inform you of the measure of this mixture in every single connotation, and how they are interwoven and bound one to another.

Before we enter into this explanation, we must inform you of what we said regarding the explanation of the **Chariot** <note>original: *Merkavah*; the divine realm or the "vehicle" through which God's presence interacts with the world.</note>: that while they are called "Eye" or "Ear" or "Nose" or "Foot," they are not literal eyes, ears, or feet. Rather, these are connotations and hints. So too, you must know that in the Chariot above there are matters called **Water** (W), **Fire** (F), **Wind** (W), and **Earth** (E). God forbid <note>original: *chalilah chalilah*</note> that one should think these are water, fire, wind, or earth like our own! Rather, they are awesome, supernal "paths" named according to their attributes. They use these names but are not like these physical elements. 

This is what **Rabbi Akiva** <note>A foundational sage of the 1st-2nd century CE and a central figure in Jewish mystical tradition.</note> said to his students: "When you arrive at the stones of **pure marble** <note>original: *avnei shayish tahor*</note>, do not say 'Water! Water!', for it is said: *He who speaks lies shall not be established before my eyes*" <note>Psalm 101:7. This refers to a famous passage in the Talmud (Hagigah 14b) warning mystics that the brilliant spiritual light of the upper realms can be mistaken for water, but to call it "water" is a falsehood because it is non-physical.</note>. In the *Chapters of the Palaces* <note>original: *Pirkei Heikhalot*</note> this matter is explained further: they say there is a specific Palace above, and when those ascending to the Chariot who are not worthy reach it, great matters appear to them within that Palace. Such a person deceives himself in his mind into thinking they are water, and he asks: "What is the nature of this water?" Immediately, a voice goes out from above and proclaims that this man is from the "family of the deceivers," and he is immediately punished. 

Therefore, contemplate how they revealed that there is no literal water there. From this, you may understand the other matters—Fire and Wind. As it is said: *He makes His angels winds, His ministers a flaming fire* <note>Psalm 104:4</note>. Do not let it enter your mind that they are fire or wind like these physical ones; rather, they are named based on the secret of their attributes. 

Now that we have informed you of this, we must return to inform you of the secret of all the connotations derived from the secret of these three Names: **El**, **Elohim**, and **Y-H-W-H**.
*   The foundation of **Water** is included in the attribute of **El**.
*   The foundation of **Fire** is included in the attribute of **Elohim**.
*   The foundation of **Wind** <note>or "Spirit"; original: *Ruach*</note> is included in the Name **Y-H-W-H**, may He be blessed.
*   The foundation of **Earth** is included in the attribute called **Adonai** <note>The name of God associated with the Sefirah of *Malkhut* (Kingship), the most "grounded" of the emanations.</note>. 

And behold, I am informing you of a great secret: the foundations are four, but the divisions are three. How so? **Fire**, **Wind**, and **Water** are included in the attributes of **Elohim**, **El**, and **Y-H-W-H**. You will find Fire on one side, Water on the other, and Wind in the middle.

<meta>This page continues the discussion of the divine attributes, moving from the internal unity of the "Right" and "Left" sides of the Godhead to the external forces of judgment and the "Other Side." # Gate 5

Do not think in your mind that the forces of the Right <term>The "Right" represents the attribute of Mercy (Chesed)</term> and the Left <term>The "Left" represents the attribute of Justice or Severity (Gevurah)</term> above disagree with one another, or hate one another, or contradict one another—Heaven forbid! <gloss>(a) When you see them appearing to disagree: Meaning, when you see from the verses hinted at that these forces and attributes disagree; for this is one of the ways of the "Great Unity," as I wrote at the end of Gate 4 regarding the matter of Holiness.</gloss> Rather, when you see them appearing to disagree, they are merely deliberating in judgment to bring the justice of the world's inhabitants to light through a judgment of truth. They are included in the attributes of Mercy and Judgment, and the secret is: *And the two of them went together* <note>Genesis 22:6, describing Abraham and Isaac at the Binding—a classic symbol of Mercy and Justice walking in harmony.</note> and the secret of *The judgments of the Lord are true; they are righteous together* <note>Psalm 19:10</note>, meaning that all have one intention. For they are all in agreement with a single consensus, which is to cling to the Name Y-H-W-H, may He be blessed. This is what the Sages of blessed memory meant when they said: "Above there is neither envy, nor hatred, nor competition."

If so, what is the meaning of those who stand on the Right and find merit, and those who stand on the Left and find liability? Know that all of this is to bring justice to light and so that every creature receives its proper judgment. But the forces of the Right and the Left above are as one in their clinging to the Name Y-H-W-H, may He be blessed. All these forces, whether of the Right or the Left, love one another. This is why the Sages instituted in the blessing of the "Creator of the Lights" <note>The *Yotzer Or* blessing from the daily morning prayer service.</note>: *All of them are beloved, all are pure, all are mighty, all perform with awe the will of their Creator.*

Contemplate this very deeply and you will see what I have explained. Do you not see that all the holy ones intend to complete their task together? For this is one of the ways of the Great Unity <term>The Great Unity: The Kabbalistic concept that all seemingly diverse divine attributes are actually parts of a single, unified essence.</term>. Therefore, they said in the *Yotzer* blessing: *And they all accept the yoke of the Kingdom of Heaven from one another, and give permission to one another in love to sanctify their Creator with tranquility.* And they all answer as one with awe. And how do they answer? The camps of the Right say "Holy," and the camps of the Left say "Blessed." And these and those together say "He shall reign." Those who merit to understand this secret will understand how they are all in agreement in the unity of the Name, may He be blessed.

All that we have said applies to what is "inside the line," <note>Referring to the inner, holy dimensions of the divine realm.</note> which is the secret of the walls of the Upper Sanctuary. But from the walls and outward, there are (b) evil camps on the side of the Left, and they are not "above" but "below." <gloss>(b) There are evil camps: I have already explained this entire matter in Gate 8 under the nickname "Nature" and in Gate 3 under the nickname "Good," and also regarding the disagreement concerning prayers.</gloss> And the head of all these evil forces is **Samael** <note>The primary figure of evil or the Accuser in Jewish tradition.</note>. These are all masters of strife and hatred. They are not among the members of the King’s courtyard, but reside outside the three partitions and outside the nations surrounding the camp—*every leper, everyone with a discharge, and everyone defiled by a corpse* <note>Numbers 5:2; here used allegorically to describe spiritual impurities cast out from the divine center.</note>. Three camps are mentioned in this portion. (c) And it is not according to this matter now <gloss>(c) "Not according to this matter now": The intention of the whole matter is to say: outside all the levels of holiness—from the palaces downward, such as the Holy Living Creatures and the four camps of the Divine Presence (Shekhinah) and all the levels I explained above in Gate 2—these are the accusers who lie in wait for when they can enter within to snatch the good bounty through sin.</gloss> and it says further: *That they defile not their camps, in the midst whereof I dwell* [Numbers 5:3].

These are the "young lions" that *roar for prey* <note>Psalm 104:21</note>. Regarding whom did the scripture say *that they defile not*? Surely it speaks of those who are outside the line, waiting for when humans stumble through sin and impurity so they can accuse them above. Then the judgment might go forth that they be handed over into the hands of these accusers. Those who know this matter understand how much one should be careful of transgressions. # Gate 5 [Page 64]

It is [divided] into three parts. And why are they four? Likewise, the division of the letters of the Great Name, which are three <note>The letters Yod, Heh, and Vav, as the letter Heh is repeated.</note> and their total is four. Know that the division of the letters of the Name, may He be blessed, is "three that are four." Similarly, the division of the elements is "three that are four." The reason is that the division of the elements is essentially three: Water against Fire, and Air <note>original: *Ruach*, meaning wind or spirit</note> mediates between them. The Earth is the receptacle for all three.

As one of these three elements prevails within the Earth, so is the action performed within the Earth. Likewise, the three letters Y-H-W of the Name, may He be blessed, correspond to the Names *El*, *Y-H-W-H*, and *Elohim*. *El* <term>the attribute of Mercy</term> stands against *Elohim* <term>the attribute of Justice</term>. The Name Y-H-W-H <term>the attribute of Compassion</term> mediates between them. *Adonai* <note>original: אדנ"י</note>, which is the final attribute, is the receptacle for these three Names. As one of these three names prevails, <margin>Severity</margin> so is the action performed through *Adonai*.

How so? If the attribute of Lovingkindness <note>original: *Chesed*, associated with the Name *El*</note> prevails over any person in the world, the attribute of *Adonai* completes that action and bestows good upon those whom the law empowers, as we stated above. But if the attribute of Judgment <note>original: *Din*, associated with the Name *Elohim*</note> prevails, it completes the action and punishes those deserving of punishment according to the law. This is the secret of the verse: *The man, the lord of the land, spoke* <note>Genesis 42:30. The word for "Lord" here is *Adonei*, the same root as the divine Name discussed.</note>.

When you understand this, you will understand the secret of the Supreme Crown <note>original: *Keter Elyon*</note> called *Ehyeh* <note>meaning "I Will Be"</note>, which is entirely mercy; it bestows and does not receive. You will also understand the secret of *Adonai*, which is the final Sefirah <term>an emanation or "sphere" of divine light</term>, which is entirely judgment; it receives and does not bestow <note>meaning it does not originate its own light, but reflects what it receives</note>. I must enlighten your eyes in these matters, for they are closed and sealed. I am hinting at them here in writing, but I will complete all these matters for you through oral tradition <note>original: *Kabbalah*</note>, God willing.

The secret of the final Sefirah is that it receives and does not bestow within its own kind <gloss>meaning, like channels</gloss>, but it bestows upon everything that is below it. (a) For this reason, it is called *Adonai*. As for what I told you—that it is entirely judgment—this is from the perspective of its true essence. However, when it is filled by the Sefirot above it, it reflects that filling: if Kindness, then Kindness; if Judgment, then Judgment; if Mercy, then Mercy. Understand this very well.

I have now informed you in brief outlines how the attribute of *Adonai* is filled by the three Names and how it acts upon created beings according to the law. In this way, you will understand that as water, fire, or air transform within the earth, (b) so the earth acts according to their strength.

Since I have informed you of this great principle, you can now understand why *Adonai* is the "Gateway for Prayers," and why it is called the "Lower Court of Law," and why it "strikes and heals, kills and brings to life." You should study and understand all we explained in the First Gate, which is the Gate of *Adonai*. When you combine the matters we explained there with the matters explained here, then your eyes will see and your heart will rejoice. (c). You will understand why it is called "Lord of the World" or "Earth" or the other names we wrote in the First Gate.

# Gate 5

...over the face of the deep, and the spirit of God hovered over the face of the waters <note>Genesis 1:2</note>. And who is the "receptacle" <note>original: *beit kabul*, a vessel or container</note> for these three? It is the Earth. As it is written: "And the earth was unformed and void..." <note>Genesis 1:2</note>. Likewise, the receptacle for these three Names—*El*, *Elohim*, and *Y-H-W-H*—is the Name *Adonai* <term>Lordship</term>. For all the decrees judged in the Heavenly Court of *El*, *Elohim*, and *Y-H-W-H* are handed over to the hand of *Adonai* to be finalized. Therefore, you will find that *Adonai* completes all the judgments that are decreed above within the lower world.

This is the order of the oral tradition regarding the descriptive titles <note>original: *kinuyim*</note> for those who know the truth of His Great Name, may He be blessed.

# Gate 5

But the Tree of Life was not withheld from the First Man <note>original: *Adam HaRishon*</note> at first. However, after the First Man sinned and "cut the shoots" <note>original: *katzatz bi-netiyot*, a Talmudic idiom for causing a rift in the divine unity through heresy or improper mystical practice</note> and separated the Master <note>original: *aluf*, referring to the "Master of the World" or the unity of the Godhead</note>, they did not allow him to approach the Tree of Life. Because he sinned, he was pushed back; for the Tree of Life cannot be attained except through the Tree of Knowledge. This is because the Tree of Knowledge is the gatehouse through which one enters the Tree of Life. For the secret of the Tree of Knowledge is:
(A) It is the tree of the Sefirah of *Da'at* <term>the attribute of Knowledge</term>, which is the Middle Pillar. Just as the Tree of Life is the tree of *Binah* <term>the attribute of Understanding</term>, so too *Malchut* <term>the attribute of Kingship</term> is the tree of Knowledge. This is symbolized by the letters *He*, *Vav*, *He*: the secret of the first *He* is Life; the secret of the *Vav* is the Tree of Life; the secret of the final *He* is the Tree of Knowledge.
(B) This secret is the "bond of unity" for those who know the mysteries of Emanation. Therefore, guard this matter carefully. You will find that after the First Man sinned with the Tree of Knowledge, the destruction <note>original: *ha-shod*</note> occurred, and the Tree of Life was withheld from him. This is the secret of the verse: "Behold, the man has become as one of us, to know good and evil; and now, lest he put forth his hand, and take also of the tree of life" <note>Genesis 3:22</note>. Therefore, the Lord God sent him forth from the Garden of Eden.

Know that this Sefirah is called the **Written Torah**, because Moses our Teacher—peace be upon him—alone merited to approach the Great Name called *Y-H-W-H*. This is the secret of "And Moses alone shall come near unto the Lord" <note>Exodus 24:2</note> and "there has not arisen a prophet since in Israel like Moses, whom the Lord knew face to face" <note>Deuteronomy 34:10</note>. Therefore, it was said of him: "With him I speak mouth to mouth, even manifestly, and not in dark speeches" <note>Numbers 12:8</note>. Because Moses our Teacher, peace be upon him, gazed through the "Lucid Mirror" <term>original: *Aspaklaria ha-Me'irah*, a clear lens or looking glass</term>, he entered within the final *He* to attain the Middle Pillar; this is the meaning of "manifestly and not in dark speeches."

But all the other prophets only prophesied through *Netzach* and *Hod* <term>the attributes of Victory and Splendor</term>. The final *He* of the Name hindered them and guarded the gate so they could not enter. They would look from behind it. Therefore, all their prophecy

<meta>This page continues the exploration of the Garden of Eden’s layout as a map of the divine attributes (Sefirot). Having established that the Tree of Knowledge serves as the gateway, the author now focuses on the "Middle Pillar," symbolized by the letter Vav in the Name of God, which connects the highest source of life to the physical world.</meta>

# Gate 5

In this Gate, all the orders of the Divine Chariot <term>Merkavah; the structure of the divine realm</term> and all the Holy Names take hold—whether from above, from below, or from the sides—as we have already guided you. Within it, all the Sefirot <term>divine emanations or attributes</term> are anchored, because it stands in the middle, inclines toward every side, and unites with them all, just as they all unite within it. This is what is meant in the *Book of Formation* <note>original: *Sefer Yetzirah*, an ancient foundational text of Jewish mysticism</note> when it says: "The Holy Palace is positioned exactly in the middle." The meaning of the "Middle Pillar" is the mystery of the Name YHVH <note>original: יה"וה</note>, blessed be He; it stands in the place of the Name and is like the likeness of a line <note>original: *kav*</note> within a palm. This Name extends upward to the Infinite <note>original: *Ein Sof*</note> and the end, returning to be anchored in the Name *Ehyeh* <note>original: אה"יה; "I Will Be"</note>, corresponding to the mystery of the uppermost point <note>the tip of the letter Yod</note>. It then returns to be unified below in the Name *Adonai* <note>original: אד"ני; "My Lord"</note>, after which it spreads to the sides, and all sides take hold of it from every direction.

Thus you learn that the letter *Vav* of the Name YHVH stands in place of the entire complete Name, and all Names are anchored in it. For those who know the mystery of the Divine Chariot, it becomes clear that when that *Vav* of the Name extends from every side, it is said of it: **(A)** *"I have taken off my robe"* <note>original: פשטתי את כתנתי; Song of Songs 5:3</note>; this refers to its unique union with the final *He* of the Name. This is the mystery of the Middle Pillar in every place. Behold, the head of the letter *Vav* at the top supports the mystery of **Crown, Wisdom, and Understanding** <note>original: *Keter, Chokhmah, Binah*</note>. Its middle supports the mystery of **Greatness, Strength, and Beauty** <note>original: *Gedulah, Gevurah, Tiferet*</note>. Its lower part supports **Endurance, Glory, and Foundation** <note>original: *Netzach, Hod, Yesod*</note>. The mnemonic for this is: "with lower, second, and third stories you shall make it" <note>original: Genesis 6:16. The Hebrew mnemonic letters used here, *CH-CH-Y-M*, refer to the groupings of these attributes</note>.

The final *He* of the Name remains unified with the letter *Vav* as we have said. This is the mystery of why the *Vav* of the Name is called the "Middle Pillar" and stands in the place of YHVH. This is also the secret of the letter *Vav* in the name of Jacob, and the secret of the phrase "the God of Jacob." This is the Sefirah called the **Tree of Life**, meaning the tree in which the Sefirah of Understanding—which is called "Life"—is unified. This is the mystery of the "Upper Unity" among the three highest Sefirot. Therefore, it stands "in the midst of the garden" **(B)**, which the Translation of Onkelos <note>the standard Aramaic translation of the Torah</note> renders as "in the center of the garden," which is the Middle Pillar as we explained. Through this tree, Understanding <note>*Binah*</note> is unified with Kingdom <note>*Malchut*</note>. For the two *He*s of the Unique Name are unified in the Middle Pillar, one from above and one from below. The upper one is called "Life" and is the secret of the "Life of the World to Come," and it is the secret of the phrase "He swore by the Life of the World." However, "Life of the Worlds" <note>plural</note> refers to the attribute of Foundation <note>*Yesod*</note>, which draws the "Life" of the Tree of Life from Understanding. All these are drawn from the Middle Pillar, which is the trunk of the tree, until they reach the attribute of Foundation **(C)**, and then it is called the "Life of the Worlds."

If so, consider that the Holy One did not warn the First Man <note>Adam</note> not to eat from the Tree of Life, nor did He prevent him from it at first—for when would he have eaten? Rather, He prevented him from eating from the Tree of Knowledge because many external "husks" <term>clippot; forces of impurity or imbalance</term> take hold of it **(D)**, which would cause "cutting and separation" <note>a rift in the divine unity</note>.

The Sefirah above is the mystery of the letter *Vav* of the Name, and the Name in its "preceding number" <term>a method of gematria</term> equals the word "Line" <note>original: *Kav* = 106</note>. Thus it is said to be in the likeness of a line. **(A)** *"I have taken off my robe"* hints at the upper Sefirot, for Beauty <note>*Tiferet*</note> desires to unite with Understanding <note>*Binah*</note>. This is the Upper Unity. It must also begin with Kingdom <note>*Malchut*</note> in the mystery of the five lower Sefirot, as explained at the end of this Gate and the start of Gate 9, regarding the two chapters of Unity and Connection. The two *He*s mentioned refer to the attributes of Understanding and Kingdom. <meta>This page continues the discussion of the "Middle Pillar" in the divine structure, specifically identifying it with the attribute of Truth and the Sefirah of Tiferet. It explains how this central force balances the polarities of Mercy (Right) and Judgment (Left).</meta>

# Gate 5

And when the judgment is concluded, it is finalized by these three: those on the right and those on the left present the arguments, and He is the one who decides the law, standing in the middle. Therefore, "Truth" <note>original: *Emet* (אמ"ת)</note> is written upon His seal, to inform you that all the hosts of letters—from *Aleph* to *Mem*, which is the middle—turned to his merit on the right side (the merit of the letters). Those letters from *Mem* until the *Tav* turned to his liability on the left. When both these and those finished teaching merit or liability, the judgment was concluded with ultimate precision and perfection.

As I have told you: *Aleph* is on the right, *YHVH* is in the middle, and *Elohim* is on the left. So you will find the letter *Aleph* with all its hosts on the right, *Mem* in the middle, and from it until *Tav*, etc., the *Tav* with all its hosts is on the left. All the hosts of the Heavenly Court included in the mystery of the letters deliberated in the judgment. When the judgment was finished, it was concluded by the three groups called "Truth" <note>spelled *Aleph-Mem-Tav*, representing the beginning, middle, and end of the alphabet</note>. Therefore they said: "The seal of the Holy One, Blessed be He, is *YHVH* Truth." And this is the meaning of: *"The judgments of YHVH are true"* <note>Psalm 19:10</note>. 

Because "Truth" is the mystery of the Middle Pillar, it was given to Jacob, who stands in the middle, and the mystery is: *"You give truth to Jacob"* <note>Micah 7:20</note>. How so? Abraham, who is Loving-kindness <term>Hesed; the attribute of expansive benevolence</term>, is to the right. Isaac, who is Fear <term>Pachad; the attribute of restrictive justice and awe</term>, is to the left. Jacob, who is Truth, is in the middle. Regarding this it is said, *"Execute a judgment of truth,"* meaning that three must be involved in the judgment, for a court of only two is considered "insolent" <note>a legal principle from the Talmud stating that a minimum of three judges is required for a valid, respectful court</note>. Behold, it is explained to you that wherever you find "Truth" <note>*Emet*</note>, the intention is for the middle attribute that includes all faces and all sides.

Similarly, you will find the Written Torah, which is the mystery of the Middle Pillar, and it is comprised of the Right and the Left as we have informed you; it too is called "Truth." This is the meaning of: *"The Torah of truth was in his mouth"* <note>Malachi 2:6</note>. Thus you have learned that the attribute of Truth is the middle attribute and includes everything. For this reason, He, *YHVH* blessed be He, is called by this name. And this is the Sefirah that is also called:

## Beauty
<note>original: *Tiferet*</note>

You must know the meaning of "Beauty" <note>*Tiferet*</note>. We have already informed you that the name *YHVH*, blessed be He, is the body of the Tree <note>referring to the Tree of the Sefirot</note>. In it is the root, and in it everything is unified. The branches from here and from there unite within it, and He, blessed be He, acts in all and rules over all. When He judges His creatures and acts within them according to the uprightness of His judgment, we have already informed you that He clothes Himself in a garment appropriate for that action. If He clothes Himself in a garment of Loving-kindness <note>*Hesed*</note>, the judgment emerges to benefit the creatures, as we informed you in this Gate. Therefore, He is called by every specific name and every title according to what the hour requires. All those garments and titles are called **Beauty**.

Do you not see that it is written:

In this way, open your eyes and see why the letter *Vav*, the Middle Pillar which is the Name *YHVH* blessed be He, is called **Beauty** <note>*Tiferet*</note>. It is because it includes everything, rules over everything, and clothes itself in all the Names according to what it sees the hour requires. Those garments are called **Beauty**, which is something no other Sefirah is able to do...

When the Name [God] judges His creatures, the forces of the right argue for merit and the forces of the left argue for liability, as we have informed you.

Meanwhile, Greatness <term>Chesed</term> and Might <term>Gevurah</term> remain below in their places and do not ascend higher than their station. # Gate 1

Unto the **Infinite** <term>Ein Sof; the primordial, boundless state of God before any emanation</term>, and behold, you will find all the **seventy princes** <note>In Jewish thought, these are the celestial representatives of the seventy root nations of the world</note> surrounding **Greatness** <term>Gedulah; another name for the attribute of Mercy or Chesed</term> and **Power** <term>Gevurah; the attribute of Judgment</term>. And just as Greatness and Power do not ascend from their place upward, so too the seventy princes of the nations cannot ascend from the place to which they are attached. But **Israel** is attached to the **middle line** <term>Kav Ha-Emtza’i; the central axis of the Sefirotic tree that balances right and left</term>, as we have made known. And just as the middle line ascends until the Infinite, so too Israel, who cling to it, ascend until the Infinite. 

And this is the secret of the verse: *“and your enemies shall wither before you”* <note>original: "ויכחשו אויביך לך" - Deuteronomy 33:29</note>. Moses, our teacher (peace be upon him), brings good tidings to Israel, saying: *“and your enemies shall wither before you, and you shall tread upon their high places.”* This means that even though all the nations may ascend, there is a limit and an end to their ascent, for they cannot rise higher than the places to which they are attached—which are Greatness and Power. But Israel, who are attached to the middle line, which is **Knowledge** <term>Da'at</term>, and it is the **Appearance of the Lord** <note>original: "הרע"ח" - likely a shorthand for "Mar'eh Kohen" or a similar mystical designation of the divine image</note>—just as the middle line ascends to the Infinite, so those who cling to it ascend with it to the Infinite. 

This is the secret of: *“And you shall tread upon their high places,”* and the secret of: *“Israel, in whom I will be glorified”* <note>original: "ישראל אשר בך אתפא"ר" - Isaiah 49:3</note>. That is to say, just as **Beauty** <term>Tiferet; also meaning Glory/Splendor</term> ascends upward to the Infinite and clothes itself in the garments of the **Crown** <term>Keter</term> and is glorified by them, so too Israel, who cling to Beauty, ascend with it. This is the secret of *“Israel, in whom I will be glorified.”* 

But if, Heaven forbid, Israel should sin and become distant from **Knowledge** <term>Da'at</term>, which is the middle line—when they sin, they have no ascent and are handed over into the power of the seventy princes, and immediately to the nations of the world in exile. This is the secret of: *“Therefore my people have gone into captivity for lack of knowledge”* <note>Isaiah 5:13</note>. This means that when they separated from Knowledge—which ascends to the Infinite—they fell into the hand of the princes of the nations. And this is the secret of: *“Because you have rejected knowledge, I will also reject you from being a priest to Me; seeing you have forgotten the law of your God, I will also forget your children”* <note>Hosea 4:6</note>. 

Behold, here is the resolution to the difficulty I raised: how can **Knowledge** be the third between **Wisdom** <term>Chokhmah</term> and **Understanding** <term>Binah</term> when it is not positioned between **Greatness** and **Power**? I will answer this difficulty with the help of God. Know that if Knowledge only ascended to the boundary of Greatness and Power and no further, we would have to say it only balances between them and is not a "third" to Wisdom and Understanding. But since Knowledge is the middle line, and it ascends from below to the end of all levels until the Infinite, Knowledge is indeed the third and the decider between all the Sefirot, both upper and lower. 

How so? Behold, the middle line, which is Knowledge, ascends to the Infinite, which is the **Crown**. If so, it is found to be the middle between **Wisdom** and **Understanding**, which are close to the Crown. And when the middle line is between Greatness and Power, it is the middle between them. It is that which connects all the Sefirot from top to bottom and from the sides. And behold, I am drawing for you a form from which you will understand the matter.

# Gate 5

**Jacob**, who represents the **Middle Line** <term>Kav Ha-Emtza’i; the central pillar of the Sefirotic tree that balances Mercy and Judgment</term>, ascends alone to the **Crown** <term>Keter; the highest emanation, representing the Divine Will</term>, a place where the celestial Princes do not ascend. Thus, the inheritance of Jacob has no **boundaries** <note>original: "מצרים" (meitzarim). This is a wordplay on "Mitzrayim" (Egypt), suggesting that Jacob's spiritual reach is not confined by "narrow places" or limitations.</note>. He breaks through all boundaries, for while all the Princes ascend only as far as the Right and Left—corresponding to **Abraham** and **Isaac**—Jacob, being in the middle, ascends alone to the Crown, even unto the **Infinite** <term>Ein Sof</term>. This is an inheritance without boundaries. Consequently, all the Princes and their dominions remain below the inheritance of Jacob. 

The Prophet explained this great secret when he said: *"Then you shall delight in the Lord, and I will cause you to ride upon the high places of the earth, and I will feed you the heritage of Jacob your father..."* <note>Isaiah 58:14</note>. The meaning of the verse is this: You, the House of Israel, are destined to inherit the **Upper Eden**, which is **Understanding** <term>Binah</term>, and from there and upward—the place where there are no boundaries and which is called **Rehovot** <note>original: "רחובות" (Broad Places). In Kabbalah, this refers to the expansive nature of the higher Sefirot.</note>. 

*"And I will cause you to ride upon the high places of the earth"*—these are the Princes of the nations who only ascend to the "high places of the earth," which is the level of **Greatness** <term>Gedulah/Chesed</term> and **Power** <term>Gevurah</term> where Abraham and Isaac stand. But you shall "ride upon them," meaning you shall ascend higher than Greatness and Power, reaching the place of Understanding to cling to the Crown. 

*"And I will feed you the heritage of Jacob your father"*—specifically the heritage of Jacob, and not the heritage of Abraham or Isaac. This is because the heritage of Jacob is that which ascends above all the Princes of the nations, as we have said, and it is an inheritance that has no boundaries. Therefore, contemplate the secret of the heritage of Abraham and Isaac versus the secret of the heritage of Jacob, and you will then grasp the wonders of the Lord, blessed be He.

From these principles we have made known to you, you should contemplate the secret of **Knowledge** <term>Da'at</term>. This is the Sefira that includes all the Sefirot; it is the root and the spring that has no end or limit. Because the Sefira of Knowledge begins from the **Kingdom** <term>Malchut; the lowest Sefira</term> and reaches until the **Infinite**, it has two descriptions in the Torah. 

The description that begins from the Kingdom—whose secret name is **Lord** <note>original: "אד'ני" (Adonai)</note>—is the secret of the **Tree of Knowledge** <note>Etz Ha-Da'at</note>, for the attribute of Kingdom is the secret of the Tree that Knowledge sustains. The second description, which reaches the Infinite, is the secret of the verse: *"Knowledge is too wonderful for me; it is high, I cannot attain it"* <note>Psalm 139:6</note>. This means that although the Sefira of Knowledge is found within all the Sefirot, both above and below, it nevertheless rises until the Infinite—which is the secret of the Crown—having no end or limit. No created being can extend themselves to the end of its depth, for it has no end or limit above. This is why it is said, *"it is high, I cannot attain it."*

Contemplate, then, the secret of the Sefira of Knowledge. Since you have entered these chambers, we must inform you that just as Abraham and Isaac were parts of the **Chariot** <term>Merkavah; the divine structure through which God interacts with the world</term> aligned with the Right and the Left, so too is Jacob aligned with the Middle Line, which is the secret of the name **YHWH** <note>The Tetragrammaton, the four-letter name of God</note>, standing in the center. Just as the name YHWH is centered against all sides, and all the holy names and titles attach to it and are unified in it—from below, from above, and from the sides—so too is Jacob. His **twelve tribes**, which are the secret of the **twelve diagonal boundaries** <note>original: "י"ב גבולי אלכסון" (12 gevulei alachson). A concept from the Sefer Yetzirah describing the primary axes of the universe.</note>, are attached to the name YHWH. 

The secret is written in the Torah: *"He set the boundaries of the peoples according to the number of the children of Israel"* <note>Deuteronomy 32:8</note>. Therefore, you will find in Israel the secret of the entire Chariot, just as the name YHWH carries the entire Chariot. How so? The name YHWH stands between the name **El** <note>associated with Mercy/Right</note> and the name **Elohim** <note>associated with Judgment/Left</note>, and in these three, everything is attached from here and from there. So too in Israel there are three qualities corresponding to these: **Priest**, **Levite**, and **Israelite**. The Priest <note>Kohen</note> corresponds to El; the Levite <note>Levi</note> corresponds to Elohim; and the Israelite <note>Yisrael</note> is dedicated to YHWH in the middle. Do you not see that the form of Jacob’s Chariot is made in the image of the Upper Chariot? Just as all names and titles are attached to the name YHWH, so the entire form of the Patriarchs is included in Jacob and his sons.

# Gate 5

<margin>Firstfruits</margin> And even though <note>original: "ואע"פ"</note> these matters are deeper still: When the body of the First Man <term>Adam Ha-Rishon; the primordial human soul</term> was made, it was formed amidst the sourness <note>original: "chometz" (vinegar/leavening). A metaphor for the harsh, acidic forces of the "Other Side" or impurity.</note> of the demons and the powers of impurity. That "filth" <term>Zohama; the spiritual residue or "slime" of the primordial serpent</term> did not separate from the body of Adam until it was refined little by little through the righteous of the generations—much like silver that one refines inside a furnace.

**Seth** came and refined it a little, as it is said: *"And he begot [a son] in his own likeness, after his image; and called his name Seth"* <note>Genesis 5:3</note>. **Enoch** came and refined a little of that filth, as it is said: *"And Enoch walked with God"* <note>Genesis 5:22</note>. **Noah** came and refined it further, as it is said: *"Noah walked with God"* <note>Genesis 6:9</note>. **Shem** came and refined it more, as it is said: *"And he shall dwell in the tents of Shem"* <note>Genesis 9:27</note>. **Abraham** came <gloss>Meaning: they entered and rested [upon him]</gloss> and refined it further <gloss>Plainly: His whole self was upon the altar</gloss>; nevertheless, a bit of filth emerged from him in the form of **Ishmael**. **Isaac** came and refined it more, yet even from him a bit of filth emerged in the form of **Esau**. 

But **Jacob** was found to be entirely refined and pure; there is no refuse <note>original: "psollet"; the dross or waste-product of the refining process.</note> in him. Thus, Jacob is the perfect form of the First Man as he was before Adam sinned. Therefore, Israel is called the *"Firstfruits of the increase"* of YHVH, may He be blessed, and they are called <margin>Firstfruits</margin> "Firstborn," for they are the beginning of the creation. It is found that Jacob, peace be upon him, is the complete form who has no refuse in him at all, unlike Abraham and Isaac who had some refuse—as with Abraham, from whom Ishmael emerged, and Isaac, from whom <margin>139a</margin> Esau emerged. 

For this reason, when Jacob was about to depart from the world, he said to his sons: "Perhaps there is refuse among you, as there was with Abraham and Isaac?" They all answered and said: *"Hear, O Israel, the LORD our God, the LORD is One"* <note>Deuteronomy 6:4</note>. Just as there is only One in your heart, so too there is only One in our hearts. Thus we learn that Jacob and his sons were all "fit seed" <note>original: "zera kasher"; spiritually viable and pure.</note> with no refuse among them, whereas Abraham and Isaac did have refuse, which is why Ishmael and Esau emerged. 

In that small bit of refuse that was in Abraham and Isaac, the demons "took hold" all around. For if there had not been a bit of refuse in Abraham, the upper demons would not have been able to take hold of them at all. However, as we have informed you regarding the matter of the Names and the Epithets <note>original: "Shemot ve-Kinnuyim". In Gikatilla’s system, "Names" are the core Sefirot, while "Epithets" are the lower descriptive titles through which external forces can connect.</note>, there is no name that is entirely simple without any mixture; rather, from every side, there is a bit of mixture in them. Because of this, they take hold and are delayed by one another. 

So too, in the matter of Abraham and Isaac, there was a great need for the perfection of the **Chariot** <term>Merkavah; the structure of the Divine realm</term> and the **Princes** <term>Sarim; the 70 celestial governors of the nations</term> that there be a bit of filth in them. This provided a place for the upper demons to take hold within that bit of filth. Had Abraham and Isaac been refined through and through, the Seventy Princes would not have been able to take hold of them at all, and the Chariot would have been found lacking, and the Princes would be separated, having no place of connection to the [Divine] Ministers. 

Behold, the bit of filth in Abraham and Isaac gave a place for the upper Princes to take hold of them. Therefore, you find Abraham and Isaac on two sides facing the Princes—one on the Right and one on the Left. One is in the Epithets of **EL** <note>God (Mighty One)</note> on the Right, and one is in the Epithets of **Elohim** on the Left. But Jacob, peace be upon him, who is refined and has no refuse, is in the middle between Abraham and Isaac. He is designated for the name **YHVH**, which stands in the middle. The Princes have no portion in the name YHVH, as we have already informed you, because it is in the middle. And who is it that inherits the name YHVH? Jacob and his sons, who are in the middle. 

Now that we have arrived at this principle, I shall enlighten your eyes with a Midrash of our Sages, of blessed memory, regarding Jacob, peace be upon him, to whom the Blessed One said: *"And your seed shall be as the dust of the earth, and you shall spread out [u-faratzta] to the west, to the east, to the north, and to the south"* <note>Genesis 28:14</note>. Why is the language "And you shall spread out" used? This was not said to Abraham, to whom it was said: *"Lift up now your eyes, and look from the place where you are northward, and southward, and eastward, and westward"* <note>Genesis 13:14</note>—behold, He set boundaries for Abraham: north, south, east, and west. And so it was for Isaac. But regarding Jacob, what is written? *"And you shall spread out westward, eastward, northward, and southward"*—meaning, your inheritance has no boundaries <note>original: "meitzarim"; also meaning "straits" or "Egypt".</note>.

## Gate 5

The **Priest** <note>original: "Kohen"</note> stands in the place of **Abraham** <note>representing the attribute of Kindness/Chesed</note>. The **Levite** stands in the place of **Isaac** <note>representing the attribute of Strength/Gevurah</note>. **Israel** <note>the non-priestly tribes</note> stands in the place of **Jacob** <note>representing the attribute of Beauty/Tiferet</note>. Do you not see how these matters are aligned? For the Name, may He be blessed, arranged Jacob and his sons according to the order of the **Perfect Chariot** <term>Merkavah; the divine celestial structure described in the visions of the prophets</term> which is designated for the truth of His blessed Name. I am now informing you of hidden secrets: You already know that there are twelve **constellations** <note>original: "mazalot"; the signs of the Zodiac</note> and from them comes the power for the twelve months of the year <margin>See the *Holy Orchard* <note>original: "Pardes HaKodesh"; likely a reference to the Kabbalistic work Pardes Rimonim by Moses Cordovero</note></margin>. Each and every constellation is designated for the specific needs of its month. All the constellations and months <margin>The power, existence, and sustenance for all of them comes from the Name YHWH, may He be blessed, in this manner...</margin> receive their power, existence, and sustenance from the Name **YHWH** <note>The Tetragrammaton, the four-letter Name of God</note>, may He be blessed.

Know that the twelve constellations in the heavens—by which the creatures below are sustained—receive power from twelve **seals** <term>Chotam; a specific permutation or arrangement of the four letters of God's Name</term> through which the Great Name **YHWH**, may He be blessed, expresses His strength and excellence. You will find these twelve seals arranged in four **banners** <term>Degalim; groupings or standards, mirroring the four camps of the tribes in the desert</term>. Similarly, you find four seasons in the year. In the form of these, you find twelve tribes in Israel and four banners, shaped after the twelve seals of the Name and their four banners. 

How so? The letter **Yod** [י] carries three seals, as does the first letter **He** [ה], the letter **Vav** [ו], and the final letter **He** [ה]. All of them carry three seals. We are illustrating this table here so that you may see these great matters with your own eyes.

You must know this: Know that the court of YH"WH, may He be blessed, is called *Mishpat* (Balanced Judgment). The court of Adon"ai is called *Tzedek* (Justice/Righteousness). Whenever the Name YH"WH judges the creatures, He judges them with Mercy according to His attribute, which is comprised of Kindness and Judgment. But when the Name Adon"ai judges the creatures, it judges them with Absolute Judgment, for the Name Adon"ai is Absolute Judgment and contains no Mercy unless it is flowed into it from the Name YH"WH, may He be blessed. This is why it has no light of its own, except for what comes to it from the Name YH"WH. If you ask: when does the Name YH"WH judge, and when does the Name Adon"ai? **Behold**, I will enlighten your eyes, God willing, and you must set your heart to find these desirable words. We have already informed you at the beginning of this book that there are three Names above: *Ehyeh* (I Will Be), which is entirely Mercy; in the middle is *YH"WH*, which is Kindness, Judgment, and Mercy mixed together; and below is *Adonai*, which is entirely Absolute Judgment. We have already informed you that all the abundance and goodness that comes to the Name Adonai is...

### The Divine Pronouns: I, You, and He

The attribute <note>referring to Malchut, the lowest Sephirah</note> is designated by the term **"I"** <note>Hebrew: *Ani*</note>, while the Name **YHWH** <note>The four-letter Name of God, associated here with the higher attribute of Tiferet</note> is designated by the term **"You"** <note>Hebrew: *Atah*</note>. His [highest] Name is designated by the term **"He"** <note>Hebrew: *Hu*; referring to the most hidden, transcendent aspect of the Divine</note>.

Know that **Adonai** <note>The Name of God associated with the Earthly presence</note> is referred to by the term **"I"** (*Ani*). This is the **Assembly of Israel** <note>Hebrew: *Knesset Yisrael*; the personification of the spiritual community of Israel and a name for the Shekhinah (the Divine Presence)</note>, which walks with them, warns them, and constantly cautions them not to sin against the Name **YHWH**. She <note>The Shekhinah is traditionally described with feminine pronouns in Kabbalah</note> says to them: "If you sin before Me, I will punish you, and I will strike you and take vengeance upon you," as it is said: *“And if you walk contrary unto me... then will I also walk contrary unto you... and I will smite you, even I”* (Leviticus 26:23-24). It also says in several places: *“And you shall fear your God; I am YHWH.”* 

The reason she says **"I"** without us specifically inviting her presence is because she knows our "evil inclination" <note>Hebrew: *Yetzer Hara*</note>; therefore, she prepares us and comes forward of her own accord to warn us. She proclaims: "Be careful before Me, for I am the one who stands to bring life and death, to strike and to heal," as it is written: *“See now that I, even I, am He, and there is no god with me: I kill, and I make alive; I wound, and I heal”* (Deuteronomy 32:39). 

Reflect on this, for this is a foundational principle <note>Hebrew: *Binyan Av*; literally 'a father's building,' a term for a primary rule of interpretation</note> for the entire Torah: wherever it says **"I"** (*Ani*), it refers to the attribute of **Adonai** making herself present and coming forward to say, "See now." "See now" certainly means "be careful and know that I, even I, am He; I kill and I make alive, I wound and I heal." It is like a person saying to his friend, "Look at this thing! Why are you not waking up to see it? Look and reflect upon it!" Similarly, the attribute <insert>according to its tradition</insert> speaks and proclaims: *“See now that I, even I, am He.”*

In this way, you will find throughout the Torah the positive commandments, as it is written: *“And you shall keep my commandments and do them: I am YHWH”* (Leviticus 22:31). And in the negative commandments: *“You shall not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of your people... I am YHWH”* (Leviticus 19:18). This means: I am the attribute that pays a good reward to the righteous and takes payment from the wicked, as it says: *“I kill and I make alive, I wound and I heal.”*

If so, consider that this attribute stands as a gate, as it says: *“This is the gate of YHWH”* (Psalm 118:20). **Adonai** is the one who mentions and says, "See now that **I, I** am He," making herself, her dominion, her rewards, and her punishments known to all creatures so they may know to be careful and not sin before **YHWH**, may He be blessed, so that she does not have to punish them or take retribution. This is the secret of the word **"I"** (*Ani*) said regarding the attribute of **Adonai**.

However, the reason **YHWH**, may He be blessed, is referred to by the term **"You"** <note>Hebrew: *Atah*</note> is because He is internal and is not [immediately] found by creatures in the same way the attribute of **Adonai** is. This is because the Great Name **YHWH**, may He be blessed, dwells within the Name **Adonai** like a king in his palace <note>Hebrew: *Heikhal*</note>, and He is not "found" until He is sought. This is what is meant by: *“But if from there you shall seek YHWH your God, you shall find Him”* (Deuteronomy 4:29). 

King David, peace be upon him, who knew the secrets of the upper world, warned his son Solomon about this, saying: *“And **you** (*Atah*), Solomon my son, know the God of your father and serve Him... if you seek Him, He will be found by you; but if you forsake Him, He will cast you off forever”* (1 Chronicles 28:9). This is the Great King whom every person must go toward, arranging and ordering His praises and His goodness, saying before Him: "**You** (*Atah*) are the ruler of the upper and lower worlds; **You** are He, and there is none like You." 

This is the secret of all prayers: a person must first arrange the praises of **YHWH**, may He be blessed, and afterward request his needs. This follows the example of Moses our teacher, peace be upon him, who said: *“**Adonai** [God], You (*Atah*) have begun to show Your servant Your greatness and Your mighty hand... what God is there in heaven or in earth that can do according to Your works?”* (Deuteronomy 3:24). Only after he arranged the praises of the Name using the term **"You"** (*Atah*) did he return to ask for his needs, saying: *“Let me go over, I pray You, and see the good land.”* 

All prayers and blessings we plead before Him follow this order. Do you not see that the beginning of all the middle blessings of the Prayer <note>The *Amidah*, the standing prayer also known as the *Shemoneh Esrei* (Eighteen Blessings)</note> starts with **"You"** (*Atah*)? As it says: *“**You** (*Atah*) grant man knowledge.”* And on Festivals, Rosh Hashanah, and Yom Kippur: *“**You** (*Atah*) chose us.”* And on the Sabbath evening: *“**You** (*Atah*) sanctified.”* And for the Afternoon prayer (*Mincha*): *“**You** (*Atah*) are One.”* 

However, the morning prayer of the Sabbath starts with "Moses rejoiced" <note>Hebrew: *Yismach Moshe*</note>, and the Additional prayer (*Musaf*) starts with "To Moses You commanded" <note>Hebrew: *Le-Moshe Tzivita*</note>. Examine and you will grasp through them the words of the Living God, for both of these prayers are founded upon the attribute of the "Living God" <note>Hebrew: *El Chai*, referring to the Sephirah of Yesod</note>, which is the <meta>secret</meta>...

---

...like You. And you already know that Wisdom <note>Hebrew: *Chokhmah*</note> is called the "Ancient Torah" which preceded [the world] by 500 years before the beginning of the world, which was Kindness <note>Hebrew: *Chesed*</note>, the perfection of the world, bound in power like a crown. And this was done through the power of the "will be" forces, and it did not emerge into action as a crown until it emerged in the structure of writing... <meta>and therefore</meta>

-># Gate 5<-

The princes of the world <note>These are the celestial guardian angels or spiritual "ministers" assigned to the various nations of the earth.</note> are judged with harsh decrees in the courts of the high ministers, and nothing is left for them except what was decreed upon them by the High Court. Know that any judgment handed over to a messenger <note>Hebrew: *shaliach*; referring here to an angel or intermediary agent of God.</note> to fulfill contains no mercy at all, for the messenger cannot change or forgive the decree. However, the King Himself can forgive and pardon, even if great sins were committed against Him. 

The Blessed Lord said to Moses: **“Behold, I send an angel before you to guard you on the way... pay attention to him and listen to his voice; do not rebel against him, for he will not pardon your transgressions”** (Exodus 23:20-21). This means: be careful not to sin, for if you do, that angel will execute the final judgment, as he has no authority to overlook your sins or forgive them. 

Then Moses, our teacher, peace be upon him, said: **“For how then shall it be known that I have found favor in Your sight, I and Your people? Is it not in Your going with us?”** (Exodus 33:16). The Blessed Lord then taught Moses how to achieve this. At that moment, Moses stood and prayed: **“Let my Lord (Adonai), I pray, go in our midst”** (Exodus 34:9)—referring to the King Himself, in whose power it is to show mercy and forgive. This is why the verse concludes: **“...and pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for Your inheritance.”** 

God confirmed this with a covenant, stating that such a gift is not given to the other nations of the world, saying: **“Behold, I make a covenant...”** (Exodus 34:10). Therefore, Israel always supplicates to the attribute of **Adonai** to have mercy and forgive even when they are not worthy, saying: **“O Lord (Adonai), hear; O Lord, forgive; O Lord, listen and act”** (Daniel 9:19). 

Many righteous people were afraid of the attribute of **Adonai** if they encountered it alone <note>Meaning, the attribute of Justice/Kingship without the tempering influence of Mercy.</note>, so they would draw down mercy and goodness to it from the **Supreme Crown** <note>Keter; the highest Sephirah</note> and from the other Names of Mercy, just as David used to do: **“But You, O Lord (Adonai), are a God full of compassion, and gracious, long-suffering, and plenteous in mercy and truth. O turn to me, and have mercy upon me”** (Psalm 86:15-16). 

If you understand this, you will enter many inner chambers. You will know how the prophets and the pious used to draw the "pipes" <note>Hebrew: *tzinorot*; the spiritual channels through which divine energy flows between the Sephirot.</note> of kindness and mercy toward the Name **Adonai**, so that they would not encounter it while it was "lacking" or "dry" <note>Metaphors for when the Shekhinah (Presence) is not receiving the flow of Mercy from the higher Sephirot, leaving only the "dry" heat of strict Justice.</note>. In this way, the holy sages of Israel, such as the *Tannaim* and *Amoraim* <note>The early sages of the Mishnah and Talmud.</note>, knew how to repair the channels and direct all the Names of Mercy until they were all drawn into and arrived at the Name **Adonai**. Then, they could accomplish all their desires in the world, because they knew how to direct all the channels toward the Name **Adonai**. 

This is the secret of the verse: **“I will set him on high, because he has known My name. He shall call upon Me, and I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble; I will deliver him, and honor him”** (Psalm 91:14-15). 

All that we have said regarding the attribute of **Justice** <note>Hebrew: *Tzedek*; another term for the Sephirah Malchut.</note> having harsh judgments refers to when she executes judgment upon the enemies of Israel and the other nations. However, when she judges Israel, she is like a mother **(a)** who has compassion for her children. When she comes to execute judgment upon Israel, she does so gently and with kindness so they are not destroyed. The secret of this is: **“As an eagle <margin><unclear>Zeir Anpin, etc.</unclear> <note>The marginal note links the eagle to the Sephirah of Tiferet, often called "The Small Face" or Zeir Anpin.</note></margin> stirs up her nest, flutters over her young”** (Deuteronomy 32:11). For if she were to judge a person with a harsh judgment for even a moment, they would succumb to every trouble. Understand this well. 

Nevertheless, her judgments alone are not equal to the judgments made when **Compassion** <note>Hebrew: *Mishpat*; associated with the Sephirah Tiferet.</note> is joined with her, for then mercy prevails. 

Know that the attribute called the **Middle Line** <note>The central axis of the Sephirotic tree, balancing Mercy and Judgment.</note>, which is the secret of the Name **YHWH**, is called in the language of the Torah by the term **“You”** <note>Hebrew: *Atah*.</note>. I shall now open for you, with God’s help, the **Gates of Light** <note>A reference to the title of this book, *Sha'are Orah*.</note>. 

Know that there are three Names, from bottom to top: 
1. The lowest is **Adonai**, and its designation in the Torah is **“I”** (*Ani*), such as: *“I am YHWH your God”*; *“I, even I, have spoken”*; *“I kill, and I make alive; I wound, and I heal”*; *“And you shall fear your God; I am YHWH.”*
2. The middle is **YHWH**, and its designation in the Torah is **“You”** (*Atah*). As the sages of old said **(b)**: *Atah* <note>The word *Atah* is spelled Aleph-Tav-He.</note> refers to the "Sign of the He" <note>This relates to the structure of the Hebrew letters and the flow of divine emanation.</note>. You already know that the Middle Line is "Awesome." 
3. The highest Name is **Ehyeh** <note>"I Will Be," the name revealed at the Burning Bush.</note>, and its designation in the Torah is **“He”** (*Hu*), such as: *“But He, being full of compassion, forgives iniquity and destroys not”*; *“For He delights in mercy.”* 

And why is the Name **Adonai** nicknamed... 

---

...above in this gate as an explanation of the secret of the designations. **(a)** *“Who has compassion for her children”*: Meaning she strikes and chastises them for their own good so they will return from their evil way, and not to harm or destroy them in a flare of anger, as we explained. **(b)** *“And in the column [of] You, all of You”*: That is to say, the word **“You”** (*Atah*) is the secret of the "All," which is the Name of **Tiferet** <note>The Sephirah of Beauty/Balance.</note>, as explained above. Some Kabbalists designate the **Kingship** (*Malchut*) with the name **“You”** because she includes all things... and there are those who designate the **Supernal Wisdom** (*Chokhmah*) with the name **“You”** based on the verse *“For You are our father”* (Isaiah 63:16). There is no doubt about this at all. The author of the *Recanati* <note>Menahem Recanati, a 13th-century Italian Kabbalist.</note> explained this on the portion of *Bereshit* regarding the verse *“And You preserve them all”* (Nehemiah 9:6), saying that just as Wisdom is called "Elohim" and "Solomon's Appointment," so too the word **“You”** hints at them... and the word **“You”** (*Atah*) includes all sounds/voices, for it begins with *Aleph* [the first letter] and ends with *Tav* [the last letter]...

From the forms of these letters, all the structures of the "Chariots" <note>Hebrew: *Merkavah*; referring to the complex celestial systems that carry the Divine Presence.</note> were made, both in the higher and lower worlds. 

What you must know is that the twenty-two foundational letters are (a) divided into three groups:
1. **The Three Mothers**: *Aleph, Mem, Shin* (*אמ"ש*), from which emerged the three elements: Air, Water, and Fire. 
2. **The Seven Doubles**: *Bet, Gimel, Dalet, Kaf, Pe, Resh, Tav* (*בג"ד כפר"ת*), through which all "sevens" were created above and below. With them, the seven planets were formed, along with all celestial and earthly heptads (b) according to the secret of the "Seven Doubles."

With God’s help, we shall yet hand over to you mighty traditions regarding how all the upper and lower Chariots are carried by these three divisions of the twenty-two letters. Then you will see the secret of the word **"You"** <note>Hebrew: *Atah* (אתה)</note>—how it is the secret of the bond between all worlds. It sustains the mystery of the twenty-two-letter alphabet through which all form and all speech were created.

This is the secret of the "Central Line" and the secret of the Name **Y-H-W-H of Hosts** <note>Hebrew: *Y-H-W-H Tzevaot*</note>. This is the Name positioned in the center, which carries all other Names and titles. All worlds—above and below—are attached to it and unified within it.

(d) Because the Name called **Y-H-W-H** is accessible to created beings through His actions and His awesome deeds, we call Him by the term **"You"** (*Atah*), as one who stands directly before us and speaks with Him. 

However, the Highest Crown <note>Hebrew: *Keter Elyon*</note>, which is called the Infinite (*Ein Sof*) and the Name **"I Will Be"** <note>Hebrew: *Eheyeh*</note>, cannot be grasped by any prince, angel, or prophet in the world. For even Moses our Teacher, the master of all prophets, only spoke with the Name **Y-H-W-H**, may He be blessed, which is the Central Line. Moses (e) did not enter beyond the Sephirah of Understanding (*Binah*). He did not even reach the very end of the Fifty Gates of Understanding, much less what lies inside them. For our Sages of blessed memory said: "Fifty gates of Understanding were created in the world, and all were given to Moses except for one." Reflect on this: if even Moses our Teacher, peace be upon him, did not enter beyond Understanding, there is no one who can reach the "Eye" of the Highest Crown called the Infinite.

Because we lack the power to grasp Him there, we do not speak with Him in the second person—as one speaking to another face-to-face saying "You." Instead, just as the Name *Eheyeh* cannot be grasped "face-to-face" because it is hidden high above, we do not call Him "You" (since He does not stand "opposite" us in a graspable way). Rather, we call Him by the term **"He"** <note>Hebrew: *Hu* (הוא)</note>. We speak of Him as one who is not present before us, as a person describes a matter and says "it is such-and-such." 

Consider the sign: **"And the children of Israel saw it and said to one another: What is it? (Man Hu), for they did not know what it was (Mah Hu)"** (Exodus 16:15). Know that (f) the Manna descended from the Highest Crown, and with God’s help, we will yet grasp hidden secrets regarding this. But keep this rule: "They did not know what **He** (*Hu*) was." There is no one in the world who knows the essence of the Crown which is called "He." 

Guard this well. If so, here is the resolution: the three Names—**I Will Be** (*Eheyeh*), **Y-H-W-H**, and **My Lord** (*Adonai*)—have three corresponding pronouns in the Torah: **He** (*Hu*), **You** (*Atah*), and **I** (*Ani*). 

When you understand the secret of *Eheyeh* and its pronoun "He," you will understand the secret of the verse: **"And He (*Ve-Hu*), being merciful, forgives iniquity and does not destroy"** (Psalms 78:38). For He is the possessor of absolute mercy, with no mixture of Judgment <note>Hebrew: *Din*</note> within it; therefore, "He" certainly forgives iniquity. You will also understand the secret of the verse: **"But He (*Ve-Hu*) is at one..."**

<meta>This page continues from the discussion of the Divine Names, specifically transitioning from the concept of "You" (Atah) and the Tetragrammaton (Y-H-W-H) toward the Name "Elohim" and its role in the celestial hierarchy of Judgment.</meta>

Wherever you find the name **Elohim** in the Torah, you will be able to know toward which side it leans. (l) I have already informed you, my soul’s friend, that the Great Name called **Y-H-W-H** (blessed be He) is alone the essence and the trunk of the tree, leaning upward, downward, and to the sides. He clothes Himself in all other holy names and all other titles, as I have informed you. Depending on the action that He (blessed be He) renews in His world, He is called by that specific name, varying according to that action. Therefore, He is sometimes called *Ehyeh*, and called *Yah*, and called *Adonai*, and called *Adonai Tzva’ot* <note>Lord of Hosts</note>, and called *Elohim Tzva’ot*, *El Chai* <note>Living God</note>, or *Elohim Chayim* <note>Living God (plural form)</note>—all according to the action He renews in the world. Thus, He wears the "garment" of the Name that describes the action.

Now, this Name called **Elohim** is the Name appointed over Judgment (*Din*). The sign of this (k) is: "For judgment belongs to God" <note>original: *ki ha-mishpat l'Elohim hu*; Deuteronomy 1:17</note>. When He (blessed be He) performs an action from the side of Judgment, He is called by that action: **Elohim**.

Now, know and see that the side <gloss>(Meaning: the angle between right and left above, distinct from the "Treasurer of the Window"; see the *Pardes* <note>Likely referring to the kabbalistic work *Pardes Rimonim* or the concept of the four levels of interpretation.</note>)</gloss> designated before Him as the "Left Side" is referred to in the Torah as **Elohim**. This is because that side is the place of Judgment, and through it, all who come into the world are judged with all the appropriate judgments—whether for good or for evil, for life or for death. In it are several established courts of law, and each one completes its work and its judgments in truth and faithfulness, and everything is conducted with upright justice. This is what is called the "Upper Court" <note>Hebrew: *Beit Din shel Ma’alah*</note>. There, creatures are judged for peace or for the sword, for famine or for plenty, for life or for death. This is the Name called **Elohim**, and everything is judged in His court. Regarding this, our Sages (may their memory be a blessing) said: "A person is obligated to bless [God] for the evil just as he blesses for the good." 

(And we seek proof for this matter: from where [do we know it]? Rabba bar Chana said that Rabbi Yochanan said: The verse states, "In **Y-H-W-H** I will praise the word, in **Elohim** I will praise the word" <note>Psalm 56:11</note>. "In **Y-H-W-H** I will praise the word"—this refers to the attribute of Good. "In **Elohim** I will praise the word"—this refers to the attribute of Punishment.)

Now we must tell you that everything is judged in the Court called **Elohim**. If the judgment emerges for good, the name **Y-H-W-H** or **El** is called upon it. But if the judgment emerges for punishment, it is called **Elohim**. Guard this [knowledge] very carefully. You must contemplate that wherever you find **Elohim** in the Torah, it represents the attribute prepared to judge and adjudicate the entire world. 

We have already informed you in the previous Gate how the "Great Sanhedrin" <note>The supreme celestial council</note> of above stands between the Name called **Y-H-W-H** and the Name called **Elohim**, and how the attribute of Mercy (*Rachamim*) mixes with the attribute of Judgment so as not to destroy the creatures at the time of judgment. Therefore, the Great Sanhedrin of above is established toward the left side, between **Y-H-W-H** and **Elohim**, and it leans toward the left. Regarding this, it is said: "Your navel is a round goblet, let not mixed wine be lacking" <note>Song of Songs 7:3</note>. This [navel] is the Great Sanhedrin. Because it is written, "The face of an ox was on the left" <note>Ezekiel 1:10</note>, the Great Sanhedrin is called by the term *Shedarek* <note>A mystical name for the celestial council, likely derived from a permutation of "your navel" (*shorerka*) and Aramaic roots.</note>. 

The Torah of the Lord prepares a remedy for the sinner at the time they judge him for his sins in the Court of *Shedarek*, provided he returns in repentance, as it is said: "It shall be health to your navel" <note>Proverbs 3:8; here "navel" (*shir-re-kha*) is linked to *Shedarek*</note>. And the Prophet proclaims and says that repentance is the healing, as it is said: "And he shall return and be healed" <note>Isaiah 6:10</note>.

Now, open your eyes and see that in the Great Court called **Elohim**, all beings of the world—both upper and lower—are judged. We must inform you of the great principles upon which the world stands, which is the secret of the "Work of Creation" <note>Hebrew: *Ma’aseh Bereshit*</note>. To enlighten your eyes regarding the secret of why the name **Elohim** is mentioned throughout the entire story of Creation: the secret is that all created beings, both upper and lower, were all created through the "Line of Judgment" and Justice. There is no creature among all creatures upon which the Court called **Elohim** did not reach an agreement before it was created. From that Judgment emerged how this creature was fit to be—such as a grain of barley in its height, the form of its limbs, its vitality, and its sustenance. And from Judgment it emerged that this creature would be subservient to such-and-such a creature, whether in bodily servitude or financial subservience. Such was the Judgment in the entire Work of Creation and for every creature.

# The Fifth Gate

(9) And who can bring Him back? For the secret of the righteous and upright is He. Now that we have informed you of this, contemplate and see that the quality of **Adonai** <term>the Name associated with the Sefirah of Malchut, or "Sovereignty"</term>, which is the secret of **Sovereignty** (*Malchut*), is bound to **Beauty** (*Tiferet*), which is the secret of the Name **Y-H-W-H** <note>original: יהוה; the Tetragrammaton</note>. He (blessed be He) becomes unified with the **Crown** (*Keter*), which is the secret of the Name **Ehyeh** <note>original: אהיה; "I Will Be"</note>, also called **The Infinite** (*Ein Sof*). These three levels are the secret of the totality of Unity and Faith. Regarding them, we say in the Rosh Hashanah prayer: "And You shall reign over us, You alone, **Y-H-W-H** our God, over all Your works."

And why does it say "one" twice? Because **Sovereignty** (*Malchut*) must take hold of **Beauty** (*Tiferet*) through the secret of the three lower Sefirot, and **Beauty** must take hold of **Understanding** (*Binah*), which is the secret of the three supernal Sefirot. This is the secret of "**Y-H-W-H** shall be one and His Name one," and the secret of "And You shall reign over us, You alone, **Y-H-W-H** our God, speedily, etc." 

Now that we have informed you of this regarding the word "You" (*Atah*), this secret of the Name is sufficient for us. It is now appropriate to pause at this Gate. Here, five Names of the Lord (blessed be He) have been explained to you in this book. Five other Names remain, and with the help of God, we shall arrange them before you, each one in its proper place. With His help, mercy, and kindness, may He enlighten our eyes and show us wonders from His Torah, Amen.
