# Gate 8

(5) And all of them [the fifty gates of Understanding] were given to Moses except for one, etc. <note>original: "וכולם נמסרו למשה חוץ מאחד"</note>. Furthermore, the reason it is called **Binah** <term>Understanding</term> is that it is the secret of the birth of sons and daughters (7) through the secret of **Binah** and **Tevunah** <term>Insight; a secondary aspect of Understanding</term>. Therefore, as a punishment for the sin of [unfulfilled] vows, children die; and for the sin of vows, a man's wife dies. (7) This is "measure for measure," because **Tevunah** is the source of the vow, as is known to the Kabbalists. 

And whoever knows the nature of the organs will know what our Sages, of blessed memory, said: (4) "The son's brain is drawn from the father's brain." All of this follows the secret of **Binah** and **Da'at** <term>Knowledge</term>, for from the place of **Binah**, [the essence] is drawn from the brain through **Da'at**, passing through the passages of the spinal cord until it reaches the prepared place <note>a reference to the reproductive organs</note>. (5) This is the secret of the verse: **"O Lord, open my lips, and my mouth shall declare Your praise"** (Psalms 51:17). They have already alluded in the *Sefer Yetzirah* <note>The Book of Formation, an ancient mystical text</note>: "He established a covenant between the ten fingers of the hands, which is the **Covenant of the Mouth**; and He established a covenant between the ten toes of the feet, which is the **Covenant of Circumcision**." The allusion refers entirely to the circumcision of the tongue and the circumcision of the organ. One who understands the secret of this root will come to know the reason why it is called **Binah**. 

And here we shall explain: (7) **"Who is wise, let him understand these things; who is prudent, let him know them, for the ways of the Lord are right"** (Hosea 14:10). **Binah** stands between **Chokhmah** <term>Wisdom</term> and **Da'at**, and they unite to become one with another; this is the secret of "With Wisdom, with Insight, and with Knowledge" <note>Exodus 31:3</note>. Everything is alluded to here; this is the secret of the connection between the Upper Sefirot and the lower ones. 

Sometimes this Sefirah is called **Yovel** <term>Jubilee; the 50th year of liberation</term>. Remember our teaching that all types of freedom and redemption are dependent upon this Sefirah. The reason is that all seven lower Sefirot are sometimes affected—Heaven forbid—by the corruption of those below, which resembles an interruption of the Divine flow, as the verse says: (100) **"And in that day did the Lord God of Hosts call to weeping, and to mourning"** (Isaiah 22:12). Therefore, when human beings sin below, and the Sefirah of **Binah** diminishes its types of blessings, as it were, it is found—

->In the Gate<-

Let the student contemplate the principles of these matters. For this reason, the heart <note>L-L, numerical value 60</note> stands by the power of **Binah**, which is called "my heart" <note>Liba-i</note>, just as **Malchut** <term>Kingship</term> is called "my heart." (8) This is the secret of the "lower understander," meaning **Yesod** <term>Foundation</term>, which is the understander that bestows flow upon **Malchut** and is the "Return" <note>Teshuvah/Repentance</note> for the seven upper ones, as explained above, which are the three joints of the Queen. Therefore, both are called **Binah**, which is the secret of (9) the scripture "those who understand" <note>Ha-mevinim</note>, meaning the Heavenly script that calculates the two hidden shoulders in the likeness of the tongue, which is in the middle between the brain and the heart, dividing their mysteries and bestowing from its understanding and wisdom to others through recognition. 

(8) And all were given to Moses except for one. Therefore, the secret of the Levites was to accompany [the Divine], standing in the "Name of the Sons" and in the power of **Binah**, etc., which is called "my heart," as explained in the Mahzor <note>Festival prayer book</note>. (2) Regarding the secret of **Binah** and **Tevunah**: this is explained in the *Zohar*, which says that she has children. Praise to **Tevunah**, for there she stands. Since the Shekhinah <term>Divine Presence</term> is there to say "to Tevunah," she is all-encompassing, just as the Higher One is found within **Tevunah**. For **Binah** includes the letters H, V, H, and H <note>The components of the Divine Name</note>, because **Binah** is *Ben* <note>Son</note> + *YH* <note>the first two letters of the Name</note>. Since the letters *YH* are in them, alluding to **Chokhmah** and **Binah**, they give birth to the "Son," which is **Da'at**, also called **Tiferet** <term>Beauty</term>. 

But **Tevunah** was part of the general structure, for **Tevunah** is *Bat* <note>Daughter</note> and *Bat* and *H*, alluding to **Tiferet** and the Crown <note>Atarah/Malchut</note>, which are the core of the building. They are all included in the letters *YH* from them, and this is the "Return" to God, and not the others. It is not in the likeness, but only that all **Tevunah** belongs to the end of **Binah**, which is superior in its emanated mercies. For He is the master of the script that ascends and is thus joined to Understanding, in the secret of **Chokhmah**, **Binah**, and **Da'at**, as I wrote above in Gate 5 regarding the nickname of **Da'at**. This is the "King" in the prayer book. 

(3) "Who is wise, let him understand these things." From them, "the prudent shall understand." Prudence stands between the Wise and Knowledge to hint that **Binah** is the secret of the Joiner. From the language of "demolition," **Da'at** is the Son in the secret of "Wisdom with Insight and Knowledge," as explained. And what was said—that (4) "the son's brain is drawn from the father's brain"—means that the flow that goes out to **Tiferet** in the line of the arms of **Binah** comes from the **Chokhmah** bestowed upon it through the mediation of **Binah**. 

So it is exemplified in the lower world in the secret of human speech, which is in the likeness of the five [Sefirot] above, as I wrote in the introduction to the book. The father's brain is drawn into the son's brain. And they said (5) the secret of "O Lord, open my lips," etc., for there is the union of all. "And my mouth shall declare Your praise" means the "Mouth of Wisdom," which was the Crown, shall draw from the beginning, which is **Binah**, called "the Son of these," and declare from the end that which speech moves and brings forth. 

He continues to expand the explanation regarding (6) the **Covenant of the Mouth** and the **Covenant of Circumcision**, etc., the tongue and the circumcision of the organ. The hint is in the names of **Binah** and the Crown <note>Atarah</note>, which are the Upper Covenant and the Lower Covenant joined together, as explained in Gate 2. All of this is (7) "measure for measure" in all knowledge: that **Binah** is the "Mother of the Sons," and the sons are the six [lower] Sefirot. When she gives him her desire, it becomes **Malchut**. They cause the removal of a man from his children [if he sins]; if he removes the flow from the children and the "Desire" <note>the wife/Malchut</note>, his children and wife will depart—measure for measure. For [Binah] was the place of the vow <note>N-D-R</note>, as explained in Gate 2 under the nickname of "Hearing" and "Breath." As it were, it is said: "I have sent my children away." (8) "And the Lord God of Hosts called in that day to weeping and mourning"—this occurs when the flow is diminished in the lower realms.

# Gate 8

From Him, it is sanctified to you, as it says: **"And cause Your face to shine upon Your sanctuary that is desolate"** (Daniel 9:17). It is certainly "Your sanctuary," for even though it is in ruins, it remains Your sanctuary. This is what is meant by "upon Your sanctuary that is desolate," just as it says: "And I will bring your sanctuaries unto desolation" (Leviticus 26:31)—even when they are a desolation, they remain in their holiness. This is the meaning of "And cause Your face to shine upon Your sanctuary that is desolate." And what is the reason for this? Because the holiness <note>original: לק' - abbreviation for לקדושה (to holiness)</note> fell upon it. This is what they meant by saying "for the Lord's sake" <note>original: אד'ני</note>—for the sake of the one who called You "Lord" <note>original: אדון</note>, namely Abraham. Our father Abraham established a place for it <note>referring to the Sefirah of Malchut/Kingship</note>. He was able to adorn the *Sefirot* <term>divine emanations</term> of Kingship and unify the Blessed Name in the world. Therefore, Abraham our father was "one" (Ezekiel 33:24) in all his limbs to unify the Name. The secret is that "Abraham was one and inherited the land," meaning he inherited his [God's] Kingdom <note>original: מלכותו (Malchuto)</note>; therefore, he was able to unify the Name.

(e) The secret of this is: **"And he went on his journeys from the south even to Bethel"** (Genesis 13:3). Because Abraham our father prepared the way and unified the *Sefirot* of Kingship with the *Sefirot* of Wisdom, Understanding, and Knowledge <note>original: חב"נה - Chochmah, Binah, Da'at</note>, he began by saying "My Lord, God" <note>original: אד"ני יה"וה - Adonai YHVH</note>. This is the "General Principle" <note>original: בנין אב (Binyan Av)</note>: wherever you find "My Lord, God" <note>Adonai YHVH</note> written, it is the secret of the restoration of the *Shekhinah* <term>the Divine Presence</term> and her adorning herself to take hold of the *Sefirah* of *Binah* <term>Understanding</term>. 

However, wherever you find written "God, My Lord" <note>original: יה"וה אד"ני - YHVH Adonai</note>, it is the secret of the flow and emanation from above to below, where the *Sefirah* of *Binah* flows upon all the *Sefirot* until the *Sefirah* of Kingship encompasses all types of flow, emanation, and blessing, as it says: "God, the Lord, is my strength" <note>original: יה"וה אד"ני חילי</note> (Habakkuk 3:19). This is the rule: every place you find *Adonai YHVH*, it is the secret of the *Shekhinah* adorning herself below to unite with *Binah* and receive flow and emanation from her; and every place you find *YHVH Adonai*, it is the secret of the flow being drawn from above to below.

(f) The secret of this is: **"Truth shall spring out of the earth; and righteousness shall look down from heaven"** (Psalms 85:12). What is written afterward? "Yea, the Lord shall give that which is good; and our land shall yield her produce" (Psalms 85:13). And now, contemplate these "keys" that we have delivered into your hands in this Gate, for with them you can open many gates that were locked with many locks, which not everyone is worthy to enter.

This *Sefirah* <note>Binah</note> is called in many places **Binah** <term>Understanding</term>. (g) The reason is that she is the secret of the **Supreme Intercessor** <note>original: המליץ העליון (Ha-Melitz Ha-Elyon)</note> standing between the upper *Sefirot* and the lower *Sefirot*. She is the one who emanates upon all the other *Sefirot* the emanation of flow and blessing from the "Supreme Crown" <note>Keter</note>. Through this *Sefirah*, a person shall contemplate the "Principle of Principles" and the "Foundation of all Foundations," for without her, there is no way to enter into the knowledge of His Primordiality, blessed be He. She is like the "Faithful Intercessor," as it says: "I stood between the Lord and you" (Deuteronomy 5:5). 

(h) And on Shabbat, which is the secret of the "Lower Intercessor," it says: "It is a sign between Me and the children of Israel forever" (Exodus 31:17). The masters of Kabbalah have already alluded that the *Sefirah* of *Binah* is like the tongue in the mouth. Truly, like the tongue in the mouth from several aspects:
1. First, she is the secret of (the written) (i) the "Third Crown." 
2. Second, she is the secret of the "Connection" that exists for the upper *Sefirot* and the emanation of their blessing upon the ten lower *Sefirot*. 
3. Third, because without *Binah*, no person can enter the knowledge of the Primordial One of the world. 

And behold, Moses our teacher, peace be upon him, who is the "Faithful Intercessor," attained forty-nine gates within *Binah*, as our Sages of blessed memory said: "Fifty gates of Understanding were created in the world, and all of them <column-break/> were given to Moses except for one."

# Gate 8

...Understanding <note>original: בינה (Binah)</note>. And if, Heaven forbid, the soul sins, it incurs the punishment of **excision** <term>Karet; a spiritual penalty where the soul is "cut off" from its divine source</term>. It is then severed from the **Spirit** <note>original: רוח (Ruach)</note> to which it was once attached, losing its good reward. It has no way to ascend to the **World to Come** <note>original: עולם הבא (Olam Ha-Ba)</note>, for it has been severed from the **Supernal Tree** to which it was joined. This is the secret of excision mentioned in the Torah: **"That soul shall be utterly cut off from among its people"** (Numbers 15:31).

But if, after being cut off, the soul returns and improves its ways and mends its paths, it then returns to be reattached to the place from which it was originally severed. It then merits to ascend to the *Sefirah* <term>divine emanation</term> of **Understanding** <note>original: בינה (Binah)</note>, which is called the "World to Come," and it returns to the place from which it was lost. 

(4) This is the secret of **Repentance** <term>Teshuva; literally "Return"</term>, as they said: **"And his return was to Ramah, for there was his house"** (1 Samuel 7:17). Since souls are bound to spirits, and spirits are bound to higher breaths of life <note>original: נשמות (Neshamot)</note>, and those breaths are bound to the "World of Life," the Scripture says: **"The soul of my lord shall be bound in the bundle of life"** (1 Samuel 25:29). 

However, those souls that are cut off from their place and do not return are judged with many harsh punishments. Once they are severed and uprooted from the place where they were planted, they are tossed about and wander from punishment to punishment and from plague to plague. This is what the Scripture means: **"And the soul of your enemies, He shall sling it out, as out of the hollow of a sling"** (1 Samuel 25:29). The matter of the "hollow of the sling" is like a stone thrown from place to place. So too is the soul: once severed from its place, (5) it is hurled from location to location through various types of evil punishments called the **Hollow of the Sling** <note>original: כף הקלע (Kaf ha-Kela)</note>.

In this way, you should contemplate the secret of Repentance mentioned in the Torah: it is the secret of the soul's return to the place from which it was uprooted, returning to its rest, as we say: **"Return, O my soul, to your rest"** (Psalm 116:7). By what means does it return to its rest? Through the excellent "medicines" that the Torah established for all types of sin and iniquity, as found (6) in the **Torah of the Priests** <note>The biblical Book of Leviticus</note>. This is what is meant by: **"The Torah of the Lord is perfect, restoring the soul"** (Psalm 19:8). Truly, if the Torah had not made known the ways of Repentance, there would be no way to return. But the prophet cries out and says: **"Return, you backsliding children, I will heal your backslidings"** (Jeremiah 3:22). 

And how do we know that the secret of the *Sefirah* of Understanding is the secret of Repentance—a foundational principle for the entire Torah? As it is said: **"And his heart will understand, and he will return, and be healed"** (Isaiah 6:10). If so, contemplate how Repentance is the secret of the World to Come.

After we have explained this great secret to you, we must return and inform you of the levels of Repentance. For every individual of Israel, after being "sold" <note>metaphorically sold to sin or exile</note>, has a way to return: **"He shall have the right of redemption... in the Jubilee he shall go out"** (Leviticus 25:48, 54). It also says: **"In this year of Jubilee you shall return, every man to his possession"** (Leviticus 25:13). Through the secret of the *Sefirah* of Understanding, the soul can return and take hold in the place from which it was severed. This is why it says "return, every man to his possession," using the language of **"possession"** <note>original: אחוזה (Ahuza)</note>. 

This *Sefirah* is also called **"Upper Justice"** <note>original: צדק עליון (Tzedek Elyon)</note> by the Kabbalists <term>mystics</term>. That is to say, it is the *Sefirah* from which the Attribute of Judgment begins, even though it is rooted in the "World of Mercy." This is the secret of Upper Justice which corresponds to **"Lower Justice"** <note>original: צדק תחתון (Tzedek Tachton)</note>, for the *Sefirah* of **Kingship** <note>original: מלכות (Malchut)</note> is also called "Lower Justice." The two are aligned with one another: the Gates of Justice <note>Malchut</note> correspond to the Gates of Understanding <note>Binah</note>, following the secret of the Divine Names *Adonai* and *Elohim* <note>original: אדנ"י יהו"ה - read here as the combination of the names representing judgment and mercy</note>. Because these two *Sefirot* are aligned and both are called by the name "Justice" <note>original: צד"ק (Tzedek)</note>, the verse says: **"Justice, justice shall you pursue"** (Deuteronomy 16:20). This means: pursue the attainment of the Gates of [Lower] Justice in order to enter through them into the life of the World to Come, which is the secret of Upper Justice. Therefore it says "Justice, Justice" twice. 

The verse continues to explain: **"That you may live"**—referring to Upper Justice; **"And inherit the land"**—referring to Lower Justice, which is the secret of the **Land of Israel**, as it says (7): **"Righteousness [Justice] lodged in her"** (Isaiah 1:21).

->And you will understand<-

---

Understanding. Explanation: (1) There is a movement from place to place, for excision is nothing but a disconnection, like a branch cut off while its source remains. It lives through it <note>meaning the soul's potential remains in the source</note>. For the Wisdom that is bestowed... then it was compelled to return and be separated. It is not said that it will be lost or perish entirely, but rather (2) it is severed and cut off from the height where it was attached. The spirit and the breath of the Name are spread out and moved from place to place, and this is "the soul of your enemies He shall sling in the hollow of a sling" through various evil punishments. As found (3) in the "Torah of the Priests"—this refers to the Book of Leviticus, in which the ways of Repentance through offerings, sin-offerings, and guilt-offerings are clarified in detail. (4) In these I have found "Justice and righteousness lodged in her."

->And he understood<-

# Gate 8

...like the other *Sefirot* <term>divine emanations</term>, there are many paths (1) until they gather and ascend to the *Sefirah* of **Understanding** <note>original: בינה (Binah)</note>, and the destruction remains below. 
But when the lower *Sefirot* take hold of the *Sefirah* of the **Jubilee** <note>original: יובל (Yovel); the fiftieth year in the Torah when slaves are freed and land returns to its owners</note> and draw the flow of its blessings downward, then all kinds of freedom and redemption are found in all the *Sefirot* and among all those who are sustained by the *Sefirah* of **Kingdom** <note>original: מלכות (Malchut)</note>, which receives the flow of blessing from them. 

Know that a time is destined to come when the righteous will ascend until they take hold of the *Sefirah* of **Understanding**, which is the secret of the **World to Come** <note>original: עולם הבא (Olam Ha-Ba)</note>. Then they will go out to freedom and be redeemed from all types of destroyers and all types of punishments, according to the secret of the verse: **"Who redeems your life from the pit"** (Psalm 103:4). Corresponding to this quality and this promise—that we are prepared to enter the life of the World to Come—we were commanded in the Torah many positive and negative commandments. Their reward is found nowhere else but in the *Sefirah* of **Understanding**, which is called the **World to Come**. It is also called **Jubilee** <note>original: יובל (Yovel)</note> because through it, one goes out from servitude to redemption, from mourning to a festival, and from darkness to a great light. 

In this way, I am handing over to you hints that, if you are worthy, you will contemplate their principles. The secret of **Understanding** is called **Jubilee** because through it, everything goes out to freedom. The reason is that anyone who merits to cleave to it will never see anxiety or any lack, because it cleaves to the Supernal *Sefirot* in the **Inner Chambers** <note>original: בתי גואי (Batei Gavai)</note>, where there is no anxiety and no lack of anything. One who cleaves to the Jubilee is redeemed, for there is nothing surrounding the Jubilee that can cause harm—no prince, no angel, and no thing in the world—only the **World of Mercy** <note>original: עולם הרחמים (Olam Ha-Rahamim)</note> alone. 

This is because the *Sefirot* of **Greatness** <note>original: גדולה (Gedulah/Chesed)</note> and **Strength** <note>original: גבורה (Gevurah)</note> are the ones that can happen upon or delay the bringing of goodness to the world. However, since the *Sefirah* of the Jubilee is the World of Mercy, it is called an **inheritance without borders** <note>original: נחלה בלא מצרים (Nachala belo meitzarim)</note>. This is the inheritance of our father Jacob, peace be upon him. It is not like the inheritance of Abraham, which had borders, nor like the inheritance of Isaac, which had borders. Therefore, anyone who merits to cleave to the *Sefirah* of the Jubilee shall have redemption, for there is nothing there to delay, prevent, or accuse. 

This is the secret of (2) the verse: **"And I will cause you to ride on the high places of the earth, and feed you with the heritage of Jacob your father"** (Isaiah 58:14). This refers to the heritage of the **Middle Pillar** <term>the central axis of the Sefirot, associated with Tiferet/Jacob</term> which ascends and takes hold in the World of Mercy, while the "high places of the earth"—the heritages of Abraham and Isaac—remain below. 

If you contemplate these hints we have mentioned, many gates will open for you. Furthermore, because it is so, it is called **Broad Places of the River** <note>original: רחובות הנהר (Rehovot Ha-Nahar); a reference to Genesis 36:37</note>, for it is a place that has no borders, and no adversary, delayer, or preventer of goodness. Anyone who merits in this world to be planted in those places, **"his fruit shall not fail and his leaf shall not wither"** (Psalm 1:3). What is the reason? **"He shall be like a tree planted by streams of water, that spreads out its roots by the River <note>original: יובל (Yovel/Jubilee)</note>, and shall not fear when heat comes; its leaf shall be green, and in the year of drought it shall not be anxious, nor shall it cease from yielding fruit"** (Jeremiah 17:8). 

The reason he does not see "when heat comes" and the like is because in this place there is no delayer, adversary, or preventer; for this place is above the seventy celestial princes. Therefore, it is called "Broad Places." Regarding this, it is said: **"He brought me out into a broad place"** (Psalm 18:19). 

Understand this well. This *Sefirah* is called in the language of our Sages, may their memory be a blessing, **Repentance** <note>original: תשובה (Teshuvah/Return)</note> (3). The reason is that the **Higher Breaths** <note>original: נשמות (Neshamot)</note> are emanated from this place. The **Spirits** <note>original: רוחות (Ruachot)</note> come from the place of the "Hof" <unclear>perhaps a shorthand for a specific divine name or location</unclear>, and the **Souls** <note>original: נפשות (Nefashot)</note> from the *Sefirah* of **Kingdom**. These are bound to one another until they merit to be united in the *Sefirah* of **Understanding**. How so? The soul is bound to the spirit, the spirit to the higher breath, and the higher breath to the *Sefirah*...

---

<margin>
As explained above (1): several paths of the upper emanation were explained as they flow according to the will of the holy and remembered "wings" that emerge from the sides. They gather and ascend above to Understanding. This state was given as a gift, for there the flow of the revelation of powers and hosts is found. Even when evil has business, the powers of Judgment and the "awakeners" stand in their place to act according to their power and fulfill their mission... 
And this is (2) "And I will cause you to ride on the high places," therefore, etc. See also above in Gate 5 regarding the "Paths of Knowledge."
(3) The reason is that the Higher Breaths are emanated from this place, etc. This is the secret of Soul, Spirit, and Higher Breath...
(4) And this is the secret of Repentance <note>original: תשובה (Teshuvah)</note>, meaning it is called "Return" because it merits the extra souls. Likewise, in the future, through the merit of the **Great Jubilee**, all things will return to their source. The Soul, Spirit, and Higher Breath—which are Kingdom, Beauty, and Understanding—become bound to one another until the highest Sefirah, "Breath within Breath," and the soul returns to its sources, as explained above regarding the "Conclusion of the Gates."

# Gate 8

(1) **Living God** <note>original: אלהים חיים (Elohim Hayyim)</note>, as we have explained. Since the *Sefirah* <term>divine emanation</term> called **Kingdom** <note>original: מלכות (Malchut)</note> receives the flow of life from the Source of Life through the **Tree of Life** by means of **Living God** <note>original: אל חי (El Hai)</note>, (2) she is also called the **Land of the Living**, as it is said: *“I shall walk before the Lord in the lands of the living”* (Psalm 116:9). Understand this very well. And the sign for this is (3): *“See, I have set before you today life and good”* (Deuteronomy 30:15). But if, God forbid, [Israel] crosses the line, then [it brings] death and evil. We have already explained several matters regarding this secret in the first Gate.

This *Sefirah* also whitens the sins of Israel and is called **Atonements** <note>original: כפורים (Kippurim)</note>. Because she is the secret of the **Lebanon** <note>original: לבנון (Levanon); the author connects this name to the Hebrew word 'lavan' meaning white</note> which is glorious in the World of Mercy, which is entirely white. She whitens the sins of Israel. I shall now explain: We have already informed you that as long as Israel is righteous, the *Sefirah* of **Kingdom** is adorned and united with the upper *Sefirot*, like a bride donning her jewelry. But if, God forbid, Israel corrupts the path of the Torah and the commandments, their stench clings to her, as it is said: *“Because of your transgressions was your mother sent away”* (Isaiah 50:1). May He be blessed; for the sake of His mercy and kindness, He established for Israel one day a year to purify them from their impurity and to wash them, and He called it the **Day of Atonements** <note>original: יום הכפורים (Yom Ha-Kippurim)</note>. 

The reason it is called the "Day of Atonements" in the plural form is because these two *Sefirot*—the *Sefirah* of **Understanding** <note>original: בינה (Binah)</note> and the *Sefirah* of **Kingdom**—become united on that day. The *Sefirah* of **Understanding** purifies and washes away every kind of filth (4) and dirt that Israel has placed in the *Sefirah* of **Kingdom**. When these two *Sefirot* unite to reverse [the judgment] by the merit of Israel and to turn [the red of sin] into whiteness (5), they are called on account of this the **Day of Atonements**.

The prophet said: *“Though your sins be like scarlet, they shall be as white as snow”* (Isaiah 1:18). The upper one is called **Lebanon** (6), and the lower one, in its garment, is a scarlet garment. Israel must transform the scarlet garment into white. This is why it is called the **Day of Atonements**. This is the secret of the "scarlet thread" <note>A thread in the Temple that miraculously turned white on Yom Kippur as a sign of forgiveness</note> that would turn white because of the essence of the Atonements. For the nature of the *Sefirah* of **Understanding** is to shine upon the *Sefirah* of **Kingdom** and purify her from every kind of impurity (7). 

This is the secret of the **Scapegoat** <note>original: השעיר המשתלח (ha-se'ir ha-mishtale'ach)</note> sent out on this day. Since these two *Sefirot* are positioned opposite each other in the secret of the **Upper Mother** <note>original: אימא עילאה (Ima Ila'ah)</note> and the **Lower Mother** <note>original: אימא תתאה (Ima Tata'ah)</note>, out of the depths on this day through the purification of Israel (8), **marital relations** are forbidden on the Day of Atonements, while they are permitted on Sabbaths and Festivals. 

The secret known to those who know the hidden wisdom: *“And moreover, she is truly my sister; she is the daughter of my father <note>referring to Wisdom</note>, but not the daughter of my mother <note>referring to Understanding</note>, and she became my wife”* (Genesis 20:12). <gloss>See into this.</gloss> This is the secret of why it is called the Day of Atonements. Understand this very well. And this *Sefirah* is called in the language of our Sages:

->The World<-

---

Until here. (1) **Living God**, as we explained, this refers to the beginning of Gate 3. (2) She is also called **Land of the Living**, understand this [clearly], for in her receiving the flow of the blessing of life from the "Middle One," namely **Foundation** <note>original: יסוד (Yesod)</note>, according to the "Booths" of the beginning of creation, life and good descend into the world. But if the influence is entirely from the side of Judgment, then, God forbid, there is evil, as written at the end of Gate 1. This is what is brought as a sign (3): **“See, I have set before you...”** etc. (4) **Every kind of dirt and filth** that Israel placed in the *Sefirah* of **Kingdom**: meaning every kind of filth from the forces of impurity that were formed upon her to receive influence in the aspect of *Elohim* <unclear>may their name be blotted out</unclear>, the harsh judgment in the world of Israel and the worlds, as explained in Gate 2 under the nickname "Abandoned." And behold, by the influence of the *Sefirah* of **Understanding** with the power of the Mercies that come into her, she already subdues and removes that harsh Judgment which is within her, and she shows her face in the light of Mercy; this is her "whitening" and purification. (5) On account of this they are called **Day of Atonements**—two atonements as the literal meaning implies. (6) **The lower one in its garment, a scarlet garment**: meaning the sin of Israel, as it is said, *“Though your sins be like scarlet,”* they must turn this scarlet garment to white, as it is said, *“they shall be as white as snow.”* (7) And this is the secret of the **one sent out** on this day, for there was power to clean the forces of impurity from the Holy place and to establish it in its correction to its original state outside the camp, as explained in the **Recanati** <note>Menahem Recanati, a 14th-century Italian Kabbalist</note> on the Torah portion *Acharei Mot*, and there I have elaborated. (8) **Marital relations are forbidden**: because when she stands alongside her Mother’s house, her husband is not in union with her as on other Sabbaths and Festivals. At that time, she ascends in the secret of "seclusion," and there is no union of **Beauty** <note>original: תפארת (Tiferet)</note> with the **Crown** <note>original: עטרה (Atarah), another name for Kingdom</note>, for they are not in their [usual] attachment... while beneath her rotate Sabbaths and Festivals. He is the "house of the father" to her merit, **Beauty** shall hover over her, for he is mostly Kindness. And regarding the **Crown** it is said, like that which *“Your right hand has planted.”* And Abraham had a daughter, and every time, Abraham here refers to the attribute of **Kindness** <note>original: חסד (Chesed)</note>. This is what is said: *“she is truly my sister; she is the daughter of my father but not the daughter of my mother,”* meaning **Understanding**, who is the Upper Mother; if she were, she would not be his wife, and this is his union with her.

->And Abraham in this verse hints at **Beauty** <note>Tiferet</note>, who is mostly Kindness, and his arm is for the Crown.<-

# Gate 8

(9) Understand this very well. Know and believe that all those who are destined to merit and enter the World to Come <term>Olam Ha-Ba; the spiritual realm of the afterlife</term> will only enter through the process of Judgment. This is what the Sages, of blessed memory, meant when they spoke of the "three groups on the Day of Judgment." It is in that place that the reward of the righteous is given—a reward that has no comparison, no end, and no measure. This is as the Sages, of blessed memory, stated: "Rabbi Hiyya bar Abba said in the name of Rabbi Yochanan: All the prophets only prophesied for the Days of the Messiah, but as for the World to Come—'No eye has seen a God besides You, who acts for those who wait for Him'" (Isaiah 64:3). This *Sefirah* <term>divine emanation</term> is also called by the Kabbalists:

->**Upper Shekhinah**<-
<note>original: שכינה עילאה (Shekhinah Ila'ah); the "Upper Divine Presence," associated with the Sefirah of Binah (Understanding)</note>

This is because she is the secret of receiving the flow and emanation from the Upper World, which is the World of Mercy. She causes various types of abundance and emanation to flow into the rest of the *Sefirot* that are below her. When created beings fulfill the Torah and the commandments, she dwells within and reveals herself in all the other *Sefirot*, pouring out various types of abundant blessing and goodness throughout the system. Then, all the worlds are filled with goodness and blessing, and the *Sefirah* of Kingdom <note>original: מלכות (Malchut)</note>, which is called the:

**Lower Shekhinah**
<note>original: שכינה תתאה (Shekhinah Tata'ah); associated with the physical world and the indwelling presence of God among humanity</note>

also returns to pour out her blessings upon those below, dwelling among them as it is said: "And I will dwell among them" (Exodus 25:8) and "I will place My sanctuary in your midst" (Leviticus 26:11). At such a time, all the worlds are in a state of perfect rectification and filled with completion; nothing is lacking. 

However, if, God forbid, those below corrupt the line of the Torah and the commandments, the Upper Shekhinah withdraws. With her withdrawal, the spiritual channels <note>original: צנורות (tsinnorot)</note> are obstructed, the luminaries are darkened, and the "Righteous One" <note>the Sefirah of Yesod</note> is gathered in. Then the Lower Shekhinah withdraws from the lower beings, and the Upper Shekhinah withdraws from the upper beings, leading to the destruction of the world. Therefore, those who know how to acknowledge their Creator know how to rectify the path of the Shekhinah—to return her to her place and repair the damage to the channels. Then the Upper Shekhinah returns to emanate her blessings to the *Sefirot*, and the *Sefirot* pour that blessing into the Lower Shekhinah. 

Then she, too, returns to her place to pour blessing into the world. The rule of the matter is: when the Upper one withdraws, the Lower one withdraws; when the Upper one returns, the Lower one returns. There is a known secret regarding both of them: "Know this day and take it to your heart that the Lord is God in heaven above" (Deuteronomy 4:39)—this refers to the **Upper Shekhinah**—"and upon the earth below"—this refers to the **Lower Shekhinah**. Lest you say there are two authorities, Heaven forbid! They are but one alone, for "the Lord is God in heaven above and upon the earth below; there is no other." 

One who knows this great secret also knows the secret of the verse: "And the neighbor women gave him a name, saying, 'A son is born to Naomi'" (Ruth 4:17). For the one born in these "places" was the essence <note>referring to the soul of King David/the Messiah</note>, and he is the heir of a specific inheritance between the two Shekhinahs. This is the secret of: "Mount Zion, the far reaches of the north" (Psalm 48:3), "Like the dew of Hermon that descends upon the mountains of Zion, for there the Lord commanded the blessing, life forevermore" (Psalm 133:3). It also says, "The city of David, which is Zion." Understand this very well. This *Sefirah* is also called by the Kabbalists:

->**Source of Life**<-
<note>original: מקור החיים (Mekor Ha-Hayyim)</note>

Because she draws the flow of life from the World of Mercy into all existing things. And because she is the Source of Life, the *Sefirah* of **Beauty** <note>original: תפארת (Tiferet)</note> is called the **Tree of Life**, meaning the tree that draws life from the highest place. Thus, the Tree of Life is in the midst of the Garden, and the "Middle Line" pours life into the *Sefirah* of **Foundation** <note>original: יסוד (Yesod)</note>, which is called **Living God** <note>original: אל חי (El Hai)</note>, and is also called:

->**God**<-
<note>original: אלהים (Elohim)</note>

---

(1) <note>margin: Understand this: they linked it to the Lower Justice which was always judged by him, deciding the laws as explained above in the first reason.</note> 
(2) <note>margin: And it is written: "And I will dwell in their midst" (Exodus 25:8), meaning when the Upper Shekhinah dwells within all the Sefirot and pours into them.</note> 
(3) <note>margin: "And upon the earth below"—this is the Lower [Shekhinah]. This is the secret of what the Sages said many times: there is a Shekhinah below and a Shekhinah above.</note> 
(4) <note>margin: "And he is the heir of a special inheritance between the two Shekhinahs." Although the Kabbalists interpreted this verse regarding souls that merit the Shekhinah, who are called her children... the author here seems to suggest that the merit refers to the two Shekhinahs mentioned, who sanctified the one born there. For the souls that merit in the world are a house of holiness... and that newborn also had his source and inheritance in the Foundation (Yesod), which stands between the two Shekhinahs. For Zion is the City of David, his inheritance... and the essence of this newborn was the purpose... since he is the essence of the Sefirah of Yesod.</note>

# Gate 8

<margin>91</margin>
...all kinds of abundance and blessing, until the *Sefirah* of Kingdom <note>original: מלכות (Malchut)</note> pours out her blessings without end. But if, God forbid, human beings corrupt their ways and their actions, then the attribute of Understanding <note>original: בינה (Binah)</note>—which is the "World to Come"—withholds the flow of her blessings. She does not pour them out except in a restricted measure, in a manner where blessing is not found except in a tiny amount, just enough so that the world is not completely destroyed. It is as if there were no blessing there at all. Furthermore, that small amount that "drips" from the *Sefirah* of Understanding (A) does not arrive through the proper channels <term>tzinorot; the spiritual conduits through which divine energy flows</term> to the *Sefirah* of Kingdom, for all the channels have been corrupted. Thus, the *Sefirah* of Kingdom is left dry, and that meager dripping leaks here and there through the fractures, so that no blessing is found there at all. 

This is like a parable of water pipes that have been damaged and broken: the water coming through those pipes spills out through the cracks and fractures here and there, such that no benefit comes from them. When the remaining water in the pipes reaches the desired destination, it has been so diminished by the corruption of the cracks and breaks that not enough remains to water the land, to drink, or to satisfy other needs. Thus, a curse is found in the world. Furthermore, those waters that spill out through the cracks and fractures go to places where they were not intended to go, until those places find themselves receiving benefit during the time of corruption. Regarding this, it is said: "Under a hated woman when she is married; and a handmaid that is heir to her mistress; under a servant when he reigns; and a fool when he is filled with food" <note>Proverbs 30:21-23. The author uses these verses to describe how the "External Forces" or unworthy nations receive the divine flow that "leaks" from the broken system.</note>.

If you understand the great principles we are explaining here, you will enter many chambers of wisdom. You will understand and grasp the reason why the Land of Israel is completely desolate while the lands of the nations are not totally destroyed. Now, if you should challenge this and say: "Is it not so that the Land of Israel (B) 'gives rain upon the face of the earth,' and the other lands are blessed through it?" as it is said: "And through you shall all the families of the earth be blessed" <note>Genesis 12:3</note>. And it also says: (B) "Who gives rain upon the face of the earth, and sends waters upon the face of the fields" <note>Job 5:10</note>. By law, once the flow is cut off from the Land of Israel, the other lands should be utterly destroyed, since their blessings depend entirely on hers! 

Know that if the channels had not been corrupted and developed cracks and breaks, what you say would be true. But since they have been corrupted, cracked, and broken, the water drips here and there, and by that dripping, the other lands are sustained. Despite this, no true blessing is found in that dripping, for blessing is only present in all the lands when they (C) drink by way of the Land of Israel, as it is said: "And through you shall all the families of the earth be blessed." 

Understand this very well. Here, a great and distinguished matter has been explained to you regarding the secret of drawing down abundance through the *Sefirah* of Understanding, whether in a time of favor or a time of anger and corruption. You will see hidden things revealed before you. Indeed, regarding other matters of the "World to Come," you will yet hear many wonders and many pearls of wisdom, God willing. But for what we need to explain in this work of ours, what we have mentioned is sufficient.

Know that this *Sefirah* <note>Understanding/Binah</note> is called the **Great Shofar** <term>Shofar Gadol; the ritual ram's horn, here symbolizing the cosmic blast that grants freedom</term> (D). The reason is that this *Sefirah* is called "Jubilee" <note>original: יובל (Yovel); the fiftieth year in the biblical cycle when slaves were freed and debts forgiven</note>, and this is the Great Shofar through which servants go out to freedom. The sign of this matter is the Yom Kippur of the Jubilee year. If (E) you contemplate well on what was explained previously in this gate regarding this *Sefirah*...

<header>Gate 8</header>

# The World to Come

->(Indeed. The secret of "Three books are opened," etc.)<-

And because it is called *Kippurim* <note>original: כפורים (Atonement)</note> as we have explained, and it is the secret of life as we have written, we pray on the Day of Atonement: "Inscribe us for life in the Book of Life" in that specific *Sefirah* <term>Sefirah; one of the ten divine attributes or emanations in Kabbalah</term>. Many of the great sages of these generations have erred in their understanding of the "knowledge of life" that we request from the New Year <note>Rosh Hashanah</note> until the Day of Atonement <note>Yom Kippur</note>; they could "not find their hands or feet" <note>a Hebrew idiom meaning they were utterly confused</note> and were forced into many far-fetched interpretations. 

The essential truth is this: we pray from the New Year until the Day of Atonement that we may merit to be pure from the impurities of our sins, and that we merit to be written in the Book of the Righteous in the World of Life—which is the World to Come—regardless of whether we live through that entire year or die during that year <margin>(A)</margin>, for the decree is written in the Book of the Righteous, which is the Book of Life <margin>(B)</margin>, as it says: *“Everyone who is recorded for life in Jerusalem”* <note>Isaiah 4:3</note>. Within this, we also ask in the rest of the prayer services, such as in the "May there ascend and come" <note>original: Ya'aleh Ve-Yavo; a prayer for festivals</note> and other places, that we be "established" throughout the year with a good life, that we may live and not die. We do the same on other Festivals and New Moons. 

However, the specific phrases "Remember us for life" and "Inscribe us in the Book of Life" that we say on the New Year and the Day of Atonement refer only to being counted among the ranks of the righteous who are worthy of the life of the World to Come, whether we physically live that year or die. This is what the Sages, of blessed memory, meant when they said <margin>(C)</margin>: "Three books are opened on the New Year: one for the perfectly righteous, one for the perfectly wicked, and one for the intermediate." 

If you contemplate this law deeply, your eyes will see and your heart will rejoice; you will be freed from many doubts, and your mind will find rest regarding the method of the Talmud in explaining what we have said. The Talmud’s precision is evident in its choice of the categories "righteous," "wicked," and "intermediate." For if you were to say that the intention of our Sages in this place was to request the life of this world or a "good life," then you would find no dead person who could be counted among the righteous, and no person alive during that year who could be counted among the wicked <note>This refers to the observable reality where righteous people die and wicked people remain alive during the year</note>. Thus, several foundations of the Torah would be uprooted from their place. 

But the truth and the straight path is that the intention of what they instituted for the New Year and the Day of Atonement—in "Remember us for life" and "Inscribe us in the Book of Life"—is that God should atone for our iniquities, forgive our sins, and write us with the righteous who are worthy of the life of the World to Come. They are written in the Book of Life whether they physically live or die. Guard this principle very closely and do not look at any other interpretation that opposes it in this matter. 

Because this *Sefirah* is the World of Life, it is called the World to Come <note>original: ע"ה - Olam Ha-Ba</note>. The reason it is called the "Coming World" is that it is constantly drawing forth its blessings, coming every day, every moment, and every hour, influencing the world with blessings. As it is said: *“And a river goes out of Eden,”* meaning <margin>(D)</margin> that it never ceases, like a spring and a source of water whose waters do not fail. It is called the "Coming World" because it is always "going and coming." 

And if you should say: "But did you not say that its blessings sometimes cease if the people of the world sin?" Know that the intention is not to say that the blessings cease entirely, but rather that if human beings straighten their ways below, then the Upper World pours out blessings without end and without limit. Then the storehouses of the pillars of the *Sefirot* are filled with everything...

You must know that the two Sefirot, which are the names *YHVH* and *ADNY* <note>The Tetragrammaton and the name Adonai</note>, correspond to one another. The upper one is called **Praise** (*Tehillah*) and the lower one is called **Prayer** (*Tefillah*). The reason is that the upper one <note>Binah</note> is attached to the "Head of the Degrees," and from her come all types of emanation, flow, blessing, and life. Therefore, she is called **Praise**; that is to say, it is upon us to laud and praise the One who performed all these miracles for us and our ancestors and brought us out from slavery to freedom—for this reason, she is called **Praise**.

The lower one <note>Malkhut/Kingship</note> is called **Prayer**. The reason is that the lower one is attached to the secret of prayers and supplications because of the multitude of sins and "stains" by which we have sinned, which "stain" the Judgments attached to her. Therefore, the Sefirah of **Malkhut** <term>Malkhut; the final Sefirah, representing the Shekhinah or Divine Presence in the world</term> is the secret of **Prayer**. The sign for this is <note>The Hebrew letter 'Zayin' (ז)</note>: *“But I am prayer”* <note>Psalm 109:4</note>. This is the secret of: *“O God, do not keep silence; do not hold Your peace”* <note>Psalm 83:2</note>. Because **Prayer** is attached to this attribute, the gates of all prayers were established in the Name unique to her, which is *Adonai*. They arranged it at the start of all prayers: *“Adonai, open my lips, and my mouth shall declare Your praise”* <note>Psalm 51:17</note>. This is the "gate" of all prayers, as we wrote in the First Gate.

However, the Sefirah of **Binah**, which is attached to the "Head of the Degrees," and from which life, blessings, and all types of emanation, existence, and endurance come, is the secret of **Praise** (*Tehillah*). This means to praise, laud, glorify, and exalt for all the goodness, miracles, and wonders that He performs with us constantly, for she is the secret of Freedom and Redemption, as we have written. When she appears, miracles and wonders appear for Israel.

Behold, the secret of <note>The Hebrew letter 'Ayin' (ע)</note> **Prayer** is the matter of supplications and the seeking of mercy: to have mercy on us, to forgive our sins, to save us from our troubles, to fulfill our lacks, to keep us alive, and to guard us from all types of destroyers and calamities, and all such requests that depend on prayer. All these things are attached to the Sefirah of **Malkhut**.

But the secret of **Praise** is *after* the Lord has accepted our prayer, and after He has heard our voice, accepted our supplications, forgiven our sins, brought us back from our troubles, fulfilled our lacks, and guarded us from all types of destroyers and calamities. Then, a duty is incumbent upon us to praise and laud before Him for the abundance of goodness He has bestowed upon us. Now see the difference between **Praise** (*Tehillah*) and **Prayer** (*Tefillah*): **Prayer** is attached to the Sefirah of **Malkhut**, while **Praise** is attached to the Sefirah of **Binah**, which is the secret of Redemption, Freedom, and all types of salvations. Therefore, everyone is worthy of **Prayer**, but not everyone is worthy of **Praise**. For with **Prayer**, each person prays according to their own pain and trouble. But **Praise** is specifically for thanking and lauding the Name for the greatness of His goodness that He has performed. And who is it that can sufficiently extend His praise? Therefore, it is said: *“For the upright, praise is comely”* <note>Psalm 33:1</note>.

# Gate 8

...and count fifty days <note>original: "u-sefartem hamishim yom"; refers to the Counting of the Omer between Passover and Shavuot</note>, which is the cause for the Giving of the Torah. On Sukkot, there are eight days including the festival of Atzeret <note>Shemini Atzeret, the "Eighth Day of Assembly"</note>. 

We have already informed you that these are the eight Sefirot <term>Sefirot; the ten creative forces or attributes through which God interacts with the world</term> that begin to be counted from the Sefirah of **Binah** <term>Binah; "Understanding," the third Sefirah and the source of liberation</term>, with the seven beneath it; they are "a portion for seven and also for eight" <note>Ecclesiastes 11:2</note>.

And behold, they hinted that "He" <note>Hebrew: *Hu*. In Kabbalah, the pronoun "He" often refers to the hidden, transcendent aspect of God associated with Binah</note> is fifty, and "He" is eight, and the wise shall understand. But the eight days of Hanukkah, for which the Sages established the miracle of the oil, comes from the **Will** <note>Hebrew: *Ratzon*; a reference to the highest divine intent</note> to the Sefirah of **Binah**. And **Binah** is the secret of the Menorah <note>The seven-branched candelabrum</note> and its lamps, as it is said: *"Toward the face of the Menorah shall the seven lamps shed light"* <note>Numbers 8:2</note>. 

The Menorah and the lamps are meant for "opening blind eyes": *"Open Your eyes and see"* <note>Daniel 9:18</note>. For the eight days of Hanukkah are the secret of the matter and the great miracle. Those who know the foundations of these things know that the miracle performed with the oil through the Sefirah of **Binah** occurs because the "birth" of the oil is from there, from the Supernal **Will**. 

Accordingly, the Menorah, the lamps, and the oil are the secret of all the Sefirot. The one who reveals this secret is the Menorah of the prophet Zechariah and the "two golden pipes that empty the gold from themselves" <note>Zechariah 4:12</note>, which do not need to bring oil from another place. Rather, the two pipes empty the celestial "olive oil" upon it. One who understands (7) this will understand the secret of **Ya-H** <note>The first two letters of God's Name (Yod and He), representing the union of Wisdom and Understanding</note>, and the secret of *"Let every soul praise the Lord [Ya-H]"* <note>Psalm 150:6</note>, and the secret of the complete Hallel <term>Hallel; "Praise," specific psalms of thanksgiving recited on festivals</term> during the eight days of Hanukkah.

Behold, we have hinted to you great, strong, and deep hints through which you can contemplate the secret of Hallel and the secret of every place where "Tehillah" <term>Tehillah; "Praise" or "Psalm," specifically referring here to the Sefirah of Binah or Malchut in a state of praise</term> is mentioned. Not for nothing did the Sages say: *"Anyone who says 'A Psalm of David' [Tehillah Le-David] every day is assured that they are a child of the World to Come"* <note>Talmud, Berakhot 4b. This refers to Psalm 145, known as Ashrei</note>. 

Great things were hinted at here, for the secret of *Tehillah* is the secret of the World to Come, as explained in this gate. Do not find it difficult and ask: "But did the Sages not say that anyone who recites the complete Hallel every day is like one who blasphemes and reviles?" <note>Talmud, Shabbat 118b. This warning exists because Hallel is reserved for specific miraculous occasions</note>. 

Complete Hallel is one thing, and *Tehillah* is another. Complete Hallel (5) is only said at a designated time. *Tehillah* is the secret of the arrangement and the rectification of the Sefirah, its longing and its ascents, but it is not the "body" of the Hallel itself. 

Therefore they said: *"Anyone who says Tehillah Le-David..."*—meaning anyone who says this psalm every day, which begins with the language of *Tehillah* (the secret of the Sefirah of **Binah**) and contains many yearnings and ascents from the two Sefirot established one for the other, which are **Binah** and **Malchut** <term>Malchut; "Kingship," the final Sefirah that receives the divine flow and manifests it in our world</term>—is assured to be a child of the World to Come. And if you merit to enter the "chambers of the levels" within this psalm, you shall see and rejoice.

After you know this, contemplate the secret of **Malchut**, which is associated with the Name **ADON-AY**, which is the secret of Prayer, as explained in the First Gate. It is the gate through which one enters to reach the Sefirah of *Tehillah*, which is eighth to it. Therefore, the Psalmist included them as one in this verse, saying first: *"Lord [Adonai], open my lips"* <note>Psalm 51:17</note>—which is the secret of Prayer—and afterwards: *"and my mouth shall declare Your praise [Tehillatekha]"*. Meaning: by being worthy to arrange the Prayer properly, I shall merit to be fit to offer *Tehillah*. 

As we explained: *"Praise [Tehillah] is becoming to the upright"* <note>Psalm 33:1</note>, and as we explained the verse: *"My glory I will not give to another, nor My praise [Tehillati] to graven images"* <note>Isaiah 42:8</note>. Keep these foundations regarding the matter of *Tehillah* and Prayer. And this Sefirah is the second letter of the Four-Letter Name...

***

The Torah was given through **Gevurah** <term>Gevurah; "Might" or "Judgment"</term> and it is a miracle. Likewise, the power of Prayer is the "Written Torah," and it is also the "Great Assembly" and the reception of all goodness, as explained at the beginning of this gate. 

(a) "He" is fifty: the secret of Hanukkah. The wise will understand that **Binah** is the eighth in the simple count [from the bottom], and it is the Fiftieth Gate. It includes the seven beneath it; each one is included in the others (meaning, all seven are contained in each). Thus there are forty-nine gates, and the Fiftieth Gate is like the Sefirah above, representing the logic of the Atzeret [Assembly].

(b) Regarding the Menorah: He explained that the branches are the seven Sefirot, and the Menorah hints to **Binah**, for its foundation was like the "body" of the Menorah for the seven branches. The oil is the flow that comes from the Supernal **Keter** <term>Keter; "Crown," the highest Sefirah</term> and **Chokhmah** <term>Chokhmah; "Wisdom"</term> to **Binah**, and from **Binah** to the seven branches. 

The Menorah, the lamps, the two pipes, and the two olives also hint to the Name *Ya-H*, for the two pipes emptying from the two olives above the bowl of the Menorah and its seven lamps hint to the oil that descends from the power of **Keter-Chokhmah** upon **Binah** and the seven Sefirot. This is the secret of the Kingdom of God. 

(c) "They do not need to bring oil from another place," because from there [the Supernal source] is the "birth" of the oil that descends. 

(d) One who understands this will understand the secret of **Ya-H**. All of this is what we intended by this title at the beginning. 

(e) "For complete Hallel is not said except at a known time." This means specifically on a holiday, to mention the powers of this attribute regarding miracles and wonders; this is not appropriate at all times or in all places, as I wrote above. 

But *Tehillah Le-David* [Psalm 145] is the secret of mentioning the "rectification" of Prayer and its yearnings to provide the "will" of sustenance and livelihood to every living thing through **Malchut**. This is what a person needs every day. Therefore, it is appropriate for a person to mention it and awaken it immediately upon rising to request and pray for their needs before the Blessed Name.

## Gate 8

(1) <margin>(1) The aspect of Tehillah [Praise]; for the Foundation [the Sefirah of Yesod] knows who is worthy to speak in praise and who is worthy to remain silent. For a multitude of words in praise—while they are indeed praise and Hallel [exaltation] fitting for the Blessed One—are only fitting in accordance with our own merit. However, in relation to the Blessed One’s own essence, such words are entirely insufficient and represent a great deficiency in His true strength, as is explained by the scholars who speak of the Divine attributes and how a person should be tested and distinguished by them.</margin> And we must awaken you to great principles that our Sages hinted at concerning the matter of *Tehillah* <term>Tehillah; a specific form of "Praise" often associated with the Sefirah of Binah</term>, to make known that not every person is worthy to praise, and not every hour is fitting for praise. Because this level is so very great, they said in the first chapter of Tractate Berakhot: Rabbi Shimon ben Pazi said, "David spoke one hundred and three chapters in the Book of Psalms, and he did not say 'Halleluiah' <note>original: "Halleluyah"; literally "Praise Yah"</note> until he saw the downfall of the wicked, as it is said: *'Let sinners cease from the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless the Lord, O my soul. Halleluiah'* <note>Psalm 104:35</note>." 

Now, consider two great things they hinted at: The first is that it is not fitting to mention the matter of *Tehillah* except in a place where it is "prepared"—meaning, to perform miracles and wonders and to destroy the wicked, just as He did in Egypt, where the first Hallel <term>Hallel; a prayer of praise consisting of Psalms 113–118</term> was said, as it is written: *"The song shall be for you as on the night a festival is sanctified"* <note>Isaiah 30:29</note>. And the second point is that even though David saw many wonders of the Lord, he did not find the heart to mention Hallel except in a matter truly worthy of Hallel. 

Consider a parable: A person who wears royal garments while engaged in a lowly task—is there any greater disgrace than this? Therefore, the Sages said: "One who recites the 'Great Hallel' every day is considered a blasphemer and a curser" <note>Talmud, Shabbat 118b; this refers to reciting Hallel when it is not liturgically required, which cheapens the praise</note>. And because of the great height of the Sefirah of **Binah** <term>Binah; "Understanding," the source of divine emanation and liberation</term>, it is not fitting to mention its praises except in the places and times worthy of mention. And behold, the prophet proclaims: *"I am the Lord, that is My name; and My glory I will not give to another, nor My praise [Tehillah] to idols"* <note>Isaiah 42:8</note>. Would it ever enter your mind that His praise could actually be given to idols? Rather, this is a matter well known to the Kabbalists: any prayer that is not proper is called "disqualified" <note>original: "pasulah," a wordplay on "pesilim," meaning idols</note>. 

(2) <margin>(2) This tradition was held by them, as explained above at the end of the second Gate [Sha'ar Bet].</margin> And there was a tradition held by the RaN <note>Likely referring to a specific teacher or Rabbeinu Nissim, though in this context it refers to a Kabbalistic lineage</note>, and such is the explanation of the verse: One who does not enter to serve within the Sefirah of **Malchut** <term>Malchut; "Kingdom," the lowest Sefirah and the gateway to the divine</term>—which is the lowest point—during the time of prayer, how is it possible for him to enter before the Heights of the levels, before the Sefirah of **Binah**? "Praise is becoming to the upright" <note>Psalm 33:1</note>, but not to "idols" [unworthy prayers]. Understand this well. 

And now you must consider that we have already explained earlier in this Gate that the *Neshamah* <term>Neshamah; the highest level of the soul, associated with the intellect and divine breath</term> is attached to the Sefirah of **Tehillah** [Binah]. The *Ruach* <term>Ruach; the middle level of the soul, associated with spirit and emotion</term> is attached to the Sefirah of **Tiferet** <term>Tiferet; "Beauty," the central Sefirah</term>. And the *Nefesh* <term>Nefesh; the lowest level of the soul, associated with physical vitality</term> is attached to the Sefirah of **Malchut**. And behold, David explained this matter in secret and said: *"Let every soul [Neshamah] praise [Tehalleil] Yah. Halleluiah"* <note>Psalm 150:6</note>. 

(3) <margin>(3) And the name Yah [YH] is known to hint at the three upper Sefirot, as explained above in the explanation of the second letter of the Name. Therefore, see Gate 9.</margin> It is already known to the Kabbalists that the name **Yah** hints at the three upper Sefirot; therefore, the *Neshamah* shall praise **Yah**, because of the connection between the *Neshamah* and that Praise, which is why it says, *"Let every Neshamah praise Yah."* And if you should say: "But it is written, *'Praise [Halleli], my Nefesh, the Lord [YHWH]'* <note>Psalm 146:1</note>—behold, Hallel is dependent on the *Nefesh*!" Know that the Hallel of the *Neshamah* depends on the name **Yah**, while the Hallel of the *Nefesh* depends on the name **YHWH**, for within it is included the Sefirah of **Malchut**, which is the secret of the final letter **He** [H] of the Name. 

There are two kinds of Hallel: "Complete Hallel" and "Incomplete Hallel" <note>In Jewish law, "Complete Hallel" includes all the verses, while "Incomplete Hallel" omits certain parts on specific days</note>. Complete Hallel depends on the Sefirah of **Binah**, a place where there is no lack of any kind and where no blemish ever attaches, because she is above all the "Princes" [heavenly powers] and is attached to the World of Mercy. But Incomplete Hallel depends on the Sefirah of **Malchut**; and because the **Malchut** is sometimes "breached" and a blemish attaches to it when Israel sins and provokes anger, so too the Incomplete Hallel—which is said with "skipping" [omitting verses]—is called in reference to it. This is the secret of Complete Hallel and Incomplete Hallel. Understand this well.

For all things cascade and descend from above, and on the day the moon is renewed below, so it is above... they recite Hallel because of its blemish and its occasional separation.</margin> was blemished and returned to be renewed. But the Hallel for miracles and wonders, and the Hallel for joys and good things—such as the Hallel of Passover, Shavuot, and Sukkot—at those times the Sefirah of **Binah** shines forth. On Passover, fifty [gates/days] the Children of Israel ascended, and through it they were redeemed. # The Ninth Name of the Holy Names

This is the name called **YAH**. You must know that the Great Name, which is the Blessed YHVH, is called the "Unique Name" (A) <note>original: "Shem HaMeyuchad"</note>, which is to say it is the mystery of the unity of all ten Sefirot as one (B). We have already explained that the first two Sefirot <term>Sefirot; the ten creative powers or attributes of God in Kabbalah</term> are included in the letter *Yod* of the Unique Name: the "tip of the Yod" is the mystery of the *Keter* (Crown), and the body of the *Yod* is the mystery of *Chokhmah* (Wisdom). The third Sefirah, which unites with both of them, is the mystery of *Binah* (Understanding), which is included in the mystery of the "First *He*" of the Name.

Thus, we find the first two letters of the Name are both included within the three Upper Sefirot. The letter *Vav* of the Name includes six Sefirot: three from the upper half of the letter *Vav*—which are *Gedulah* (Greatness/Mercy), *Gevurah* (Might), and *Tiferet* (Beauty)—and three from the lower half of the letter *Vav*—which are *Netzach* (Victory), *Hod* (Splendor), and *Yesod* (Foundation). The final Sefirah of the Name, which is the tenth, is included in the final letter of the Name, which is the letter *He*.

Now, we must inform you of the reason why the first two letters of the Name are pronounced on their own, while the last two letters of the Name are not pronounced on their own. You already know what we explained regarding the two *He* letters of the Name: the First *He*, which is Understanding, has the seven lower Sefirot united with it. The Final *He*, which is *Malkhut* (Kingship), is united with the nine upper Sefirot through the Foundation. The bottom line is that the core of all ten Sefirot is the three Upper Sefirot, from which all seven lower ones are nourished. If, Heaven forbid, the flow of the Three were to cease, then we would find the destruction of the Temple, the burning of the Sanctuary, and the exile of the children among the nations.

Therefore, the first half of the Name, which is **YAH**, can be pronounced on its own. But the second half of the Name, which is **VH**, cannot be pronounced on its own, for that would be "cutting the saplings" <note>original: "Katzitzah BaNetiot"; a Talmudic metaphor for heresy or causing a division within the divine unity</note>. For the upper realms do not depend on the lower ones. Furthermore, in its numerical value, it does not equal the full Name. But when you call upon **YAH**, the final half of the Name is also included within it, and this is not considered a "cutting" or division. Thus (C), its spelled-out numerical value in the mystery of *Yod-He* <note>original: "Yod-He" spelled as YVD-HA</note> equals twenty-six, so the half is like the whole. This applies to the first half of the Name, but the standing and existence of the final half of the Name is only through the mystery of **YAH**.

We must also awaken you to the many places in the Torah where the name **YAH** is mentioned, such as: "For a hand is upon the throne of YAH; the LORD will have war with Amalek from generation to generation" <note>Exodus 17:16</note>. This is the explanation of the verse: Amalek the wicked came from the power of the Primordial Serpent (D), and there is his attachment and his strength. From the moment the Primordial Serpent cast his filth into Eve, Adam "cut the saplings" above and separated the "Chieftain" <note>A reference to God as the "Aluph" or Master of the world</note>. This is the mystery of the departure of the Divine Presence (*Shekhinah*), whose primary dwelling (E) was among the lower beings and not...

## The Ninth Gate

(A) **Meaning the mystery of the unity of all 10 Sefirot as one:** This refers to the way all five Sefirot [of the lower structure] are shaped according to the whole, as will be explained further.

(B) **And we have already explained:** This was in Gate 5, in the explanation of the small and large letters. The entire matter mentioned here proceeds from the mystery of the letters included in the first ones of Gate 8.

(C) **And so its spelled-out value in the mystery of Yod-He:** Meaning the letters of *YAH* in their full spelling (*Yod* + *He*) equal the number twenty-six, just like the full Four-Letter Name. Thus, the half [of the Name] contains our lower world.

(D) **For there is his attachment and his strength:** Meaning the attachment and strength of Amalek is within them [the forces of the Serpent].

<header>### Gate 5</header>

**(6)** This is the mystery of the first *He* <term>He; the fifth letter of the Hebrew alphabet, which appears twice in the four-letter Name of God, YHVH</term> of the Name YHVH, may He be blessed. We have already informed you in this gate how these two *Sefirot* <term>Sefirot; the ten divine attributes or emanations in Kabbalah</term>—which are *Binah* (Understanding) and *Malkhut* (Kingdom)—are aligned with one another within the [structure of] the eight *Sefirot*. These are what are called throughout the entire Torah "Lord God" <note>original: "YHVH Adonai"</note> when they appear as one, as we have explained.

Behold, the mystery of *Binah* is the gate to the upper *Sefirot*, and from it, the seven lower *Sefirot* receive an abundance of blessing. Similarly, the *Sefirah* of *Malkhut* is the gate to all ten *Sefirot*, and from it, all beings in the world—both celestial and terrestrial—receive an abundance of blessing, existence, and stability. Behold, the *Sefirah* of *Malkhut* is a receptacle for all the blessings coming from the *Sefirah* of *Binah*. Therefore, this one mirrors that one, and both *Binah* and *Malkhut* are the mystery of the two letters *He* found in the Name YHVH, may He be blessed. The first *He* is *Binah*; the last *He* is *Malkhut*.

Behold, *Malkhut* receives the mystery of the abundance of blessings drawn down from *Binah*, as explained. Therefore:
*   This one is the Sabbatical Year <note>original: "Shemittah," referring to Malkhut</note> and that one is the Jubilee <note>original: "Yovel," referring to Binah</note>.
*   This one is the Upper Divine Presence <note>original: "Shekhinah Ila'ah"</note> and that one is the Lower Divine Presence <note>original: "Shekhinah Tata'ah"</note>.
*   This one is the Upper Mother and that one is the Lower Mother.
*   This one is the gatehouse for the upper *Sefirot* and that one is the gatehouse for the lower *Sefirot*.

Through the first *He*, all the other *Sefirot* receive blessings; and through the last *He*, all created beings receive blessings and existence. This one is called "Praise" <note>original: "Tehillah"</note> and that one is called "Prayer" <note>original: "Tefillah"</note>. This one is called "Atonement" <note>original: "Kippur"</note> and that one is called "Atonements" <note>original: "Kippurim"</note>. This one is called "the eighth" and that one is called "the eighth"—from the top down, *Malkhut* is the eighth; from the bottom up, *Binah* is the eighth, because the two highest *Sefirot* are included within *Binah* as explained. This is the mystery of the verse: "On the eighth day, it shall be a restriction <note>original: "Atzeret," often translated as a festive assembly</note> for you" (Numbers 29:35), as we have already clarified above.

Hold fast to a great principle regarding these two *Sefirot*, *Binah* and *Malkhut*: we have already informed you that both are aligned with one another and receive an abundance of blessing from each other. Now you must know that both are the mystery of the "Stewards" <term>Parnassim; divine administrators or providers</term> into whose hands the seal of the entire Name YHVH, may He be blessed, is entrusted. 

The Upper *He*, which is *Binah*, is the mystery of the Upper Steward from whom all the *Sefirot* receive abundance and blessing. Therefore, you will find that the seal of the entire Name is entrusted to her; for the Name is written as YHVH but is vocalized with the vowels of *Elohim* (God), and it is called by its name in this way: YHVH read as *Elohim*. Thus, the Name is read according to its vocalization because she [Binah] bears the entire seal.

The last *He*, which is *Malkhut*, is the mystery of the Great Final Steward from whom the world of angels receives its station, rest, abundance, sustenance, and life. Likewise, the world of the heavens—the sun, moon, and stars—and the hosts of the earth—metals, plants, and living creatures of all kinds—all receive the power of existence, stability, and life as is fitting from the *Sefirah* of *Malkhut*, which is the mystery of the last *He* of the Name. Therefore, you will find that the seal of the entire Name is entrusted to her; she is called by His Name in this way: it is written YHVH but read as *Adonai* (Lord). Thus, the Name is read according to the vocalization.

You have thus learned that the Name YHVH, may He be blessed, has two vocalizations in the Torah. One is the vocalization of *Elohim*, which is the mystery of *Binah*, in this manner: YHVH [vocalized as Elohim] in the verse "Lord God <note>original: "Adonai YHVH"</note>, how shall I know that I will inherit it?" (Genesis 15:8), and others like it. The second is the vocalization of *Adonai*, which is the mystery of *Malkhut*, in this manner: YHVH throughout the entire Torah. 

If you contemplate this great principle that we have placed in your hand here, you will understand the mystery of the two letters *He* in the Name—how they are aligned against one another, and the keys of the Name are in their hands, one above and one below. Through the vocalization of both of them, the Name is read throughout the Torah, not by one vocalization alone. From this, you will understand the mystery of the Divine Presence <note>original: "Shekhinah"</note> in the union of the two letters *He*. Both have a single intention; one draws from the other, and everything is a perfect unity for the Blessed Name. He who knows how to direct his heart to the mystery of these two letters *He* in the Name must <note>reference to footnote (50)</note>(50) focus his intention at the time of unification <note>original: "Yihud"</note>, for in both of them lies the mystery of perfect unity. Of both of them it is said: "The Lord shall be one and His Name one" (Zechariah 14:9)—to align one against the other and to join the *Sefirot* together. This is the essence for those who know the essence of the tradition...

(A) It seems likely to me that although *Binah* is called *Kippur* (Atonement), and the term *Kippur* refers to the five sources of fire <note>original: "dinur," likely referring to the "river of fire" or divine judgments</note>, she is called *Kippurim* [plural] above... as I have written in this gate. We have already explained this earlier in the chapters of this gate. 

(B) One must focus their intention at the time of unification—meaning at the time of reciting the *Shema* <note>The central Jewish prayer "Hear O Israel," affirming God's unity</note> according to the opinion of "Hear O Israel," etc., and to fulfill "Y-H is one," for in both of them is the mystery of the Great Unity, as we have explained above in the prayer of this gate and at its end.
