# Gate 10

Those twelve permutations of the **Unique Name** <note>The Tetragrammaton, Y-H-V-H</note> and the **Central Column** <note>The middle path of the Sefirot tree, balancing Mercy and Judgment</note> that mediates between them are the mystery of the twelve attributes that sustain **Judgment** <note>Din</note> and **Compassion** <note>Rachamim</note>. When the supreme attributes shine forth from the level of **Keter** <note>The Crown</note>—associated with the Name **Ehyeh** <note>I Will Be; Exodus 3:14</note>, which is entirely compassionate—then all the worlds and all the **Sefirot** <note>Divine emanations</note> are filled with blessing, life, mercy, and every kind of abundance. (B) We have already explained in the first gate how the Name **Y-H-V-H** stands in the middle of two other Names: **Ehyeh** <note>at the top</note> and the Name **Adonai** <note>My Lord; at the bottom</note>. The Name **Adonai** acts as a storehouse to receive all the types of abundance coming from both of them. 

Now I shall explain: Know that when the Name **Ehyeh** is above in the **World of Compassion**, and the Name **Y-H-V-H** is in the middle in the **World of Justice**, and the Name **Adonai** is below in the **World of Final Judgment**, you must understand how they operate when they are joined together or (C) when each one acts on its own. Know that the action of the Supreme Name, which is:

->**Ehyeh**<-

Prior to the ten Names <note>the ten Sefirot</note> are the four letters <note>A-H-Y-H</note>, and their doubling creates forms within the "depth of the Hand" <note>Hebrew: *Yad*, also the number 14</note>. The *Yud* was the middle point of the *Yah* <note>Y-H</note>, and these are the twenty permutations; the whole is called the **Point of Compassion** and the source of all mercy. (C) This middle point is the mystery of *Yah Y-H-V-H*. 

These are the **Thirteen Supreme Attributes of Mercy**, which are entirely and greatly compassionate. They are the "Twelve Repairs of the Beard" <note>Hebrew: *Tikunei Dikna*; a Kabbalistic metaphor for the channels of divine grace</note> which were established and which I mentioned above in Gate 5 regarding the order of prayer. The prophet <note>Micah</note> mentioned them in the verse: *"Who is a God like You..."* <note>Micah 7:18</note>. [The verse continues:] *"Who pardons iniquity..."* and *"passes over transgression."* First is the abundance of the heart's desire; *"He does not retain His anger forever"* is the fifth, *"because He delights in kindness."* *"He will again have compassion on us; He will subdue our iniquities."* *"You will be truthful"* and *"You will cast all our sins into the depths of the sea."* *"You will show faithfulness to Jacob and kindness to Abraham, as You have sworn to our ancestors"*—twelve—*"from days of old"*—thirteen. 

Corresponding to these below are the thirteen attributes [of the Name] (A) <note>from Exodus 34:6</note> "The Lord, the Lord, God, Merciful and Gracious..." and so on. Why did [Moses] not recite those supreme attributes [from Micah]? Because at that moment, he was standing in the place of **Judgment**, and those attributes were linked to Judgment. Therefore, he did not say those exact ones, for they are in the place of Judgment, and these attributes are composed of both Judgment and Compassion, where the attribute of Justice stands. 

However, the prophet <note>Micah</note> at that time was standing and arranging the praise of the **Ancient of Days** <note>Aramaic: *Atik Yomin*; the most hidden level of the Divine</note> and saw the thirteen repairs of the Beard that decide all judgments. Facing the thirteen supreme judgments which are all mercy, he saw the holy supreme image of the "Hidden One" which is never interrupted. Because of this, "all eyes are mended and strengthened by these repairs" <note>original Aramaic: *v-bgini kakh kol eini katishen v-takifin b-tikuni*; quoting Zohar, Parashat Kedoshim</note>. 

And in the portion of *Acharei Mot*, it is taught: "In thirteen qualities is [the Beard] repaired... three by three... and the Holy One, blessed be He, is found in them three times." Through these, it is possible for prayer to be "crowned." These are also the thirteen attributes by which the Torah is interpreted <note>the hermeneutic rules of Rabbi Ishmael, such as *Kal Va-Chomer* (a fortiori)</note>. All of them are "God in Understanding" <note>Elohim b'Binah</note>, for from there the Torah emerges. They belong to the "Right Hand" of the Holy One, blessed be He, which is **Kindness** <note>Chesed</note>, for the Torah is a "Torah of Kindness" for Israel. 

I found in the writings of **Rav Hai Gaon** <note>939–1038 CE, a leading Babylonian scholar</note> that the thirteen attributes are themselves the **Sefirot**—Heaven forbid [that one should think otherwise]! For according to the measure of ten, there would be three extra. Therefore, the **Shekhinah** <note>Divine Presence</note>... this repetition is necessary for this and for what is within. In the days of our holy ancestors, they asked: "Are these ten attributes ten generations born from ten levels?" In our speech, we call them three great levels, which are a tradition of the holy ancients from the mouths of prophets. 

It seems to me that he means there are three more hidden levels above, called: **Primordial Light** <note>Or Kadmon</note>, **Pure Light** <note>Or Tsach</note>, and **Refined Light** <note>Or Ha-Mitzuhtzah</note> (see the book *Pardes* <note>by Rabbi Moshe Cordovero</note>). This follows the opinion of some Kabbalists. The Gaon further stated that when asked if these actions are created attributes and the development of the Name, [he replied] that those **Sefirot** had no number or world-calculation, except by way of the **Ten Worlds** that developed from them. For these have no number and cannot be perceived. He who created them alone, blessed be He, is the Master of all; He is not grasped by any mind or knowledge at all in His hiddenness. 

Solomon, peace be upon him, said regarding the Name and the worlds that "there is no number to His kingdom." These **Sefirot** have no number because their essence is rooted in the Unity of God. But according to the mystery of the Ten Worlds that developed from them, these are perceived matters that testify to all that is hidden. Just as the spirit indicates the soul, and the celestial sphere indicates its Mover. From the number of spheres, we know their Movers, and these are above them. In the **Book of Formation** <note>Sefer Yetzirah</note>, it says: "Ten Sefirot of nothingness <note>Belimah</note>, their measure is ten which have no end." They are straight... they have a measure (3, a number). 

Behold, the Name will also have time and an end to its power. But according to what is grasped from the actions, they are ten, totaling one hundred. These holy created Sefirot have no time or end. The "six worlds" mentioned are the ten actions that were perceived. Thus, we find a basis for clarifying the attributes according to what appears. It is a wonder to the Kabbalists that initially, it seems all thirteen attributes were included within the **Ten Sefirot**, as you will see in the commentary of **Rama"k** <note>Rabbi Moshe Cordovero</note> and **Rasha"l** <note>Rabbi Solomon Luria</note>... (B) And we have already explained in Gate 5 that at the beginning, the All was in the permutation of... (C) or when each one acts on its own.

# Gate 10

At that time, all the worlds above and below are filled with **grace, mercy, and favor**, and there is no judgment or punishment there, neither a little nor a lot. When the Name (blessed be He) was appeased by Moses to atone for the sins of Israel, He entrusted him with a key to open the **World of Mercy** in times of anger, and to transform the entire Attribute of Justice into complete mercy. He gave him the **Thirteen Attributes of Mercy** <note>Exodus 34:6-7, the fundamental verses describing God’s compassion</note>. This is what our Sages of blessed memory meant when they said: "A covenant is made regarding the Thirteen Attributes—that they never return empty-handed." Whenever these are mentioned before Him, the Attribute of Justice returns to mercy and He forgives their sins. As our Sages of blessed memory taught: "This teaches that the Holy One, blessed be He, wrapped Himself like a **prayer leader** <note>original: *Shaliach Tzibur*; the leader of communal prayer</note> and showed Moses at Sinai, saying to him: 'Whenever Israel sins, let them perform this order before Me, and I will forgive their sins.'"

One who understands what we have said (a) will understand the depth of what they revealed in this law. And now that we have placed this great principle in your hand, we must inform you that when the time came which the Holy One, blessed be He, spoke of to Abraham to redeem Israel from Egypt, we were not worthy of redemption. Ezekiel revealed this secret: **"On the day I chose Israel, I lifted my hand to the seed of the house of Israel and made myself known to them in the land of Egypt... and I said to them, 'Cast away every man the detestable things of his eyes'... but they rebelled against Me and would not listen... and I thought to pour out My fury... but I acted for My Name’s sake"** <note>Ezekiel 20:5-9</note>. 

What did the Holy One, blessed be He, do? He saw that the end-time had arrived, and He saw that Israel was not worthy of redemption. At that moment, the **Face of the Crown** <term>Keter; the highest of the ten Sefirot, representing the Divine Will and absolute compassion</term> was revealed—this is the **World of Absolute Mercy**. Then all the **Sefirot** <note>Divine emanations</note> and all the **channels** <note>original: *tzinorot*; the pathways through which divine energy flows</note> were filled with grace and mercy, and the "Face of Anger" passed away. For all the Sefirot stood in joy and gladness, because the **Face of Absolute Mercy** had been revealed. This is why the Holy One, blessed be He, said to Moses: **"Thus shall you say to the children of Israel: 'Ehyeh' <note>original: אהי"ה; 'I Will Be'</note> has sent me to you."** This means: the World of Absolute Mercy was revealed over all the Sefirot, and the Name **Ehyeh** appeared there. The Attribute of Justice was transformed into Mercy, and for this reason you are redeemed—for you were not worthy of being redeemed based on your evil deeds. Rather, the end-time arrived and the **Face of Mercy** was revealed; through the Name of Mercy, which is **Ehyeh**, you are redeemed even though you are not worthy of it. This is because this Name, **Ehyeh**, which is the World of Mercy, performs kindness, does good, shows mercy, and grants grace not based on strict justice, as it is said: **"And I will be gracious to whom I will be gracious"** <note>Exodus 33:19</note>. This is the secret the Holy One, blessed be He, entrusted to Moses regarding the redemption from Egypt.

And one who understands what we have explained in this Gate will increase in trust and joy, and will know how great is the mercy of the Name (blessed be He) upon His creatures—specifically upon Israel—in that He does good for them and is gracious and merciful to them through the revelation of the World of Mercy, even though they are not worthy of that mercy. This is the matter of the **Exodus from Egypt** and the reason it mentions **Ehyeh**. 

After we have explained these principles to you, we must inform you that while the Name **Ehyeh** is hidden in the secret chamber, and the Name **YHVH** <note>The Tetragrammaton, the four-letter Name of God</note> (blessed be He) judges His creatures according to the path we explained in the Sixth Gate, then judgment concludes in either good or bad. If, God forbid, Israel causes it, and judgment is decided in the "House of Judgment" of **YHVH** (blessed be He), and the legal ruling emerges that the Sefirah of **Yesod** <note>Foundation</note> must withdraw from the Sefirah of **Malchut** <note>Kingdom</note>, then that is the time of destruction and exile, and it is called an **"Evil Time."** This is what the verse means: **"The righteous is taken away because of the evil"** <note>Isaiah 57:1</note>. Then the Sefirah of Malchut, which is called **Adonai** <note>original: אדנ"י; 'My Lord'</note>, remains dry <gloss>(because she is for the need of the created beings, and not the flow that comes for her own need to be established forever; see the law in Chapter 9 of...)</gloss> of all upper goodness, and becomes filled with all kinds of judgment, punishment, and destructive forces. Woe to the creatures who encounter them at that time, for there is no one who can escape her hand, and she concludes judgment with wrath, fury, and great anger. 

But when the Name **Ehyeh** (blessed be He) appears, and mercy descends through the channels to the Name **YHVH**, then all the Sefirot are rectified, and all the channels are straightened, and all kinds of flow, mercy, and blessings go through them to the Name **Adonai**. Then it is a **"Time of Favor,"** and then the Sefirah of Malchut receives all kinds of flow and blessing from the Name **Ehyeh** and from the Name **YHVH**. Then all the creatures of the world, upper and lower, are in joy and gladness and every kind of satisfaction, and the entire world is found full of

->**Peace**<-

# Gate 10

**A.H.H.** <note>The letters Aleph-Heh-Heh, a permutation or shorthand for the Divine Name Ehyeh, "I Will Be."</note> This is the operation of absolute mercy. It is the Name that does good and gives a free gift, acting out of mercy rather than according to the strict law. As it is said: *And I will proclaim the name of YHVH before you, and I will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and I will show mercy on whom I will show mercy* <note>Exodus 33:19</note>. "To whom I will be gracious" and "on whom I will show mercy"—all this is according to the Divine Will, which is beyond the comprehension of any created being. It was through the quality of this Name, which is entirely mercy—the Name **A.H.H.**—that they went out of Egypt.

We must open for you gates through which we may enter into several great matters mentioned in the Torah in a hidden manner. People often do not take care to open their eyes and see how many hidden pearls are buried in those places! Had their eyes been opened, they would have increased their strength of trust in the Name (blessed be He), who has informed us of the many paths by which we may enter the many chambers whose gates were once locked. All of them are full of various comforts, an abundance of blessing, good reward, and many kinds of joy.

And behold, I shall explain. Know that the Name (blessed be He) engraved within the **Chariot** <term>Merkavah; the Divine assembly or structure of spiritual realms</term> several established courts of law to judge the creations. All of those judgments are truth and upright justice; there is nothing crooked or perverse in them. (a) We have already explained in the Sixth Gate <note>The gate discussing the Name YHVH</note> that all the inhabitants of the world are judged in the Great Court that stands between the Name **YHVH** and the Name **Elohim**. We explained how a person is judged for all their deeds, the mystery of "the first sin is overlooked," the mystery of "leaning toward kindness," the mystery of "long-suffering" before the judgment, and "abundant kindness" during the judgment, and "truth" after the final verdict. We revealed many high secrets therein.

Ultimately, if a person returns in repentance before the punishment of the judgment reaches them, they are accepted. If not, the judgment strikes them through the Lower Court called **ADNY** <note>The Name associated with the Sefirah of Malchut/Kingship</note>. We must inform you of the greatness of the mercy of the Name (blessed be He) toward His creatures. He has revealed to us supreme secrets: that even though the inhabitants of the world are judged in the Heavenly Court and are deserving of various punishments, those below can transform all that judgment and punishment into good. This is the meaning of: *The righteous one rules through the fear of God* <note>2 Samuel 23:3</note>. Our sages explained this as: "Who rules over Me? The righteous person; for I decree a decree, and he annuls it."

How so? Know that when there is a righteous person in the world who is worthy of concentrating on his prayer and contemplating all the way to the World of Will and Mercy—even though a decree was issued in the Heavenly Court—when that prayer of that righteous person ascends to the **Keter** <term>The Crown; the highest of the ten Sefirot</term>, then the gates of the World of Mercy are opened. Upon its spreading forth, all those judgments that were decreed are annulled because the lights of Mercy have appeared. All the **Sefirot** <term>Divine Emanations</term> are filled with mercy, types of abundant blessing, and spiritual emanation. At that hour, the Sefirot have no power or place to hold judgment, and no attribute can maintain anger or wrath. For God stands in joy and will, and (b) all faces of indignation pass away, and all the masters of judgment are transformed into mercy. 

This entire attribute flows with great mercies through the **Thirteen Supernal Channels** <gloss>These are the Thirteen Rectifications of the Holy Beard (Dikna Kadisha)</gloss> into the Thirteen Attributes found in the World of Judgment. All of this is not from the perspective of the legal sentence, but from the perspective of Will and Mercy. Even if the people of the world are not worthy of it, since that righteous person caused the gates of mercy to be opened, God conducts Himself with the attribute of mercy that is outside the law. This is the meaning of: *I will be gracious to whom I will be gracious*, even if it is not according to the law; *and I will show mercy on whom I will show mercy*, even if it did not emerge from the judgment. For when the face of Mercy appears from the Crown, everything is transformed into mercy. This is the matter (c) of the **Raising of the Hands** <note>The Priestly Blessing</note>, the secret of the **Incense**, and other similar commandments. At the time the gates of the World of Mercy are opened, it is called a "Time of Favor," meaning:

# Gate 10

The wise person will understand what was said in the Rosh Hashanah liturgy regarding the "Decree" <note>original: *Gzar Din*; the final judicial sentence in the heavenly court</note>—that for the community, it can be "torn up" <note>nullified through repentance</note>. This relates to what is written in the Torah: *For what nation is there so great, who hath God so nigh unto them...* <note>Deuteronomy 4:7</note>. Behold, I am hinting at the verse: *Seek the Lord while He is found* <note>Isaiah 55:6</note>. One who wishes to achieve their desire and tear up their decree should seek the Blessed Lord in the mystery of the **Highest Crown** <term>Keter Elyon; the first and highest of the ten Sefirot, representing the infinite Divine Will</term>. This is the essence of the "Ancient Existence," from whose truth the Sefirot were revealed. This is a very deep matter. You will yet understand great principles within it, with the help of the Blessed Name. 

With the word *Kedem* <note>meaning "ancient" or "before"</note>, we shall explain in this gate things that reveal many secrets regarding this matter. Now, open your eyes and see what we have delivered into your hands in this gate, so that you may increase in great trust, yearning, and hope. You shall know and comprehend how beneficial prayer and supplications are, and how great is the power of the **Mitzvot** <term>commandments or sacred deeds</term>, which are able to open the gates of the **World of Mercy** <term>Olam Ha-Rachamim; a high spiritual realm characterized by absolute compassion</term> and tear up a decree to push away many kinds of punishments and damages. When you trust in the Blessed Name with a whole heart, then *you shall call, and the Lord will answer* <note>Isaiah 58:9</note>. This is what is meant by: *He shall call upon Me, and I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble...* <note>Psalm 91:15</note>. 

The explanation of the verse is: "He shall call upon Me" through the quality of Great Mercy, and then "I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble, I will deliver him, and honor him." For at the hour when a person is punished below, it is as if there is a "damage" in the spiritual channels above. <margin>(a)</margin> I am hinting at this: *Of the Rock that begot thee thou wast unmindful* <note>Deuteronomy 32:18</note>; *He hath drawn back His right hand* <note>Lamentations 2:3</note>; *In all their affliction He was afflicted* <note>Isaiah 63:9</note>. This is the secret of "I will be with him in trouble." And the verse concludes: "I will deliver him and honor him." 

What does "I will honor him" mean in this context? It explains a great matter: it is not enough for the righteous one who calls that I should deliver him from his trouble; rather, since the World of Great Mercy will shine forth, all the Sefirot—both the higher and the lower—become filled with every kind of joy, blessing, and emanation <term>Atzilut; the process of divine light flowing into the world</term>. All of this was caused by that righteous person who opened the gates of the World of Mercy. Since he caused all the Sefirot to be blessed because of him, it is fitting to treat him with honor from above and below, in the secret of *...and before His elders shall be G-d's glory* <note>Isaiah 24:23</note> and *The wise shall inherit glory* <note>Proverbs 3:35</note>. Behold, I hint at "And I will honor him" <note>original: *Va-achabdehu*</note>: I will attach him to the light <margin>(b)</margin> called **Glory** <term>Kavod</term>. Understand this.

However, you must contemplate the explanation of what we have clarified in this gate: that the Name **Ehyeh** <note>I Will Be</note> is the secret of the World of Mercy. It is the secret of the **Highest Crown** (Keter), and it is hinted at by the "tip of the Yod" <note>The small decorative stroke on top of the first letter of the Name YHVH, symbolizing the most hidden point of creation</note> of the Blessed Name **YHVH**. From it, all the Sefirot draw their sustenance until they reach the Sefirah of **Malchut** <term>Kingship; the tenth Sefirah, representing the physical world and Divine sovereignty</term>, which is the secret of the Name **Adonai**. With God's help, if you are worthy, you will yet hear deep and hidden traditions regarding the Name Ehyeh, but it is not our intention to expand on this matter more than this measure for now. 

This Sefirah <note>Keter</note> is referred to in the Torah in many places by way of a hint as **He** <note>original: *Hu*</note>. I shall explain: Know that because the Sefirah of Keter is hidden and concealed, <margin>(c)</margin> there is no one who can contemplate it at all, except by "hearing of the ear" <note>tradition/reception</note> and not by direct knowledge. <margin>(d)</margin> This is similar to what is said: *Destruction and Death say: "We have heard a rumor thereof with our ears"* <note>Job 28:22</note>; *God understandeth the way thereof, and He knoweth the place thereof.* Due to its extreme concealment, it is called in the Torah with the language of "He" <note>Third person</note>, as it does not stand "face to face" <note>Second person/Directly accessible</note>.

->How?<-

---

(a) I am hinting: "The Rock that begot you, you forgot," "He drew back His right hand"—all this was explained above in the Sixth Gate regarding the structure of **Gevurah** <term>Strength/Judgment</term>. The matter of "In all their affliction He was afflicted" and "I am with him in trouble" can be understood from what I explained in Gate 100 regarding the "eclipse" of the double Malchut and its tranquility; look there. (b) The light called **Glory** is the remembrance that was received from the "72" <note>The 72-letter Name of God</note> which was included in the 32 Paths of Supreme Wisdom (**Chochmah**), and "Glory" is also received as the Name in every place. (c) No one can contemplate it except through the "hearing of the ear"—meaning by way of **Kabbalah** <term>tradition/reception</term> and hearing person-to-person back to the prophets who heard from the Blessed Name. Even they heard matters from His mouth but did not grasp or know its essence or substance, for even Moses our Teacher only grasped as far as the Gate of Mercy within **Binah** <term>Understanding; the third Sefirah</term>, and this is the meaning of "My back" <note>God telling Moses he can only see His back, not His face</note>. (d) Like the verse "Destruction and Death say: We have heard a rumor..." the intention is that Wisdom <note>Chochmah</note> tells of it, but as for the "Crown" <note>Keter</note>, it is so hidden that no one can grasp knowledge of its place or substance with any understanding at all. Even "Destruction and Death"—referring to the "Ancient Dead"—said to us that they too only "heard a rumor" from others. No living being can understand it, for only "God understands its way and He knows its place," as I wrote above in Gate 9 regarding the title of Wisdom, and there in Wisdom it is so, certainly in the Crown and what is above it.

# Gate 10

Peace and understanding. (ט) Those who knew how to arrange these three systems <term>Ma’arakhot; specific configurations of Divine attributes or Sefirot</term> during the era of the Prophets and the Sages <note>original: *Tannaim* and *Amoraim*; the rabbis of the Mishnaic and Talmudic periods</note> were able to repel all decrees and all types of retribution. They stood as a shield, buckler, and protection for Israel. They would align and repair the "channels" of the Lord—may He be blessed—so that they would be drawn toward the Name **Adonai** <term>The Divine Name associated with the Shekhinah and the physical manifest world</term>. Their prayers would ascend unto the **Source of Will** <note>original: *Mekor ha-Ratzon*; a reference to Keter, the highest Sefirah</note>, opening the gates of the World of Mercy. Then the **Sefirot** <term>the ten creative powers or attributes of God</term> would be filled with abundance, mercy, and an light that has no end or measure. As it is written: *The Lord is God, and He hath given us light* <note>Psalm 118:27</note>.

You must understand that great matters are hinted at in Scripture, yet people are not often awakened to set their hearts upon them. Know that when the light of the World of Mercy appears, as we have written, all types of goodness, mercy, and life appear with it. When does this happen? It occurs at the time when the "Face" of the **Crown** <note>original: *Keter*</note> looks toward the face of the World of Judgment, becoming equal through the light of the face of the King of Life. Wherever you find the phrase "Light of the Face" <note>original: *Or Panim*</note> regarding the realms above, it is the secret of the gates of the great World of Mercy being opened and all the Sefirot being filled with compassion and life. Then all worlds exist in grace and mercy, and no "Master of Judgment" <note>an angelic prosecutor</note> has the power to harm any creature in the world through judgment or punishment at all. 

This is the secret of the verse: *Many there are that say: "Oh that we could see some good!" Lord, lift Thou up the light of Thy countenance upon us* <note>Psalm 4:7</note>. And also: *The Lord is God, and He hath given us light* <note>Psalm 118:27</note>. And: *Make Thy face to shine upon Thy servant* <note>Psalm 31:17</note>. And: *For the Lord is righteous, He loveth righteousness; the upright shall behold His face* <note>Psalm 11:7; the author notes that the Hebrew phrasing "their face" implies a plural "facing"</note>. Rather, when the World of Mercy and the World of Judgment look "face to face," then everything exists in mercy and perfection.

I shall now explain. In the abundance of the Mercy of the Blessed Name toward Israel, He commanded His holy priests to bless them. However, it is possible that Israel might not be worthy to receive that blessing; perhaps they are soiled by various sins and iniquities, and the "Accusers" <note>original: *Mekatregim*; prosecuting spiritual forces</note> of Harsh Judgment might—God forbid—protest against them, saying that Israel does not deserve that blessing because their sins block it. What did the Blessed Name do? He delivered into the hands of His holy priests the **Keys to the World of Mercy**. He said to them: "Whenever you come to bless Israel, open the gates of Will and the Crown, so that the Supernal Mercies are awakened." The gates of Grace, Will, and Great Mercy then open, and all worlds—at the hour you bless Israel—exist in favor, will, grace, and mercy. There will be no obstructor or accuser against the blessing. For when the gates of Mercy are open and the Upper Face shines upon the Lower Face, at that hour the Accuser and the Master of Judgment above have no power to stir up judgment or punishment, because all the worlds are unified in blessing, perfection, and mercy. The "Faces of Wrath" depart, and then all faces shine. 

This is the secret of what He commanded regarding the Priestly Blessing: *Thus* <note>original: *Koh* (כ"ה)</note> *shall you bless the children of Israel* <note>Numbers 6:23</note>. The word "Thus" <note>Hebrew: *Koh*</note> refers to the Ineffable Name that opens the upper gates, causing all faces to shine. And what do you say? *The Lord bless thee, and keep thee... The Lord make His face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee.* What is the meaning of *The Lord make His face shine upon thee and be gracious unto thee*? It means: at the hour when the Great Mercy appears from the Highest Crown—which is the "Face" that illuminates all the Sefirot—at that hour your will shall be completed and your desire filled from every side. And if it is not strictly "legal" <note>according to the attribute of Justice</note> because you are not worthy of mercy, He will give you a **free gift** <note>original: *Matnat Chinam*</note> even though you do not deserve it. For this is the way of the Supernal Mercies and the Shining Face: to give a free gift to created beings, as it is said: *And I will be gracious to whom I will be gracious* <note>Exodus 33:19</note>. (כ) This is the secret of *The Lord make His face shine upon thee and be gracious unto thee.*

Understand this well. This "lamp" is a key with which you shall enter many chambers of the Torah whose gates were previously locked. Happy is he who merits this, and happy is the people to whom the Blessed Lord has given such a great gift.

(ב) <gloss>And this is the secret of "The Lord make His face shine upon thee..." and what follows.</gloss>

# Gate 10 (Page 108)

->**"And now, I pray, let the power of my Lord be great, according as Thou hast spoken, saying..."** <note>Numbers 14:17</note><-
And it continues, "The Lord is longsuffering, and of great mercy..." How deep and great are the matters in these passages! This is the secret behind the verse, "He is thy praise, and He is thy God" <note>Deut. 10:21; original: *Hu tehillatkha ve-Hu Elohekha*</note>. Therefore, it says later in that same verse, "who hath done for thee these great and terrible things, which thine eyes have seen." In this way, a person must contemplate every place in the Torah where the expression **"He"** <note>original: *Hu* (הוא)</note> is used, for it hints at the connection of the **Sefirah of Mercy** <term>Keter; the Crown, representing the highest, most hidden Divine Will</term> with the other **Sefirot** <term>the ten creative attributes of God</term>. This matter is exceedingly deep; a person must receive it through **Kabbalah** <term>traditional oral reception</term> from "mouth to mouth" to know the path he should follow. He must contemplate how the Sefirah of Mercy is revealed through the other Sefirot and how He transforms the **Attribute of Judgment** into the **Attribute of Mercy**. All of this is found in the hints provided by the Torah through the word "He." Likewise, when it says, "See now that I, even I, am He" <note>Deut. 32:39</note>, and many similar instances.

After we have explained some of the hints regarding the Sefirah of the **Crown** <note>Keter</note> which is called "He," we must tell you that the Sefirah of **Beauty** <note>Tiferet</note>, which is called "The Lord" <note>the Tetragrammaton, YHVH</note>—may He be blessed—is also indicated in the Torah by the expression **"Thou"** <note>original: *Attah* (א"תה)</note>. The mnemonic for this is "Thou art awesome" and "Thou [art the Lord]" <note>referencing liturgical and biblical phrases</note>. We have already written about this in the Second Gate and hinted at it in the First Gate. Because the Sefirah of Beauty, called YHVH, has actions that are more revealed than those of the Sefirah of the Crown, the Torah refers to it with the hint of "Thou," as if one is speaking directly to someone present. This is the secret of the beginning of many prayers: "**Thou** grantest man knowledge," "**Thou** hast sanctified the seventh day," "**Thou** hast chosen us from all the nations." Even the fixed formula of the blessings uses the word "Thou," as in "Blessed art **Thou**, O Lord, teach me Thy statutes" (ז). We have already explained this in Gate 5.

Likewise, regarding the final Sefirah, which is called **Adonai** <term>Malkhut; the "Kingdom" or the Shekhinah, the Divine Presence in the physical world</term>, the language that hints at it in the Torah is **"I"** <note>original: *Ani* (אני)</note>. As it says: "See now that I, even I, am He." What is this "I, even I"? It makes known the secret of her "nursing" <note>original: *yenikah*; the way a lower Sefirah draws spiritual sustenance from higher ones</note> by way of **Greatness** <note>Chesed/Kindness</note> and **Might** <note>Gevurah/Severity</note>, and by way of **Victory** <note>Netzach</note> and **Splendor** <note>Hod</note>. Sometimes she draws from the side of Mercy, and the whole world is in goodness and perfection; and sometimes she draws from the side of Judgment, and the whole world experiences various types of pain and punishment. This is why it says, "See now that I, even I, am He," followed by the variations: "I kill, and I make alive; I wound, and I heal" <note>Deut. 32:39</note>. Thus, all is clarified.

And here I am hinting at the Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil: "she hath done him good and not evil" (ח) "all the days of her life," for she hints at eternal life. One who understands this will understand why the language is doubled: "for I, even I, am He." The secret is: "I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God; I am the Lord your God." One who understands the beginning and the end of this verse (ט) will understand the secret of "for I am the Lord," and the secret of "I kill and I make alive." This is the secret hinted at in the Torah in many places regarding both **Positive Commandments** and **Negative Commandments**: "I am the Lord." Regarding the poor and the stranger, "thou shalt leave them; I am the Lord" <note>Lev. 19:10</note>. "Thou shalt not curse the deaf, nor put a stumbling block before the blind... but shalt fear thy God: I am the Lord" (י). Both attributes are as one. "Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself: I am the Lord" <note>Lev. 19:18</note>.

Everything is well-explained. There are endless laws and homilies in the **Talmud** <term>the central text of Rabbinic Judaism</term> that depend on these hints we have written here. Wherever they expounded upon the phrase "I am the Lord," sometimes they interpreted it as a Judge who punishes, and sometimes they interpreted it as one worthy of paying a reward. One who understands what we have explained will understand the reason why the Sages interpreted these things in this manner. In these two concepts we have mentioned, all the homilies the Sages explained regarding every place it says "I am the Lord" are included, even (יא) though the language of their interpretation changes (יב). We have already expanded the explanation of the word...

<meta>This page continues the exposition of Gate 10, specifically focusing on how the pronoun "He" (Hu) acts as a linguistic signifier for the highest and most hidden Divine realm, the Crown (Keter). It links this hidden mercy to the miracles experienced by the Israelites in the desert.</meta>

# Gate 10

<meta>image quality: good; catchword: With the wings (בכנפי)</meta>

As we have already explained, the **Higher Crown** <term>Keter; the first and most hidden of the ten Sefirot, representing Divine Will</term> is associated with the name **I Will Be** <note>original: *EHYEH* (אהי"ה)</note>. The Middle Line is associated with the **Tetragrammaton** <note>the four-letter name YHVH</note>. The secret of the **Kingdom** <term>Malchut; the final Sefirah, through which Divine energy enters the physical world</term> is the name **Lord** <note>original: *Adonai* (אדנ"י)</note>. All of these three **Sefirot** <term>Divine attributes or emanations</term> represent the End, the Beginning, and the Middle. For each of them, the Torah uses specific terms that hint at that particular Sefirah. 

For instance, the name **I Will Be** <note>EHYEH</note> is hinted at in the Torah by the expression **"He"** <note>original: *Hu* (הוא)</note>. This is because "He" refers to someone who does not stand "face to face" <note>the third-person pronoun implies distance or hiddenness</note> due to how deeply concealed this level is. The Torah hints at this in several places because this is the **World of Mercy**, from which all types of forgiveness and atonement emerge, as we have explained in this Gate. This level passes over and nullifies all types of harsh judgments when it is revealed. Therefore, the verse says: **"And He [Hu], being merciful, forgiveth iniquity and destroyeth not; yea, many a time He turneth His anger away, and doth not stir up all His wrath."** <note>Psalm 78:38</note> 

If you contemplate this verse, you will see many things explained in this Gate, all of which are included in this one passage. This is also hinted at in the verse: **"He [Hu] is righteous and upright."** <note>Deut. 32:4</note> Likewise, in every other place where you find the expression "He" speaking of the Blessed Name, you must contemplate the depth of the hint. For example: **"He [Hu] is thy praise and He [Hu] is thy God,"** <note>Deut. 10:21</note> and **"For He [Hu] is our God, and we are the people of His pasture,"** <note>Psalm 95:7</note> and **"The Lord [YHVH], He [Hu] is God."** <note>1 Kings 18:39</note>

One must contemplate the entire Torah in such places to know how the Sefirah of the **Crown** <note>Keter</note> is revealed through the other Sefirot in every verse. Understand the reason why "He" is linked with "praise" and "He" is linked with "God" in the phrase **"He is thy praise and He is thy God."** Happy is the ear that hears and understands these words! It is already known to the **Kabbalists** <term>those who receive the hidden mystical tradition</term> what "thy praise" and "thy God" refer to.

Therefore, it uses the term **"He"** with each of them. This means (c) that the World of Mercy was revealed to Israel when they left Egypt, and through this, God conducted Himself with them in the wilderness. As it says: **"That Thou, O Lord, art seen eye to eye."** <note>Numbers 14:14</note> This is the secret of: **"And My eye spared them from destroying them, neither did I make an end of them in the wilderness."** <note>Ezekiel 20:17</note> This is the reason for the **Manna**, the **Well**, the **Quail**, the **Clouds of Glory**, and the other signs and wonders in the wilderness. 

Therefore, it is said: **"He is thy praise and He is thy God."** (d) For if the Sefirah of Mercy, called "He," had not been constantly revealed in the wilderness over the Sefirah of **Adonai** <note>the Kingdom</note>, and had it not poured its blessings and the "Light of the Face" and Mercy upon it, the Sefirah of Adonai would have made an end of Israel in the wilderness <note>due to the strict justice required for their sins</note>. When the dew fell on the camp, the Manna fell upon it; for in the "Dew" <note>Tal</note>, the attribute of "He" (*Hu*) was present, descending and bringing it down. He also answered them with all other miracles, even though sometimes they were not worthy of it. This is the meaning of "And I will spare and I will have compassion." Regarding the matter in which it becomes unified, except for things that are appropriate for our time. As for why the language sometimes places the *Nun* before the *Lamed* <note>The text likely refers to the orthography of specific Divine names or grammatical permutations</note> and sometimes the *Yod* before the *Nun*, contemplate what I explained previously regarding the "Bent Nun" and the "Straight Nun" <term>The Hebrew letter Nun has two forms: נ (bent) and ן (straight/final), representing different states of Divine energy</term>, and the truth will be revealed to you. There are three ways that the Sefirah of **Anakh** receives from the Sefirah of **Ayin**:

(1) The first is hinted at in the phrase: "And he placed the **Crown** of **Kingdom** upon her head" <note>Esther 2:17; interpreted here as the flow from the highest Sefirah (Keter) to the lowest (Malchut)</note>. (2) The second: "**YHVH Adonai** is my strength" <note>Habakkuk 3:19; a combination of the names associated with the Middle and End of the Sefirotic ladder</note>. (3) And the third: "Blessed be **YHVH from Zion**, who dwells in **Jerusalem**" <note>Psalm 135:21</note>. For one who knows how to direct their heart through these three paths and knows how to align the channels to the Sefirot, it is said of them: "I will set him on high, because he hath known my name" <note>Psalm 91:14</note>.

This Sefirah is also called **Kedem** <term>Ancient / Before / East</term>, and I shall now explain it. Know that before the creation of the world, no creature had the power to search or investigate, because the "Separation" was locked before them (4) and it would be as if they had no regard for the honor of their Creator. As our Sages said in the chapter "One does not interpret" <note>Hagigah 11b, a famous Talmudic passage regarding the limits of mystical inquiry</note>: (5) "Ask now of the days that are past, since the day that God created man upon the earth" <note>Deuteronomy 4:32</note>. One might think a person could ask about what was before the world was created; therefore, the verse says "since the day that God created man"—you are permitted to ask from that point onward, but not before. Because the Sefirah of the **Crown** (Keter), which is called **I Will Be** <note>EHYEH</note>, preceded everything, and in it all the Sefirot were included and hidden before the world was created. When it arose in the Divine Thought to create the world, the Sefirot were revealed from the "Hiddenness of the Crown." Therefore, it is called **Kedem** (Ancient/Before), as it precedes everything, since (6) it is the Sefirah from which the secrets of the Sefirot were revealed.

This means (7) that the "Plantings" are planted in the Garden, and the Garden is planted in Eden—this is the secret of the Perfect and True Unity. From **Kedem**. Everything is thus clarified.

While the Sefirah of **Kedem** shines its face and gladdens all the Sefirot with joy, tranquility, and happiness, all the worlds exist in Divine Will. (8) Know that regarding the **Generation of the Division** <term>The generation of the Tower of Babel</term>, initially they dwelt in a single union, as it is said: "one language and few words." # Gate 10

Regarding the phrase **I am the Lord** <note>Hebrew: *Ani YHVH*</note> in Gate 5, I wrote there things that will enlighten your eyes; contemplate them and what we have written here, and keep them for others. Then you will see how many wonders are hinted at in the Torah, and you will rejoice in your light and see their secrets revealed before your eyes. It is enough for us to hint to you in this gate regarding the word **He** <note>Hebrew: *Hu*</note> <margin>The word **He** is sometimes used for Judgment, and sometimes it turns toward Mercy according to its root; its root is on high.</margin> which is said of His Name, may He be blessed. With the help of Heaven, if you are worthy, you will yet receive hidden and concealed matters in these subjects from mouth to mouth.

This Sefirah <term>Sefirah (plural: Sefirot): One of the ten Divine emanations or attributes through which the Infinite interacts with the world.</term> is called in the language of the Torah **Nothingness** <note>Hebrew: *Ayin*</note>. You must know that due to the great hiddenness of the Sefirah of the **Crown** <note>Hebrew: *Keter*</note> and its being concealed from all created beings, such that none can contemplate it except through "hearing" <note>original: "hearing an ear" (Job 28:22), implying indirect perception</note>, as we have written above, it is therefore called by the term **Nothingness** (*Ayin*). (Wisdom) "Is the Lord among us or **not** (*Ayin*)?" <note>Exodus 17:7; interpreted here as asking if the Divine presence is manifest through the Sefirah of Wisdom or the Sefirah of the Crown/Nothingness</note>, which are the secret of the two upper Sefirot that are unified in the letter *Yod* of the Holy Name.

You must also know the secret of what is hinted at in the verse: "But **Wisdom** shall be found from **Nothingness**" <note>Job 28:12</note>. In truth, through the secret of the *Yod* of the Name <note>(12) We have already elaborated on the explanation for this in Gate 5... and already (1) we wrote above in Gate 9...</note> from the secret of the **Crown** <note>(2) From the secret of the **Upper Tip** of the letter *Yod* it was revealed as a point of "Thought," as it was above in Gate 9.</note>, the "Upper Tip" was revealed, and this is "Wisdom shall be found from **Nothingness**." The sign for this is the letter *Yod* and the point <note>the tip</note> that is upon it.

Know that when the world is judged with several harsh judgments due to the multitude of their transgressions and sins, the people of the world must hurry to unite themselves with this Sefirah so that they may find healing for every plague and every illness. This is what is meant by "A Song of Ascents: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from **whence** <note>The Hebrew word for "from whence" is *Me-Ayin*, which the author reads literally as "From the Sefirah of Nothingness/Crown"</note> shall my help come?" One who understands this verse will contemplate many things we have hinted at in this gate; for when the "World of Mercy" is revealed and a "Shining Countenance" is found, then the Attribute of Judgment is turned into the Attribute of Mercy. This is the meaning of "From **Nothingness** (*Ayin*) shall my help come; my help is **from with the Lord**."

He did not say "from the Lord" <note>Hebrew: *Me-et YHVH*</note> or "from [within] the Lord" <note>Hebrew: *Mi-YHVH*</note>, but rather **from with** <note>Hebrew: *Me-im*</note> **the Lord** <note>(3) This is "From with the Lord" because the word "from with" indicates a thing itself and not merely "in" it; that is, something that is "with" the Lord. Since we "ascend in holiness" and do not descend, one must understand it from that which is most high, above the *Yod*... whereas "from the Lord" (*Me-et*) can speak of something lowered down... The word "And he was there **with** the Lord" [Exodus 34:28] is not similar at all to the word "From with" (*Me-im*), for even if Moses was there with the Lord, he could still be very far below Him... the Holy One does not permit [complete union] as explained in the blessing of Portion Mishpatim... this is why he said "there were boundaries between them."</note>, which is the "Tip of the Yod" of the Unique Name. If you contemplate this, you will be amazed and wonder, and you will understand that no man has the power to understand this matter at its core, for they would become confused in several places where the text is written with this imagery. For example, "And he was there **with the Lord**," and they might think these are equal, yet there are many boundaries between them, but we are not engaged in that explanation now.

Furthermore, I must awaken your thoughts in this place regarding the secret of the word **Nothingness** (*Ayin*), which is the First Sefirah, and the secret of the Sefirah **I** <note>Hebrew: *Ani*</note>, which is the last Sefirah.
**A** [Aleph]: The secret of the "Tip of the Yod," the World of Mercy, the Name **I Will Be** <note>Hebrew: *Ehyeh*</note>.
**Y** [Yod]: The secret of the essence of **Wisdom** and the expansion of **Thought**, the first letter of the Name.
**N** [Straight Nun]: The secret of the extension of the flow of blessing and mercy from Sefirah to Sefirah until they reach the Sefirah of the **Kingdom** <note>Hebrew: *Malchut*</note>.

And here I will explain the **Straight Nun** [ן] and the **Bent Nun** [נ]. The **Straight Nun** is the "World of Mercy" which is extended through the "Line of **Beauty**" <note>Hebrew: *Tiferet*</note>. (4) The **Bent Nun** <note>(4) The **Bent Nun** is the secret of the **Kingdom** which receives the flow of blessings, and therefore it is written as a "Bent Nun" to represent its capacity to contain the reception.</note> is the secret of the **Kingdom** which receives the abundance of blessings and types of emanations that are poured out from the Sefirah of **Nothingness** through the channels by way of the Sefirot until they reach the Sefirah of **I** (*Ani*). (5) This is the secret of the **Bestowing World** <note>(5) This is the secret of the "World that Bestows and does not Receive," meaning it does not receive from any other thing above it, only from God Himself; but it is bound to Him like a flame is bound to a coal.</note> which does not receive, and the secret of the **Receiving World** which does not bestow, and so forth.

And he placed in its mouth a vessel from the vessels of the Holy Temple that had the [Holy Name] engraved upon it, in order to complete the thought of the Generation of the Dispersion. But the herald cried out above: "And I will punish Bel in Babylon, and I will bring out of his mouth what he has swallowed, and the nations shall not flow unto him anymore" <note>Jeremiah 51:44</note>. And Daniel came (f) and decreed that the "swallowed" item be removed from the mouth of the image.

<column-break/>

->[Lower Column/Commentary]<-

For punishment, for the power of the recipients and the multitude of recipients is the strength of their quantity in the world. And to say that it was fitting (a) for it to be thus: to rebel against the Unique One of the world, because the power of the "Chief Cornerstone" <note>Referring to the Sefirah of *Malkhut* or *Atarah*</note>, through which the guidance of the world is conducted alone, was the point where most of those who err went astray. For they thought that "Yah" <note>A Name of God</note> alone held the dominion and the kingdom over the lower realms, and that she was the cause for all deeds done upon the earth. They thought they could draw influence from the higher realms to the lower realms while separating the lower from the upper, believing the upper realms had no providence over the lower ones—as was explained above regarding the "Value of Man" in the chapter explaining the concept of Knowledge (*Da'at*). Such was also the thought of the Generation of the Dispersion; they built "a city and a tower within it." The "city" is a hint to the "Small City" <note>Ecclesiastes 9:14, often a metaphor for the human body or the lower world</note>, and also the "Height of Breadth." The "tower" is the "Tower of Strength," where the Name of the Lord is within it. And "as if in the heavens" is a hint to the "Upper Waters." Their intention was to make a construction modeled after the Upper Construction, to awaken and bring their thought into a powerful action, so that they might draw down influence. As we have explained several times in Gate 8, all things are affected and awakened by the action of the deed below. Because they were capable of this, they thought that afterward, the Divine influence would belong to them alone in their thought, according to another matter and the counsel he placed there. For this reason, they hinted at the **Crown** <note>Hebrew: *Atarah*</note> which they called "Name" <note>Hebrew: *Shem*</note>, because the word "Name" (*Shem*) with the [Holy Name] equals the same numerical value <note>Gematria</note>, to say that it would be left to them alone, and they would be separated from the living [Source]. And when they separated, this was "measure for measure": (b) Had they not been divided and separated, they would have been able through this awakening to "cut the plantings of the Garden"—from the place where the Name is balanced—and to draw down the forces of Judgment there and destroy it. For they were all as one in their generation, and there was not even one "good giant" among them, so the world would have returned to "tohu and bohu" <note>Chaos and void</note>. (c) And even though the thought of the Generation of the Dispersion was not completed in that valley, after some time, one like Nebuchadnezzar came as the revelation of their punishment. This is to say that their stumbling—which he wanted to cause—was all because they rebelled by saying "let us make for ourselves a name," desiring that they all as one should draw power over the whole world, like the power of the **Crown** ruling alone, rather than being scattered under the rule of various ministers <note>Angelic princes</note> and stars. (d) And Nebuchadnezzar came after he destroyed the kingdom and conquered nations and stretched his hand into the Holy Temple. Seeing that he was able, he returned to add the thought of the Generation of the Dispersion into action, to draw the **Crown** alone to himself according to his power, and to "make a name" for himself so that he might arrange this government in his own hand, so that Israel would not leave their exile... as the prophet Jeremiah said. And he said, "I will ascend above the heights of the clouds; I will be like the Most High" <note>Isaiah 14:14</note> in drawing down the influence according to his will. He made a tall image, patterned after the tower built by the Generation of the Dispersion. It was entirely of gold, "sixty cubits" high, and his intention was that "sixty" should correspond to the **Crown** through the powers upon it, which are the names of sorcery. This was like the construction they made, which was modeled after the Upper Construction. He also stood it in the Plain of Dura in the province of Babylon, which is the very place where the Generation of the Dispersion corrupted their way, as it is said of them: (e) "And they found a plain in the land of Shinar." The land of Shinar was the province of Babylon mentioned here; it was called *Shinar* for the wickedness [of those who] were "shaken out" (*nina'aru*) there from the waters of the Flood. Afterward, it was called *Babel* because of the confusion (*balal*) of their languages, as it says: "Therefore its name was called Babel, because there the Lord confounded the language of all the earth." The same happened with that [image of] Bel, from which Daniel (f) brought out the "swallowed" item from its mouth, causing it to be hated until all the nations who had come there were divided, just as with the Generation of the Dispersion, of whom it is said: "Therefore its name was called Babel... and from there the Lord dispersed them."

# Gate 10

With praise, laud, song, and melody, they [the prayers] are sent (3) via the Great and Holy Name, and of their own accord, they rise and cleave to the **Crown** <note>Hebrew: *Keter*; the highest of the ten Sefirot, representing the Divine Will that transcends human understanding</note>. Know that the days which involve prayer and counting <note>likely referring to the "Counting of the Omer" or the systematic arrangement of the Sefirot</note> require one to mention the holiness of the Crown. This is what is meant by the liturgy: "A crown they shall give to You, O Lord our God," spoken by the hosts above along with the masses below. This Crown gathers all the prayers and praises performed during the Morning Service. (2) All the hosts of above and below unite as one in the mission of the Crown to the depth of the primordial existences, waiting for one another so that they may all be unified. Thus, the prayers rise as one into the "World of Will" <note>Hebrew: *Olam Ha-Ratzon*</note> so that the sustenance of all worlds may be drawn from the depth of existence. For all the heavenly hosts look and wait for when their portion from the Crown will reach them, by which they are sustained. The sign for this is: "The eyes of all look hopefully to You" <note>Psalm 145:15</note>, and I am hinting at (4) "You open Your hand and satisfy the desire <note>original: *Ratzon*, also meaning "Will"</note> of every living thing." Know that through this Will, every living being draws its needs from the Crown. If it be the Will of God, we shall yet compose and arrange a work concerning the matters of the World of the Crown, its exits and its entrances, according to what we have grasped, for these are ancient matters.

This Sefirah is called the **Head of the Heart**, and the reason is that this Sefirah is the secret of the World of Great Mercies, Will, and Desire; it pardons the sins of Israel when the "Face of Will and Mercy" is revealed. I shall hint: the beginning (5) of all colors is whiteness; the end of all colors is blackness. This Sefirah, in its perfection, is Whiteness. But there is a place "outside the camp" that is total blackness, the sign of which is (6) "the one who distinguishes between the holy and the profane, and between light and darkness." All of this is hinted at in the verses: "Even to your old age, I am He; and even to gray hairs will I carry you" <note>Isaiah 46:4</note>, and (7) "Before the gray-headed you shall rise, and you shall honor the face of the old man" <note>Leviticus 19:32</note>. 

Know also that there is **Laban the Aramean** <note>original: *Lavan Ha-Arami*; "Lavan" also means "White." In Jewish mysticism, he represents a deceptive, "extrinsic" whiteness that masks impurity</note> (9) who deceives (10) people and traps them in the dwellings of darkness. "There is a way that seems right before a man, but its end is the way of death" <note>Proverbs 14:12</note>, for "the lips of a strange woman drop honey... but her end is bitter as wormwood." Just as Laban the Aramean sought to join with Jacob and uproot everything, root and branch—for such is his way with anyone he encounters—were it not for 

->God<-

the Mercies that surround and encompass all. Because of this, the "Ness" <note>unclear: possibly "miracle" or "banner"</note> was performed, and the "Dread" <note>Hebrew: *Pachad*, a name for the Sefirah of Gevurah/Judgment</note> gathered the Crowns to be at the head of the structure...

---

(1) Know that this Crown is surrounded by 37 types of "merits of worlds" and 620 types of kingdoms mentioned by the Kabbalists, which they called the "Pillars of Light" that spread from the light of the Crown like threads. The word "Crown" <note>Keter</note> has the numerical value of 620, corresponding to the 620 letters in the Ten Commandments. Likewise, the verse "The Lord shall reign, the Lord reigns, the Lord shall reign forever and ever" serves as a sign for the Crown. (2) They send it via the Great and Holy Name, which is the name *Havayah* <note>the four-letter name of God, Y-H-W-H</note>, for it is God who provides through the Crown. To this they hinted in the liturgy: "They shall crown You with a triple sanctification," meaning the Crown comes from the prayer of Israel. (3) All the hosts above and below unite as one in the mission of the Crown; this means the preparation of the prayers that were accepted along with the prayer "A crown they shall give to You," filling them to cleave to the Supernal Crown... (4) "You open Your hand and satisfy the desire of every living thing": Do not read it as "Your hand" <note>Yadecha</note> but rather "Your Yod" <note>Yodecha</note>, referring to the Crown. The things included in the *Yod* of the Name are what provide every living thing with its needs. (5) Whiteness is the beginning of all colors, for it is what gives the power to receive all shades. (Explanation: To understand "white," you must imagine it as a canvas upon which you can paint any color you wish). Blackness, however, does not give power to receive any other color. (6) "The one who distinguishes between the holy and the profane and between light and darkness" is explained in Gate 5, regarding the secret of "God has made one thing opposite the other" <note>Ecclesiastes 7:14</note>... (10) "Who deceives people": This means that while he appears white and pure, he is actually black and impure... he appears to a person as the "straight path" and his lips drop honey, but his end is the way of death. This is Laban the Aramean... (12) From the "peeled white" which was on the rods, hinting that he [Jacob] rose through the line of mercy to the place of the True Whiteness, which is pure. (13) Understand the secret of "the cedars of Lebanon," for the whiteness of the Sefirot is called Lebanon.

# Gate 10
### Page 112

Rather, (a) the **tip of the letter Yod** <note>original: "קוצו של יו"ד" (Kotzo shel Yod). In Hebrew calligraphy, this is the tiny upward stroke at the start of the letter Yod, representing the most infinitesimal, primal point of divine emanation</note> alone serves as a conceptual hint to something we lack the power to grasp. Know that the **three upper Sefirot** <term>Sefirot: the ten creative powers or attributes through which God interacts with the universe</term> included in the Name of the Lord (YH), may He be blessed, are all three hidden. Even though a small portion of the second, **Understanding** <note>Hebrew: *Binah*</note>, was revealed to Moses our teacher (peace be upon him), he only achieved forty-nine of the **fifty gates of Understanding**; (b) that final gate outweighs them all. 

All these levels of perception that we speak of regarding the Holy One, blessed be He, pertain to this world. However, when we merit the life of the **World to Come**, we shall then achieve a great perception of the three upper Sefirot. (c) I am hereby hinting to you that "the place causes" <note>a talmudic idiom meaning the context or specific spiritual level dictates the result</note>; the keyholes are now placed in your hand. 

Now, my son, listen to my voice: I have placed in your hand **ten keys** <note>referring to the ten chapters or "Gates" of this book, each corresponding to a Sefirah</note> in this composition. Through them, you may enter several locked gates that not everyone merits to enter. You must contemplate every single gate and establish these matters clearly. Know how the **Torah** is woven upon the **Epithets** <term>Epithets: descriptive names of God like "Merciful" or "Great"</term>, and how the Epithets are woven upon the **three Holy Names**, and how all the Holy Names are woven upon the Name **YHVH**, may He be blessed, which unifies them all above and below, into the innermost chambers. 

What you must guard regarding the Epithets is to know from which Holy Name each epithet stems, and to which Sefirah that Name hints, and to know (d) how the Sefirot unite with the Holy Names through the letters of the Name **YHVH**, blessed be He. When you merit to unify the Name in this way, you will enter many hidden chambers. Then, when you call out, the Lord will answer. You will be among those of whom it is said: "I will set him on high, because he has known My name. He shall call upon Me, and I will answer him" <note>Psalm 91:14-15</note>. 

When you enter these chambers in this world, you will merit to know their mysteries in the life of the World to Come; for there are chambers within chambers and mysteries within mysteries in every single letter of the Torah. Our Sages of blessed memory said: "In the future, the Holy One, blessed be He, will reveal the secrets of the Torah to Israel." Even though Solomon was wiser than all men, he (e) could not reach even one of these mysteries; he said: "All this I have tested with wisdom; I said, 'I will be wise,' but it was far from me" <note>Ecclesiastes 7:23</note>. 

If the Sages said this refers to the secret of the **Red Heifer** <note>Hebrew: *Parah Adumah*; a biblical ritual whose logic was considered the ultimate unsolvable mystery</note>, (f) know that the Red Heifer is the "gate-house" through which one enters the gates of mysteries. This is why Solomon said he could not even enter the gate-house, let alone the inner chambers of mysteries. All of this is hinted at in the verse: "This is the statute of the Torah" <note>Numbers 19:2</note>; it is all explained. 

Now, my son, contemplate this composition. If the Name grants us merit and you are blessed, it will be like a gate-house to enter as many chambers as you desire. May He, in His mercy, grant me the merit to be among the disciples who hear the law from His mouth, fulfilling the scripture: "And all your children shall be taught of the Lord; and great shall be the peace of your children" <note>Isaiah 54:13</note>.

(a) The **tip of the Yod** is a conceptual hint to the primal "Thought" which has no measure or limit, as explained earlier in Gate 9. 
(b) That **final gate** outweighs them all because it is the knowledge of the Creator Himself. 
(c) I am hinting that "the place" refers to **Understanding** (*Binah*), which is inherited in the World to Come. Through it, the world will be filled with the knowledge of God at the time of the Great Jubilee, as explained regarding the "Great Shofar."
(d) To know how the Sefirot unite with the Holy Names: all of them are "branches" of the Holy Names that are never erased, and all of them are learned from the Name of the Lord (YHVH). 
(e) Solomon could not reach the mysteries because his wisdom was of the level of **Kingship** (*Malchut*), also known as "Lower Wisdom."
(f) Know that the **Red Heifer** hints at the "Crown of the Kingdom" <note>the Sefirah of Malchut</note> which receives from the side of Judgment, and it serves as the gate-house to the inner mysteries. This is hinted at in the phrase "This is the statute of the Torah." May the Lord open our eyes to His Torah. Amen.

# Gate 10

For a **confirmed leper** <note>Hebrew: *Mitzora Muchlat*. In biblical law, this is a person whose skin disease has been definitively diagnosed as spiritually impure</note> it is possible to become pure, and this is the great secret. **Leprosy** (b) comes as a result of **evil speech** <term>Lashon Hara: the sin of gossip or defamation, which the Sages teach manifests physically as leprosy</term>; all of this is explained. For everything is drawn from the source of the **Ancient Serpent**, and he causes the **Gates of Mercy** to be closed. But if there is even one **interceding angel** out of a thousand, he causes the "World of Mercy" that was closed to open. Then, a "quarantined leper" might avoid becoming a "confirmed leper." But if he has no intercessor, he becomes a **confirmed leper**.

He who understands the great hints we have alluded to regarding **Adam’s** eating from the **Tree of Knowledge** during the years of **Arlah** <term>Arlah: literally "uncircumcised," referring to the biblical law (Leviticus 19:23) forbidding the fruit of a tree for its first three years</term> will know why it is called the "Tree of Knowledge" and why it is called "Good and Evil." It is possible for it to be called "Good" and not "Evil"—this occurs when the **Tree of Life** is attached to it, rather than the thing called *Arlah*. This is the meaning of "She does him good and not evil all the days of her life."

Now see how great the power of **Israel** is through the commandments of the Blessed Name. He commanded **Adam** to wait just one hour before eating from the *Arlah* <note>The Kabbalistic tradition suggests the fruit of the Tree of Knowledge was initially forbidden as "Arlah" but would have become permitted had Adam waited until the Sabbath</note>, but he could not. Yet He commanded **Israel** to wait three years, and they wait! As it is written: *“Three years it shall be as forbidden (uncircumcised) to you; it shall not be eaten.”*

I am hereby hinting that "the tree was good for food," and the inner meaning of "every tree for food" and "you shall count their fruit as forbidden." "And she took from its fruit." *“Three years it shall be forbidden to you”* refers to the **three partitions of Arlah**. *“And in the fourth year, all its fruit shall be holy for giving praise”* (e)—this is the **fourth thin partition**. *“And in the fifth year, you may eat its fruit.”* If Adam had eaten the fruit while standing (g) within the secret of the thing called **“the Fifth,”** he would not have brought destruction upon the world. All of this is explained.

Know that the secret of the **fourth year** and the **fifth year** mentioned in the section on *Arlah* supports the secret of how the *Arlah* (impurity) clings to the **Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil**, and the secret of how it is separated from it in the "Fifth." (f) *“And it was in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, on the fifth day of the month... and I saw, and behold, a stormy wind came from the north... and a brightness was around it, like the color of Chashmal”* <term>Chashmal: a mysterious celestial glow or "electrum" seen in Ezekiel's vision</term>. All this is explained to those with eyes to see.

He who understands this will understand what the Sages (may their memory be a blessing) said: **“Adam was one who pulled at his foreskin”** <note>A Talmudic metaphor suggesting Adam tried to undo his covenant with God or hide his sins</note> and what they said: **“Adam was a sectarian”** <note>Hebrew: *Min*. Implying he strayed into heretical beliefs</note> and the rest of what they said in Tractate **Sanhedrin**. All those laws are explained through these keys. 

Afterward, contemplate the great principles we have handed to you in hints regarding the secret of the **White Head** <note>Hebrew: *Reish HaLavan*. A reference to the highest, purest level of the Divine</note>. Everywhere you find the term "White" in the Torah, contemplate whether it refers to the "whiteness" that comes from **Laban the Aramean** <note>Laban's name means "white," but in the Bible, he is a deceiver. Here, it represents a false or external purity</note> or if it is from the **pure, clean White**, which is the **World of Mercy**. For everything is explained before you.

Now that we have handed these principles to you, we must inform you of the matter that is the **seal of this book**. We have already informed you in several places that the **Highest Crown** <note>Keter: the first and highest of the Sefirot</note> is something no creature can contemplate except through the **hearing of the ear**. And not only the Highest Crown, but even the Sefirah of **Wisdom** <note>Chokhmah</note> which emanates from it first—there is no one who can contemplate it. As it says: *“But where can Wisdom be found?... We have heard a report of it with our ears. God understands its way, and He knows its place.”* This is as we explained in the **Ninth Gate**. Therefore, realize that the Crown has no specific letter in the **Unique Name** <note>The Tetragrammaton (YHVH). The "Crown" is often associated with the infinitesimal tip of the letter Yod, rather than a full letter</note>, but rather—

<gloss>
(b) The "Evil" is like the **Ancient Serpent**, and thus there was a state of impurity here—measure for measure—for the blood that was defiled by "Evil Speech." 
(g) The secret of the thing called **"the Fifth"** is the **Atarah** <note>the "Diadem" or "Crown" of the final Sefirah, Malchut</note>, which is the final holiness of the Name that was inside the shell of the *Arlah*, similar to the *Chashmal*. 
(e) And in the **fourth year** was the thin shell adjacent to it called **Nogah** <note>Glow/Brightness</note>, and therefore all its fruit is holy and requires redemption. These "shells" are hinted at in the verse: *“And it was in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, on the fifth day of the month...”* as the Master [the author] wrote in the Eighth Gate regarding the substituted names. These verses prepare the matter of the *Arlah* and the sin of Adam. These verses mention these matters because the power of Israel appears great compared to Adam; it shows that these verses are built upon a single intention. 
(f) *“And it was in the thirtieth year, in the fourth... on the fifth”* hints at the prepared **Atarah** and the clinging of these *Arlah* shells, and there exists within them a power like **five**: like the color of *Chashmal*. They also called this by the hint of the number **fifty**. This is hinted at by "in the fourth [month] on the fifth [day]," which are the fourth portions of the Name, and it is sanctified twice in the law of the New Moon, as I wrote above at the end of Gate 9 and in Gate 5 regarding the nickname "Mid-Heaven." 
(i) Understand what the Sages said, "Adam was one who pulled at his foreskin," etc. This means that from what we have written, he remembered the connection upon him and the second one in the world, as we explained, for this is the essence of "sucking" [spiritual nourishment] and idolatry. As we explained in Gate 9, this refers to the nickname "Stature," and so it is above.

<meta>This page serves as the colophon (the printer's concluding note) for the Krakow edition of the Kabbalistic work Sha'arei Orah (Gates of Light). # Gate 10

**Hitherto** the Lord has helped us in His mercy and abundant kindness to begin and complete this honored and awesome book called **Gates of Light** <note>Hebrew: *Sha'arei Orah*, a fundamental 13th-century Kabbalistic text by Joseph Gikatilla that explains the ten Divine attributes or *Sefirot*</note>; as is its name, so is its praise. It enlightens the eyes of the wise in the hidden depths of the wisdom of Kabbalah. Without this book, one who approaches this wisdom would be like a blind man groping in the dark. Anyone who draws near shall merit to behold the sweetness of this praised wisdom and to visit the halls of its secrets upon a paved path. So may the Lord allow us to print many books without end through His strength, beauty, and greatness. May He establish and set Jerusalem as a praise in the earth. May the fast of the fourth month <note>The 17th of Tammuz, a day of mourning for the breach of Jerusalem's walls</note> become for the House of Judah a day of joy and gladness. For a specific year, "Light and Salvation" <note>A chronogram referencing Esther 8:16 used to denote the date</note> shall arise for the Jews. This work was completed in its proper form and stature here in the glorious and praised holy community of Krakow.

---
<image-desc>A horizontal decorative band consisting of repeated floral and circular motifs.</image-desc>
---

**Seeing** the excellence of this commentary and the precious beauty of its greatness—a structure built for heights—which is the composition of the Genius <note>A title of high honor for a Torah scholar</note>, our Teacher and Rabbi Mattithiah, son of our Teacher and Rabbi Solomon Delacrut <note>A 16th-century Italian Kabbalist who settled in Poland and became a key figure in spreading Kabbalah in Eastern Europe</note>. It illuminates and brightens the eyes of the wise in the wisdom of Kabbalah. It was kept hidden and sealed in the storehouses of his son, our Teacher and Rabbi Joseph, son of Mattithiah, who gave it to me to print in order to bring merit to the many and for the honor of his father. Therefore, I hastened to print it. This time, I thank the Lord who, after much labor and toil, allowed me to reach the completion of this work, which is the work of the Lord. 

If I were to record in this book all the hardships that befell me during its printing, the parchment would be too short to contain it. For all the "bones" <note>The core text or structure</note> of the *Gates of Light* that were before me were covered in the filth of errors. In my poverty, I corrected the distortions according to what I found in the manuscript of the aforementioned Genius and according to my own limited intellect. If I have erred, let the fault remain with me, and may the good Lord forgive. 

Before I finish speaking—and my prayer is to You, O Lord—just as You gave me strength and courage to complete this lovely vessel, so may You continue to give me the power to bring merit to the many by bringing to the press the book of *Recanati* <note>A classic Kabbalistic commentary on the Torah by Menahem Recanati</note> and the *System of Divinity* <note>Hebrew: *Ma'arekhet Elokut*, an anonymous 14th-century work</note> with the commentaries of the aforementioned Genius, which are still hidden in the storehouses of his son, as well as other books without end.

->These are the words of the humble Abraham, son of Eliezer (may he live for many good years), of Dietelsheim, from the holy community of<-
->Posen <note>Modern-day Poznań, Poland</note>, a mother city in Israel.<-

->The year **1580** <note>The Hebrew letters spell *Shem* (Name), which equals 340, referring to the year 5340 in the Jewish calendar</note> according to the abbreviated count.<-

**Joseph ben Abraham Gikatilla — Matthatias ben Solomon**
**Delacrut. [Commentary on] *Sha'arei Orah* <note>The "Gates of Light," a foundational text of Jewish mysticism.</note>. Offenbach, [no publisher named],**
**1715**
Rabbi Delacrut's commentary is printed in <term>Rashi script<note>A semi-cursive typeface traditionally used for rabbinic commentaries to visually distinguish them from the primary text.</note></term> to distinguish it from Gikatilla's work. First published after the author's death in Kraków in 1600 by Delacrut's son Joseph, this early 18th-century edition claims that until the addition of Delacrut's commentary, Gikatilla's *Gates of Light*, like a "hidden revelation," could not be understood. The usefulness of Delacrut's translation <note>Though called a translation, it functions as an explanatory commentary that "decodes" the mystical Hebrew for the reader.</note>, it is stated, is obvious for anyone who has eyes to see.
</insert>
